Abstract: When researchers compare multilingual models for probing, interpretability, or cross-lingual transfer, they often align embedding spaces and assume that shared-language representations are comparable. We show that this assumption can be premature for decoder-only models. We pretrain paired 310M-parameter models (one English-only, one bilingual) across eight typologically diverse languages, separately controlling for English exposure, total compute, and document overlap. After aligning on shared English vocabulary, we test held-out words and find that token embeddings look similar after alignment, but the deeper hidden states that the model uses for prediction do not. This gap holds for all eight languages and survives controls for document overlap and alternative alignment methods. This hidden-state mismatch grows through middle transformer layers, suggesting that it arises from contextual processing rather than the input representations where alignment is performed. Embedding alignment can mask real differences in how models internally represent a shared language, which matters for any downstream study that treats aligned models as interchangeable.

</details>

*Saksham Khatwani,He Cheng,Majid Afshar,Dmitriy Dligach,Yanjun Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了生物医学知识图谱(KG)与大型语言模型(LLM)在临床诊断中的整合策略,提出"外科手术式对齐"(surgical alignment)概念,主张KG训练应以稀疏、局部的参数更新为主,并提出GID和GD两个优化几何诊断指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KG-LLM整合方法在不同任务和训练范式下的效果差异不清晰,且仅以任务准确率作为评估标准,无法揭示训练对预训练模型的深层影响。本文旨在系统性研究KG任务形式、训练范式与预训练模型被改变程度之间的关系。

Method: 1. 五种KG任务形式(三条路径判断P@10/P@2/PN@10、下一跳预测NHP、路径补全PC);2. 三种训练范式(KG-SFT+KL正则、GRPO/Comp-GRPO、RM-R1);3. 两个知识图谱(UMLS、PrimeKG);4. 三个基座LLM(Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma-7B);5. 引入Gradient Intervention Density(GID)和Gradient Distortion(GD)两个优化几何诊断指标;6. 2×2消融实验区分目标函数与KL正则对稀疏度的独立贡献;7. 使用ROUGE-L、CUI-F、PDSQI-9等指标评估。

Conclusion: 评估KG-LLM整合效果应将优化几何(参数更新的稀疏度与偏差)与任务准确率并列为第一类评估维度。"外科手术式对齐"是基于判断的KG训练范式的固有特性,有助于保留预训练模型的广泛临床推理能力;目标函数的选择是实现稀疏更新的主要杠杆。本研究为KG-LLM整合提供了新的分析框架。

Abstract: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) offer structured medical knowledge that can ground large language model (LLM) reasoning in clinical diagnosis application, yet how KG signal should be integrated into LLMs remains an open question. We present a systematic study spanning five KG task formulations, three training paradigms, two KGs, and three base LLMs. At the task level, all paradigms improve over the non-finetuned baseline, but methods with comparable in-domain accuracy show substantially different knowledge transfer behavior. We introduce Gradient Intervention Density (GID) and Gradient Distortion (GD) to measure how broadly an optimizer modifies the pretrained model. GID and GD together reveal a clear divide: KG-judgment training under KL regularization produces sparse, localized updates (a regime we term as surgical alignment), while task-specific SFT produces dense ones. A controlled ablation shows that the objective and KL contribute to sparsity independently, and the paradigms that produce sparse updates also improve reasoning quality, even when their in-domain accuracy is lower than task-specific SFT. Assessing KG-LLM integration thus requires complementing accuracy with optimization-geometry diagnostics. Our implementation can be found at this https URL .

</details>

TL;DR: 本文提出MEGA-CDP，一个基于2,274份中英文临床指南构建的大规模基准，包含42,353个带参考临床决策路径（CDP）的临床病例，用于评估医疗大语言模型在单轮和交互式多轮场景下生成符合指南的决策路径的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗LLM基准主要评估最终答案准确性，缺乏对模型是否遵循临床实践指南所定义的多步骤决策路径（CDP）的评估。临床决策需要严格的流程遵循，步骤遗漏或顺序错误可能导致临床上不安全的结果。

Method: （1）自动化的指南到病例构建流水线：将PDF指南转为Markdown，用LLM提取决策树并生成CDP，再合成对应的临床病例摘要；（2）两种下游任务设置：单轮病例摘要设置（直接生成完整CDP）和多轮交互设置（通过问询逐步获取信息）；（3）CDP导向的两阶段评估框架：先用LLM-as-a-judge在5分Likert量表上对每个步骤进行一致性打分，最后用动态时间规整（DTW）将步骤级分数聚合为路径一致性代价（PCC），另备选最优传输（OT）和最长非递减子序列（LNDS）指标。

Result: 在16个代表性LLM上的实验表明：（1）当前模型在可靠临床决策支持方面仍然困难，单轮PCC最低28.41%（GPT-5.4），多轮PCC普遍更高（最低55.92%）；（2）结局准确性与路径一致性衡量决策的不同方面，模型可以结局正确但路径不一致；（3）专业医疗模型（如HuatuoGPT-o1-7B在多轮设置PCC高达91.73%）并不一致地优于通用模型；（4）多轮交互设置比单轮设置更具挑战性；（5）不同评判模型（GPT-5.4 Mini、Qwen3-8B、BERTScore）和不同路径级指标（DTW、OT、LNDS）给出的模型排名趋势一致。

Conclusion: MEGA-CDP揭示了当前LLM在遵循临床指南定义的决策路径方面存在显著不足，强调了CDP导向评估的重要性。结果显示结局准确性不能替代过程一致性评估，且专用医疗模型未必优于通用模型，凸显了开发更可靠、更具指南依从性的医疗LLM的必要性。

Abstract: Following clinical decision pathways (CDPs) defined by clinical practice guidelines is essential for safe and reliable medical decision-making. However, existing medical large language model (LLM) benchmarks mainly evaluate final-answer accuracy, providing limited evaluation of models' ability to adhere to guidelines. To address this gap, we introduce MEGA-CDP, a benchmark for evaluating whether medical LLMs can generate guideline-adherent CDPs using provided guidelines as references. MEGA-CDP is constructed from 2,274 English and Chinese clinical practice guidelines through a guideline-to-case pipeline, yielding 42,353 clinical cases with explicit reference CDPs. It supports both single-turn vignette and multi-turn interactive settings, and introduces a CDP-oriented evaluation framework for measuring pathway consistency. Experiments on 16 representative LLMs show that reliable clinical decision support remains challenging for current models, demonstrating the need for CDP-oriented evaluation and the value of MEGA-CDP for advancing guideline adherence in medical LLMs.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM在自主科研中仍依赖预设问题和证据，缺乏"无问题无证据"条件下的全局审查能力。本文针对科学错误检测场景，探索如何系统性地训练Scan能力。

Method: 1）三阶段任务范式Reason（指定错误和证据）→Verify（指定候选证据）→Scan（无问题无证据）；2）构建VERA-13K数据集（12,900样本，6类错误）；3）使用DAPO强化学习算法，设计三类细粒度奖励：推理完整性、证据对齐、错误精度。

Conclusion: Scan式验证是可训练的能力；通过任务分解、链式数据构造和细粒度奖励建模，可实现从证据指定推理到问题与证据皆缺失验证的原则性训练路径。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly capable scientific assistants, yet they remain far from fully autonomous research. This transition requires models to actively inspect academic papers, build global evidence views, and make traceable judgments without prespecified issues or evidence. However, existing work provides limited task paradigms or training studies for such issue- and evidence-absent verification. We study this challenge through scientific error detection, where models must determine whether errors exist and justify them with evidence-based reasoning. To fill this gap, we present VERA-RL, a reinforcement-learning formulation for scientific error detection over academic papers. Following a Reason--Verify--Scan progression, we construct VERA-13K, a 12,900-sample dataset organized into 4,300 matched chains, covering 6 scientific-error categories across the research workflow and broad natural-science domains. We further introduce fine-grained rewards for reasoning completeness, evidence alignment, and error precision. Training Qwen3-VL-8B with VERA-RL substantially improves verifiable reasoning, approaching flagship MLLMs such as Gemini 3 Pro and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B on Scan.

### [80] [Which Metrics Save the Most Human Annotation? Prediction-Powered Evaluation and Meta-Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26638)
*Mingqi Gao,Anthony Sicilia,Weiyan Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"预测驱动评估"（PPE）框架，将预测驱动推断（PPI）应用于机器翻译系统比较，以少量人工标注与大量自动指标分数结合，获得数据高效且无偏的系统对比。并提出元指标PPSR，衡量自动指标在PPE中可节省的人工标注比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在非可验证任务中，人工评估虽可靠但昂贵，自动指标虽可扩展但常有偏。传统做法将自动指标视为人工评估的代理，缺乏在同一流程中融合两者的形式化方法。PPI理论为结合二者提供了新思路，但其在MT系统比较中的适配（参数vs非参数、配对vs非配对、元评估）尚未被系统研究。

Method: 1）将PPI应用于MT成对系统比较，推导无偏估计量、闭式最优λ、渐近置信区间与Z检验；2）提出预测驱动的配对置换检验（基于符号对称性假设）；3）将PPI扩展到非配对设计；4）基于方差缩减推导PPSR元指标，为各系统对的Pearson相关系数平方的均值，解释为"标注节省比例"；5）在6个WMT数据集（WMT22–24）上进行蒙特卡洛重采样实验，覆盖功效、置信区间宽度、I型错误率、判别能力与排序稳定性，并与r/ρ/τ/SPA等系统级元指标对比。

Result: 1）PPE在MT系统比较中无偏且数据效率高于纯人工；自动指标覆盖接近95%名义水平，CI宽度小于纯人工；2）配对Z检验在小样本时偏反保守（Type I最大达0.123），配对置换检验更稳健；3）配对设计几乎在所有情况下方差更低（92%–100%），建议优先采用；4）PPSR在6个数据集上均取得最高的判别力与排序稳定性；PPSR的指标排序与传统系统级元指标差异显著，而与PDP等段级元指标更接近；5）PPSR与实际标注节省量高度相关（Pearson 0.86–0.99）。

Conclusion: PPI为人工与自动评估的结合提供了原则性框架，PPSR重新定义了元评估的目标——衡量节省人工标注的能力而非与人工判断的一致性。PPE和PPSR可推广至所有使用逐点人工评分的非可验证任务，为MT及其他领域的评估实践提供了实用工具与理论保障。

Abstract: Across various non-verifiable tasks, human evaluation is reliable but expensive, while automatic metrics are more scalable but often biased. Building on prediction-powered inference (PPI), we propose prediction-powered evaluation, a framework that combines limited human judgments with large-scale automatic scores to obtain data-efficient system comparisons that are provably unbiased. We develop parametric and non-parametric procedures, analyze the efficiency trade-off between paired and unpaired designs, and validate the framework on six WMT datasets. We further introduce the Prediction-Powered Saving Ratio (PPSR), a meta-metric that measures how much human annotation an automatic metric can save when used within prediction-powered evaluation. PPSR directly targets metric utility for prediction-powered evaluation and yields more discriminative and stable metric rankings than existing system-level meta-metrics. Overall, our new paradigm reframes automatic metrics as tools for reducing human annotation cost rather than replacing human judgment, and applies broadly to non-verifiable tasks.

</details>


### [81] [Information-Guided Frontier Decoding: Contextual Utility-Driven Commitment in dMLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26641)
*Xingyou Fang,Jingxing Zhong,Xiaosong Yuan,Xiaofeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出IGFD（信息引导的前沿解码），一种无需训练的解码策略，通过综合考量token置信度、邻域不确定性和结构性承诺风险，优化扩散多模态语言模型（dMLLM）中masked token的承诺顺序，提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于置信度的解码策略倾向于优先承诺局部容易但上下文效用低的token（如标点符号），导致有信息量的语义锚点被延迟，削弱上下文传播并增加错误累积。论文识别出两种承诺顺序失败：上下文效用盲视和结构性承诺风险。

Method: IGFD是一个免训练、免额外前向传播的解码策略，包含三个核心组件：（1）信息引导承诺分数：综合置信度(conf)、邻域不确定性(need)的乘积作为上下文效用代理，以及结构性token惩罚(struct)；（2）动态候选前沿：约束token选择范围为靠近已承诺token的可扩展区域；（3）每步从前沿内选择top-k个分数最高的token进行承诺，保持与基线相同的解码预算。默认参数为α=0.7, β=0.5, γ=0.2, r=2。

Result: 在三个dMLLM骨干模型（LLaDA-V、MMaDA、LaViDa）上的六个基准测试（LLaVA-Bench、CHAIR、MathVista、ScienceQA、MME、GQA）均一致优于原始解码、AdaBlock和Wavefront基线。消融实验验证了邻域需求、结构性惩罚和动态前沿各自的有效性；BERTScore评估显示语义保真度显著提升；承诺行为分析表明IGFD在早期阶段更优先承诺高不确定性token和内容性token，延迟标点承诺，且不增加额外前向传播成本。

Conclusion: IGFD通过重新设计承诺排序目标——从单纯追求局部容易转向追求既可靠又有上下文信息量的token——有效解决了置信度解码中的两种失败模式。该方法无需训练、辅助模型或额外前向传播，可即插即用地应用于不同dMLLM架构，在感知、推理和减少幻觉等多个维度带来一致提升。

Abstract: Decoding quality in diffusion multimodal language models (dMLLMs) depends heavily on the order in which masked tokens are committed. Existing confidence-based strategies prioritize locally easy tokens, but confidence does not necessarily reflect contextual usefulness. As a result, structurally easy tokens such as punctuation may be committed before informative semantic anchors, weakening context propagation and increasing error accumulation. We propose Information-Guided Frontier Decoding (IGFD), a training-free decoding strategy that ranks candidates using token confidence, neighborhood uncertainty, and structural commitment risk. IGFD encourages early commitment of reliable semantic anchors while delaying fragile structural tokens, improving contextual support during decoding. A dynamic candidate frontier further constrains token selection to locally expandable regions under the same decoding budget. The method requires no additional training, auxiliary models, or extra forward passes. Experiments across multimodal understanding, reasoning, grounding, and hallucination benchmarks show that IGFD consistently outperforms existing decoding strategies across the majority of benchmarks and diffusion MLLM backbones under identical decoding budgets.

</details>


### [82] [Meta-Learning Where to Allocate Experts: Task-Conditioned Layer-Wise Compression for MoEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26650)
*Rongfeng Wang,Shichao Weng,Zhiqiang Wang,Xinyu Liu,Yang Yi,Peilong Zhou,Hongwei Tang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaNet，一种基于支持集的轻量级控制器，用于冻结 MoE 模型推理时的逐层专家分配压缩，通过预测每层的专家保留阈值和有界路由偏置，在不修改骨干网络的前提下实现任务感知的专家激活量调控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MoE 模型推理时每层激活的专家数固定，无法适应不同任务和不同层的冗余度差异：浅层与深层、不同任务间的专家需求并不一致。已有方法要么是离线静态的层间分配，要么是仅基于 token 级局部信号做动态路由，缺乏任务级上下文支持。本文旨在填补这一空白，实现任务条件下的逐层专家分配。

Method: MetaNet 采用支持集-查询集 (support-query) 的元学习范式。对于每个任务 τ，利用小规模支持集 Sτ 经冻结的骨干网络推理，提取每层的路由统计量（softmax 平均概率 s、归一化熵 H、最大概率 m、Top-R 累积质量 c^(R)）。MetaNet 由双分支控制器组成：(1) 预算分支输出离散预算 logits，经 softmax 加权得到保留阈值 ρ_τ,l；(2) 先验分支输出每专家分数 p_τ,l，经 tanh 映射为有界路由偏置 b_τ,l（最大幅值 τ_b=0.05，远小于 gate logit），仅微弱扰动冻结路由器。预算通过累积概率质量阈值化（保留阈值 ρ 决定达到参考质量 M^(R) 所需的最少专家数）确定每层激活数 k_τ,l；查询时 b_τ,l 加到 gate logit 上做 TopK 选择。训练损失包含任务 CE、性能保持单边 Huber 惩罚（与固定 K_nat 参考损失对齐）、预算损失（压缩+救援，由 s_safe 软门控切换）、对齐 KL 损失、稳定性一致性损失和辅助正则项。骨干、原始路由器、所有专家参数全部冻结。

Result: 在 DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Chat 上：保守设置平均激活 3.61 个专家（比固定 k=6 减少 40%），MMLU 准确率 0.489 略高于固定 k=6 的 0.474；激进设置激活 2.28 个专家（减少 62%），准确率 0.438，仅下降 3.7 个百分点。MMLU 训练的控制器零样本迁移到 C-Eval（52 个学科），平均激活 2.90 个专家（减少 52%），准确率 0.386。零样本迁移到 OLMoE-1B-7B 时 MMLU 准确率达 0.573（优于固定 k=8 的 0.521）。GoogLeNet 跨架构合成任务验证框架通用性。消融显示预算分支与先验分支互补：仅预算分支准确率降至 0.375（gate 协议仅 0.038），仅先验分支保持 0.484 但需 12 个专家；完整方法 gate 协议达 0.943，低使用专家选择仅 0.004。层位置消融表明深层（18-26）最易压缩，浅层（0-8）压缩代价大。激活专家减少 62% 但端到端延迟仅下降 4.9%，说明稀疏性未完全转化为加速，需专用运行时支持。

Conclusion: MetaNet 证明 MoE 中专家需求因任务和深度而异，建模这种逐层变化可获得优于固定均匀 top-k 路由的准确率-激活专家权衡。方法为零样本跨骨干和跨架构迁移提供了可能。但当前实现仅减少路由层专家激活工作量，不减少模型存储或峰值内存；端到端加速依赖运行时对稀疏路由的利用；评估限于多选题基准，对开放生成、长上下文等场景的适用性有待验证。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a subset of expert networks, increasing capacity while keeping per-token computation sparse. In many deployed MoEs, the number of active experts is fixed across layers and tasks, although layer roles and expert redundancy vary with depth and demand varies with difficulty. Existing approaches address only part of this setting: layer-wise allocations are usually determined offline and reused for all tasks, while token-level methods vary expert activation using local routing signals without task-level context. We propose MetaNet, a support-set controller that predicts, for each layer, an expert-retention threshold and a bounded routing bias. The backbone, experts, and router remain frozen. On DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Chat, MetaNet provides a tunable accuracy-expert-activation trade-off. Relative to fixed k=6, a conservative setting activates 3.61 experts on average (40% fewer) and achieves comparable MMLU accuracy (0.489 vs. 0.474), whereas an aggressive setting activates 2.28 experts on average (62% fewer) with accuracy approximately 3.7 percentage points lower. The MMLU-trained controller also transfers to C-Eval without retraining, activating 2.90 experts on average (52% fewer than fixed k=6) at 0.386 accuracy.

</details>


### [83] [Beyond Reflection: Affirmation as a Promising Behavioral Marker Associated with Quality in Text-Based Counseling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26689)
*Michimasa Inaba*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文基于大规模日文文本咨询数据集KokoroChat，通过多层分析发现"肯定（Affirmation）"比现有研究广泛关注的"反映（Reflection）"更一致地与咨询会话质量相关，并通过ESConv跨数据集迁移实验验证了这一质量信号的普适性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI辅助文本咨询研究多借鉴动机性访谈（MI）框架，聚焦于"反映（Reflection）"这一核心技能，但MI主要用于行为改变而非情感支持，且缺乏对各类咨询策略与会话质量关系的系统性实证证据。本文旨在填补这一空白，探究哪些咨询师行为与更高质量的会话相关。

Method: 1. 数据基础：使用KokoroChat（6,589个日文专业咨询会话）；2. 新增标注：使用Gemini 2.5 Flash自动为306,495条咨询师话语标注11类策略标签，为客户话语标注4级痛苦水平；3. 质量指标：使用客户评分（分高/中/低三档）和痛苦变化（Δdistress）双重指标；4. 统计方法：分层卡方检验、Spearman相关与偏相关分析、混合效应模型、Mundlak分解、时序稳健性检验；5. 跨数据集迁移：在KokoroChat上训练逻辑回归模型，迁移至ESConv英文数据集验证。

Result: 1. 高分会话中Affirmation使用率显著更高（高分组9.9% vs 低分组6.5%），Question使用率显著更低；2. Affirmation与痛苦缓解相关性最强（ρ=-0.201, p<.001），而Reflection无显著相关性；3. 经混合效应模型和Mundlak分解控制咨询师个体差异后，Affirmation与质量的关联依然显著（控制咨询师随机效应后，ρ=-0.101仍显著）；4. KokoroChat训练模型迁移至ESConv时，预测概率与Δemotion显著负相关（ρ=-0.072, p=0.014），Affirmation系数最大（+0.536）。

Conclusion: 在文本咨询中，明确的"肯定（Affirmation）"行为比MI框架中强调的"反映（Reflection）"更一致地与会话质量相关。作者解释这可能源于文本渠道缺乏非言语接纳信号，故需要通过语言明确传达肯定与鼓励。该发现对人类咨询师训练和AI辅助情感支持系统设计具有指导意义，并应避免LLM对客户产生不分对象的谄媚式肯定。未来工作应从宏观频率分析转向序列级时机建模，并区分基于具体努力的肯定与泛化赞美。

Abstract: While AI-assisted text-based counseling is gaining attention, it remains empirically unclear which counselor behaviors are associated with higher dialogue quality. Existing research often focuses heavily on Reflection, borrowing frameworks from Motivational Interviewing. To address this gap, we conduct a multi-layered analysis using KokoroChat, a large-scale Japanese text counseling dataset conducted by professional counselors and trainees, newly annotated with counselor strategy tags and client distress levels. Our results show that, under the quality indicators used in this study, Affirmation is more consistently associated with session quality than Reflection among the analyzed strategies. Cross-dataset transfer experiments further suggest that this quality signal can be observed to some extent on ESConv, an English dataset with non-expert supporters. These findings provide empirical implications for counselor training and emotional support system design. We release the additional KokoroChat annotations and experimental source code at this https URL .

</details>


### [84] [Scaling phoneme-based TTS augmentation for ASR: A unified pipeline and controlled study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26697)
*Zhen Wang,TianRui Wu,RongQi Han,Hao Wu,Wei Liang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的音素级TTS-to-ASR数据增强流水线，核心是一个基于F5-TTS架构从头训练的多语言TTS模型，并提出了基于真实ASR标签音素频率的候选文本选择方法PFGS。实验在阿拉伯语、法语、意大利语和葡萄牙语四种语言、共13个测试集上展开，证明合成规模、候选文本内容和参考语音质量是TTS增强ASR性能的关键控制变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成语音能为ASR提供可扩展的监督信号，但其下游效用取决于所选文本的语言内容、参考语音的声学特性以及合成数据的总量。已有工作对文本构造的影响进行了探索，但在跨语言、跨测试域的匹配协议下，合成规模、候选文本音素组成和参考语音质量的独立影响尚未得到充分刻画。本文旨在系统性地填补这一空白。

Method: 1. 流水线设计：构建统一的五阶段流水线——数据准备、音素TTS训练、参考语音质量控制与任务构造、合成语料控制、ASR训练与评估。
2. 多语言TTS模型：采用F5-TTS架构，从头在阿拉伯语、法语、意大利语和葡萄牙语的自然录音上训练，引入32维可学习语言嵌入实现语言ID条件化，输入侧拼接含噪mel状态、参考mel、512维音素文本嵌入和扩展后的语言嵌入。
3. 音素表示：阿拉伯语、法语、意大利语使用eSpeak进行G2P，葡萄牙语使用gruut。
4. 参考语音过滤：保留时长3–12秒、至少3词、语速3–25字符/秒的样本，并用Faster-Whisper large-v3校验转写一致性。
5. PFGS选择方法：从真实ASR训练标签的G2P序列中统计每个音素出现次数（阈值τ=200），构建音素频率先验π(p)，对候选句按其音素序列的均值频率打分排序，选择top-N。
6. ASR训练：各语言独立训练WeNet混合CTC/注意力Conformer；TTS增强分支与real-only分支从同一real-only检查点继续训练，使用相同的优化与解码配置（attention_rescoring, beam=10）。

Result: 实验1（合成规模，r∈{0,10%,30%,60%,100%}）：随机增强在13个测试集中的11个上优于匹配real-only继续训练；最佳比例因语言和域而异，葡萄牙语收益最显著（100%时CV/FLEURS/MLS绝对WER降低9.03/7.36/6.32点）；阿语CV和意语MLS在任何比例下均未改善。
实验2（选择策略，60%预算）：PFGS在13个测试集中12个上优于real-only、9个上优于随机选择，相对WER降幅0.6%–19.3%；低频控制未带来稳定改善。法语后置分析显示PFGS降低了音素熵（5.2220→5.0891 bits），提升了bigram和trigram在三个测试集上的曝光。
实验3（参考语音过滤，固定文本与合成数）：意语CV WER从11.45降至11.16（−0.29），法语CV WER从11.70降至11.11（−0.59）。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一个统一的音素级TTS-to-ASR增强流水线和一个基于真实标签音素频率的候选文本排序方法PFGS。在四种语言和13个测试集的受控研究中证实：合成规模、候选文本内容、参考语音质量均是影响TTS增强ASR收益的关键控制变量。PFGS在多数设置下优于随机选择和低频选择；参考语音过滤在固定文本与合成数条件下可带来额外WER下降。

Abstract: Synthetic speech provides scalable supervision for automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its benefit depends on the selected texts, reference speech, and amount of synthesized data. We present a unified phoneme-based TTS-to-ASR augmentation pipeline built around a multilingual TTS model trained from scratch using the F5-TTS architecture with language-ID conditioning. The pipeline combines language-specific grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, reference-speech filtering, candidate-text selection, synthesis, and matched ASR continuation. We further propose phoneme-frequency-guided selection (PFGS), which ranks candidate sentences using phoneme frequencies estimated from real ASR training labels. Experiments with separate monolingual ASR systems for Arabic, French, Italian, and Portuguese span 13 test sets. Across the synthesis-scale sweep, random augmentation improves over matched real-only continuation on 11 test sets. Under a nominal 60% synthesis budget, PFGS improves over real-only training on 12 test sets and over random selection on 9. Its largest relative word error rate (WER) reduction against random selection is 19.3%. With target texts and synthesis counts fixed, reference-speech filtering reduces absolute WER by 0.29 and 0.59 points on Italian and French Common Voice, respectively. These results identify synthesis scale, candidate-text content, and reference quality as important control variables in TTS-based ASR augmentation.

</details>


### [85] [PragAlign: Evidence-Sensitive Reply Assistance Across Chinese and Japanese Appropriateness Judgments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26700)
*Xin Zhong,Satori Hachisuka*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了PragAlign框架，通过分离语境阅读与选择性澄清来辅助多语言回复，并针对中、日两种语言进行了人类评估研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言场景下的回复辅助不仅需要语言能力，还需要文化适配的恰当性判断。现有方法难以同时兼顾语境理解与文化敏感性。

Method: 提出PragAlign框架，将"语境阅读"与"选择性澄清"解耦。在中文与日语场景下，对比PragAlign、Direct和Rule三种方法。由9位母语为中文的评审与3位母语为日语的评审进行排名评估。

Result: 中文评估中，PragAlign排名显著优于两个基线方法。日语评估中，Direct平均排名最低，但差异不显著；PragAlign获"最佳"投票率最高。10个场景中有5个两组选了同一最优条件，其中4个共同选择了PragAlign。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了跨语言共享与语言特异的判断模式，为设计兼顾语言能力与文化理解的回复辅助系统提供了依据。

Abstract: Reply assistance in multilingual settings requires linguistic competence and culturally situated judgments of appropriateness. We present PragAlign, which separates context reading from selective clarification, and evaluate it alongside Direct and Rule. Nine native Chinese speakers judged Chinese materials, while three native Japanese speakers judged matched Japanese versions. In the Chinese evaluation, PragAlign received significantly better ranks than both baselines. In the Japanese evaluation, Direct had the lowest mean rank, PragAlign had the highest top-rank rate, and the omnibus difference was not significant. The groups selected the same top condition in 5 of 10 scenarios, including four shared PragAlign selections. The results identify shared and language-specific judgment patterns and inform reply assistance designed to support linguistic and cultural understanding.

</details>


### [86] [Towards Expert Financial QA via Self-Improving RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26706)
*Junjie Xiong,Shawheen Ghezavat,Aum Hirpara*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Self-Improving RAG，一个面向金融问答的三智能体（检索/推理/评判）+编排器的多智能体框架，通过Judge驱动的反馈自纠错与升级策略（更大k、保守提示、降低接受阈值）在FinanceBench上将LLM Judge准确率从53%提升到86%，并恢复36.4%初始错误答案；强调封闭域（“围墙花园”）约束和审计追踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准单轮RAG在高风险金融领域缺乏对自身错误的识别与纠正能力，也无可追溯的审计轨迹，无法满足金融监管合规要求；且金融QA必须在授权文档内检索（封闭域），无法依赖web搜索兜底。

Method: 三智能体协作：(1) Retrieval Agent按规则路由选择检索管线，重试时扩大top-k（10→20→30）并启用RSE；(2) Reasoning Agent按Standard→Conservative→Detailed升级提示策略生成带引用答案；(3) Judge Agent输出三维质量向量（grounding/completeness/numeric faithfulness，加权U_t）；Orchestrator使用动态阈值衰减（τ_t=τ₀−λ(t−1)）和最优答案保留机制（monotonic improvement），Judge评分低于阈值触发升级重试。所有决策带置信度与来源记录，支持审计。

Result: 在FinanceBench（150题，66%数值计算）Oracle-Guided评测：86%准确率（+62.3%相对提升），领域相关问题+81.1%；36.4%的Lazarus Rate（12/33触发重试的题目被纠正）；消融显示提示升级贡献最大（-10.6%），重试预算关键（B=1降25.5%）；但Deployment模式（盲Judge无gold）仅31%准确率，揭示盲质量估计仍是瓶颈；确定性格式化数值验证出现+2.1%的反常现象（单位/格式敏感导致过度重试）。

Conclusion: Self-Improving RAG在封闭域金融QA中以Judge驱动的重试替代复杂的动态路由，提供强可解释性与完整审计轨迹；盲Judge可靠性、延迟（15–25s）和数值精确匹配仍是主要限制；未来方向包括学习式升级（RL）、单位感知归一化以及向法律/医疗等高风险领域扩展。

Abstract: Expert-level financial question answering requires both grounded verification to catch numeric hallucinations and audit trails for regulatory compliance, attributes that standard single-pass RAG systems lack. We take a step toward this goal with Self-Improving RAG, a framework that decomposes document QA into three specialized agents (Retrieval, Reasoning, and Judge) coordinated by an orchestrator with feedback-driven self-correction. When the Judge Agent scores an answer below a dynamic threshold, the system triggers retry with escalated strategies: broader retrieval, more careful prompting, and relaxed acceptance criteria. We evaluate on FinanceBench (SEC filing QA), where Self-Improving RAG achieves 86% oracle-guided accuracy (measuring agreement with gold answers) with a 36.4% Lazarus Rate, recovering nearly 4 in 10 initially incorrect answers through targeted retry. A key finding is that a fixed retrieval pipeline with judge-driven retry achieves strong results without dynamic routing, providing full interpretability. Every decision is logged with confidence scores, enabling the audit trails required for regulated financial applications.

</details>


### [87] [Preserving General Capabilities during Domain Specialization with Uncertainty-Calibrated MOPD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26735)
*Ziyuan Liu,Jiao Ou,Jian Liang,Ruiming Tang,Cheng Luo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）在垂直领域专精化中损害通用能力的问题，提出"不确定性校准的MOPD"方法，通过双温度采样、正优势密度轨迹过滤与基于中心化对数似然（CLL）的方向-背书一致性令牌过滤三个层面协同增强学习信号的发现与验证，在角色扮演与医学两个垂直领域上同时提升通用能力恢复与领域性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在面向角色扮演、医疗等垂直领域进行SFT或偏好优化时，会显著提升领域能力但伴随严重的通用能力（推理、代码、指令跟随、写作等）下降。现有常用做法是将通用数据混入领域数据进行协同训练，但该方案需要额外构建并筛选高质量通用语料，且需要启发式调参混合比例，开销巨大。多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）可让垂直域模型与通用模型分别作为教师、在学生自采样轨迹上提供token级别监督，从而避免人工构造通用数据的负担。但标准MOPD存在两个关键缺陷：（1）学生按自身分布采样时倾向于采样自身概率高的token，难以暴露具有大幅正优势（teacher概率明显高于student）的"金增益"机会；（2）优势的正负号仅指示更新方向，无法证明该方向在教师自身分布下是可靠的——例如教师与学生都将Paris排在首位但学生略高，会导致原本被强背书的token被误压。

Method: 提出"不确定性校准的MOPD"，将token级信号选择问题拆分为"学习机会发现"与"更新方向可靠性验证"两个互补任务，三个层面依次实现：（1）双温度采样：对每个prompt同时采样一个锚点响应（T=1.0）与若干探索响应（T=1.5、top-p=0.9），扩大候选轨迹池以提升大幅正优势token的暴露机会；（2）正优势密度轨迹过滤：以token级teacher-student对数概率差的平均值作为"正优势密度"得分r(y)，只保留正优势密度不低于该prompt对应锚点的探索响应，从而抑制高温度噪声；（3）中心化对数似然（CLL）方向-一致性过滤：在教师分布下计算s_cll(x)=exp(min(log p_T(x)+H[p_T], 0))作为熵校准的token级教师背书分数，并与teacher典型概率尺度b_T=exp(-H[p_T])相比，其keep概率统一为w_cll(A_t, x) = ½(1 + sgn(A_t)·(2s_cll(x)-1))，使保留概率同时反映方向与背书的一致性：正优势+强背书更倾向保留，正优势+弱背书更倾向过滤，负优势+弱背书更倾向保留，负优势+强背书更倾向过滤。CLL提供了硬性top-k切分的连续熵自适应替代方案。算法整体为：采样→按正优势密度过滤轨迹→对保留轨迹中每个非零优势token按keep概率进行伯努利掩码→在保留token上计算MOPD反向KL目标。理论上证明：(1) 正密度过滤后，保留轨迹的均值正优势密度不低于锚点；(2) CLL等价于在熵自适应典型尺度下比较token概率，连续地将保留偏好从强化转移到抑制。

Result: 实验在两个垂直领域专精化场景上验证：（1）角色扮演专精化（Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 → CoSER SFT 4B作学生与领域教师，原Qwen3-4B作通用教师，468次外层更新）；（2）医学专精化（II-Medical-7B-Preview为学生与领域教师，Qwen3-8B为通用教师，231次外层更新）。通用能力评估覆盖9个基准（GPQA-Diamond、AIME25、HMMT25、ZebraLogic、LiveCodeBench v5、IF-Eval、WritingBench、Arena-Hard v2的HP与CW、LiveBench）。结果：相对标准MOPD，角色扮演场景通用平均+4.73%（50.70→53.10）、角色扮演平均+3.78（41.22→45.00）；医学场景通用平均+10.84%（49.06→54.38），医学平均保持接近最优（60.95→60.65）。消融显示三个组件均贡献正向：CLL采样掩码（Gen.Avg 50.70→51.01）+ 双温度采样（→52.83）+ 正密度过滤（→53.10）。在等rollout预算（每prompt 8条响应）对照下，本文方法通用与角色扮演平均均优于MOPD（53.10/45.00 vs 52.23/43.38），证明增益并非源于更多采样。正密度过滤诊断显示被保留轨迹相对被丢弃轨迹的正token比例从0.5026升至0.5939、平均正优势从0.0705升至0.1375。CLL对硬top-k（k=1,3）方案取得最佳通用与角色扮演平均。温度敏感性研究表明T=1.5为角色扮演最佳，过高温度稳定性下降。CLL采样掩码在角色扮演平均与GPQA上优于CLL加权变体。

Conclusion: 本文将MOPD中领域-通用能力权衡问题重新定义为token级别信号选择问题，提出"不确定性校准的MOPD"，通过双温度采样+正优势密度轨迹过滤实现"学习机会发现"，通过CLL方向-背书一致性过滤实现"更新可靠性验证"，在不改变教师引导MOPD目标的前提下同时改善了轨迹级与token级的监督选择性。在角色扮演与医学两个垂直领域实验验证：相对于标准MOPD，在保持垂直领域性能的同时显著提升了通用能力恢复（+4.73%与+10.84%）。结论指出，不确定性感知下的信号发现与方向一致性过滤是垂直领域专精化中保护通用能力的有前景原则。

Abstract: Specializing large language models to vertical domains improves domain-specific behavior but often degrades general capabilities such as reasoning, coding, instruction following, and creative writing. We study this domain--general trade-off in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), where a specialized student is supervised on its own sampled trajectories by domain and general teachers. Standard MOPD faces two limitations: ordinary on-policy sampling rarely exposes tokens with large positive teacher--student advantages, while the advantage sign alone does not establish whether the resulting update direction is reliable. We propose uncertainty-calibrated MOPD to address these limitations. Dual-temperature sampling broadens the candidate trajectory pool, and positive-advantage-density filtering selects trajectories with stronger positive learning signals. Centered log-likelihood (CLL) filtering then computes an entropy-calibrated teacher-endorsement score and probabilistically retains token updates according to direction--endorsement consistency. Experiments on role-playing and medical-domain specialization show that our method improves the general-capability average over standard MOPD by $4.73\%$ and $10.84\%$, respectively, while maintaining vertical-domain performance. Ablations and diagnostic analyses further confirm that the gains do not merely result from a larger rollout budget and that the proposed trajectory- and token-level mechanisms address their intended failure modes.

</details>


### [88] [Letters hide the truth from our eyes: English homophones have meaningfully different phonetic realizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26749)
*Yu-Hsiang Tseng,Mirjam T. C. Ernestus,Louis F. M. ten Bosch,R. Harald Baayen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过分析14,000个英语同音异形异义词（heterographic homophones）语音样本，发现同音词对（如wait/weight）的语音实现存在系统性差异，这种差异即使在控制词长后仍然存在，并且可以通过语义上下文进行预测。研究提出了基于时间归一化梅尔频谱图和上下文嵌入向量的线性映射方法，挑战了传统音韵学中抽象音位单位的概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统音韵学和心理语言学模型（如Levelt的模型）假定同音词共享相同的音位表征，因此预测其语音实现应当相同。然而，Gahl (2008)和Lohmann (2018)发现同音词的词长存在差异，Gahl & Baayen (2024)进一步发现这种差异可由语义预测。本研究旨在探究同音词的语音实现差异是否超越词长层面，涵盖更精细的频谱特征，并检验这些差异是否由词义系统性决定。

Method: 1. 数据来源：从Redhen 2016数据集中提取35对同音异形异义词，每词200个token，共14,000个语音样本，确保每个token出现在独特的上下文中。
2. 语音表征：构建时间归一化梅尔频谱图，通过动态调整步长使所有token的频谱图具有固定维度（50时间步×21频率带=1,050维向量）。
3. 语义表征：从GPT-2中提取上下文嵌入向量（768维），使用五词窗口作为上下文。
4. 分类实验：使用线性判别分析（LDA）配合主成分分析（PCA降维），通过10折交叉验证测试：(1) 35对同音词对的区分能力；(2) 70个词成员之间的区分能力。
5. 差异可视化：使用广义可加模型（GAM）和张量积平滑函数估计差异频谱图。
6. 形式-意义映射：使用辨别性词典模型（DLM）的线性辨别学习（LDL）进行形式与意义之间的线性映射，包括完整置换基线和词内置换基线。
7. 控制词长：使用偏最小二乘（PLS）从频谱图中去除词长信息，检验差异是否独立于词长。

Result: 1. 同音词对区分：LDA分类准确率达79.30%（vs. 置换基线2.82%），表明35对同音词对在频谱特征上可清晰区分。
2. 同音词成员区分：整体准确率51.13%（vs. 基线1.43%），所有35对同音词的成员区分准确率均高于随机水平。
3. GAM差异频谱图：所有35对同音词均显示显著的频谱差异（平均ΔAIC=3413.92），差异涉及元音起始时间、辅音频谱能量、共振峰模式等多个方面。
4. 形式-意义对齐：LDL映射显著优于置换基线；语义质心预测的频谱图与GAM估计的差异频谱图高度吻合。
5. 去除词长效应后：PLS去除词长信息的频谱图仍能区分同音词成员（M=62.50%）并与语义向量对齐，表明差异不能完全归因于词长。
6. 线性映射的有效性：简单的线性映射即可捕捉形式与意义之间的系统性关联，无需非线性模型。

Conclusion: 该研究表明英语同音异形异义词仅是"近似同音"，其语音实现不仅在时长上有差异，在精细的频谱特征上也存在系统性差异，且这些差异可由词在语境中的意义预测。时间归一化频谱图是研究语音实现细节的有效工具，无需依赖语音转写。这些发现对形式音韵学和心理语言学中关于抽象音位单位的假设提出了挑战，支持辨别性词典模型（DLM）的预测，即形式与意义之间存在紧密的双向映射关系。词义在语境中的变化会系统性地影响语音实现的细节，这一结论在词的类层面和个体token层面均成立。

Abstract: The distribution of spoken word duration of English homophones is known to co-vary with frequency of use. This study investigates whether other aspects of the phonetic realization of homophones also differ. A series of quantitative investigations of 14,000 homophone tokens in American television news broadcasts revealed that the tokens of homophone pairs such as \textit{weight} and \textit{wait} have different phonetic realizations, and that these can be predicted from their meanings in utterance context. These systematic differences remain even when taking duration-related variation into account. Time-normalized spectrograms emerged as an excellent tool for probing the fine details of phonetic realization, and obviate the need for phonetic transcriptions, which inevitably hide the phonetic truth from our eyes.

</details>


### [89] [Instruction Quality Matters: Refining Instructions for Effective Preference Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26779)
*Seohyeong Lee,Hwaran Lee,Buru Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出指令质量是偏好学习中被忽视的上游瓶颈，提出一种基于奖励信号选择弱指令并利用rubric引导的LLM反馈进行指令精炼的流水线，在不丢弃数据的情况下提升偏好数据质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏好数据优化方法主要关注响应层面或标注层面，假设指令固定不变。然而，模糊或不完整的指令会限制候选响应的质量分布（既限制上限也降低下限），导致偏好信号弱化。因此，指令质量本身构成偏好信号形成过程中的隐藏瓶颈。

Method: （1）通过Best-of-N和Worst-of-N分析证明低质量指令同时压缩了响应质量的天花板和地板；（2）提出指令精炼流水线：利用奖励模型（ArmoRM）分数阈值τ（默认0.13，对应约30%指令）筛选弱指令；（3）使用GPT-4o作为LLM-as-a-judge，基于七个rubric维度（清晰度、特异性、完整性、安全性、可回答性、简洁性、格式一致性）生成结构化诊断反馈；（4）迭代地根据反馈精炼指令并重新生成响应，直到min(R1,R2)≥τ或达到最大迭代次数T=3。在线设置中每轮数据生成前对所有指令进行一次无条件精炼。

Result: 离线实验（UltraFeedback，32K指令）：DPO和SimPO在LLaMA3-8B和Mistral-7B上均获得持续提升，AlpacaEval LC WR最大提升约8%p。在线实验（SPA、Reward Model、Implicit Reward）：第三轮迭代中AlpacaEval LC WR持续提升，最高达7.14%p。跨奖励模型实验（OSSAT-RM）证实效果非特定于某一奖励模型。消融实验表明rubric引导反馈优于无rubric的通用改写。最佳阈值分析表明中等阈值（τ=0.13，约精炼30%指令）效果最优。人类评估显示88.4%精炼后指令保留核心任务意图。IFD分析表明性能提升并非源于任务简化。

Conclusion: 指令质量是偏好信号信息量的关键决定因素，超越响应质量和优化目标本身。基于rubric引导的指令精炼能够在不丢弃样本的前提下系统性提升偏好数据质量，与以响应为中心的数据优化策略互补，构成偏好数据优化的一个独立且有效的维度。

Abstract: Preference learning optimizes models using response pairs, yet the informativeness of these pairs is fundamentally shaped by the instructions from which they are generated. We identify instruction quality as a hidden bottleneck in preference learning: low-quality or ambiguous instructions restrict the response-quality distribution, limiting strong chosen responses and weakening preference signals. Through Best- and Worst-of-N analyses, we show that instruction quality constrains both the ceiling and floor of sampled response quality. Motivated by this observation, we introduce an instruction-refinement pipeline that selects weak instructions using reward signals and revises them with rubric-guided LLM feedback, improving preference data without discarding examples. Across offline and online preference learning settings, experiments on multiple models and benchmarks show broad alignment improvements over original data and alternative data-improvement strategies. Further analyses indicate that instruction refinement raises achievable response quality and complements response-centric preference data curation. Overall, instruction quality emerges as a key factor governing how informative preference signals are formed for LLM alignment. Code is available at: this https URL

</details>


### [90] [RuleWeaver: Benchmarking Rule-Centered Scenario Reasoning for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26832)
*Bohan Yu,Shi-Yang Li,Pengfei Cao,Jun Zhao,Kang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 RuleWeaver，用于评估大语言模型能否从给定规则池中识别相关规则、区分规则角色、按依赖链应用规则并在具体场景中得到一致结论。基于 200 个规则组和 96 个场景 QA 的测试显示，当前 11 个代表性模型仍明显不足：同源设置最高 rubric 为 53.83/100，跨源设置最高为 50.27/100。主要瓶颈不是格式遵循，而是依赖链对齐（14.2%）、中间结论质量（21.0%）、问题分解（28.4%）和例外/冲突处理（30.4%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有指令遵循基准主要检查输出格式和内容约束，逻辑推理基准则通常假定规则已给定，并将规则视为相对同质的推理前提。它们难以同时评估模型在真实场景中识别相关规则、理解条件/例外/冲突/优先级角色、正确应用规则以及维持多步依赖关系的能力。论文旨在填补这一评测空白。

Method: RuleWeaver 从 GovReport、WikiHow、CUAD 和 BookSum 提取 11,145 个 IF-THEN Meta Rules，经质量过滤、聚类和人工检查保留 200 个高质量规则。对每个规则进行五轮渐进式语义增强，得到 ABSTRACT、ADDITIVE、NEGATE、EXCEPTION、CONFLICT 和 IRONCLAD 六类复杂规则，共 200 组、800 个变体。随后通过依赖规划、子场景生成、最终合成和迭代质量审查构建场景 QA。每个实例包含 5 个相关规则和干扰规则，覆盖 7 类问题及 48 个同源、48 个跨源样本。评估 11 个模型，并使用 100 分 all-or-nothing rubric、rule recall、rule precision 衡量答案质量、规则检索和应用正确性。

Result: 同源设置中，GPT-5.5 获得最高 rubric 53.83 和 precision 74.58，Kimi-K2.6 获得最高 recall 72.92；跨源设置中，Claude-Opus-4.6 获得最高 rubric 50.27 和 recall 62.50，GPT-5.4 获得最高 precision 78.64。11 个模型平均而言，跨源设置使 recall 下降 11.93 分、rubric 下降 4.05 分，precision 略升 2.42 分。语义上 CONFLICT 平均表现最高（42.7%），IRONCLAD 为 40.6%，ABSTRACT 为 39.7%，EXCEPTION 最低（34.6%）。多步整合错误最常见（86.7%），其次是规则选择错误（72.2%）和规则交互错误（69.5%）。规则精度与 QA 平均 rubric 的相关性为 0.66，高于召回率的 0.20。LLM judge 与人工评分的 Spearman 相关系数为 0.808（GPT-5.5 审计），替代 judge 的模型级相关性为 0.882–0.918，说明主要排名趋势较稳健。

Conclusion: RuleWeaver 证明，复杂、以规则为中心的场景推理仍是当前 LLM 的显著短板，尤其体现在跨源规则组合、例外与优先级、长依赖链和较大规则池条件下。模型往往能够遵守表面格式，却难以稳定识别所有相关规则、正确处理规则交互并传播中间结论。论文建议未来扩展到更大规则库、非结构化文档检索、交互式场景、多语言数据和动态规则更新。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to specialized domains, where effective use of domain expertise often requires reasoning over complex rules in concrete scenarios. However, existing benchmarks only partially evaluate this capability, as they either focus on output-level instruction constraints or overlook the distinct roles that rules play in scenario reasoning. To address these gaps, this paper introduces RuleWeaver, a benchmark construction framework for evaluating rule-centered scenario reasoning. RuleWeaver starts from corpus-derived IF-THEN Meta Rules, progressively augments them into complex rules, and composes these rules into rule-centered scenario QA instances. Beyond final-answer correctness, RuleWeaver further supports process-level evaluation through rubric-based answer quality, rule recall, and rule precision. Experiments on 11 representative LLMs show that current models still struggle with complex rule-centered scenario reasoning, with even the best-performing model achieving only around 50% of the maximum rubric score. We make our code and dataset available here: this https URL .

</details>


### [91] [Planting a Latent Variable in Natural-Looking Text: a More Realistic Test of Belief States in LLMs and Their Link to Concept Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26887)
*Alexandru-Iulius Jerpelea*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种在自然文本中"植入"可控潜在变量的方法：用LLM教师生成文本的同时，通过稀疏自编码器(SAE)方向沿环形马尔可夫链进行"潜意识引导"。训练学生transformer后证明：学生确实追踪了该潜在变量的贝叶斯后验信念，且8个状态在表征空间中按马尔可夫链的顺序排列成环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作（如Shai et al., 2024）仅在合成玩具数据上证明transformer会追踪"信念状态"，从未在自然语言场景下验证，也未将信念状态与LLM特征的概念几何联系起来。本文旨在：(1)在更真实的自然文本环境中验证信念状态假设；(2)探索潜在变量自身的几何结构是否由其统计动力学塑造。

Method: 1. 教师模型为Gemma-2-2B，配合Gemma Scope SAE（16K latents，layer 12）。从SAE中选取K=8个不相关、近正交、难以外观的潜在方向。2. 沿这8个方向在残差流中（layer 12至L-2）注入方向向量d_i × a_i × (ρ_ℓ/ρ_12)，强度s=1.5。3. 状态切换遵循"环形马尔可夫链"：停留概率0.95，切换时跳到相邻状态。4. 每个文档256个token，每token的KV cache重置以保证可计算理想贝叶斯观察者。5. 生成40万文档约102M tokens，训练110M参数的Llama风格transformer学生。6. 设置两个对照：control1（不引导）和control2（停留概率相同但均匀跳到任意其他状态，无环形结构）。7. 用最优观察者（贝叶斯后验b_t）作为探针目标，用脊回归从学生残差流读出b_t，并用傅里叶分析检测8个状态中心是否构成圆环。

Result: 1. **信念状态追踪**：最佳单层R²=0.49，argmax准确率0.577，约为最优观察者上限0.762的四分之三。control2也达到R²=0.41，但差异来自利用马尔可夫链结构；在"首次驻留"段（状态未切换前）两者无差异，证明学生确实学习了HMM结构。2. **概念几何**：8个状态的中心点在layer 9-11的PCA前两维上按环形顺序排列。控制"前状态泄漏"后，环形在前两维消失，但傅里叶分析显示存在一个平面，8个状态按真实马尔可夫链顺序排名第1（2520种排列中），解释38%方差。control1和control2的真实顺序排名居中。3. 余弦相似度热图显示邻居状态最相似，符合转移矩阵T的结构。

Conclusion: 本文成功在自然文本中植入可控潜在变量，验证了transformer在更现实场景中追踪信念状态的能力，并提供了概念几何（潜在变量值自身的排列）由其背后数据生成过程的统计动力学塑造的支持证据。这是连接信念状态理论（Shai et al.）与可解释性文献中概念流形假设的重要一步。

Abstract: LLMs are thought to track "belief states," i.e., running probability distributions over the latent variables that govern language (Shai et al., 2024; Sarfati et al., 2026), but so far this has only been comprehensively demonstrated on toy synthetic data and in a few isolated case studies. It has also never been empirically connected to the geometry of LLM features (the concepts interpretability finds in model activations). In this work, we plant a controllable latent variable inside natural-looking text. An LLM teacher writes ordinary text while we "subliminally" steer it along one of K = 8 unrelated sparse autoencoder directions at each token, with the active directions following a ring-shaped Markov chain. A small transformer model trained on this corpus does indeed track the Bayesian posterior belief about our planted latent variable. Moreover, it also arranges the 8 states themselves on a ring, in the exact order of the Markov chain, which is supporting evidence that a concept's geometry can be formed by the statistical dynamics of the latent variable behind it.

</details>


### [92] [TabuLM: Morphology-Aware Tabular Pre-training for Low-Resource Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26923)
*Ireddi Rakshitha,Devavarapu Yashwanth,Ntakirutimana Pierre*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TabuLM 是首个针对低资源语言 Kinyarwanda（卢旺达语）的形态学感知表格预训练语言模型，通过扩展 KinyaBERT 的双层架构并引入表格结构嵌入与两个新预训练目标，在首个卢旺达语表格问答基准 TabQA-kin 上以 62.0% EM 超越所有微调基线，并揭示了 GPT-4o 在聚合问题上的规模无关性能天花板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kinyarwanda 是形态丰富的班图语（超过1200万使用者），但现有预训练流水线完全忽视表格数据（卢旺达政府主要数据均为表格形式），而英语表格模型（TAPAS、TaBERT 等）无法迁移到形态复杂的低资源语言，导致政策关键数据无法被任何语言模型访问。

Method: 在 KinyaBERT 两层 Transformer 上做三项轻量扩展：(1) 加性行/列/单元格类型嵌入；(2) 每个注意力头学习一个 3 标量的表格结构偏置（同行/同列/表头信号）；(3) 两个新预训练目标——Masked Cell Recovery (MCR，整单元格掩码后从行列上下文重构) 和 Column Type Prediction (CTP，从单元格值预测列语义类型)。新增参数 <0.1%。预训练在 172 张卢旺达政府表（~35000 单元格，NISR/RAB/REB/MoH）上进行 10K 次迭代（LAMB，单卡 RTX 3090），微调在 TabQA-kin（526 QA 对/31 表）上用 AdamW 进行 20 轮。

Result: TabuLM 在 TabQA-kin 评估项上取得 62.0% EM，比 KinyaBERT-large（56.3%）高 5.7 点，比 mBERT（49.3%）和 XLM-R（50.0%）高 11.7–12.7 点；消融显示行/列/单元格类型嵌入贡献最大（去除下降 4.0 EM），而表格结构偏置实际收敛接近零（~5×10⁻⁶）；GPT-4o 与 GPT-4o-mini 均停留在 64.0%，瓶颈在聚合问题上（仅 25.9–29.6% EM），3-shot 提示反而下降至 7.4%，而所有微调模型聚合均达 79.2–88.9%（95% CI 不重叠，统计稳健），表明该缺陷是结构性的、规模无关的。

Conclusion: TabuLM 证明将形态学感知与表格结构预训练相结合是低资源 Bantu 语言结构化数据理解的有效路径；行/列/单元格类型嵌入比注意力偏置更有效；微调可突破 LLM 在聚合问题上的规模无关性能天花板（~64%），是当前唯一可本地部署（65M 参数、单卡 GPU、零 API 成本）的方案；架构的语言无关部分可推广至 Swahili、Kirundi 等 Bantu 语言。

Abstract: We present TabuLM, the first language model pre-trained on Kinyarwanda tabular data. Kinyarwanda is a morphologically rich Bantu language spoken by over 12 million people in Rwanda, yet lacks any dedicated tabular representation learning resource. TabuLM extends KinyaBERT-large, a two-tier morphological transformer, with additive row, column, and cell-type embeddings and a learned table-structure attention bias that sharpens same-row and same-column attention. Pre-training uses two new objectives: Masked Cell Recovery (MCR), which masks entire cells and forces reconstruction from row and column context, and Column Type Prediction (CTP), which predicts column semantic types from observed cell values. We pre-train on 172 Rwandan government tables (~35,000 cells) from NISR, RAB, REB, and MoH open-data portals, and introduce TabQA-kin, the first native Kinyarwanda table question-answering benchmark comprising 526 QA pairs across 31 tables and four question types. TabuLM achieves 62.0% exact match on TabQA-kin, outperforming KinyaBERT-large by 5.7 EM points and all multilingual baselines (mBERT 49.3%, XLM-R 50.0%) by 11.7-12.7 points. Analysis shows that structural table embeddings are most decisive for comparison and lookup questions, while morphological awareness provides complementary gains. Our code, data, and pre-trained checkpoint are publicly available.

</details>


### [93] [Mapping Written Words to Spoken Words in a Different Language Using Only Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26925)
*Gabriel Pirlogeanu,Dan Oneata,Horia Cucu,Herman Kamper*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于对齐的方法，利用视觉接地（visual grounding）将印地语口语词与英语书面词建立映射，无需目标语言的转录或显式模型训练。该方法通过自监督语音特征（如HuBERT）对带有相同关键词的语音片段进行对齐，并引入负样本挖掘以提升效果，显著优于基于注意力的神经基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在世界7000多种语言中，许多低资源语言缺乏文字系统或识字人口，使得数据采集极为困难。视觉接地语音数据（让人描述图片并录音）是一种有前景的数据收集方式，但如何从此类数据中学习跨语言（书面词到外语口语）的词映射仍具挑战。现有工作使用端到端多模态神经网络，缺乏透明度和灵活性，且词汇表受限于固定的图像标注器。本文旨在探索一种更简单的基于对齐的方法，能够动态构建词汇并更精确地定位词。

Method: 1. 通过现成的图像描述系统（Tag2Text、BLIP-2、GIT）从图像中自动生成英文描述，构建词表；2. 基于查询词将语音-图像对分为正集（图像描述包含该词）和负集（不包含），可选择语义负集（共现词）；3. 使用自监督语音特征（HuBERT第7层）进行两类对齐：连续特征对齐（CFA，基于余弦相似度+高斯平滑）和离散特征对齐（DFA，基于k-means+Smith-Waterman）；4. 通过"区间堆叠"聚合对齐分数：正样本对齐加分，负样本对齐减分，筛选出对应查询词的语音片段。

Result: 在Places Hindi数据集（20k样本）上，CFA+负样本挖掘的P@10在关键词定位上达到49.9%，显著优于基于注意力的CNN基线（10.4%）；在关键词识别上达到63.0%（基线18.8%）。连续特征优于离散特征，负样本挖掘对定位任务提升尤为显著（约111%相对提升）。系统对图像描述系统的选择鲁棒，对语音表示的选择也较为稳健（多语言mHuBERT取得略优的50.7%）。单语（英-英）设置下表现明显优于跨语言（印地-英）设置，跨语言性能差距主要源于文化差异而非语音表示本身。

Conclusion: 本文证明可以在没有目标语言转录或显式模型训练的情况下，仅通过视觉接地直接学习跨语言的书面词到口语词的映射。基于对齐的方法比神经基线更简单、更强大。负样本挖掘对抑制共现词和功能词至关重要。该方法对未来低资源语言文档化具有重要价值，但跨语言性能受文化差异影响——讲不同语言的人会以不同方式描述图像。未来工作可关注选择更适合目标文化语境图像以缩小该差距。

Abstract: In many low-resource settings, even just eliciting speech for data collection is difficult. One promising approach has been to ask speakers to describe images. But how do we build models from such visually grounded speech data? Given a dataset of images with Hindi spoken captions, we consider how we can map a written English keyword to spoken realisations of that word in Hindi. Previous work trained end-to-end multimodal neural models. Instead, we explore a simpler alignment-based approach built on self-supervised speech representations. Written English tags are automatically obtained from images using off-the-shelf image captioning systems. Hindi utterances associated with the same keyword are then aligned (using self-supervised features), and alignment evidence is aggregated to identify recurring speech segments corresponding to the target word. Experiments evaluating keyword spotting and localization show that our alignment-based approach outperforms a previous attention-based neural model. We also show the benefit of incorporating negative examples during alignment. Our work demonstrates that cross-lingual word-to-speech mappings can be learned directly from visual grounding without transcriptions or explicit model training.

</details>


### [94] [KinyaEmbed: Contrastive Sentence Embeddings for Kinyarwanda via Multi-Stage Curriculum Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26941)
*Ireddi Rakshitha,Devavarapu Yashwanth,Ntakirutimana Pierre*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出KinyaEmbed,首个专为卢旺达语(超过1200万使用者)设计的句向量模型。基于KinyaBERT-large,通过四阶段课程对比学习(MNRL损失)训练,并采用七检查点集成策略。在SemRel2024-rw上Spearman ρ=0.7298,超过mE5-large 20.9%、OpenAI text-embedding-3-large 41%;在文档聚类任务中取得最佳轮廓系数0.2146。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卢旺达语虽使用者众多但在多语言预训练语料中严重欠表征,导致LaBSE、mE5、OpenAI等通用多语言嵌入模型在该语言的STS任务上表现不佳。现有研究主要通过指令微调(如AfriE5)在通用多语言骨干上做适配,但缺乏针对卢旺达语形态学特征(黏着语、16个名词类别)的专门句向量方案。

Method: 1) 架构:KinyaBERT-large(12层768维)+均值池化+L2归一化;2) 训练目标:MultipleNegativesRankingLoss(MNRL);3) 四阶段课程:Stage 1用卢旺达官方公报18,000个单语释义对(scale 30/35/40);Stage 2用715条NLLB翻译的MNLI三元组(scale 35);Stage 3用OPUS-100英卢对齐对(scale 20);Stage 4用KinyaCOMET中质量≥0.8的2,936对人类标注对(scale 20);4) 集成策略:7个检查点(sc30/35/40、v12、step22A、step23A×2)归一化平均,step23A双权重以平衡单语STS与跨语对齐。

Result: 在SemRel2024-rw上ρ=0.7298,超越mE5-large(+20.9%)、OpenAI text-embedding-3-large(+41.0%)等7个基线;在自建无污染Wiki-RW-STS(300对维基百科句对)上ρ=0.6005,领先mE5-large-instruct 8.6%;文档聚类取得最佳轮廓系数0.2146和最低Davies-Bouldin指数2.9004;但信息检索P@1仅0.4733(任务不匹配,模型未针对不对称检索优化);FLORES P@1=0.3587低于翻译专用模型。消融显示Stage 1贡献最大(ρ从0.380升至0.739,+94%)。

Conclusion: 语言专属预训练+针对性课程对比学习是低资源语言句向量质量的关键决定因素,通用商业模型的规模优势无法弥补。KinyaEmbed在单语STS和文档聚类上设定新基准,但在不对称检索和跨语对齐上仍有改进空间。模型、检查点、KinyaCOMET筛选对及Wiki-RW-STS基准已全部开源(CPU可部署),为卢旺达1200万使用者的NLP应用(卫生公告语义搜索、法律文档聚类、教育资料检索)提供基础设施。

Abstract: We present KinyaEmbed, the first dedicated sentence embedding model for Kinyarwanda, a morphologically rich Bantu language spoken by over 12 million people in Rwanda. Existing multilingual embedding models such as LaBSE, mE5-large, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large perform poorly on Kinyarwanda due to severe under-representation in their pre-training corpora. KinyaEmbed is built on KinyaBERT-large and trained via a four-stage curriculum using MultipleNegativesRankingLoss (MNRL): Stage 1 leverages ~18,000 paraphrase pairs from the Official Gazette of Rwanda with three temperature scales; Stage 2 fine-tunes on 715 NLLB-translated MNLI triplets for entailment structure; Stage 3 aligns representations using English-Kinyarwanda OPUS-100 translation pairs; Stage 4 refines with 2,936 high-quality pairs filtered from KinyaCOMET at quality threshold 0.8. We evaluate on SemRel2024-rw and introduce Wiki-RW-STS, a new contamination-free Kinyarwanda STS benchmark of 300 pairs derived from Kinyarwanda Wikipedia. A seven-checkpoint ensemble (all5+23A*2, with the final stage double-weighted) achieves Spearman \r{ho}=0.7298 on SemRel2024-rw, surpassing mE5-large by 20.9% and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large by 41.0%. KinyaEmbed also achieves the best document clustering silhouette score (0.2146) across all evaluated models. All checkpoints, the KinyaCOMET filtered pairs, and the Wiki-RW-STS benchmark are publicly available.

</details>


### [95] [JudgeStealer: Extracting LLM Judging Capabilities across Evaluation Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26982)
*Chen Chen,Yaolin Chen,Xuehan Sun,Juan Lin,Xueluan Gong,Yuhang Zheng,Qian Wang,Kwok-Yan Lam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出JudgeStealer，首个针对LLM评判能力的跨评估协议（逐点评分、成对比较、列表排序）模型提取框架。该方法利用协议间的强一致性，仅通过逐点查询即可获得监督信号，并将其转化为成对和列表形式的训练数据，无需额外受害模型查询。结合基于语义多样性、预测不确定性和评判偏见的动态样本选择、自适应分数平滑以及多协议回顾训练机制，在多个专有和开源LLM评判模型及奖励模型上显著优于现有提取基线，并对主流防御机制具有鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM评判能力作为重要知识产权（用于模型评估、RLHF奖励、安全审核等），但黑盒API访问使其面临模型提取攻击威胁。现有提取方法未专门针对LLM评判器，且在受限查询预算下难以支持多种评估协议。

Method: JudgeStealer采用两阶段框架：Stage I通过动态样本选择（联合考虑语义多样性、预测不确定性、长度偏见和位置偏见）选取信息量大的逐点样本查询受害模型，并使用离散高斯平滑的自适应目标训练初始代理模型；Stage II利用协议间一致性（逐点评分可直接推导成对比较和列表排序），将逐点监督转化为成对和列表数据，无需额外查询，并通过多协议联合训练缓解灾难性遗忘。

Result: 在GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Qwen3-235B-A22B、DeepSeek V4 Pro及UniRRM等受害模型上，逐点、成对、列表评估准确率分别最高达73.3%、87.0%和71.6%，在475/480的指标比较中优于基线方法。在0.6B至32B不同规模的代理模型上效果稳定，对异常检测、反蒸馏扰动和所有权追踪等防御机制均保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: LLM评判能力可在受限黑盒监督下被有效复制，揭示了基于模型的评估服务面临的知识产权风险，亟需更强的保护机制。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly used across various evaluation scenarios, making their judgment capabilities valuable intellectual property. However, black-box access exposes these capabilities to model extraction attacks. Existing extraction methods do not specifically target LLM judges and provide limited support for multiple evaluation protocols under restricted query budgets. In this study, we propose JUDGESTEALER, the first query-efficient model extraction framework for replicating judging capabilities across pointwise scoring, pairwise comparison, and listwise ranking protocols. JUDGESTEALER exploits the strong cross-protocol agreement to acquire pointwise scores and transform them into pairwise and listwise supervisions without additional victim queries. To capture informative judge patterns and improve query efficiency, JUDGESTEALER dynamically selects pointwise inputs based on semantic diversity, predictive uncertainty, and potential judge biases. It further applies score smoothing and multi-protocol review to preserve the ordinal structure of scores and mitigate catastrophic forgetting during surrogate adaptation. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LLM-as-a-judge and reward models show that JUDGESTEALER consistently outperforms existing extraction baselines, achieving up to 73.3%, 87.0%, and 71.6% accuracy for pointwise, pairwise, and listwise evaluation, respectively. JUDGESTEALER also remains effective across different sur- rogate model scales, adaptation strategies, and reasoning settings. Moreover, JUDGESTEALER demonstrates robustness against representative extraction defenses.

</details>


### [96] [ITL: Interpretable Document Alignment with Structured Reference Frameworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27031)
*Raúl Giráldez,Dayrelis Mena,Jesús S. Aguilar--Ruiz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ITL（Intelligent Target Locator），一种领域无关、语言可移植的方法论，用于量化目标文档与结构化参考文档（SRD）之间的概念对齐程度，通过术语层面的亲和力度量实现可解释、可追溯的对齐分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文档对齐方法（如BM25、BERT、Sentence-BERT等密集检索方法）主要返回整体相似度分数或离散类别标签，缺乏概念级别的、可追溯到术语证据的细粒度对齐度量。组织（政府、大学、企业等）在评估文档与监管、战略或项目框架的对齐程度时，需要既可解释、可审计又可比较的量化指标。

Method: ITL包含两个阶段：(1) 参考模型归纳阶段——从SRD中为每个概念cj提取包含独立词（IND）、二元组（2G）、三元组（3G）和共现词（COC）的术语轮廓RTSj，并计算四个权重度量：基于归一化熵的区分度δ(t)、基于模式空间大小的特异性σ(t|RTSj)、相关性η(t|RTSj)和重要性φ(t|RTSj)=η·δ；(2) 文档对齐阶段——将目标文档D分割为文本单元Si，按相同语言学流程处理后，计算术语级、单元级和文档级的亲和力矩阵Λ(D,SRD)，其中单元级亲和力Λij= Σ f(t|Si)·φ(t|RTSj) / |T(Si)| ∈ [0,1]。同时定义参考亲和力λref和相对亲和力λrel作为解释锚点。

Result: 以联合国17个可持续发展目标（SDG）官方陈述作为SRD进行内部一致性评估：每个目标陈述均对其对应概念获得最高亲和力（对角线值0.18-0.38），非对角线均值比对角线均值低两个数量级，最大交叉亲和力（0.020）低于最低参考亲和力（0.18），证明方法能有效区分17个目标的术语轮廓；但该实验为自参照设置，未评估对未见文本或外部文档的泛化能力。

Conclusion: ITL提供了一种通用、领域无关、语言可移植的框架，用于量化文档与结构化参考框架的概念对齐，并通过术语层面的权重设计实现每个亲和力值的可追溯性。未来工作将扩展至外部文档、多领域、多语言验证，比较不同文档级聚合策略，并与语义对齐方法进行对比评估。

Abstract: Measuring alignment between documents and structured reference frameworks requires identifying conceptual evidence distributed throughout the text and reporting it through measures that are quantitative, interpretable, and traceable. Many commonly used retrieval and classification approaches return either pairwise similarity scores or one or more class labels, whereas fewer methods provide concept-level scores that are directly traceable to the terminological evidence supporting them. We present \emph{Intelligent Target Locator} (ITL), a domain-agnostic and language-portable methodology that estimates the affinity between the textual units of a target document and the concepts defined in a \emph{Structured Reference Document} ($SRD$). From the $SRD$, ITL induces concept-specific terminological profiles built from independent terms, bigrams, trigrams, and co-occurrences. Each term is assigned an importance weight that combines concept membership, term-type specificity and inter-concept discriminability. The output is a textual-unit--concept affinity matrix that can be aggregated at different levels of granularity. We conduct an internal consistency assessment using the 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), evaluating each official goal statement against the $SRD$ induced from the same set of descriptors. Every statement reached its highest affinity with the corresponding concept, and the mean affinity across the remaining concepts stayed marginal relative to the mean reference affinity. This separation indicates that ITL distinguishes the conceptual profiles of the framework. ITL thus offers a general basis for quantifying document alignment with structured frameworks while keeping each result traceable to the terminological evidence that supports it.

</details>


### [97] [Representing and Parsing Korean Constituency Structure at Different Levels of Granularity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27035)
*Jungyeul Park,KyungTae Lim,Zihao Huang,Eunkyul Leah Jo,Yige Chen,Chulwoo Park*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了韩语组块分析中终端单元（终结符）的表示问题，基于Penn韩语树库构建了三种表示（Morpheme+XPOS、Eojeol+XPOS、Eojeol+UPOS），并在统一的金标准标注条件下比较了自顶向下、中序和自底向上三种非二元转换系统的性能，最终从语言学和资源设计角度论证了以"语节（eojeol）"作为组块结构终端域的合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 韩语组块分析面临一个独特的表示挑战：短语结构树的终结符不对应于简单的表层词，而韩国语的"语节"（eojeol）是形态复杂的空格分隔单位，包含词干与格助词、动词词尾、派生后缀、辅助成分等。现有韩语句法资源（KAIST、世宗、Penn韩语树库）在如何表示语节内部形态和非显现成分上存在差异，这使得在统一比较韩语组块分析结果时面临表示层面的根本障碍。本文旨在解决韩语组块结构中"什么应作为终结符"这一核心表示问题。

Method: 1. 从Penn韩语树库出发，移除空元素，将显现语节与树库对齐，保留Penn韩语句法短语标签。2. 构造三种表示：(a) Morpheme+XPOS（以形态素为终结符，韩国语细粒度XPOS为预终结符）；(b) Eojeol+XPOS（以语节为终结符，组合XPOS序列为预终结符）；(c) Eojeol+UPOS（以语节为终结符，粗粒度UPOS为预终结符）。3. 在统一的Stanza双向LSTM编码器–LSTM堆栈框架下实现自顶向下（Dyer等2016）、中序（Liu和Zhang 2017）和自底向上显式arity（Fernández-González和Gómez-Rodríguez 2019）三种非二元转换系统。4. 所有实验使用金标准终端切分和金标准预终结符标签，将Morpheme+XPOS和Eojeol+XPOS的预测通过固定对齐投影到Eojeol+UPOS域进行统一评估，同时报告EVALB与jp-evalb两种F1指标，并按arity和树高度分解结果。

Result: 在统一Eojeol+UPOS域上的归一化评估下，Morpheme+XPOS的自底向上系统取得最佳性能（EVALB F1=84.76，jp-evalb F1=82.17）；Eojeol+XPOS显著优于Eojeol+UPOS（在底向上和顺序下几乎接近形态素条件）；Eojeol+UPOS原生解析大幅落后。转换顺序方面，自底向上普遍最优，顺序其次，自顶向下最弱。形态素切分虽带来更长的转换序列，但其提供的细粒度形态与XPOS证据能持续提升对语节层级短语结构的恢复，改进从底层向高层传播，并延伸至三元、四元及更高arity成分。

Conclusion: 在金标准切分与预终结条件下，细粒度形态与XPOS表示对所评估的基于转换的解析器具有重要价值。但这一经验发现仅关乎解析可用的信息，不决定语言学上更优的终端域。语言学和资源设计层面的理由支持将语节（eojeol）作为短语结构注释稳定且可解释的表层终端域，同时将形态素序列与XPOS信息作为对齐的形态句法证据加以保留。本文为面向表层的韩语组块解析、韩语树库转换、组块–依存互操作性以及在保持语节为终端域的同时利用形态信息的解析模型奠定了基础。

Abstract: Korean constituency parsing raises a representational challenge because the terminal units of a phrase-structure tree do not straightforwardly correspond to simple surface words. Korean eojeols are morphologically complex spacing units, and existing constituency resources differ in how they represent eojeol-internal morphology and non-overt elements. This paper compares three constituency parsing representations derived from the Penn Korean Treebank: Morpheme+XPOS, Eojeol+XPOS, and Eojeol+UPOS. We construct these representations by removing null elements, aligning Penn Korean phrase structure with overt eojeol tokens, preserving Penn Korean phrase labels where possible, and varying the terminal and preterminal layers. We then evaluate canonical non-binary transition-based constituency parsers in top-down, in-order, and bottom-up orders under a shared modeling and evaluation setup. All experiments use gold terminal segmentation and gold preterminal labels and therefore evaluate constituency parsing conditioned on gold morphosyntactic annotation. Eojeol terminals yield shorter transition sequences, but Eojeol+UPOS parsing substantially underperforms the morphologically richer conditions. Eojeol+XPOS narrows this gap, while Morpheme+XPOS gives the strongest results even after its predictions are projected to the eojeol terminal domain. Under these gold-annotation conditions, the results show that fine-grained morphological and XPOS representations provide valuable evidence for the evaluated parsers. This empirical finding concerns the information available for parsing and does not by itself determine the linguistically preferable terminal domain. Independently, linguistic and resource-design considerations motivate eojeol as a stable and interpretable surface domain for phrase-structure annotation, with morpheme-level and XPOS information retained as aligned morphosyntactic evidence.

</details>


### [98] [Reasoning about In-Context Samples for Machine-Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27036)
*Maxime Bouthors,Josep Crego,François Yvon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于片段（Fragment）的推理框架用于LLM机器翻译。模型先从检索到的相似范例中提取源-目标平行片段作为中间推理痕迹，再据此生成最终译文。通过从大模型蒸馏银片段来训练Qwen3-8B，在6种语言、16个领域的实验表明该方法显著优于标准k-shot提示和基本草稿方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CoT机器翻译研究主要模拟人类译者的通用推理过程（如术语分析、翻译、修订），但未充分利用翻译记忆库（TM）中检索到的相似范例所提供的精确片段匹配信息。如何让LLM在翻译过程中显式地从范例中识别并复用平行片段，是提升翻译质量（尤其是专业领域术语和短语层面）和翻译过程可追溯性的关键问题。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 使用Qwen3-32B作为教师模型，基于包含源句和k个检索范例的提示，生成"银片段"（平行源-目标片段对）和候选草稿；(2) 学生模型Qwen3-8B通过LoRA微调（rank=16，2个epoch，学习率2e-4）学习在生成最终译文前重现这些推理痕迹；(3) 训练了四个变体进行消融——基线(B)、仅草稿(D)、仅片段(F)和片段+草稿(F+D)。训练数据来自OPUS的16个领域/语对，每领域筛选10k高质量样本（共160k），检索采用BM25与Levenshtein距离结合。

Result: 在BLEU、COMET和MetricX三个指标上，基于片段的方法（F和F+D）显著优于基线（B）和仅草稿方法（D）。片段方法在16个领域中的14个取得胜率优势，且对检索范例数量k具有鲁棒性。在未训练的GNOME领域也表现出良好的泛化能力。源片段忠实度高达99.7%精度，但提取率（ER）从银片段的70%降至学生模型的35%，说明学生模型会生成而非仅提取片段。值得注意的是，草稿单独使用反而会降低翻译质量。

Conclusion: 片段提取（FE）作为一种推理形式能显著提升LLM机器翻译质量，且对检索噪声具有鲁棒性，可泛化至未见领域，并提供翻译过程的可追溯性。但草稿生成质量较低（BLEU约30 vs 银片段38），限制了其效用。未来方向包括：使用强化学习改进推理痕迹质量、增大k值（>3）、以及通过用户研究验证可追溯性的实用价值。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can be trained to perform chain-of-thoughts reasoning in order to improve the reliability of their responses. In this work, we investigate how explicit reasoning can be leveraged for LLM-Based Machine Translation (MT) with in-context samples. We introduce a novel fragment-based reasoning framework in which the model first extracts parallel source-target fragments from retrieved similar exemplars, and uses these fragments as intermediate reasoning traces to produce the final translation. To train our model, we distill silver fragments and drafts from a large teacher model. Our experiments with the Qwen3 model family, over 6 languages, including up to 5 domains per language, demonstrate that fragment-based MT significantly outperforms alternative methods like standard k-shot or basic drafting.

</details>


### [99] [Cascaded Batch Prompting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27038)
*Sho Hoshino,Peinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出级联批提示（Cascaded Batch Prompting）：先批量执行自由形式的类别推理，再把每个答案单独映射为受约束的类别符号，从而在基本保留批量推理吞吐优势的同时，提高或稳定分类准确率。GPT-4.1、GPT-4.1-mini 和 Phi-4 上的 MMLU/MNLI 实验显示，该方法总体优于单条提示，并在多数模型—任务组合上优于常规批提示；MMLU 最高达到 86.81%。代价是符号定位阶段增加一次逐样本调用，使实现层面的推理成本约为常规批提示的 1.2 倍，且超大批次仍可能出现输入—输出错位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规批提示虽然能在一次调用中并行处理多个样本并显著加速推理，但特殊格式要求和多实例上下文会增加模型负担，使准确率不可预测，甚至明显低于逐样本提示。论文认为其根源是模型在同一步中同时承担复杂语义推理和严格的符号输出约束；当批量扩大时，这种任务耦合更容易导致能力下降。因此，作者希望将认知任务拆分，在保留批处理效率的同时提高稳定性。

Method: 方法包含两个阶段：（1）推理阶段：模型以批大小 b 同时处理输入 x，并生成类别名称 n̂，而不承担最终符号格式约束，即 n̂=G_{x→n}(x)；（2）符号定位阶段：将上一阶段生成的类别名称送入另一个提示，由模型完成从 n̂ 到类别符号 ŝ 的映射，即 ŝ=G_{n→s}(n̂)。完整流程为 ŝ=G_{n→s}(G_{x→n}(x))。研究在 MMLU 多项选择问答和 MNLI 自然语言推理任务上，将该方法与单条提示、常规批提示比较；主要模型为 GPT-4.1、GPT-4.1-mini 和 Phi-4，批量大小为 1–128，并采用 top-p=0.9 的核采样。指标包括准确率、实例吞吐量和令牌吞吐量，显著性通过配对自助法检验。

Result: 在批量大小 32 的主实验中，GPT-4.1 上：MMLU 准确率分别为单提示 84.39%、常规批提示 85.51%、级联批提示 86.81%；MNLI 分别为 82.19%、86.14%、85.09%。GPT-4.1-mini 上，MMLU 为 80.12%、81.88%、82.96%，MNLI 为 82.60%、85.60%、86.20%。Phi-4 上，MMLU 为 74.34%、58.35%、77.18%，MNLI 为 82.15%、83.19%、83.57%。级联方法在所有 MMLU 设置中均最佳，并显著优于单提示；在 MNLI 上总体稳定且优于单提示，但不是在所有模型上击败常规批提示。级联单提示消融也持续优于普通单提示，说明收益主要来自任务分解，而不只是批处理。批大小扩展分析显示其性能总体更稳健，但大小达到 128 时，输入与输出行数不匹配会造成轻微下降；加入简单一致性检查只能将 GPT-4.1-mini 在 MMLU 上的准确率从 81.41% 提升至 81.61%，改善不显著。吞吐量方面，GPT-4.1 在 MMLU 上，单提示、常规批提示和级联批提示的输入令牌吞吐分别为 4,910、18,990、23,341 tokens/s；实例级分析则表明级联方法形成更高准确率与吞吐量的 Pareto 前沿。代价方面，级联实现需要 N/b 次批量推理调用及 N 次逐样本定位调用，成本约为常规批提示的 1.2 倍。

Conclusion: 论文的结论是：常规批提示的不可预测性主要来自语义推理与符号格式定位的耦合，而非批处理本身。级联批提示通过把两者分离，能够在扩大批量时维持更稳定、通常更高的分类准确率，同时保留接近批大小所对应的吞吐量收益；MMLU 上的优势最一致、最显著。方法适用于需要从自由形式推理结果映射到严格类别符号的分类任务。其主要限制是任务范围较窄、级联符号定位仍产生额外推理成本，并且在超大批次下可能发生输出缺失或错位。对开放式生成任务的适用性尚未验证。

Abstract: Although batch prompting makes large language model inference more efficient by processing multiple instances simultaneously, it suffers from unpredictable downstream task performance. We propose cascaded batch prompting, a two-stage approach designed to resolve the unpredictability of conventional batch prompting by disentangling complex reasoning from symbol grounding. Experiments on multiple-choice question answering and natural language inference demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the standard single prompting baseline while achieving a speedup proportional to batch size, establishing a new state of the art on the Pareto frontier.

</details>


### [100] [Research Design Tracking and Assessment for the Social Sciences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27049)
*Marco Rovera,Sergiu Burlacu,Dominique Cappelletti,Alessio Tomelleri,Sonia Marzadro,Martina Bazzoli,Annalisa Tassi,Jessica Gagete-Miranda*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 ARDTrA（Automated Research Design Tracking and Assessment）任务，旨在利用 NLP 技术自动检测社会科学论文中使用的因果研究设计并评估其应用质量。作者构建了一个由 8 位领域专家标注的 140 篇论文数据集，涵盖六类反事实研究设计，并在多轮 RAG 对话式管道上系统评估了 4 种检索策略、4 个 LLM 与 6 个嵌入模型。结果表明：平均段落长度是性能的主要驱动因素（解释 52%-66% 的方差），BM25 在平均表现上与密集检索相当或更优，且人类标注者间一致性较低的论文类型并非模型表现最差的类型，揭示了人类难度与机器难度是相互独立的两个维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在社会科学中，可靠地评估因果研究设计对循证决策至关重要，但此前完全依赖人工专家分析。该任务既缺乏形式化分析框架，也缺乏公开的专家标注评测数据集。本文旨在弥合这一空白，推动 NLP 在这一领域特定文档分析任务中的应用。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 设计专家分析框架，将任务分为 RD Identification（6 个问题）和 RD Assessment（按设计类型分为 9-16 个问题，共 76 题）；(2) 由 8 位专家标注 140 篇论文的语料库，并通过 3 位专家对 24 篇独立标注计算 IAA；(3) 使用多轮 RAG 对话管道，比较 BM25、Dense、Adaptive Auto-merging、Propositional Topic-aware 四种检索策略，以及 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-32B、Llama-3.3-70B、gpt-5.1 四种 LLM 和六种嵌入模型，并以长上下文窗口（32K tokens）作为非检索基线。评估以答案选项为单位计算精确率、召回率和 F1。

Result: 实验共进行了 164 轮。结果发现：(a) 平均段落长度与 F1 高度相关（Pearson r 0.73-0.82），解释 52%-66% 方差，gpt-5.1 除外；(b) 在按嵌入模型平均后，BM25 匹配或优于所有密集策略；(c) 嵌入模型选择影响较小，bge-large-en-v1.5 在稳健性与性能间提供最佳平衡；(d) 长上下文提示是强基线，多数检索配置未能超越；(e) RD 间难度存在差异（TbD 最易，IV 最难），但人类标注一致性与机器表现之间无显著相关，表明两者受不同因素驱动。

Conclusion: ARDTrA 任务成功形式化了社会科学论文中因果研究设计的自动追踪与评估，并证明在专家级文档分析中，检索策略本身并非性能的决定因素，段落长度才是关键；人类判断的难度与机器检索的难度是两个相互独立的维度。未来工作将探讨语言学因素和文档结构对剩余方差的贡献，以及人类与机器难度分歧的普适性。

Abstract: Reliable assessment of causal research designs in the social sciences is critical for evidence-based policy-making, yet has so far relied entirely on manual expert analysis. We introduce Automated Research Design Tracking and Assessment (ARDTrA), a task that involves detecting the research design used in a paper and assessing the quality of its application. We create an expert-annotated dataset of papers covering six families of counterfactual research designs and evaluate the task using a multi-turn RAG-based conversational pipeline. Across four retrieval strategies, four LLMs and six embedding models, we find that passage length is the main driver of performance, explaining 52-66% of the variance. A per-research-design analysis also shows that human and machine difficulty do not align: the designs that prove hardest for the system are not those on which expert annotators disagree most, pointing to two independent sources of task difficulty.

</details>


### [101] [DocTalkBN: A Novel Dataset of Expert Telemedicine Conversations in Bengali](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27110)
*Anik Saha,Fahmida Sultana Naznin,Sadatul Islam Sadi,Ananya Shahrin Promi,Wahid Al Azad Navid,Rifat Shahriyar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了DocTalkBN，一个面向孟加拉语（Bengali）的大规模多模态真实远程医疗对话数据集，并基于该数据集构建了三个下游基准任务，评测了多种大语言模型与编码器基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学对话AI需要真实可靠的医患交互数据，但在低资源语言（如孟加拉语）中此类数据集极为稀缺。现有医学对话资源大多来自医学论坛、书面健康内容或合成数据，缺乏真实临床交互中的自发性、上下文丰富性以及口语特征，难以支持文化适配的医疗NLP研究。

Method: 从孟加拉国国家级电视远程医疗节目（YouTube公开视频，1934个）中收集数据，利用Qwen3-30B-Instruct过滤与标注医学专科，使用YouTube自动生成的孟加拉语字幕结合人工审核（5名独立标注员）校验转录质量，经BNLP工具包进行PII匿名化处理后，使用Gemini-3-Flash重建结构化对话（区分医患通话与主持人-医生问答），最终构建包含1515个多轮医患通话与10274个主持人-医生问答的数据集（共557.63小时音频、1.7M tokens、26个医学专科）。随后使用Gemini-2.5-Flash结合多标注员人工验证构建三个下游任务数据集：1）医疗分诊分类（四类：自我照护/常规门诊/检查或转诊/急诊）；2）建议安全性评估（二分类：SAFE/HARMFUL，基于建议单元粒度）；3）医学命名实体识别（七类实体）。在LLM上采用zero-shot与few-shot提示，在编码器模型（BanglaBERT、mmBERT）上进行微调，使用macro-F1作为评估指标。

Result: 实验结果显示：1）医疗分诊任务最具挑战性，最佳macro-F1仅0.463（Llama 3 70B Instruct zero-shot），GPT-4o few-shot以0.448位列第二；2）建议安全性评估相对容易，所有模型macro-F1均超过0.92，GPT-4o few-shot取得最佳0.976；3）医学NER任务中Qwen 3.5 Flash zero-shot以0.743的严格F1略胜微调后的BanglaBERT（0.742），GPT-5 Mini与DeepSeek V3.2表现接近（0.704与0.694），Llama 3 70B Instruct表现最弱（0.489）。整体而言，临床推理类任务（如分诊）对当前LLM仍具较大难度，而建议安全性与NER相对更易处理；few-shot提示对大多数任务有轻微提升，但Llama 3 70B Instruct在分诊与安全性任务中出现轻微下降。错误分析表明，分诊任务中模型常混淆"常规门诊"与"转诊"决策，NER任务中存在过度预测泛化医学词与边界错误问题。

Conclusion: DocTalkBN是首个面向孟加拉语的大规模多模态真实远程医疗对话数据集，保留了真实临床交互的口语特征与上下文丰富性。基于该数据集构建的三个基准任务（分诊、建议安全性、NER）有效揭示了当前LLM在临床推理型任务上的局限性，为低资源语言医疗NLP、对话AI及更安全的医疗技术研究提供了有价值的资源。数据集与代码已公开。

Abstract: Reliable medical conversational AI requires authentic expert--patient interaction data, yet such datasets remain scarce, especially for low-resource languages such as Bengali. We present DocTalkBN, a large-scale multimodal dataset of real-world expert telemedicine conversations in Bengali, collected from nationally broadcast telemedicine programs featuring board-certified physicians. DocTalkBN contains 557.63 hours of paired audio and text, 1,515 multi-turn patient calls, 10,274 host--doctor question--answer exchanges, totaling 1.7M tokens, spanning 26 medical specialties. Unlike prior resources derived from medical forums, written health content, or synthetic data, our dataset preserves the spontaneity, contextual richness, and spoken characteristics of authentic medical interactions in a low-resource setting. To support benchmark-driven research, we further construct three downstream tasks from the corpus, medical triage classification, advice safety evaluation, and medical named entity recognition, and benchmark a diverse set of large language models and encoder-based baselines. Our results show that DocTalkBN is a practically useful resource, particularly for clinically grounded reasoning tasks. We release this resource to facilitate future research on reliable medical NLP and safer, more culturally grounded healthcare systems for low-resource languages. Our source codes and dataset are publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [102] [Cross-Lingual Alignment Without Joint Training: Do Monolingual Language Models Converge on Universal Representations?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27115)
*Ej Zhou,Suchir Salhan,Catherine Arnett,Anna Korhonen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究独立训练的单语语言模型之间是否能在无需联合训练的情况下实现跨语言对齐。研究发现，这些模型确实发展出可对齐的表征几何结构，一个简单的Procrustes旋转即可在模型间映射隐藏状态，并且该旋转能够跨模型传递事实内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将多语言模型的跨语言对齐归因于联合训练（共享参数、混合语言批次或显式对齐目标）。本文质疑这一假设的最严格形式：若两个模型在不同语料、不同语言上独立训练，无任何共享参数或对齐信号，它们的表征是否仍可对齐？这关系到语言无关的概念表征是否能仅从语料中自发涌现，对柏拉图表征假说进行跨语言检验。

Method: 采用三层递进证据标准：(1) 相关性分析，使用线性CKA度量独立训练的单语模型在平行句对上的表征相似度，以随机打乱为对照，并在不同训练数据规模（5MB至1000MB）和不同架构的~1B模型间进行验证；(2) 构造性分析，比较Procrustes正交旋转、仿射映射和单隐层MLP三种投影方法在表征重建和检索任务上的表现；(3) 因果分析，采用跨模型激活修补（cross-model activation patching），将旋转后的英语残差注入德语等模型的残差流，在事实完形填空任务（如国家→首都）上检验是否改变模型预测。

Result: 关键结果包括：(1) 在Goldfish 9语言模型和5个独立开发的~1B模型上，匹配CKA显著高于随机打乱基线（SGPT池化下FLORES匹配CKA均值0.78 vs 随机0.17），且对齐随数据/模型规模增大及语言相似度提升而增强；(2) 单一Procrustes旋转即可达到88.7%的检索准确率（P@1），在检索任务上优于更灵活的仿射和MLP映射（尽管后者在MSE和CKA上更优）；(3) 旋转后的英语残差注入德语模型后，在85%的跨事实对上将预测翻转为供体模型的答案（语言内上界为98%），远超随机高斯对照（约50%）和未投影对照（低于50%）；(4) 该旋转可零样本迁移到新任务、新词位置和新关系类型。

Conclusion: 跨语言对齐可以从语言结构和其承载的信息中自发涌现，而非必须依赖联合训练。这意味着可以用少量锚点对将独立训练的单语模型"拼接"为多语言系统，为模块化多语言系统、模型融合和模型缝合提供了实用方向。研究局限在于语言覆盖偏向高资源印欧语系，参数量限于~1B（更大模型因数据中存在多语言内容难以严格单语化），且评估限于事实探针而非开放式生成。

Abstract: Cross-lingual alignment in multilingual language models is typically attributed to joint training: shared parameters, mixed-language batches, or explicit alignment objectives. We ask whether monolingual models trained on non-parallel data learn alignable representations without joint training. By testing on strictly monolingual language models, such as the Goldfish model families and independently developed models from different research labs, we find three results. Correlation: these models develop alignable representational geometry across layers, with alignment strengthening as data scale, model scale, or linguistic proximity increases. Construction: a single Procrustes rotation fit on parallel sentences maps hidden states between models. Causation: the same rotation transfers functional content; patching a rotated English residual into a German model on a factual cloze flips the prediction to the donor's capital in most cases. We confirm that cross-lingual alignment can emerge from the structure of language and the information it carries rather than from joint training, and this points to practical future directions including model stitching, merging, and modular multilingual systems built from monolingual components.

</details>


### [103] [TwinKV: A Composable Repair Pass for KV Cache Eviction via Pairwise Key Redundancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27128)
*Hong Chen,Yudong Zeng,Yongwei Huang,Zuhao Ouyang,Junyan Zhang,Xuming Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 TwinKV，一种基于键向量两两冗余度的免训练、无注意力信号，将其作为可组合的"修复通道"（repair pass），在任意现有 KV cache 驱逐策略选定的保留集合上进行审计与交换：识别被误删的无副本"孤儿"与被保留但有副本的"冗余供体"，在不改变原策略预算与打分规则的前提下完成替换。该修复通道被验证可与四种近期驱逐策略（StreamingLLM、PyramidKV、SnapKV、ExpectedAttention）组合，在 LongBench、LooGLE、RULER 与短上下文 MMLU-Pro 控制集上以压缩比 {0.3, 0.5, 0.7} 评估 Qwen3-4B 与 Llama-3.2-1B 两个模型家族。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理受 KV cache 内存瓶颈制约，对资源受限的小模型尤为突出。现有主流驱逐方法以注意力大小作为重要性代理，但本文通过留一法探针在真实长上下文 QA 数据上测得注意力与 token 对正确答案的因果边际效用几乎完全不相关（Spearman ρ=−0.004, p=0.96），从而质疑整个"注意力—重要性"假设链。同时基于全局锚点（上下文均值）的注意力无关替代方案只能衡量"全局独特性"，无法识别"局部唯一性"——即某个事实是否在上下文其他地方被重复。

Method: TwinKV 以每个 token 的键向量为单位，计算其在排除局部窗口 w（默认 32）后的非邻近近重复（余弦相似度 > τ，默认 Qwen3 上 0.85、Llama 上 0.90）的计数 r_i，分数为 −r_i/n，并强制保留首部 sink 与尾部 recent 窗口。其作为修复通道时：对任意策略 S_0，找出 b_i(S_0) < τ 的孤儿（被删但无存活副本）与 b_j(S_0) ≥ τ 的冗余供体（被保留但有等价副本），按严重度排序后两两交换，保持 |S_1| = |S_0| = K。针对 LongRoPE 等非均匀 RoPE 调度，推导出旋转不变形式以避免将位置旋转混入内容冗余。计算复杂度为 O(n²d)，与注意力同阶。

Result: 在 Qwen3-4B 上，修复通道在 LongBench/LooGLE 上对 StreamingLLM（最多 64% 单元改善）、PyramidKV（57%）、SnapKV（41%）多数配置有效，ExpectedAttention（16%）因已接近性能上限而收益有限；RULER 上三个非上限策略在所有 (长度×压缩比) 单元上均获改善，PyramidKV 提升高达 +21.86 均值（4K/0.5：31.15→70.92）。Llama-3.2-1B 在 LongBench/LooGLE 上绝对均值增幅更小但正向比例更高，RULER 上包括 ExpectedAttention 在内全部策略在每个单元均获改善。失败模式仅出现在 LongBench TREC（少样本分类模板），因示例间距过窄导致假阳性 twin，可通过加宽窗口 w=64–128、提高 τ=0.95–0.97 修复。短上下文 MMLU-Pro 控制表明在低冗余场景下修复通道无改进空间且可能小幅退化。

Conclusion: TwinKV 验证了"键向量两两冗余度"作为免训练、无注意力信号可有效修正现有驱逐策略的结构性失误；其作为可组合修复通道（而非独立策略）的设计允许在不动原策略打分规则与预算的前提下提升多数配置。但其效果受策略起点（是否已接近上限）、任务结构（是否存在真实重复 vs 模板回声）、上下文冗余度共同制约，应作为针对结构性失败的补充机制而非通用替代方案。

Abstract: Long-context inference is bottlenecked by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache, especially for small models under tight resource budgets. Existing KV cache eviction methods score tokens using the model's attention distribution or, in attention-free variants, each key's distance from a global reference point. Using a controlled leave-one-out probe, we find that attention magnitude is unrelated to a token's causal contribution to the answer (Spearman $\rho=-0.004$), challenging the premise behind dominant eviction methods. We introduce TwinKV, a training-free, attention-free redundancy signal that detects whether a token's key has a near-duplicate elsewhere in context. Rather than replacing existing policies, TwinKV acts as a composable repair pass: given a policy's fixed retained set, it identifies evicted tokens with no surviving duplicate (\emph{orphans}) and retained tokens whose information is duplicated elsewhere (\emph{redundant donors}), then swaps them while preserving the original budget and scoring rule. We compose TwinKV with four recent eviction policies across LongBench, LooGLE, RULER, and a short-context MMLU-Pro no-harm control at compression ratios ${0.3,0.5,0.7}$. On Qwen3-4B, TwinKV improves a majority of configurations for two policies, is near-even for a third, and helps only a minority for a fourth adaptive baseline already near a performance ceiling; gains across the three non-ceiling policies are smallest at the loosest ratio. On RULER with Llama-3.2-1B, however, that fourth policy improves in every evaluated cell because its Alone score leaves substantial room to improve. More broadly, Llama-3.2-1B shows a smaller average LongBench gain but a higher fraction of improved cells on LongBench and LooGLE than Qwen3-4B, plus a clean RULER win. We also identify few-shot classification exemplars as a task structure where TwinKV does not help on either model.

</details>


### [104] [Said Aloud, Read Different: Cross-Modal Instability in Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27135)
*Basel Mousi,Fahim Dalvi,Shammur Chowdhury,Firoj Alam,Nadir Durrani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种针对多模态模型的对比不稳定性(CI)评测基准，揭示语音输入（尤其是阿拉伯语）会引发显著的跨模态决策不一致，即使聚合准确率保持较高水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多在单一模态内评估多模态模型的幻觉或一致性，而忽视了当语义等价的查询以不同模态（文本 vs. 语音）和语言（英语 vs. 阿拉伯语）呈现时，模型的视觉接地决策是否真正一致。聚合准确率无法捕捉到决策边界层面的碎片化推理失败。

Method: 1. 构建了涵盖18个MENA国家、10,150个文化接地图像的对比三元组基准（每图含1个支持陈述Q+和2个合理但不支持的替代项Q-），并经过图像盲过滤和人工验证（Gwet's AC1 ≈ 0.996 for Need-Image）。
2. 提出对比不稳定性(Contrastive Instability, CI)指标：CI = 1 - N_consistent/N_partial，条件于至少部分正确的三元组，隔离碎片化推理与完全失败。
3. 合成英语/阿拉伯语语音版本（含男女声及加噪/混响扰动），在Qwen2.5-Omni (3B/7B)、Qwen3-30B-Omni和Phi-4-multimodal上进行文本与语音对比评估。

Result: 核心发现：
1. CI揭示了聚合准确率无法捕捉的不一致性：例如Q2.5-3B阿拉伯语文本F1达0.77但CI高达0.43。
2. 语音显著放大不稳定性，尤其在阿拉伯语中（Q2.5-3B: 文本CI 0.43 → 语音CI 0.71；Q2.5-7B: 0.35→0.63；Q3-30B: 0.28→0.47），英语则相对稳定。
3. 阿拉伯语的CI系统性高于英语，且语音进一步扩大跨语言差距。
4. 模型规模增大降低CI（如阿拉伯语文本CI从0.43降至0.28），但无法消除跨模态/跨语言不一致。
5. 低SNR条件下CI单调上升，阿拉伯语对声学退化更敏感。
6. 联合语音-文本输入缓解但不能完全恢复纯文本稳定性。

Conclusion: 模态并非中立输入通道：语音（尤其在阿拉伯语中）会在保持语句级准确率的同时损害三元组级决策一致性。CI作为互补诊断指标，能有效揭示标准准确率无法反映的接地推理碎片化。模型缩放和联合信号虽提升鲁棒性，但未能彻底解决跨模态与跨语言的不稳定性问题。对比评估对于超越准确率诊断接地推理稳定性至关重要。

Abstract: Multimodal foundation models are increasingly used in speech-first assistants that must interpret spoken queries and produce visually grounded decisions. Yet it remains unclear whether semantically equivalent queries yield consistent judgments across modality (text vs. speech) and language (English vs. Arabic). We introduce a speech-augmented visually grounded contrastive triplet benchmark spanning 10,150 culturally grounded images from 18 MENA countries, where each image is paired with one supported statement and two plausible but unsupported alternatives. We define contrastive instability as the conditional rate at which a model fails to resolve all statements within a triplet, isolating fragmented reasoning from complete failure. Evaluating recent multimodal models under text and speech in English and Arabic, we find that modality and language shifts introduce substantial triplet-level inconsistencies that are not fully captured by aggregate accuracy, with speech amplifying partial failures. We make the benchmark publicly available to the community.

</details>


### [105] [STAR : Sentence Translation Alignment Rate for Document-to-Document Machine Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27161)
*Yichen Dong,Hao Wang,Junhui Li,Linlong Xu,Longyue Wang,Weihua Luo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对文档级机器翻译（Doc2Doc）中常见的句子级结构失对齐问题（如漏译、幻觉），提出了一种新的辅助度量指标STAR（Sentence Translation Alignment Rate），并基于此设计了一种偏好优化框架StarPO，通过动态对齐掩码聚焦于失对齐句段。实验在新闻与文学领域表明，紧凑模型借助StarPO可超越GPT-4o等大型专有系统，同时保持更优的token效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM推动了从句子级到文档到文档（Doc2Doc）翻译的范式转变，但单遍Doc2Doc生成常出现结构性失对齐，表现为句子遗漏或幻觉，违反了源-目标对应的核心要求。现有方法多采用Sent2Sent或Chunk2Chunk范式以隐式避免结构失对齐，但这牺牲了全局规划能力并增加了计算开销。因此，亟需一种能显式量化并优化文档级翻译结构保真度的方法。

Method: 1) **STAR度量**：对源/目标文档分句（使用SaT），通过Bertalign进行句级对齐形成最小对齐单元（u_k=(s_k, t_k)），分为四类：1-to-1（U_{1:1}）、删除（U_{1:0}）、插入（U_{0:1}）和复杂对齐（U_{complex}）。STAR定义为U_{1:1}占总对齐单元的比例，并提出STAR_relax（将复杂对齐视为正例，仅惩罚遗漏和幻觉）。2) **偏好数据构建**：使用GPT-4o为每个源文档生成5个翻译候选，根据STAR分数排序并按分数差阈值τ=0.1筛选构成偏好对。3) **StarPO训练**：采用SFT冷启动后进行CPO优化，但用STAR掩码似然替代标准文档似然——掩码M(t_j)=1-I_{1:1}(t_j)，即排除已良好对齐的句子，仅在结构失对齐句段上计算偏好损失，从而避免梯度饱和，聚焦于关键结构问题。

Result: 在News-Commentary（10个语言方向）和Guofeng网络小说数据集上，基于LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B和Qwen-3-4B三类基座模型进行实验。StarPO在dCOMET和d-BLEU上均持续优于Base、SFT和标准CPO；例如LLaMA-3.1上StarPO相对CPO平均提升0.48 COMET。紧凑模型配合StarPO可超越Tower-plus-9B、GPT-4o和DeepSeek-R1等强大基线。LLM-as-a-judge评估（流畅度、内容错误、连贯性）也证实StarPO全面优于CPO和强基线。STAR本身与LLM标注的结构对齐质量Spearman相关性达0.5808（严格）/0.5774（宽松），显著优于Align-then-Slide、SEGALE及基于长度的基线（ρ<0.2）。消融实验验证严格STAR优于宽松STAR，对齐感知掩码优于随机掩码。

Conclusion: 本文提出了STAR度量与StarPO框架，有效缓解了Doc2Doc翻译中的句子遗漏与幻觉问题。通过动态掩码策略聚焦结构失对齐句段，StarPO在多个语言对和领域上一致提升了翻译质量与结构完整性，使紧凑模型能以更高token效率超越大规模专有系统。该工作为文档级翻译提供了无需复杂代理工作流的鲁棒优化范式。局限在于：当前验证集中于4B-9B紧凑模型和中高资源语言；偏好数据构建仍依赖GPT-4o生成候选，未实现完全开源离线流程。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a shift from sentence-level to document-to-document (Doc2Doc) machine translation, promising improved global coherence. However, document-to-document generation in a single pass frequently suffers from structural misalignment, manifesting as sentence omissions or hallucinations that violate the core requirement of source-target correspondence. To address this, we introduce Sentence Translation Alignment Rate (STAR), an auxiliary metric that explicitly quantifies sentence-level structural fidelity. Building on this, we propose STAR-masked Preference Optimization (StarPO), a framework that ranks document-level hypotheses by structural quality and utilizes a dynamic alignment mask to focus optimization on misaligned segments. Experimental results across news and literary domains demonstrate that StarPO significantly enhances translation quality and structural integrity. Notably, StarPO allows compact models to surpass the performance of massive proprietary systems like GPT-4o while maintaining superior token efficiency.

</details>


### [106] [Prediction of Prediction (PoP): Inter-Layer Activation Fusion for Single-Pass Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27165)
*Himal Badu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PoP（Prediction of Prediction）是一种在单次前向传播中通过融合Transformer各层中间隐藏状态来检测大语言模型事实性幻觉的机制，在TruthfulQA上达到75.5% AUROC，延迟开销低于1.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法存在两类局限：基于输出logit的不确定性度量在模型对错误断言过度自信时失效；多采样验证管线带来显著的内存和延迟开销。作者探索在单次前向传播中利用内部隐藏状态的层间转换动态来捕捉事实性错误的信号。

Method: PoP通过前向钩子捕获各层隐藏状态，计算相邻层归一化状态之间的余弦距离作为转换散度，用可学习深度权重聚合得到轨迹散度统计量；通过跨层注意力机制（Q/K/V投影）融合各层信息得到融合状态，结合转换向量和时序漂移构成元表示；最终由两层MLP评分头输出步级幻觉概率U_t，并经Platt缩放校准得到序列级分数。算法复杂度为O(L²d_k + Ld)，每解码步仅需一次生成器前向传播，零辅助生成调用。

Result: 在Llama-3-8B-Instruct上，TruthfulQA AUROC达75.5%，HaluEval达74.6%，P@R90为54.2%，优于对数熵、困惑度、静态探针、谱几何方法和DeBERTa NLI基线；校准后ECE从0.142降至0.031；延迟增加0.3ms/token（24.4ms/token），吞吐损失仅1.2%，VRAM额外开销18.4MB。跨模型迁移（Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B）和跨域迁移（FaithDial）AUROC下降不超过3.5个百分点；消融实验表明层序对性能贡献最大（打乱层序使AUROC降至58.3%），随机特征控制降至50.1%。

Conclusion: PoP证明有序的层间转换动态包含预测事实性错误的信息，且该贡献超出最佳单层探针和匹配容量的MLP基线。该机制是预测性而非因果性的，不应被过度解读为内部激活检测幻觉的通用声明；其适用性受限于白盒访问、激活内存、英语短文本场景。

Abstract: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) routinely generate factually incorrect outputs with high decoding confidence, limiting their deployment in high-stakes workflows. Existing output-stage uncertainty metrics can fail when models are overconfident on false assertions, while multi-sample verification pipelines introduce substantial memory and latency overhead. This work evaluates whether internal hidden-state transition dynamics during generation can signal factual errors without auxiliary decoding calls. We introduce Prediction of Prediction (PoP), a mechanism that captures layer-transition uncertainty by fusing intermediate hidden representations across depth during a single forward pass. Evaluated on the TruthfulQA benchmark using autoregressive transformer backbones, PoP achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 75.5% for factual-correctness classification. The mechanism operates within the base forward pass, adding less than 1.2% runtime latency and requiring zero additional generation passes.
