The numerical results are reported from the author-verified experimental implementation and are bounded by the evaluation scope described below.

</details>


### [107] [BALMS: Benchmarking Agentic LLMs for Longitudinal Mental Health Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27219)
*Yu Yvonne Wu,Arvind Pillai,Yuliang Chen,Yuwei Zhang,Sudarshan Regmi,Tess Z. Griffin,Michael V. Heinz,Lisa A. Marsch,Nicholas C. Jacobson,Andrew Campbell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BALMS 是首个面向纵向心理健康感知任务的 LLM 智能体系统基准,覆盖 3 个真实纵向数据集、2 类任务、3 种智能体范式与 5 种 LLM backbone,系统评估了零样本心理健康分数预测与证据驱动推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统心理健康评估依赖稀疏的自报量表,难以捕捉长期行为动态。现有可穿戴设备+LLM 智能体仅支持短窗口事实查询,无法评估其基于长程信号推理并生成证据对齐解释的能力,因此需要一个系统性基准。

Method: 构建 BALMS 基准:在 DiversityOne、PMData、GLOBEM 三个纵向数据集上,实现 prompt-based (Health-LLM)、tool-based (PHIA)、memory-based (Chunk RAG 与 RAPTOR) 三种智能体范式,跨 5 种 LLM backbone 评估。任务 T1 为闭式心理健康分数预测(MAE),任务 T2 为开放式推理生成,采用 Llama-3.3-70B 作为 LLM-as-Judge,按 6 项时序推理维度与 5 项通用质量维度双层评分。

Result: 1) 零样本智能体仅在更强 backbone 或紧凑语义特征下才能超越均值基线;2) CoT 主要提升推理导向 backbone(DeepSeek、Claude),最高带来 41.4% 的 MAE 下降,但不保证时间对齐与数值正确;3) 仅 Claude-Haiku-4.5 兼顾解释质量与时间对齐,开源 instruct 模型流畅但 C1/C5 调用近零;4) PHIA 在 PMData 上表现良好但在 GLOBEM/DiversityOne 出现 86% 模式坍缩,源于 5 类失败(静默执行、状态丢失、力终幻觉、魔法阈值、模式盲聚合);5) 长窗口下 Health-LLM 退化,RAG 受益最多(PMData MAE 下降约 29%),PHIA 稳定但延迟高且对 schema 敏感;6) 弃用原始手机流仅保留 Fitbit 语义特征,常匹配或超越全模态基线。

Conclusion: 纵向心理健康智能体的关键在于选择性检索历史、时间对齐证据与可解释行为特征推理,而非依赖更长上下文或更多传感器;BALMS 为未来时序智能体设计提供标准化评估基础设施。

Abstract: Mental health assessment relies on episodic self-report scales, which convert subjective states such as stress into numerical scores but provide only sparse snapshots of wellbeing. Wearable devices offer longitudinal behavioral and physiological signals for continuous, low-burden monitoring. Recent LLM-driven personal-health agents enable natural language queries over wearable signals, but mainly handle short-term, retrieval-based lookups (e.g., highest step count over a week). They do not evaluate whether agents can reason over long-term signals to predict wellbeing scores paired with evidence-grounded rationales. To address this gap, we introduce BALMS, the first systematic benchmark of LLM-based agentic systems for longitudinal mental health sensing. BALMS spans 3 real-world longitudinal datasets, 2 task families (closed-form wellbeing-score prediction and rationale generation auto-graded by an LLM-as-Judge), 3 agentic paradigms evaluated across 5 open- and closed-source LLM backbones. We find that zero-shot agents rarely outperform a simple mean baseline, except with stronger backbones or compact, semantically meaningful features. Chain-of-thought prompting improves reasoning-oriented backbones, but does not guarantee temporal grounding or numerical correctness. Together with more analysis on efficiency and temporal scaling, BALMS highlights the need for longitudinal mental health agents that selectively retrieve history, ground temporal evidence, and reason over interpretable behavioral features.

</details>


### [108] [SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27265)
*Yi Ding,Lijun Huang,Menglin Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SCIT（Suffix Cache Interchange Test），一种用于定位隐式思维链模型中因果计算载体的因果诊断方法。在CODI-GPT2上证明了反事实算术主要通过值缓存后缀轨迹传递，而非隐藏状态、键或单令牌触发；同时揭示了8B模型会转移到prompt-prefix K/V的载体偏移现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐式链式思维模型将中间推理从文本转移到连续状态，提高了紧凑性但隐藏了因果对象。现有分析通常将潜在步骤本身视为因果变量，但无法确定是哪个transformer内部对象（隐藏状态、键、值、缓存段等）承载了反事实计算效应，因此需要一种更精细的载体定位诊断方法。

Method: SCIT是一种四步因果协议：(1) 构造精确的源-接收者反事实对，在特定潜在步对源缓存片段进行修补；(2) 选择干预选项（源类型、缓存段、键/值组件、隐藏状态耦合）；(3) 验证读数（目标胜率、对数概率边际、自由生成、匹配随机损坏）；(4) 分配载体状态（活跃载体、载体偏移、无调用）。在CODI-GPT2和Sim-CoT-GPT2上使用合成的两跳算术任务（球/书/硬币词汇变体）进行评估，并通过1B/8B扩展任务进行载体机制校准。

Result: 在CODI-GPT2算术检查点上，建立了完整的充分性与必要性证据支持"晚值后缀机制"：值缓存后缀（特别是层8-9）传递反事实答案（TW 0.875-0.992），而隐藏状态、键、相同答案、部分变量控制均较弱；匹配损坏将目标胜率降至0.211。Sim-CoT-GPT2展示相同的充分性但损坏证据较弱。载体机制存在规模/任务门控：算术类GPT-2/1B单元保留潜在尾部值/KV传递，而有能力的8B和修复的非算术单元通过prompt-prefix或全缓存K/V路由（边界单元无机制调用）。训练路径敏感性显示新CODI种子未能复制原始载体。

Conclusion: SCIT贡献了三项成果：(1) 一种缓存级因果契约用于隐式CoT展开；(2) 一个检查点特定的CODI-GPT2算术载体（上下文绑定的值缓存后缀轨迹），具有Sim-CoT-GPT2的充分性佐证；(3) 一个能力门控的载体机制图，将局部机制证据与规模、任务、种子和支持边界分离。文章强调不应将单一潜在尾部映射作为通用部署保证，而应将其视为针对特定检查点、模板和干预定义的诊断框架。

Abstract: Latent chain-of-thought models move intermediate reasoning from emitted text into continuous states, improving compactness but hiding the causal object. We introduce SCIT, the Suffix Cache Interchange Test, a causal protocol that constructs exact source-recipient counterfactuals, patches declared cache segments, and identifies which transformer object carries the counterfactual computation. SCIT combines sufficiency tests with K/V component splits, hidden-state controls, semantic source controls, decoded validation, and matched corruption. On CODI-GPT2 and a Sim-CoT-style GPT-2 reproduction, counterfactual arithmetic transfers primarily through value-cache suffix trajectories rather than hidden states, keys, reusable answer slots, or single-token triggers. Complete sufficiency-and-necessity evidence for the late-value-suffix mechanism holds for the main CODI-GPT2 checkpoint; the Sim-CoT-style checkpoint shows the same sufficiency and decoded-control pattern but insufficient matched-corruption evidence for a necessity call. Beyond these local arithmetic cells, SCIT reveals carrier-regime shifts: arithmetic-like GPT-2/1B cells preserve latent-tail value/KV transfer, whereas competent 8B and repaired non-arithmetic cells route through prompt-prefix or full-cache K/V; boundary cells receive no mechanism call. SCIT therefore contributes a cache-level diagnostic, a checkpoint-specific GPT-2 arithmetic mechanism, and a competence-gated carrier map rather than a universal latent-tail claim.

</details>


### [109] [Pair-Level Essay-Scale Republication and Reuse from Fragmented Historical Text Reuse: A Workflow Study on Eighteenth-Century Books and Newspapers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27343)
*Ke Shu,Kira Hinderks,Eetu Mäkelä,Mikko Tolonen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对十八世纪书籍与报纸中"散碎文本复用证据"如何被整合为篇章级重印与再利用关系的问题，提出一种以"对层级证据整合"为核心的工作流方法。研究以休谟17部著作为种子语料，跨越ECCO书籍与Burney报纸两个异质历史语料环境，对比了分阶段规则工作流、决策树与直接LLM基线、以及自动规则适配三类方法，最终在可审计、精度可控的候选集生成上取得了最佳效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 启蒙运动时期的思想在书籍、小册子与报纸间广泛流转且常常缺乏明确署名，使得仅凭目录元数据难以重建传播链条。已有系统多单独处理书籍或报纸的复用问题，且侧重片段级检索而非对层级的证据整合；此外，跨媒介(书↔报)的系统性交叉研究尚未在篇章规模上展开。

Method: 核心方法为分阶段规则工作流（naive → structural-only → context-aware → final），并辅以三类比较：(1) 决策树基线（在小规模平衡集上训练）；(2) 两种直接LLM基线（Qwen3-30B-A3B，文本与结构化特征两种提示）；(3) 自动规则适配（LLM提出候选rescue/suppression规则后重部署）。所有方法共享同一对层级特征空间：覆盖率、跨度/束、片段链、章节集中度与上下文线索（标题、引语、副文本）。ECCO–ECCO候选集22,735对（111个标注正例），ECCO–Newspaper候选集3,583对（无预设真值，采用部署+人工审计评估）。

Result: 在ECCO–ECCO标注切片上：纯结构阶段在main切片即达F1=0.948，最终工作流在all-labeled上F1=0.825且hard切片精度最高(0.333)，决策树main达0.909但hard骤降至0.063。部署层面，最终工作流仅输出771个正例对，而两种直接LLM基线分别输出14,886与11,223对，呈高召回候选扩张器特征。在ECCO–Newspaper上：最终工作流预测的176个正例经人工审计全部确认为真实重印或复用；49个审计负例中8个实为漏报正例（审计子集P/R/F1=1.000/0.957/0.978）；175个可溯源正例中127例署名休谟、48例未署名，且平均覆盖率约0.473，多数为半文摘或重组话语单元而非完整复制。

Conclusion: 研究证实：在正例覆盖不完整的历史文本复用场景下，可审计的对层级证据整合能够产出紧凑、精度可控的候选空间供史学家审查；闭世界F1、部署规模与人工审计三者构成互补的质量信号；分阶段规则工作流在边界精度控制上优于直接LLM基线与浅层决策树，但LLM作为规则提议者或候选扩张器仍有潜力。局限包括单一作者语料、hard切片与规则精炼池重叠、报纸标注非盲且无标注一致性报告、LLM结果仅为直接提示设置等。未来工作将拓展至多作者/多语种语料、布局感知的多模态页面证据，以及LLM候选扩张+规则精炼的序列式管线。

Abstract: This paper addresses the recovery of essay-scale republication and reuse from fragmented text-reuse evidence, a setting whose central challenge is pair-level evidence consolidation and not fragment retrieval alone. The study focuses on a candidate set centered on essays by eighteenth-century Scottish philosopher David Hume, spanning books from ECCO (Eighteenth Century Collections Online) and historical newspapers. Because the input consists of fragmented reuse hits instead of clean document pairs, and positive coverage is inherently incomplete, we formulate the task as pair-level evidence consolidation into plausible transmission relations and compare three methodological families: a staged rule-based workflow, baselines (a decision tree and two direct LLM settings), and automated rule adaptation. On labeled ECCO--ECCO slices, pair-level feature aggregation alone already reaches 0.948 F1 on the main labeled slice, while the final workflow gives the strongest overall precision-recall trade-off among the tested rule stages. On the full ECCO--ECCO candidate universe, direct LLM baselines flag up to 14,886 pairs as reprints compared to 771 for the final workflow, behaving in this direct-prompt setup as high-recall candidate expanders rather than precision-controlled deployment classifiers. On ECCO--Newspaper, manual audit confirms all 176 predicted positives as genuine cases of republication or reuse, while issue duplication and source-side multiplicity reveal additional provenance structure. Under incomplete ground truth, auditable pair-level evidence consolidation provides a practical way to produce compact candidate spaces for historical inspection.

</details>


### [110] [INTENT-AS-A-TOOL Makes it Easy to Track Agentic Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27348)
*Yutong Zhang,Jianshuo Dong,Peng Xu,Long Wang,Jie Zhang,Tianwei Zhang,Xiaoping Zhang,Han Qiu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 INTENT-AS-A-TOOL 方法，通过在 LLM Agent 的动作空间中添加"意图声明工具"，利用模型调用该工具的下一个 token 概率作为无需外部判官的细粒度意图信号，用于追踪推理过程中的智能体失准（agentic misalignment），并支持在线防御干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 被部署为自主 Agent，智能体失准（agentic misalignment）成为关键安全问题。现有 CoT 监控方法存在三个局限：（1）事后且粗粒度，仅给出整条推理轨迹的最终标签，无法显示意图何时形成；（2）依赖外部判官模型，重复调用成本高；（3）监控的是模型"说什么"而非"倾向做什么"，与动作偏好脱节。本文核心问题是：如何以细粒度且高效的方式追踪模型在推理过程中的失准意图？

Method: 核心方法 INTENT-AS-A-TOOL：在 Agent 的动作空间 A 中为每个目标行为 b 额外添加一个零参数意图声明工具 D_b（如 declare_blackmail_intent），并指示模型在决定执行 b 时先调用 D_b。给定推理前缀 r_{≤t}，将 D_b 的下一个 token 概率 s_t^b = p_θ(D_b | C_t) 作为"意图分数"（intent score），这是一个无需判官的、确定性的、前缀局部的动作偏好信号。基于该信号，文章设计了两类应用：（1）意图追踪——在每个句子边界计算意图分数沿推理深度的轨迹；（2）在线防御——当意图工具成为首选动作时，插入第一人称的反思文本以引导模型回退到安全推理。在评估中，作者使用三阶段 CoT 分类法（场景接受/意图形成/行为执行，将 rollout 分为 Rejection/Clean/Self-correction/Intent-only/Execution 五类）配合 GPT-4.1 作为判官，对 5 个开源推理模型（Qwen3-8B/32B/235B-A22B、Qwen3.5-27B、Gemma-4-31B-IT）在 3 个失准场景（blackmail、leaking、murder）共 234 个测试设置上进行实验，并与基于 prompt 的静态防御基线对比。

Result: 1) CoT 监控发现：Intent-only 类占比始终很小，说明一旦有害意图在 CoT 中出现，往往会推进到最终执行，意图形成与最终行为高度相关。
2) 意图轨迹揭示了四类失准推理模式：合理化承诺（rationalized commitment，早期决定后用推理支撑）、焦虑承诺（反复进出顶部动作但最终稳定于失准）、纠正式推理（意图分数先高后骤降至 0）和再涌现承诺（U 形轨迹，早期承诺→自我纠正→被新证据重新合理化）。
3) 防御效果：在 Qwen 系列 12 个模型-场景组合中，意图引导干预在 9 个上匹配或超过 prompt 防御；Qwen3-32B 上 blackmail/leaking/murder 三个场景分别达到 100.0%/96.5%/98.9% 的风险案例防御成功率。
4) 时序消融：与随机触发和固定间隔触发对比，意图信号在识别"关键决策点"上具有功能性价值；prompting 防御常见失败模式是：早期有效但随推理深入效果衰减，而在线干预能动态响应。
5) 与 CoT 标签一致性：四个模型的 AUROC > 0.92、Agreement > 90%（Qwen3.5-27B 除外，AUROC=0.745），表明意图分数与事后 CoT 标签高度一致。
6) 良性场景中意图工具激活率与目标失准率均为 0.0%，说明信号依赖于具体的行为可执行性。

Conclusion: INTENT-AS-A-TOOL 是一种将意图显式表达为动作空间中的工具调用的方法，通过下一个 token 概率提供无判官的细粒度意图信号。它能将 CoT 监控的事后粗粒度标签扩展为密集的逐前缀意图轨迹，揭示后合理化等推理模式，并能在模型即将执行有害动作前在线介入，将安全知识从静态 prompt 升级为动态响应。该方法在 Qwen 系列推理模型上对 3 类失准场景表现出强监控与防御能力，验证了"动作偏好"作为追踪智能体失准的有效信号。但该方法存在三类局限：（1）增加工具本身会改变动作空间，带来行为漂移；（2）依赖模型的指令遵循能力（声明可靠性跨模型差异大，如 Gemma 泄露场景仅 25.5%）；（3）需预先定义目标行为，不适用于未知失效模式发现。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed as autonomous agents, safety failures increasingly involve consequential actions. We study agentic misalignment, where agents take harmful actions under goal conflicts and pressures. Using chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring, we find that harmful execution is often preceded by intent signals in reasoning. However, post-hoc CoT labels are too coarse to show how intent changes during generation. We introduce INTENT-AS-A-TOOL, an approach that adds intent-targeted tools to give the model a dedicated channel for expressing commitment to a target behavior. The probability of calling an intent tool provides a judge-free, fine-grained signal of the model's tendency to pursue that behavior. Our results show that INTENT-AS-A-TOOL complements CoT monitoring, expands post-hoc CoT labels into dense trajectories, and identifies critical steps for online intervention. These findings suggest that action preferences are useful for tracking agentic misalignment during reasoning. Our code and data are accessible: this https URL .

</details>


### [111] [Your Voice Cloning System is Secretly a Voice Anonymizer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27360)
*Romolo Muletta,Felix Matthias Saaro,Mark Cieliebak,Jan Deriu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需重新训练即可将多语言语音克隆模型XTTSv2重新用于说话人匿名化的方法，通过引入迭代优化策略在七种欧洲语言上实现了接近最优的隐私保护和优越的语音质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有说话人匿名化系统大多为英语设计，多语言扩展困难且需从零训练复杂的多组件流水线；同时高质量多语言TTS模型（如XTTSv2）的核心操作（以目标说话人身份为条件的语音转换）与匿名化高度相似，存在被复用的潜力。

Method: 1. 利用XTTSv2的VQ-VAE提取保留韵律的码本表示；2. 从MLS训练集中为每种语言-性别组合构建10人伪说话人池，选取与原始说话人余弦相似度最低的参考语音拼接后通过Perceiver conditioner生成复合伪说话人；3. 将伪说话人嵌入、Whisper转录的文本token、原始码本表示联合输入GPT-2 backbone进行语音转换；4. 引入迭代优化策略，每轮计算"1-WER"与"1-Sim_orig"的调和平均H，选取最大化H的迭代结果。

Result: 在CommonVoice和MLS两种数据集、七种欧洲语言（de/en/es/fr/it/nl/pt）上的实验显示：隐私保护（EER≈0.49）接近理论最优0.50，显著优于SALT（0.37/0.30）和MultiLingual（0.46/0.44）；可懂性（WER）在CV上较基线相对降低38%；语音质量（ΔUTMOS）在CV上为+0.17（基线为负），MLS上为-0.35（基线为-1.29/-1.23）；英语CMOS人工评测得-0.90，优于SALT（-1.00）和MultiLingual（-1.85）。

Conclusion: 该工作证明现有高质量多语言TTS模型可直接用于说话人匿名化，无需针对特定语言训练；迭代优化有效平衡了隐私-效用权衡；未来需研究对抗鲁棒性、扩展到非欧洲语言以及泛化至其他语音克隆架构。

Abstract: Speaker anonymization suppresses speaker-identifying attributes from speech while preserving linguistic content and quality. We propose repurposing XTTSv2, a multilingual voice cloning model trained on 27k hours of speech, for speaker anonymization without retraining. Our key insight is that XTTSv2's voice cloning capabilities preserve prosodic structure independently of speaker identity, enabling voice conversion by conditioning on a pseudo-speaker. We introduce an iterative refinement strategy that balances privacy and utility by maximizing a harmonic mean of speaker dissimilarity and intelligibility. Evaluated on seven European languages across CommonVoice and Multilingual LibriSpeech, our system achieves near-optimal privacy (EER $\approx$ 0.49), competitive intelligibility, and substantially better speech quality than dedicated anonymization baselines, while requiring no language-specific training. We release the code here: this https URL .

</details>


### [112] [D2C-Routing: Dimension-to-Composition Evidence Routing for Mixed-Origin AI-Generated Text Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27380)
*Xin Chen,Fuwei Zhang,Yiqi Tong,Wei Guo,Yutian Xiao,Fuzhen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 D2C-Routing，一种用于混合来源 AI 生成文本检测的维度-到-组合证据路由框架，将传统二元检测重构为"内容来源"与"表达来源"两个维度的源归属问题，再组合为 HH/HA/AH/AA 四类协作标签。在 HART 重建的 MixD2C 基准上，四类平均 TPR@1%FPR 达 0.8603，比同划分 RACE-local 重运行高 6.5 个点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 AI 生成文本检测采用文档级二元判断（人类 vs 机器），无法应对协作写作场景中内容来源与表达来源可能分离的混合来源文本（如人类构思+AI 润色，或 AI 生成内容+人类改写）。单一的 AI 相似度分数无法指明哪个维度发生了变化，因此需要更细粒度的维度归属能力。

Method: 1）采用 HART 的内容-表达标签空间，将混合来源检测形式化为 (y_c, y_e) 两个二值维度预测，再组合为四类标签；2）基于 RoBERTa 编码器构建维度对齐证据树，内容通路使用实体链连贯性与 RST 话语模态，表达通路使用词汇连接选择、韵律/POS 模式与表面规律性；3）通过监督式内容头与表达头分别学习两个维度；4）学习门控组合层（gated composition）将两个维度表征融合为最终四类概率；5）训练目标包含维度交叉熵、组合交叉熵、AH/AA 校准项与 AA 低 FPR 排序项；6）D2C-base Fusion 通过开发集选择的概率融合多个成员模型作为检测器系统。

Result: 在 MixD2C（从 HART 重建的 70/10/20 同划分）上：单模型 D2C-Routing（双编码器，3 种子平均）AUROC 0.9858、Avg TPR@1%FPR 0.8440、AA TPR@1%FPR 0.7701；D2C-base Fusion 达 AUROC 0.9889、Avg TPR@1%FPR 0.8603、AA TPR@1%FPR 0.7708，比 RACE-local 重运行在 Avg TPR@1%FPR 上高 6.5 个点；维度头对内容与表达维度的 AUROC 分别达 0.9937 与 0.9871；消融显示移除维度监督或门控组合均削弱低 FPR 性能；外部迁移上 APT/PAN 表达维度零样本 AUROC 达 0.8993/0.9392；错误分析显示 AH（AI 内容+人类表达）与完全 AI 生成文本的区分仍是主要瓶颈，表达头在 AH 上准确率仅 0.6438。

Conclusion: 研究支持监督式源维度与学习式组合在混合来源检测中的价值；D2C-Routing 在平均与 AA 低 FPR 排序上优于同划分对照；D2C-base Fusion 是公开披露的最强检测器系统，其常规指标提升不能完全由集成规模解释；表达来源信号比完整四类预测更可靠地迁移；AH 的表达识别仍是主要不足。

Abstract: AI-generated text detection is commonly framed as a binary document-level judgment about whether a text is human-written or machine-generated. This framing breaks down for mixed-origin writing, where content origin and expression origin may differ. We cast mixed-origin detection as dimension-to-composition source attribution, inferring content origin and expression origin before composing them into four collaboration types. We propose Dimension-to-Composition Routing (D2C-Routing), which routes content-side and expression-side evidence to supervised dimension heads before a learned gated composition layer predicts the final label. On MixD2C, a reconstructed split derived from the HART mixed-origin benchmark, our disclosed D2C-Routing-based detector system reaches 0.8603 four-way Avg TPR@1%FPR, 6.5 points above the same-split RACE-local rerun. Core ablations support the routing design, while error analysis shows that distinguishing AI-content/human-expression from fully AI-generated text remains the hardest boundary. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [113] [RATIO: A Benchmark for Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations in Scientific Literature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27394)
*Maayan Sharon,Tom Hope*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RATIO 是一个大规模科学文献检索基准，将"相关性"按三种"构思操作"重新定义：Address（针对问题检索解决方案）、Broaden（检索更一般的表述）、Specify（检索更具体的实例）。该基准通过扩展话语标记远程监督方法，从数百万全文科学论文中构建，并经过大语言模型和人工审核。结合对比学习微调显著提升检索器性能，但绝对性能仍有限，为科学启发式检索开辟了新方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学术检索基准主要评估主题相关性或问题回答能力，无法区分候选文献在构思过程中所扮演的不同启发角色。在科学发现过程中，研究者需要的不只是"相关文献"，而是扮演特定启发功能的资料：直接针对问题的方案、将问题抽象化的更一般原理、以及该原理在新场景下的具体实例。这种"构思操作"的区别对于支撑假设生成的检索系统至关重要。

Method: 1）问题定义：将查询 q 与关系 r ∈ {Address, Broaden, Specify} 配对，从大规模语料中检索满足该关系的目标句。2）数据构建：采用"话语标记远程监督"扩展至语料级检索——通过人工+LLM构建各关系的标记词典（如 "to address this issue"、"more generally"、"as an example"），从 ~366.6M 连续句对中自动抽取约 300 万 (q, g) 对，并混入约 10K 干扰标记作为难负例。3）数据集分层：按时间划分训练（2015–2025.9）、验证（2025.10–12）、测试（2026.1–5），并构建经人工校准 LLM 验证的"银色测试集"。4）实验：使用 BM25、all-mpnet-base-v2、ModernBERT-embed-large、Stella-en-1.5B-v5，分别在三种关系上做对比微调，并通过 R@1/10、M@10/100 以及 Top-K 候选人工 + LLM 评判进行评估。

Result: Move-specific 微调带来显著提升：ModernBERT-embed-large 在 M@10 上分别获得 1.6×–2.4× 的提升；Absolute 性能仍较低，尤其是 Broaden（1.41K 训练对）和 Address（22.3K 训练对）。在 Top-10 候选评估中，调优模型在 89.0%（Specify）和 76.5%（Address）查询中至少返回 1 个被 LLM 判定为有效的候选，其中绝大多数（88–91%）来自跨论文检索。微调模型常检索到被评判为有效但并非挖掘正例的"启发式替代"候选，证明检索器已学到非平凡的查询-关系匹配。

Conclusion: RATIO 将"相关性"从主题相似重新定义为操作条件关系，提供首个面向科学构思-操作检索的大规模基准。可扩展的话语标记方法论可推广至其它领域或其它关系。未来工作应突破相邻句假设、扩展到非 CS 学科、加强人工标注、将检索操作集成到端到端科学推理系统中。

Abstract: Retrieved scientific literature can serve as inspiration for both human and AI scientists. Inspiration can take different forms: prior work may directly suggest how to address a problem, or surface directions at different levels of abstraction - zooming out to a more general view or zooming in to a concrete realization. We introduce RATIO (Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations), a large-scale benchmark in which relevance is defined by three operations which we name ideation moves: Address retrieves potential approaches for stated problems, Broaden retrieves more general formulations, and Specify retrieves concrete instantiations. RATIO is constructed from millions of full-text scientific papers across CS literature via a general recipe that extends discourse-marker distant supervision - previously used only for classification - to corpus-scale retrieval, combined with extensive LLM and human vetting. Experiments show that operation-specific fine-tuning substantially boosts retrievers but leaves much room for further improvements. RATIO provides a scalable training and evaluation framework for retrieval components that support literature-grounded ideation, opening up new research avenues on scientific inspiration retrieval.

</details>


### [114] [Consolidating RLVR Capabilities Across Domains: A Deep Dive into Fusion Paradigms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27409)
*Siye Wu,Kai Yang,Yuchen Cai,Xin Xu,Peng-Yuan Wang,Jiaxuan Wang,Jiashun Liu,Jiafei Lyu,Yangkun Chen,Saiyong Yang,Yanghua Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了三种将多领域RLVR专家模型融合为单一模型的方法（Merge、Mix RL、MOPD），分析了它们在性能、训练动态、成本和适用场景上的差异，并给出了实践选择指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）通常针对单一领域训练专家模型，但实际应用需要覆盖多个领域。现有的融合方法（参数合并、混合训练、蒸馏）大多被孤立研究，缺乏统一框架下的对比，导致难以选择。

Method: 在Qwen3-4B和8B骨干上，分别用全参数和LoRA训练五个领域专家（数学、科学、代码、指令跟随、Agent），在统一实验框架下对比三种融合范式：Merge（任务向量线性组合）、Mix RL（多领域数据联合GRPO训练）、MOPD（多教师在线策略蒸馏），通过行为评估、任务向量几何分析、训练动态追踪和pass@k分析进行系统比较。

Result: 三种方法平均性能差异不超过1.4分，但单基准差距可达8.6分。领域关系呈结构化特征：推理类领域（数学/科学/代码）相互促进，指令跟随和Agent与其他领域近似正交（行为和任务向量余弦相似度均证实）。Merge成本极低但保留的领域增益不均；Mix RL依赖数据混合比例，在无专家时高效；MOPD收敛最快但受限于教师。pass@32时所有方法与基模型无显著差异，说明融合仅重加权现有解而非扩展解题覆盖面，且不损害保留能力（事实回忆和长上下文推理）。

Conclusion: 给出了实践选择指南：已有专家且追求低成本时选Merge；无专家且训练统一模型时选Mix RL，需调整领域比例；保留领域特定增益比超越教师更重要时选MOPD。融合的收益是单样本精度的提升而非解题覆盖面的扩展。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves specific capabilities of large language models, but covering multiple capabilities often involves training separate domain experts and subsequently consolidating them. We organize three fusion paradigms by the artefacts they reuse: Merge combines expert task vectors, Mix RL pools their datasets, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) uses both. Because they have largely been studied in isolation, how they compare and how to choose among them remain unclear. We compare all three using shared experts and data across model scales and a multi-domain benchmark suite. Although their average performance differs by at most 1.4 points, the gap reaches 8.6 points on a single benchmark, with domain-level variation tracking cross-domain relations visible in task-vector geometry. Training dynamics expose distinct constraints: Mix RL depends on domain mixture proportions, MOPD remains bounded by its teachers, and Merge compresses all expert updates into one. All three improve single-sample accuracy without measurable gains in solution coverage or losses in held-out capabilities. These results yield a practical guideline: use Merge when experts already exist and cheap fusion is paramount; Mix RL when training a unified model without experts, with domain proportions adjusted for cross-domain transfer; and MOPD when preserving domain-specific gains matters more than surpassing teachers or minimizing end-to-end cost.

</details>


### [115] [Boosting LLM Exploration via Weak-Model Guidance in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27420)
*Xingyu Shen,Huishuai Zhang,Peng Li,Yinchun Wang,Dongyan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Prefix-Completion RLVR框架，利用弱模型生成的部分推理轨迹作为前缀，引导目标模型在RLVR训练中跳出过度自信的推理路径，缓解熵坍缩并提升pass@k（尤其大k）的推理覆盖度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR训练中存在熵坍缩现象，导致pass@k（尤其是大k）下降，推理覆盖范围变窄。现有方法多依赖算法层面的正则化，忽略了跨模型、非参数的扰动方式。

Method: 1) 辅助小模型（如Gemma-2-2B、LLaMA-3.2-1B）生成完整解并按熵突变点截断为部分前缀；2) 采用混合训练策略（概率p=0.2）让目标模型基于前缀续写推理；3) 保持标准GRPO算法不变，无需额外SFT或复杂奖励设计。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B上的6个数学基准测试中，pass@1略有提升（约+0.7），pass@128显著提升（约+3），且k越大增益越明显。消融实验表明：异源（非同族）小模型前缀效果优于同源前缀；熵基截断优于随机截断；p过大反而损害性能。绝大多数前缀被评估为"无实质引导"或"误导"，说明获益源于分布扰动而非语义正确性。

Conclusion: 弱模型前缀可作为非参数扰动信号，有效缓解RLVR熵坍缩、提升大k下的推理多样性；其效用与前缀语义质量解耦，关键在于制造分布差异以激发探索。未来可与目标级正则化方法结合以获得协同效果。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) significantly improves LLM reasoning but often causes a drop in policy entropy, leading to narrowed reasoning coverage and degraded pass@$k$ for large $k$. While existing methods mitigate this entropy collapse through algorithmic regularizations, cross-model non-parametric perturbation is also neglected. In this work, we propose a simple yet effective approach to preserve the generative diversity of LLMs during RLVR. Instead of relying solely on internal exploration, we force the target model to generate answers based on partial reasoning trajectories generated by a smaller, weaker language models. These unfamiliar prefixes effectively disrupt over-confidence and encourage the exploration of distinct reasoning paths. We empirically study the potential of outer prefixes, revealing the mechanism of the impact of distributional discrepancy to the exploration dynamics in RLVR training. Experiments across multiple mathematical benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms vanilla RLVR. Notably, the performance gain becomes increasingly pronounced as $k$ scales up, demonstrating a substantial expansion of reasoning coverage. Furthermore, our approach efficiently mitigates entropy collapse without requiring additional SFT, intricate reward designs, or complex prompting.

</details>


### [116] [Stochastic Estimation of Transduced Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27428)
*Vésteinn Snæbjarnarson,Samuel Kiegeland,Manuel de Prada Corral,Ryan Cotterell,Tim Vieira*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于无放回抽样（SWOR）的无偏估计算法，用以估计转导语言模型（TLM）的目标前缀概率，替代了此前基于阈值剪枝的有偏beam summing方法。该方法在保持无偏性的同时，在文本和DNA转导任务上实现了更优的计算-方差权衡，并首次使得长目标序列的前缀概率估计变得可行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Snæbjarnarson等人（2026）提出的beam summing算法在处理转导语言模型（TLM）时依赖阈值剪枝来控制计算量，但这种方法会产生有偏估计，且无法量化被剪枝丢弃的概率质量。当源模型熵较高且前覆盖集合指数级增长时（如DNA到氨基酸转导），阈值剪枝方法甚至在十几个目标位置后就变得不可行。

Method: 本文将beam summing中的确定性阈值剪枝替换为无放回抽样（SWOR），并结合Horvitz-Thompson重加权来保持期望权重不变。具体提出两个算法：(1) beam_swor使用固定最大粒子数M进行无放回重采样；(2) beam_swor_adaptive根据当前累积质量自适应调整粒子数量，并使用Russian roulette确保几乎必然停机。理论证明（定理3.3和命题3.4）两个算法在几乎必然停机条件下都是无偏的。

Result: 在WikiText-2字节到PTB词的转导任务中，beam_swor和beam_swor_adaptive将语料库的相对RMSE降至0.17-0.21，而阈值剪枝方法的误差接近1。在DNA到氨基酸转导任务中，阈值剪枝方法在第13个氨基酸位置就超过5分钟限制，而beam_swor_adaptive在大约5秒内可处理到第200个位置。在GPT-2的阅读时间心理语言学分析中，无偏估计使语料库surprisal降低了106 nats，但发表的结论不变。beam_swor_adaptive在两个模型上都主导了有放回SMC基线的计算-方差前沿。

Conclusion: 无放回抽样方法成功替代了阈值剪枝，提供了无偏的目标前缀概率估计，同时量化了剪枝偏差。该方法不仅在高熵源模型下使长目标序列的概率估计成为可能，还为评估剪枝误差提供了无偏参考。其在DNA生物序列分析和心理语言学应用中的优异表现，展示了该方法在跨域序列建模中的广泛适用性。

Abstract: Transduced language models (TLMs) compose a pretrained \emph{source} language model with a functional finite-state transducer to induce a language model over \emph{target} strings. Computing the probability of a target prefix under a TLM amounts to summing the source-model probabilities of all source strings that the transducer maps to target strings beginning with that prefix. This set can be exponentially large or infinite. Prior work uses a computational shortcut based on source prefix probabilities, then approximates the resulting sum with threshold-pruned beam summing. This produces a lower bound with unknown error. Instead, we resample source prefixes without replacement and reweight each selected prefix by the inverse of its inclusion probability. We show that applying this correction recursively gives an unbiased estimator of the target prefix probability and lets us estimate the mass lost by threshold pruning. Our beam-summing algorithm extends the retained source prefixes and samples which prefixes to keep, reducing their number as more probability mass is added to the running estimate. This can save computation and guarantees that the run halts with probability one. We evaluate the method on encyclopedic text and DNA against sequential Monte Carlo baselines that resample with replacement. It achieves a better compute--variance tradeoff on text and lower error at the same maximum number of particles on DNA. On a DNA-to-amino-acid transduction, it reduces runtime by several orders of magnitude relative to threshold-pruned beam summing and makes estimating prefix probabilities for long target strings feasible. Replacing threshold pruning with unbiased sampling in a published reading-time analysis substantially lowers the estimated corpus surprisal but leaves the published conclusions unchanged.

</details>


### [117] [TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27448)
*Aozhe Wang,Zhengxi Lu,Jianze Wang,Shangke Lv,Ying Liu,Weiming Lu,Jun Xiao,Yueting Zhuang,Hua Yang,Qianglong Chen,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TTPO提出了一种测试时策略优化方法，通过非对称目标函数将多数投票伪标签与OPSD自蒸馏和GRPO强化学习相结合，在无标签的测试时训练场景下实现了与有标签监督方法相媲美的数学推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的后训练方法（如RL和OPSD）依赖真实标签，无法应用于测试时训练场景。多数投票伪标签虽有替代潜力，但其错误率高（在竞赛级问题上约85%的提示的伪标签是错误的），直接用于蒸馏会污染教师信号并在每个token上误导模型。

Method: TTPO采用非对称目标函数：对与伪标签一致的rollout使用OPSD前向KL蒸馏，对不一致的rollout使用GRPO分组强化学习惩罚。原因是不一致的rollout无论伪标签是否正确都大概率是错误的。方法还包括token级选择机制：蒸馏分支通过Soft-OR组合熵和散度来降低已收敛位置的权重，RL分支通过负对数概率和置信度的乘积来识别并仅惩罚"自信错误"的token。

Result: 在五个竞赛级数学基准测试（AIME 2025/2026、HMMT 2025/2026、BRUMO 2025）上，无标签的TTPO匹配或超越了有标签的OPSD：在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B上的OpenThoughts设置中分别达到40.1/58.6/62.6的平均准确率。在纯TTT设置中，将Qwen3-1.7B从38.0%提升至45.2%。关闭思维模式时提升幅度达+25.2至+36.4个百分点，并展现出强大的跨任务泛化能力和可持续的自我进化特性。

Conclusion: TTPO成功将OPSD引入无标签的测试时训练场景，通过非对称组合蒸馏与RL，在伪标签噪声下保持稳定训练，匹配有标签方法的性能，同时展现出优于固定真值路由的自我进化能力，为测试时训练提供了一个有效且无需标注的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts that disagree with the pseudo-label are typically wrong regardless of whether the vote itself is correct. Building on this observation, we propose Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO), an asymmetric objective that distills agreeing rollouts via OPSD and penalizes disagreeing rollouts with Grouped RL. Token-level selection further refines both branches: distillation down-weights already-converged positions, while RL penalizes only confident errors. Both updates remain well-grounded even under frequent pseudo-label errors, and majority-vote routing yields tighter self-supervision as the model improves. Without any labels, TTPO matches label-supervised OPSD on five competition-level benchmarks, raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT, yields +25.2% to +36.4% without thinking, and shows strong cross-task generalization.

</details>


### [118] [CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27455)
*Yufan Wu,Yinghui He,Zhengyi Hu,Lang Wei,Ruichen Li,Qifan Yang,Ting Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CritICL是一个推理时的弱到强迁移框架,通过利用小模型的失败模式(failure modes)作为指导信号来增强大模型的推理能力,核心创新在于离线构建CritBank并通过dynamic/static两种检索策略注入基于失败模式的in-context示例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时计算方法(如self-consistency、self-refinement、LLM-as-a-judge)依赖多次生成或外部验证,推理成本高昂。作者发现同一模型家族内不同规模的模型存在结构化且高度一致的失败模式分布,这一可迁移信号未被充分利用。

Method: 两阶段框架:(1)离线构建CritBank——用SLM生成错误回答,经前沿LLM(gpt-4o-mini)标注失败模式标签和自然语言批评,并对标签做聚类去噪;(2)推理时检索:CritICL-dynamic让目标模型预测查询特定的失败模式并检索对应批评;CritICL-static利用聚合的家族级失败模式分布进行全局检索。采用基于失败模式匹配的评分排序算法选择top-K示例。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-72B和Llama-3.1-70B上的实验显示,CritICL-static的Pass@1平均准确率达59.2%和53.1%,优于standard ICL和多数test-time scaling方法;CritICL-static仅需1次生成,总token数(3768-3928)显著低于Consistency@7(5440-5689)等方法。同时验证了失败模式在家族内高一致性(聚合Spearman 0.88-0.91,跨家族仅0.43-0.46),且failure mode-based retrieval优于random/fixed/semantic retrieval,具有跨域迁移性。

Conclusion: CritICL验证了弱模型的失败模式可作为高效且可重用的推理时资源,通过将重复推理开销转移为离线资源,显著降低计算成本的同时提升推理性能,为弱到强泛化提供了新的inference-time范式,且该方法在跨领域(数学/科学)及一定程度的跨家族迁移中均有效。

Abstract: Recent advances in inference-time scaling have significantly improved the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). However, these methods typically rely on repeated generation or external verification. To address this limitation, we introduce CritICL, a novel inference-time framework that improves reasoning while maintaining high efficiency. Our key insight is that LLM failure modes exhibit structured patterns across model scales within the same family. Instead of treating failures as undesirable outputs, CritICL leverages them as a source of guidance. Specifically, we utilize failure modes derived from weaker models and incorporate them into inference through critique-based in-context examples. We propose two variants: CritICL-dynamic, which adaptively predicts input-specific failure modes and retrieves critiques, and CritICL-static, which uses a global failure mode profile to provide stable guidance. Experimental results show that CritICL consistently outperforms standard in-context learning and achieves performance competitive with or superior to test-time scaling methods, while requiring significantly fewer generations and lower token cost. Code available at: this https URL

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [119] [Zero-Shot Self-Orchestration with Ledger-Based Control for Improved LLM Coding Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26480)
*Victor Gao,Vida Khosrowshahi,Ali Khosrowshahi,Xihao Sun,Juhyun Lee,Simon*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文研究了在不训练、不进行特定基准调优的前提下，为同一LLM引入一个基于共享文件系统工作区的"管理者-工作者"多智能体脚手架，对比其与单次调用在代码生成任务上的表现差异。在LiveCodeBench最新100道困难题上，9个模型参测，结果显示该脚手架能带来显著但条件性的提升：小型或无推理模型受益最大（+23至+42分），大型强推理模型收益较小甚至为负；同时成本约增至三倍，但通常仍比切换到更大模型更具性价比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统虽常被报告优于单模型基线，但证据混杂且对比常被混淆：管道同时改变token预算、工具调用和提示，难以判断真正起作用的因素。本文旨在通过固定模型和问题集、控制单一变量（是否引入管理者-工作者脚手架），纯粹地隔离编排（orchestration）本身带来的效果。

Method: 设计零样本自编排（zero-shot self-orchestration）方案：同一模型在全新上下文中扮演不同角色，通过共享文件系统工作区（含plan.md、tasks.json、notes.md、solution.py）进行协调。管理者撰写总体计划并循环管理任务列表（最多10轮），工作者分阶段执行"构思→执行"任务；v2版本额外加入样例测试验证器和截断摘要器。基线为同模型、同温度下的单次调用。在100道LiveCodeBench困难题上，使用固定后端（OpenAI API、本地vLLM、Anthropic Messages API）对4个模型进行5次重复实验，另在OpenRouter网关对5个模型进行测试。

Result: 在固定后端实验中，Qwen3.8-27B +23.4分、GPT-5.6-Luna +10.6分、GPT-5.6-Terra +8.0分（均p<10⁻⁴，五次配对通过）；Opus-5以管理者模式达到全研究最高分91%（单次通过）。在OpenRouter测试中，Kimi-K3 +30.4分、Minimax-M3 +11.0分（推理关闭，五次16k通过）；Qwen3.6-35B则收益为零或为负（-1至-9分）。机制上两个反复出现的增益来源是：上下文管理（短工作者调用+共享笔记减少截断）和问题分解。成本方面，脚手架使token消耗约增至三倍，但Qwen3.8-27B带管理者以$51.75/100题接近Fable 5单次调用（$61.11）的准确率；GPT-5.6-Terra带管理者以$11.71达到Fable 5 87.4%中的85.0%（差距p=0.59不显著）。截断"救援"贡献了约5.0分（即Qwen3.8-27B +23.4总增益的约五分之一）。Qwen3.6-35B是显著的负例，其管理者模式在推理关闭条件下退化（-1.2至-9分）。

Conclusion: 一个轻量级、无需训练的管理者-工作者脚手架在共享工作区上能持续提升LLM编码表现，尤其对小型或无推理模型效果显著；其token成本约为单次调用的三倍，但在多数情形下比直接换用更大模型更具性价比。结论具有条件性：模型本身已具备内部规划能力时收益有限（甚至为负），因为scaffold可能用更差的计划"扰动"原本简洁正确的解法；建议未来加入"全新视角工作者"与更强验证器以缓解该类回归。

Abstract: Multi-agent large language model systems are widely reported to beat single-model baselines, but the evidence is mixed, and comparisons are usually confounded: pipelines change token budgets, tool calls, and prompts simultaneously, so an aggregate gain rarely reveals what actually helped. We investigate the effect of introducing the manager-worker scaffold over a shared filesystem workspace, with no training and no per-benchmark tuning, measured against the same model answering in a single pass. Across nine models -- five open-weight, spanning 9B to ~2.8T parameters, and four frontier closed models -- on the 100 latest hard LiveCodeBench problems, the scaffold's benefit is real but conditional: large and statistically significant for some (Qwen3.8-27B +23.4, GPT-5.6-Luna +10.6 and GPT-5.6-Terra +8.0, each over five paired passes; Kimi-K3 +30.4 and Minimax-M3 +11.0 over five paired passes with reasoning off, both at $p < 10^{-4}$, and +42 and +12 in a single pass at a 128k cap) and null or negative for others (Qwen3.6-35B -1 to -9 with reasoning off). With the manager, Opus-5 achieves the highest score in the study at 91% in one pass. Running a manager roughly triples the token bill, but it buys accuracy more cheaply than moving to a larger model does: GPT-5.6-Terra with a manager nearly matches Fable 5's single-call accuracy (85.0 against 87.4, $p = 0.59$) at a fifth of the price (\$11.71 against \$61.11 per 100-problem pass, $p < 10^{-4}$), and the Qwen-27B arm does it for \$51.75 on weights anyone can self-host. Our transcript analysis finds several mechanisms behind the gains, of which two recur: context management, in which short worker calls and shared notes organize state and reduce truncation, and problem decomposition. Improvements are modest for large models with reasoning enabled, but larger for some models with reasoning disabled and for smaller models with reasoning enabled.

</details>


### [120] [Risks and Controls for Multi-Agent Systems: an analytical framework for deployment of AI agents across organisational boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26626)
*Alistair Reid,Simon O'Callaghan,Dustin Venini,Liam Carroll,Tiberio Caetano*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 该报告提出了一个框架，用于帮助组织、政策制定者和研究者分析AI智能体之间交互时产生的风险，并按治理层级（单一治理、联邦治理、开放环境）分类讨论风险因素、失败模式和应对控制措施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI智能体被广泛部署，智能体之间的交互日益频繁且跨越组织边界，单个组织已无法完全掌控跨边界交互所带来的风险，因此需要一个系统性的框架来识别、分析和应对多智能体交互风险。

Method: 报告定义了三个部署层级（由任意两个交互智能体之间的最小共同治理约束决定）：① 单一治理（一个组织治理所有智能体）；② 联邦治理（多个组织在商定规则下部署到共享环境）；③ 开放环境（无中心权威，标准自愿采用）。在每个层级中，分别考察风险因素、失败模式和可用控制措施，并识别控制措施的执行主体，对治理真空进行刻画。

Result: 报告提供了一个分层分析框架，揭示了不同治理层级下AI智能体交互的风险特征、对应控制措施及其责任归属，识别出在某些场景下没有任何主体能够实施必要控制的治理缺口，并指出需要通过集体行动来弥合这些缺口。

Conclusion: AI智能体交互带来的风险随治理边界变化而变化，需要根据三个部署层级分别制定风险应对策略；对于跨组织边界的交互和开放环境，单一组织难以独立治理，必须通过多方协作、协议标准和集体行动来弥补治理空白。

Abstract: This report presents a framework to help organisations, policymakers and researchers reason about the risks that emerge when AI agents interact with each other, how those risks change as interactions cross organisational boundaries, and the controls that may help address them. As organisations deploy AI agents, those agents will increasingly interact with each other: inside the organisation, with the agents of partners, customers and suppliers, and with unknown counterparties on the open internet. Failures can emerge from the interactions themselves, and once those interactions cross an organisation's perimeter, no single organisation can fully see, control or govern them. The report introduces three deployment tiers, defined by the minimum common governance binding any two interacting agents: singular governance, where one organisation governs every agent; federated governance, where multiple organisations deploy into a shared environment under agreed rules; and open environments, where agents operate with no central authority and shared standards are adopted voluntarily if at all. Within each tier, the report examines risk factors, failure modes and available controls. It identifies who is positioned to apply the controls, and where no actor is positioned to act, it characterises the gap and the collective action required to close it.

</details>


### [121] [Fixed-Haven Reservation for Online Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery in Dense Warehouses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26759)
*Taisei Hirayama,Kohei Yoshida,Hiroki Sakaji,Itsuki Noda*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文针对密集仓库中多智能体取送货（MAPD）问题，提出"固定避难所（fixed-Haven）预留"协调框架及其算法实现SHARP。每个智能体拥有专属固定避难所（通常为起点），系统始终为忙碌/撤退中的智能体保留一条通向自身避难所的无冲突路径。在Haven-Reachability条件下证明有限任务释放的完备性，并在树状、窄通道等传统TP/PIBT方法失效的布局上实现100%成功率，代价是较高的集中式规划开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集仓库具有单车道通道、死端和树状导引路径，传统MAPD完备性保证（如TP的well-formedness或PIBT的双连通性假设）在这些布局上可能失效，因为缺乏足够的等待端点。核心问题是：如何为每个智能体提供可靠的非阻塞回退位置，使有限释放的任务最终都能完成。

Method: 1. **固定避难所契约**：每个智能体a拥有专属避难所η(a)（通常为其起点），仅所有者可占据，其他智能体视为阻塞。2. **安全避难所预留不变量**：忙碌智能体保留从当前位置经取货→送货→避难所的完整无冲突路径；撤退智能体保留至避难所的后缀路径（可被新任务覆盖）；闲置智能体在自身避难所等待。3. **SHARP算法**：使用SIPP进行路径验证，采用最近取货分配规则，允许撤退途中通过验证新路径覆盖后缀实现任务重分配。4. **Haven-Reachability条件**：存在任务支撑区域W⊆V\H，满足任务端点连通性、从W到各避难所的可达性、避难所分配的独占性。5. **完备性证明**：通过静默配置下的可行性、引理链（不变量保持→静默可行→分配进度→收敛至静默），证明在Haven-Reachability+有限释放+无转移承诺策略+进度条件下有限释放完备。

Result: **主鲁棒性扫描**：在well-formed/narrow-bi/narrow-bi-dead/tree四类地图、5-30智能体、λ=0.5-3.0任务生成率下，SHARP在所有测试配置上达到100%成功率，而TP在narrow-bi上退化、PIBT在narrow-bi-dead上失效、TP/PIBT在tree上完全失败。**TP式固定归巢对照实验**：在tree条件下，TP原版0%成功率，加入固定归巢+全路径验证后恢复100%成功率，说明固定回退是树状布局鲁棒性的核心机制。**无覆盖变体**：禁用撤退途中重分配后，服务时间恶化1.89倍、makespan恶化1.53倍（高负载tree条件），但仍保持100%成功率。**规划开销**：tree布局下SHARP每运行约5.7万次SIPP调用、1.86亿扩展节点，规划成本显著高于TP/PIBT基线。

Conclusion: 固定避难所预留为MAPD提供了一种有别于well-formedness/双连通性的新型完备性框架，以集中式规划开销换取结构鲁棒性。SHARP是该框架的具体实现，在密集仓库布局上具有强适用性。未来工作包括放宽固定避难所约束、支持任务停留时间模型、弱化支撑区域条件等。

Abstract: Dense warehouses often contain single-lane aisles, dead ends, and tree-like guidepaths that leave little room for idle agents to wait without blocking others. Existing Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery (MAPD) guarantees for completing all finitely released tasks typically rely on extra waiting endpoints that planned paths can avoid, or on biconnected topology; these assumptions may fail in such layouts. We study fixed-Haven reservation for online MAPD, where pickup-delivery tasks are released over time. Each agent owns a fixed Safe Haven (Haven for short), usually its start cell, that only the owner may occupy and that other agents treat as blocked. For finite task releases, we prove that this fixed-Haven contract completes all released tasks under Haven-Reachability and explicit planning/progress assumptions. We implement the contract in SHARP, a Safe-Haven Retreat Planner that keeps every busy or retreating agent on a collision-free reserved route ending at its Haven. We compare SHARP with representative TP and PIBT-family MAPD baselines: Token Passing (TP), Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT), and PIBT with Temporary Priority and Temporary Avoidance (PIBTTP-TA) for biconnected main areas with attached trees. In the robustness sweep, SHARP is the only method with 100% success on all tested configurations, at substantially higher centralized planning cost on tree-like layouts. A TP-style fixed-home-return counterfactual with full-route validation also recovers robustness on tested tree-like layouts, suggesting that fixed return is a central robustness mechanism there. A no-overwrite variant shows that disabling mid-retreat reassignment worsens service time (release-to-delivery latency) by 1.89 times and makespan by 1.53 times in the tested high-load tree condition.

</details>


### [122] [Dynamic Haven Selection for Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery in Constrained Warehouses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26939)
*Taisei Hirayama,Kohei Yoshida,Hiroki Sakaji,Itsuki Noda*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出A♯（Adaptive SHARP），一种在狭窄、含死胡同的受限仓库布局中实现多智能体取送货（MAPD）动态避风港（Haven）选择的方法。它通过可用性检查和待释放规则在任务分配时转移避风港归属，同时证明在有限任务发布序列下的安全性和效率优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定避风港撤退规划（SHARP）中，智能体完成任务后必须返回初始避风港，可能产生不必要的迂回。在狭窄通道或死胡同工作站中，远距离避风港会显著增加makespan，且直接将避风港替换为最近可用位置会引发归属冲突（多个智能体竞争同一等待位置）或允许其他智能体的路径穿过仍被占用的顶点。

Method: 提出A♯算法，包含三个核心机制：(1) 可用性测试Avail_t(a,h)，同时检查其他智能体的独占集X_t(b)和未来时空预留R_b(t')≥t；(2) 待释放规则pending-release，当智能体物理上仍位于旧避风港h_old时，将h_old保留在X_t(a)中直到其离开；(3) 基于SIPP的三段式路径验证（当前位置→取货→送货→新避风港），使用最近取货任务+最近可用避风港的贪心选择策略。在Haven结构条件和SIPP假设下，证明独占注入性、预留排他性等不变量的保持及有限发布完备性。

Result: 在14,400配对案例、72,000次运行的实验中，SHARP与A♯均达到100%成功率。在138个|A|<|H|的配置中，经Holm校正后，A♯在makespan上107个配置显著优于SHARP、无配置显著更差；中位数减少在tree地图上达16.7%。在狭窄双连通地图的服务时间上存在局部拥塞导致SHARP局部更优的情况，但属选择器启发式局限而非协议缺陷。计算时间方面A♯中位数每步耗时为SHARP的0.83倍。

Conclusion: A♯通过可用性测试和待释放规则的安全归属转移协议，在受限仓库布局中实现动态避风港选择，保持了安全避风港撤退规划的安全性与完备性，显著改善makespan。该方法将拥塞感知、学习或优化型选择器的开发留作未来工作，协议本身对选择器独立。

Abstract: Space-efficient warehouse layouts often contain single-agent-width aisles and dead-end workstations where robots have few places to wait without blocking others. In Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery (MAPD) on such constrained layouts, robots must accept online pickup-delivery tasks while preserving protected waiting locations called Havens. The Safe HAven Retreat Planner (SHARP) introduced a mechanism that extends each committed task path with a validated retreat to the agent's dedicated initial Haven, but fixed-Haven commitments can send agents toward distant Havens after deliveries. We present A-sharp (Adaptive SHARP), which changes an agent's retreat target at task assignment time. A naive switch can cause two agents to rely on the same waiting location or let another committed path pass through a location that is still occupied or reserved. A-sharp prevents these failures with an availability test for candidate Havens and a pending-release rule that keeps the previous Haven protected until the agent departs. Under explicit Haven-structure and Safe Interval Path Planning (SIPP) assumptions, we prove invariant preservation and finite-release completeness: every task in any finite release sequence is delivered in finite time. Across 72,000 runs on 14,400 paired map-agent-count-rate-seed cases over four maps, both SHARP and A-sharp complete their respective 14,400 runs. For makespan (final delivery time), a prespecified paired comparison with Holm correction over all 138 configurations with more Havens than agents finds A-sharp significantly better in 107 configurations and never significantly worse than SHARP; on the tested tree map, the median reduction is 16.7%.

</details>


### [123] [One Model, Many Minds: Unlocking Multi-Agent Synergy in a Single Agent via Mixture of Roles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27338)
*Zhichen Zeng,Huiyuan Chen,Jingru Cheng,Juan Zha,Ming Liu,Ying Chen,Xiyuan Yang,Chaosheng Dong,Haiyang Zhang,Hanghang Tong*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出Mixture of Roles (MoRe)，一种轻量级模块，通过学习多样化的steering vector码本和查询感知的路由器，在单次推理中动态组合多个角色特化，从而在保持单代理效率的同时实现多代理协作的多视角特化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单代理方法使用固定的特化（文本角色或单一steering vector），无法适应多样化的查询；多代理系统虽然能实现动态多视角问题求解，但多轮交互导致上下文长度膨胀和推理成本高昂。如何在单代理单轮推理中实现动态多视角特化是核心研究问题。

Method: MoRe包含两个核心组件：(1) 学习化的特化码本，由可学习的候选steering vector组成，初始化来自对比激活方向；(2) 查询感知路由器，通过多头交叉注意力机制动态选择并融合Top-K个候选向量。训练采用三阶段课程SFT（先优化码本→再训练路由器→最后联合优化），后接GRPO后训练，将策略空间从token空间转移到persona空间以实现清晰的信用分配。骨干LLM完全冻结。

Result: 在五个推理基准（MMLU、TriviaQA、MATH、GSM8K、MedQA）和PersonalityBench（大五人格）上的实验表明：MoRe平均比单代理基线提升2.2%，性能与多代理系统相当但token成本降低20倍。在Llama3.1-8B和Qwen3-8B两个骨干模型上均达到Top-2排名。代码本参数仅0.04M，路由器仅1.32M，仅占骨干模型的0.017%。

Conclusion: MoRe成功将专家混合（MoE）原则从参数空间计算扩展到激活空间行为特化，在单代理单轮推理中实现了动态多视角特化，在性能与效率之间取得了优越的平衡，为LLM特化提供了一种高效且自适应的方案。

Abstract: Specializing Large Language Models (LLMs) toward distinct abilities underpins successes ranging from personalized assistants to multi-agent systems (MAS). Single-agent paradigms rely on pre-defined personas or steering vectors to induce specialization, yet they impose a single fixed specialization that fails to adapt to diverse queries. Conversely, MAS achieves dynamic multi-perspective problem solving by orchestrating agents with distinct text-based roles, but fusing these specializations requires multi-turn interactions that inflate context length and inference cost. To address these limitations, we propose Mixture of Roles (MoRe), which adaptively composes multiple specializations into a single steering vector for single-turn inference. Specifically, MoRe learns a diversified codeboox of steering vectors, each of which encodes a latent role. A query-aware router dynamically fuses the codebook into a steering vector that encompasses multiple roles. By steering the backbone LLM with the composed vector, MoRe enables multi-perspective specialization in a single-agent, single-turn inference process. The proposed MoRe can be efficiently trained via a three-stage SFT curriculum and GRPO post-training, while the backbone LLM remains frozen. Experiments across reasoning and personality benchmarks show that MoRe outperforms single-agent baselines by 2.2% on average, and achieves performance on par with MAS while reducing token cost by 20x.

</details>

### [124] [EduRiskX: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework with F-Logic Reasoning for Early Academic Risk Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26107)
*Yu Fu,Yongqi Kang,Yong Zhao,Rongfang Bie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EduRiskX 提出了一种神经-符号融合框架，将时序 Transformer 预测器与基于 F-Logic 的符号推理相结合，用于在线教育中学生学业风险的早期识别。该框架在 OULAD 数据集上实现了准确率 0.900、F1 0.894，并在第 9.32 周即可识别风险学生，显著优于 PatchTST、iTransformer、LSTM 等基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线教育中存在高辍学率和学生表现异质性问题。现有的深度学习风险预测模型面临两大瓶颈：(1) 早期检测能力不足——LSTM、CNN、Transformer 等依赖大量序列数据，难以及早识别风险；(2) 可解释性差——黑盒模型无法与教育理论对齐，导致教师不信任，难以在实际教学中部署干预。教育领域亟需兼顾预测性能与教学可解释性的早期预警系统。

Method: 采用"先预测后解释"的两阶段神经-符号架构：
1. **神经预测模块（优化时序 Transformer）**：引入三项关键优化——可学习时序注意力权重矩阵（增强对评估周等关键时间点的关注）、类别加权交叉熵损失（应对仅约12%的风险学生类别不平衡）、动态周截断策略（按第5/10/15/20/25/30/35/38周分别训练以模拟真实早期预测场景）。
2. **符号推理模块（F-Logic 规则库）**：基于 Apriori 思想从训练数据挖掘120条规则（仅在80%训练集上挖掘以避免数据泄露），分为三类——静态模式规则（如总点击量极低）、时序序列规则（如三周活动连续下降趋势）、时间窗规则（覆盖第0-4、5-12、13-20周及全课程），规则置信度结合 Engagement Theory 和 Student Integration Model 的理论对齐分数（通过 SBERT 语义相似度量化）。
3. **混合融合机制**：采用两阶段训练的 logistic 回归融合（logit 空间加权和），自适应学习神经概率与符号置信度的相对权重，配合风险门控策略（仅对高风险或边缘区域学生激活 F-Logic 推理以提高效率）。系统输出四级风险等级（Critical/High/Medium/Low）并生成包含触发规则、理论因素、干预建议的结构化 JSON 解释。

Result: 在 OULAD 数据集（严格80/10/10学生级划分）上的实验结果：
- **端学期性能**：准确率0.900、F1分数0.894、召回率0.864、AUC-ROC 0.946、PR-AUC 0.960，显著优于 PatchTST（准确率0.867）、iTransformer（0.846）、LSTM（0.892）、CNN（0.865）；
- **早期检测**：平均检测周仅9.32周（领先时间28.68周，检测率94.30%），比 PatchTST 早6.38周、比 iTransformer 早4.60周、比纯神经消融版本早1.24周；
- **消融研究**：F-Logic 推理使早期检测提前约1.5周，时序注意力对早期召回贡献显著（移除后第5周召回从0.700降至0.589），类别加权损失对缓解不平衡至关重要；
- **统计显著性**：相比 PatchTST 准确率提升2.61%（p<0.001），相比 CNN 提升1.33%（p=0.008），F1 显著优于 LSTM（p=0.026）；
- **案例分析**：展示了对神经模型模糊判断（学生#45122，神经概率0.42）的修正——F-Logic 触发的三条早期规则将其提升为中高风险（0.681），实现"双重安全网"。

Conclusion: EduRiskX 验证了神经-符号融合在教育预警中的可行性：通过将数据驱动的时序建模与基于教育理论的符号推理相结合，并在 logit 空间进行可学习融合，框架在保持端学期竞争力的同时显著提升了早期检测能力。其结构化、理论对齐的解释输出解决了深度模型的"黑盒信任危机"，使框架可作为现代教育专家系统部署。未来工作将探索半自动规则优化、跨数据集泛化验证及替代融合策略。

Abstract: Predicting students' academic risk in online education is crucial for enabling timely interventions that can improve retention and learning outcomes. However, existing models often suffer from limited early detection capability and insufficient interpretability, leading to a "black-box" trust crisis that hinders their adoption in real-world pedagogical settings. To address these challenges, we propose EduRiskX, a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates a temporal Transformer-based predictor with F-Logic symbolic reasoning. The neural component models longitudinal student activity sequences using temporal attention, class-weighted loss, and dynamic weekly truncation. Acting as a data-driven expert system, an F-Logic rule base -- grounded in established educational theories (Engagement Theory and Student Integration Model) to mimic the diagnostic logic of human educators -- is constructed exclusively from the training data. The neural risk probability and the symbolic confidence score are then combined through a logistic regression-based fusion mechanism that learns the relative contribution of each signal. Experiments on the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD) using a strict 80/10/10 student-level split show that EduRiskX achieves an accuracy of 0.900 and an F1-score of 0.894 at the end of the semester (Week 38), with an average early detection week of 9.32 and a detection rate of 94.30 percent. Compared with state-of-the-art time-series models (PatchTST, iTransformer) and common deep learning baselines (LSTM, CNN), EduRiskX yields improved recall and earlier risk identification under identical conditions. Beyond predictive performance, the F-Logic module provides structured rule-based explanations linking predictions to observable behavioral patterns and educational theories.

</details>


### [125] [Standalone LLM and a Pre-specified Agentic Pipeline for Explaining ICU Mortality Predictions: a Feasibility Study on the eICU Demo Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26109)
*Di Zhu,Chen Xie,Haoyun Zhang,Zihan Wei,Ziwei Wang,Jiazhao Shi,Ziyu Wang,Qiyang Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一项关于使用独立LLM与预定义多步智能体(agentic)流水线为ICU死亡率预测提供临床解释的可行性研究，基于eICU Demo数据集进行对比分析。研究表明XGBoost预测性能良好（AUROC 0.855），且智能体分解流水线在指南依据和患者特异性方面优于独立LLM，但在SHAP对齐和方向一致性上较弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICU死亡率预测模型虽具较高判别力，但仅靠特征归因方法（如SHAP）难以提供床旁所需的临床叙述。LLM可弥合此差距，但单一提示会压缩多步推理；多步智能体流水线将数据解读、指南核查与最终解释分离，可能更适合危重症场景。本文旨在比较两种方式在临床解释质量上的差异。

Method: 使用eICU Demo数据集（2,353例ICU住院，死亡率8.1%）构建L2正则化逻辑回归和XGBoost死亡率预测模型，以AUROC/AUPRC评估并自助法计算95% CI；用SHAP进行全局特征归因；构建一个独立LLM（单次提示）和一个四步智能体流水线（数据解释→指南顾问→鉴别推理→综合器），均采用本地ollama服务的llama3.2:3b模型；在38例分层子集上生成解释，对14例与SHAP审阅子集重叠的病例对比评估SHAP对齐（Jaccard）、临床合理性、方向一致性、值特异性、指南依据和推理深度等指标，并进行结果泄露审计。

Result: XGBoost AUROC 0.855（95% CI 0.796–0.906），AUPRC 0.332；逻辑回归AUROC 0.823，AUPRC 0.345。SHAP显示年龄、最低SpO2、BUN、乳酸、呼吸频率为主要驱动特征。独立LLM在38例中1例出现明确结果泄露，移除后37例保留；14例重叠子集中：独立LLM的SHAP对齐均值0.171 vs 智能体0.077；方向一致性92.9% vs 78.6%；但智能体流水线在指南依据（0.762 vs 0.143）、值特异性（0.236 vs 0.143）、患者特异性提及率（85.7% vs 64.3%）和合理性（0.700 vs 0.671）方面均更优，且无结果泄露。

Conclusion: 预测模型具有足够判别力支持解释工作；独立LLM可生成简洁且方向一致的叙述，但患者特异性值较弱且与SHAP对齐有限；预定义智能体流水线减少了明显的结果泄露，并产生更具指南依据和患者特异性的解释，但这种改进以牺牲SHAP对齐和方向一致性为代价。因此，临床上有用的系统可能需要同时整合归因检查（保证模型保真度）和基于指南的语言层（保证可解释性），两者为互补关系而非替代关系。研究存在样本量小（仅14例重叠）、单一本地模型、数据缺失率较高等局限。

Abstract: Machine-learning models can predict ICU mortality accurately, but feature-attribution methods alone rarely provide the clinical narrative needed for bedside use. Large language models (LLMs) may bridge this gap, and multi-step agentic pipelines are a plausible extension because they separate data interpretation, guideline checking, and final explanation. This revised feasibility study preserves the original standalone-versus-agentic comparison while making the main clinical findings more explicit. Using the retained local eICU Demo artifact set (2,353 ICU stays; 8.1\% mortality), XGBoost achieved an AUROC of 0.855 (95\% CI 0.796--0.906) and an AUPRC of 0.332 (95\% CI 0.217--0.494). On a stratified 38-case explanation subset, the standalone LLM produced 1 explanation with explicit outcome leakage, whereas the four-step agentic pipeline produced none. Among the 14 cases that overlapped with the SHAP review subset, the standalone LLM showed higher SHAP alignment (mean Jaccard 0.171 versus 0.077) and higher direction consistency (92.9\% versus 78.6\%), while the agentic pipeline showed higher guideline grounding (0.762 versus 0.143), higher value specificity (0.236 versus 0.143), and slightly higher plausibility (0.700 versus 0.671). Clinically, the results suggest that agentic decomposition may improve safety-relevant grounding and patient-specific detail, but it should be paired with attribution-based checks before use in high-stakes risk explanation.

</details>


### [126] [Large Models for Battery Prognostics and Health Management: A Review and Future Roadmap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26111)
*Jiale Liu,Huan Wang,Weicheng Wang,Rong Zhu,Qiqi Wang,Min Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是第一篇系统综述大模型（Large Models, LMs）在电池预测与健康管理（BPHM）领域应用的论文。它从基础技术、四个核心研究维度、四大挑战以及未来路线图四个层面，全面梳理了大模型如何变革传统BPHM研究范式，并提出了从数据生态、智能验证、可信部署到端侧落地的系统性发展路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统BPHM方法（物理模型、任务专用深度学习）面临计算复杂、参数化困难、跨域泛化能力差、依赖大量标注的失效数据、可解释性不足等长期瓶颈。大模型凭借Transformer架构、自监督预训练和任务无关适配机制，为解决这些问题提供了变革性新范式，但该领域亟需系统性综述来整合分散成果并指引未来方向。

Method: 本文为综述性论文，采用系统性文献分析方法。首先阐述大模型基础技术（Transformer/自注意力、自监督学习、多模态数据融合、参数高效微调PEFT），然后沿四个维度梳理进展（缓解数据稀缺、增强泛化与鲁棒性、融合领域知识与可解释性、实现系统级自动化），接着识别数据、智能、可信度、部署四方面挑战，最后提出四支柱未来路线图（数据民主化、智能验证、可信增强、工业部署）。

Result: 1. 在数据稀缺方面，预训练知识迁移（如Lag-Llama微调仅需0.72%目标数据）、LLM文献解析（从PDF提取8000+电池数据）、DataGen合成数据生成取得显著效率提升。2. 在泛化能力方面，提示学习实现跨化学体系SOC/SOH估计，TimeGPT-1在143个电池上验证时序缩放规律，TTT框架支持终身在线适应。3. 在可解释性方面，物理约束解码器确保RUL预测单调性，LLM作为语义编排器调用电化学仿真工具验证推理。4. 在自动化方面，LLM-BAS双智能体实现零样本充电优化，LLM编排全流程建模管线。然而绝大多数工作仍处于实验室GPU部署阶段，缺乏标准化基准、跨化学体系对比与边缘部署实证。

Conclusion: 大模型并非任务专用模型的通用替代品，而是降低新增电池任务边际成本的强大共享基础设施，仍需领域自适应、安全验证和可解释性保障。未来需通过联邦学习与产业数据联盟构建协作数据生态，通过分层领域专属指标验证智能水平，通过物理引导设计增强可信度，通过云-边-端分层架构实现高效部署，最终推动电池管理从孤立预测任务迈向具备推理、适应与控制能力的自主系统。

Abstract: Battery Prognostics and Health Management (BPHM) is critical for ensuring the safe, reliable, and cost-effective operation of batteries across electric vehicles, grid storage, and consumer electronics. Conventional BPHM approaches, including physics-based models and task-centric deep learning methods, face challenges in computational efficiency and parameterization, cross-domain generalization, dependence on extensive labeled run-to-failure data, and model interpretability. Recent Large Models (LMs), built upon Transformer architectures and self-supervised pre-training, offer a transformative new paradigm to overcome these long-standing bottlenecks. This review provides the first comprehensive survey of LM applications in BPHM, systematically examining how these models address challenges in the field. We begin by elucidating the foundational technologies enabling LMs, including Transformer architectures, self-supervised learning, large-scale multimodal datasets, and PEFT techniques. We then categorize recent progress along four critical dimensions: mitigating data scarcity, enhancing generalization and robustness, integrating domain knowledge for interpretability, and enabling system-level automation. Despite promising results, significant challenges remain across data accessibility, intelligence validation, trustworthiness, and deployment feasibility. To guide future research, we propose a roadmap focused on building collaborative data ecosystems, validating intelligence for industrial applications, enhancing trustworthiness with physics-informed designs, and enabling efficient on-device deployment. This review establishes a systematic approach to understand and advance LM-driven BPHM, providing researchers and practitioners with essential insights for developing next-generation battery management systems capable of safe, reliable, and autonomous operation throughout battery lifecycles.

</details>


### [127] [PICasso: An AI-Enabled Design Framework for Autonomous Optimization of Silicon Photonic Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26113)
*Deepak Vungarala,Deniz Najafi,Abdulrahman Aljoudi,Zahra Ghanaatian,Navid Khoshavi,Gourav Datta,Arman Roohi,Mahdi Nikdast,Shaahin Angizi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PICasso 是首个端到端 LLM 驱动的硅光（PIC）自动化设计框架，通过 NL→YAML→GDS 结构化流水线、PDK 知识注入、DRC/LVS 物理验证和 SAX 仿真反馈，将 LLM 从脆弱的网表生成器转变为可生成可制造版图的实用 PIC 设计代理。作者还提出了 PIC-Set 基准（36 个参数化设计任务）和 Spec@k 等新评估指标，在多种 LLM 上验证了框架的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前光子设计自动化（PDA）工具仍以 GUI 为主，电路复杂度增长时手动布线呈超线性扩展，且设计、仿真、验证阶段分散在不同商业/开源工具中，缺乏版本控制、可重复性和参数灵活性。现有 LLM 应用于 PIC 设计的研究稀缺且局限：依赖启发式提示工程、缺少领域知识、仅做语法检查，导致设计虽语法正确却物理不可实现或功能错误。本文围绕三个研究问题展开：LLM 在结构化约束下能否生成功能正确的 PIC 设计？设备级优化能否端到端自动化？设备级与电路级优化能否在统一闭环中结合？

Method: 框架核心包含两条原则：(1) 提示约束生成——通过知识注入模块向 LLM 提供 YAML 语法规则、PDK 组件/端口定义、参数集、间距要求和典型失败模式；(2) 反馈驱动优化——通过 pilot 提示执行预执行验证（ASCII、YAML schema、参数、端口一致性、间距），编译后调用 gdsfactory 的 gf.read.from_yaml() 执行自动布局布线，KLayout 进行 DRC，LVS 验证网表一致性，所有违规被结构化反馈回 LLM 触发定向修复。验证通过的版图进入两阶段优化：设备级优化在物理可实现范围内扫描波导宽度/半径、MMI 尺寸等参数，最小化仿真响应与目标特性的 L2 偏差；电路级优化将相移与耦合系数作为可调变量，使用多起点 Nelder-Mead 方法最大化传输矩阵 T 的主导奇异值 σ₁²(T) 以最小化插入损耗。评估方面提出三类新指标：结构 Spec@k（YAML 解析、组件编译、布线、DRC/LVS 全部通过）、功能 Spec@k（SAX 频域仿真满足拓扑特定容差）、优化效率 η_opt = (IL_before − IL_after)/(IL_before + ε)。基准 PIC-Set 含 36 个参数化任务，按拓扑分为 C1（单组件）、C2（2-8 组件）、C3（>8 组件）三级复杂度。

Result: 在 PIC-Set 全部 36 个任务上，对比 GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Llama 3.1 70B 三种 LLM 的 vanilla 生成与 PICasso 全流水线：Claude Sonnet 4.5 + PICasso 在 C1/C2 复杂度下达到 100% 结构和功能 Spec@3；C3 高复杂度下结构 Spec@3 达 90.7%、功能 Spec@3 达 52%（vanilla LLM 在 C3 下功能 Spec 均为 0%）。GPT-4o 在 C2 下结构 Spec@3 从 vanilla 的 33.3% 提升至 99.2%。消融实验显示：pilot 验证使结构正确率从 25-42% 饱和至 100%；加入 DRC/LVS/SAX 后功能 Spec@5 达 91.7%；完整 PICasso（含优化）为 83.3%。优化层面，初始电路插入损耗均值从 vanilla 的 4.98 dB 降至 PICasso 的 3.25 dB（改善 1.74 dB），中位数从 6.85 dB 降至 0.72 dB（改善 6.13 dB）。运行时间 4-8 分钟/任务，远快于手动 GUI 工作流的 25-60 分钟。主要失败案例为 64-QAM 调制器和 90° 光混合器等相位敏感高复杂度电路，其相匹配约束超出 Nelder-Mead 优化器的收敛半径。

Conclusion: PICasso 是首个将自然语言输入、结构化多层验证和功能优化统一于单一闭环的端到端自主 PIC 合成框架，配套的 PIC-Set 基准和 Spec@k、优化效率等指标为该领域建立了标准化评估基础。实验证明架构先验、验证反馈和物理级约束对 PIC 代码生成至关重要，单纯提示工程无法达到可制造级别。框架将 LLM 从不可靠的电路生成器转变为可同时满足物理与功能约束的可制造版图设计代理。当前局限在于 Nelder-Mead 在高维相位优化上收敛不足，未来方向包括基于梯度的方法或学习代理模型以扩展优化器适用范围。

Abstract: We present PICasso, an AI-assisted framework for automated synthesis, verification, and optimization of photonic integrated circuits (PICs) from natural-language specifications. PICasso couples a structured NL -> YAML -> GDS generation pipeline with PDK aware knowledge injection, automated placement and routing, DRC/LVS validation, and SAX-based photonic simulation. To systematically evaluate AI-driven photonic design, we introduce PIC-Set, a benchmark of 36 parameterized PIC design tasks spanning core photonic primitives and multi-component circuits. Using PIC-Set, we benchmark several state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) under a unified evaluation protocol, including new metrics such as structural and functional $Spec@k$, optimization efficiency, and robustness under perturbations. Across the benchmark, PICasso significantly improves end-to-end specification satisfaction compared to vanilla LLM generation. Structural $Spec@3$ reaches up to 92.7% and functional $Spec@3$ up to 52% on high-complexity circuits. In addition, PICasso consistently reduces circuit insertion loss, lowering the mean loss from 4.98 dB to 3.25 dB (1.74 dB improvement) through simulation-guided optimization. These results demonstrate that structured domain constraints, physical verification, and simulation feedback transform LLMs from brittle netlist generators into practical PIC design agents capable of producing manufacturable layouts with competitive runtimes relative to manual GUI-based workflows.

</details>


### [128] [CIFQA: A Deterministic Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Financial Query Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26114)
*Kunjesh Parekh,Anil Kumar Tiwari,Divya Saxena*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CIFQA框架，通过将语言理解与确定性数值计算严格分离，解决LLM在计算密集型金融问答中的算术幻觉问题。该框架在定期存款查询基准上达到95.54%的计算密集型准确率和90.87%的总体准确率，显著优于GPT-5.3、Gemini 3和Claude Sonnet 4.6等前沿模型，且17B开源骨干网络表现优于这些更大的专有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿大语言模型在计算密集型金融任务中表现出系统性执行失败，即使提供完整的公式、利率表和基准说明，仍会产生数值不正确但看似合理的"算术幻觉"答案。这种局限性源于概率语言模型无法可靠执行确定性多步计算，而非信息缺失。论文旨在识别并解决这一架构性问题。

Method: CIFQA采用五阶段多智能体LLM流水线架构：(1)路由智能体分类查询类型；(2)提取智能体将自然语言转换为结构化参数；(3)规划智能体生成计算计划；(4)确定性Python计算引擎执行所有数值运算（包括利率查询引擎、利息计算引擎、日历引擎和规则引擎）；(5)响应生成器合成自然语言答案。核心原则是LLM仅负责语言理解和规划，所有算术运算完全委托给确定性引擎。骨干网络使用Llama-Scout-17B。

Result: 在126个定期存款查询基准上：CIFQA在101个计算密集型查询上达到95.54%准确率（算术幻觉率仅4.46%），总体准确率90.87%。相比之下，GPT-5.3为45.05%、Gemini 3为70.30%、Claude Sonnet 4.6为83.66%。类别分析显示CIFQA在季度付息、月度付息、累计定期存款、TDS相关和边缘案例类别中达到近乎完美的准确率。消融研究表明滚动年调整逻辑（降至48.00%）、精确利率查询模块（降至76.73%）和提前支取逻辑（降至76.92%）是关键性能驱动因素。Llama-Scout-17B骨干在CIFQA框架内的表现优于Llama-70B（89.60%）和Llama-8B（68.81%）。

Conclusion: 论文得出结论：计算密集型金融问答中的算术幻觉是架构问题而非信息问题。架构设计（特别是语言理解与确定性计算的严格分离）比模型规模更能决定数值可靠性。CIFQA提供了一个可泛化的模块化设计模式，可扩展至贷款摊销、债券定价、投资组合分析和税务计算等领域。未来工作方向包括利率趋势分析、多定期存款清算规划和跨资产类别优化等主动决策支持场景。

Abstract: Calculation-intensive financial question answering requires exact reasoning over structured rates, temporal conditions, numerical formulas, and rule-based constraints. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) perform strongly on natural language tasks, they often produce numerically incorrect yet plausible answers when solving multi-step financial calculations. To address this limitation, we introduce CIFQA (Calculation-Intensive Financial Query Answering), a deterministic tool-grounded multi-agent LLM framework for financial question answering. CIFQA separates language understanding from numerical execution by assigning specialized agents to query interpretation, routing, parameter extraction, computation planning, and response generation, while deterministic Python-based tools perform financial calculations and rule application. We instantiate CIFQA for fixed deposit query answering and evaluate it on a curated benchmark of fixed deposit queries. CIFQA achieves 95.54% accuracy on calculation-intensive queries and 90.87% overall accuracy, substantially outperforming direct LLM baselines even when provided with complete formulas, rate cards, and benchmark instructions. Ablation studies show that deterministic components such as exact rate lookup, tenure computation, rolling-year adjustment, and premature-withdrawal logic are critical contributors to performance. Notably, a 17B open-source backbone operating within CIFQA outperforms substantially larger frontier models evaluated with the same financial information, demonstrating that architectural design is a more important determinant of numerical reliability than model scale. While evaluated on fixed deposit queries, CIFQA provides a generalizable framework for calculation-intensive financial reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [129] [The Artificial Experimentalist: Discovery and Control of Self-Organizing Phenomena with Autotelic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26116)
*Marko Cvjetko,Benedikt Hartl,Michael Levin,Clément Moulin-Frier,Pierre-Yves Oudeyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了 CARL 框架，基于自目标强化学习（autotelic RL）实现对连续元胞自动机 Lenia 中自组织现象（孤子）的闭环发现与控制。CARL 通过自主采样多样化目标并学习目标条件策略，在 Lenia 演化过程中施加最小局部扰动。实验表明 CARL 在多种更新规则下生成稳定孤子的成功率高于启发式基线，能操控孤子运动方向，并可作为人类实时引导孤子穿越迷宫的高级指令接口，且具备零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对元胞自动机等复杂系统的探索多为开环方式（设定初始条件后被动观察），缺乏在演化过程中进行干预的能力。人类面对复杂系统时通常会持续观察和交互形成因果直觉，但非线性与延迟效应使人类直觉易产生偏差。因此需要一种交互驱动的自动化方法，将期望的实验结果转化为对复杂系统有效的因果干预。

Method: 形式化基于自目标强化学习的通用框架，将复杂系统建模为 (S, F)，定义干预空间 α 和任务规范 (G, r)，训练目标条件策略 π。在 Lenia 上实例化为 CARL：状态为 [0,1] 网格，动力学为带卷积核 K 和生长函数 φ 的更新规则；动作为局部添加/移除/不变扰动；使用 U-Net + FiLM 条件层的 Double DQN 训练策略；通过质量跟踪任务（带动作成本惩罚）使孤子创建成为奖励最大化涌现的副产品。

Result: （1）CARL 在 85 个训练更新规则上创建稳定孤子的成功率显著高于所有启发式基线（随机、无操作、基于质量的策略）；（2）训练后可零样本泛化到修改的动作参数、缩放核半径（4–26）和全新卷积核的高维参数空间；（3）方向控制任务中余弦相似度在训练条件下达 0.91±0.14，对未见孤子和方向分别优雅降级；（4）人类可通过实时改变目标方向和成本，引导孤子在迷宫中导航。

Conclusion: CARL 验证了自目标强化学习作为闭环控制复杂自组织系统框架的可行性，展示了组合重用能力（迷宫中同时创建与控制）。其动作成本设计促使策略与系统内禀动力学协同而非对抗，为"人工实验科学家"（artificial experimentalist）代理奠定了基础。未来需扩展至部分可观测、随机性和高维动作空间，并降低领域专业知识的依赖（如采用内在奖励或 LLM 驱动任务设计）。该工作对再生医学和生物工程具有概念意义。

Abstract: Existing methods for exploring cellular automata and other complex systems mostly operate in open loop: they set initial conditions, execute a full simulation, and observe the outcome, without intervening during execution. We introduce a closed-loop framework based on autotelic reinforcement learning, in which an agent autonomously samples diverse goals and learns a goal-conditioned policy to intervene in a complex system through minimal, local perturbations. We instantiate this framework on Lenia, a continuous cellular automaton known for life-like self-organizing patterns, in an agentic system we call CARL, and demonstrate three capabilities. First, CARL discovers stable solitons across a wide range of Lenia update rules at a higher rate than heuristic baselines. Second, it learns to steer the movement direction of existing solitons with few interventions, showing that CARL can control self-organizing patterns, not only create them. Third, humans can use trained agents to guide solitons through maze environments in real time by specifying high-level directional commands that the agent translates into low-level interventions. Trained across diverse goals, update rules, and random initial states, the agents acquire policies that generalize zero-shot to various out-of-distribution conditions. These results suggest a path toward artificial experimentalist agents that, autonomously or with human guidance, discover and control emergent phenomena in complex systems.

</details>


### [130] [The Accuracy-Efficiency Paradox Quantifying Net Energy Loss in on-Device Energy Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26134)
*Jaeik Jeong,Tai-Yeon Ku,Wan-Ki Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"准确性-效率悖论"（Accuracy-Efficiency Paradox），指出在边缘设备上进行能耗预测时，高精度复杂模型虽然能减少预测误差带来的能量浪费，但其推理能耗和由此引发的电池老化反而可能导致系统净能量亏损。为此，论文提出基于总拥有成本（TCO）的统一框架，将预测误差、推理能耗与Arrhenius定律衍生的电池老化成本融合为单一能量损失指标，并通过实验证明：在热敏感边缘环境中，最优模型的选择并非静态，而是取决于环境热敏感系数 k。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统能耗预测研究以最大化预测精度为核心目标，默认"精度越高越节能"。然而边缘设备（尤其是军事等任务关键场景）中，复杂模型的推理能耗产生局部热应力，根据Arrhenius定律会指数级加速电池老化，从而以"内能损耗"抵消精度提升带来的节能收益，形成悖论。论文旨在揭示并量化这一悖论。

Method: 1）基于Arrhenius方程推导电池老化成本 C_aging(Z)=c_l·(e^(k·3600·Z)−1)，其中 k 为综合环境常数；2）结合Landauer原理将推理能耗 Z 转换为热量 Q≈3600·Z 并推导出局部温升 ΔT=Q/C；3）提出TCO目标函数：TCO_t = c_p|X_t−Y_t| + c_o·Z_t + c_l(e^(k·3600·Z_t)−1)，将预测误差、推理能耗、电池老化统一为能量损失维度；4）实验选用LR、MLP、Transformer三种模型，基于韩国Yeosu市2021年9月–2022年8月小时级住宅能耗数据进行小时-ahead预测，对比不同热敏感度 k 下的TCO表现。

Result: 在低热敏感度（k<0.08）时，Transformer凭借2.7%的MAE优势取得最低TCO；随 k 增大，Transformer的TCO指数级上升，在 k>0.22 时沦为最差选择。MLP在 k>18.0 的极端条件下同样被LR反超。48小时动态累积TCO表明，高热敏感场景（k=20）下Transformer劣势几乎即时显现，最终LR成为最优解。实验证实最优模型高度依赖运行环境热敏感度。

Conclusion: 论文揭示了边缘AI能耗预测中"精度提升并不必然带来系统级能效提升"的悖论，并通过融合Arrhenius电池老化模型的TCO框架，为在热敏感边缘环境中选择真正能量最优的预测模型提供了理论与实证工具。研究局限包括：热行为、电池老化及推理-热转换的理论简化假设、实验任务局限于简单小时-ahead场景、以及模型范围有限。未来需在联邦学习、数据中心等更复杂场景以及多步/多站点预测任务中进一步验证TCO悖论。

Abstract: Energy forecasting aims to maximize accuracy to ensure energy efficiency by reducing energy waste, an objective that applies equally to on-device forecasting for mission-critical edge environments, including military systems. However, this paper identifies the Accuracy-Efficiency Paradox: high-precision energy forecasting models can ironically trigger a net energy deficit. This stems from both edge AI's inference energy consumption and battery aging. We propose a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) framework for energy forecasting, designed to minimize net energy loss. This framework treats not only inference energy consumption but also battery aging as a unified form of energy loss, as degradation represents a physical dissipation of the system's future energy-carrying capacity. We demonstrate that in thermally sensitive edge environments, energy saved by the superior precision of complex architectures is often outweighed by the total energy lost through their high operational intensity.

</details>


### [131] [LLMs for Academic Workflows: An Evaluation of Literature Reviews Generated with Short and Long Context Windows of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26145)
*Muhammad Ali Chaudhry,Xinyuan Hao,Haifa Alwahaby*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究评估了大语言模型（LLMs）在短上下文和长上下文设置下生成的文献综述质量，探讨上下文窗口对AI生成文献综述质量的影响及AI在文献综述写作中的辅助作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型在学术写作中的广泛应用，其生成的文献综述质量及其局限性尚缺乏系统性评估。本研究旨在探究上下文窗口大小对AI生成文献综述质量的影响，并明确AI在文献综述写作中的实际效用与不足。

Method: 研究从Semantic Scholar和Arxiv获取研究资料，由大语言模型生成20篇文献综述，由两位研究者从15个评估维度对其进行系统评价，对比短上下文与长上下文设置下生成结果的差异。

Result: 研究发现：AI生成的文献综述需经人工监督方能达到学术出版标准；随着上下文窗口扩大，LLM虽能纳入更广泛信息并保持较长输入的连贯性，但内容重复、关键文献遗漏及重描述轻综合等问题也随之加剧。

Conclusion: AI生成的文献综述可提供基础性概述，但其输出必须由领域专家进行批判性评估与精炼。未来研究应融合多种LLM与领域微调模型，并采用结合人类专业知识与AI能力的混合方法，以弥补当前研究的局限性。

Abstract: Our research focuses on evaluating literature reviews generated in short and long context settings of large language models (LLMs) to investigate the impact of context window on the quality of AI-generated literature reviews and the role of AI in supporting literature review writing. Twenty AI-generated literature reviews based on research sources from Semantic Scholar and Arxiv were evaluated by two researchers across 15 dimensions. Our findings reveal that AI-generated literature reviews require human oversight to meet academic publishing standards. As context windows increase, LLMs can incorporate broader information and maintain coherence across longer inputs, but they also exacerbate issues such as content repetition, omission of critical work, and a tendency towards descriptiveness over synthesis. Our work shows that AI-generated reviews can provide foundational overviews, but their output must be critically evaluated and refined by domain experts. Future research should consider integrating other LLMs and fine-tuned models in different domains with hybrid approaches that combine human expertise with AI capabilities to address the limitations identified in this study.

</details>


### [132] [Methodological and Conceptual Framework for 5D Multi-Table Analysis: A Unified Approach for Complex Data Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26149)
*Edouard Lansiaux,Hugo Kazzi,Aurélien Loison,Slim Hammadi,Emmanuel Chazard*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了关系超图变换器（RHT），一个用于多表数据分析的统一架构，将关系数据库表示为超图，学习五维嵌入（PentE），并执行稀疏关系注意力，复杂度为 O(n·k) 而非 O(n²)。论文在 Synthea 合成 EHR 数据集上进行了多标签 SNOMED CT 条件代码预测的实证评估，结果显示 XGBoost 在稀有代码召回率上表现最佳，而 RHT 在嵌入语义一致性上最强（1.52±0.03）。MIMIC-IV 临床验证因需 PhysioNet 凭证而尚未完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多表学习在医疗等复杂信息系统中面临五大维度的挑战：海量数据量、多变量、高基数类别特征、复杂的表间关系以及重复的时间观测。传统方法通过 SQL join 将多表融合为宽表，会导致维度爆炸、丢失关系语义、无法处理高基数和时间序列。本文旨在提供一个统一框架同时处理这五个维度的复杂性。

Method: 提出了关系超图变换器（RHT），包含四个计算模块：（1）超图构建——将关系模式转化为 n-元关系超图；（2）多尺度时间嵌入——基于 Time2Vec 的自适应时间编码；（3）高基数注意力——通过关系掩码实现稀疏注意力，复杂度从 O(n²) 降至 O(n·k)；（4）可微分关系发现——自动发现潜在关系。配合五维嵌入（PentE）将语义、关系、时间、类别、容量五个维度统一到单一潜空间中。方法论包含八个步骤的端到端管道，以及关系对比学习、动态图重布线和关系因果推断等技术创新。

Result: 在 Synthea 数据集（22,913 患者，313 个 SNOMED 代码）上：XGBoost 的 RCR@10 为 0.538，RCR@50 为 0.650，表现最优；GraphSAGE 的 RCR@10 为 0.082；RHT 的 RCR@10 为 0.035，RCR@50 为 0.168，但语义一致性达 1.52±0.03，为唯一能产生有意义的语义一致性的模型。消融实验表明 M3（分层类别编码）是语义结构的关键驱动因素。模块禁用后一致性降至 1.00±0.00。MIMIC-IV demo 规模测试中吞吐量达约 10⁵ 行/秒，压缩比达 4.09。

Conclusion: RHT 提供了首个同时处理多表数据五大维度复杂性的统一架构，并在稀有类别召回和宏观 F1 上未能超越 XGBoost，但在语义嵌入一致性上有显著优势。五大贡献：统一的 5D 概念框架、RHT 架构、方法论创新、综合基准和评估指标体系。主要局限性：实现复杂、初始超图构建计算密集、依赖关系元数据质量、当前实证仅在合成数据上完成。下一关键步骤是完成完整 MIMIC-IV 临床验证（待 PhysioNet 凭证审批），以及推出 MT-5D-Bench 标准基准。

Abstract: Multi-table learning remains a major challenge in machine learning for healthcare and other complex information systems. Relational data combine several sources of complexity, including large data volume, high-dimensional variables, high-cardinality categorical features, complex inter-table dependencies, and repeated temporal observations. We introduce the Relational Hypergraph Transformer (RHT), a unified architecture that represents relational databases as hypergraphs, learns pentadimensional embeddings (PentE), and performs sparse relational attention with complexity proportional to the average relational degree rather than the square of the number of entities. We formally define the architecture, derive the complexity of its attention mechanism, and provide an open-source reference implementation. We evaluate RHT on the public Synthea synthetic electronic health record dataset using multi-label prediction of SNOMED CT condition codes per encounter, a task characterized by high categorical cardinality and long-tailed label distributions. Comparisons with tabular, relational, and temporal graph baselines show that RHT produces more semantically coherent embeddings while remaining computationally scalable. In this benchmark, the highest rare-code recall is achieved by XGBoost, whereas RHT attains the strongest embedding semantic coherence. We also report ablation studies quantifying the contribution of each architectural component. Clinical validation on MIMIC-IV is planned following PhysioNet credentialing. Source code and experimental protocols are provided in the accompanying repository.

</details>


### [133] [Leveraging Large Language Models for Systematic Literature Review of Disease Spread Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26150)
*Orhan Yagizer Cinar,Timur Emre Ozkose,Emma Von Hoene,Amira Roess,Taylor Anderson,Hamdi Kavak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对536篇COVID-19基于代理模型（ABM）论文，开发了基于GPT-4.1和GPT-5.0的全自动LLM数据提取流水线，并与人工系统综述（SLR）结果进行对比评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM辅助系统综述的研究多集中于小样本、临床领域，且依赖Web界面难以复现；针对建模与仿真领域的大规模、API化、零样本LLM数据提取性能尚缺乏实证评估。

Method: 构建六步LLM提取流水线（准备→提示设计→提取→输出校验→对比→统计分析），通过OpenAI API以零样本方式处理536篇全文PDF，采用Jaccard指数和重叠系数按字段类型进行相似度评估，并在字段级与论文级与人工参考数据进行比较。

Result: 论文级准确率：GPT-4.1为77.95%，GPT-5.0为81.67%（差异统计显著，p<0.001，效应量d=0.28）；字段级准确率范围32.4%–100%，单选与自由文本字段表现最佳，多选字段（尤其是主观学科分类）表现最差；LLM间一致性可作为质量诊断指标——低一致性提示幻觉，高一致但低准确可能反映人工数据噪声。

Conclusion: 零样本LLM可在大规模建模与仿真SLR中实现中高度自动化的数据提取，成本低于10美元/模型运行，远低于人工SLR；通过多模型一致性分析，LLM不仅可复现人工提取，还可作为审计工具识别参考数据中的潜在问题；未来工作应探索少样本提示、监督微调及扩展至PRISMA全流程。

Abstract: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have created new opportunities to streamline and potentially automate many research processes, including systematic literature reviews (SLRs). This study reports an LLM pipeline development for extracting model-relevant information from 536 peer-reviewed agent-based modeling papers. We compare the results with those of a human-conducted SLR. Our results show paper-level accuracies of approximately 77.95% for GPT-4.1 and 81.67% for GPT-5.0. Field-level accuracy ranges from 32.40% to 100.00%, with more complex or subjective fields performing less reliably. Importantly, we find that agreement between LLMs is a potential indicator of output quality: low agreement may signal hallucinations, whereas high agreement combined with low accuracy may point to noise or errors in the human dataset. Overall, our study provides practical insights into prompt development and highlights both the potential and limitations of using LLMs for full-scale SLRs in the modeling and simulation domain.

</details>


### [134] [Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Customer Churn Prediction in Telecommunications: A Framework for CRM Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26151)
*Sandeep Gaddamwar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对电信客户流失预测中黑箱模型难以融入CRM工作流的问题，在IBM Telco基准数据集上对比了四种分类器，结合SHAP和LIME进行可解释性分析，并提出了一套将解释输出转化为CRM操作的四层集成架构，量化了商业收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高预测性能的集成和非线性模型虽能准确识别流失风险客户，但其不透明性使挽留专员无法仅凭概率分数设计个性化干预方案；现有XAI研究多将解释作为分析产出而非运营输入，缺乏从SHAP归因向量到具体CRM挽留行动以及从活动结果反馈回模型端到端的闭环框架。

Method: 在IBM Telco Customer Churn基准（7,043条记录、19个特征、原始流失率26.5%）上，对Logistic Regression、Random Forest（400棵CART树）、XGBoost和LightGBM四种分类器进行对比；预处理采用标签编码与独热编码（扩展至40维）、最小-最大缩放、分层80/20划分，仅在训练集上使用SMOTE过采样至50%平衡；全局用SHAP mean|SHAP|排名，实例级用SHAP瀑布图和LIME局部代理；提出四层CRM架构（评分-分层-解释-反馈），通过查表将前3个归因特征映射到结构化挽留动作模板，并以PSI>0.20作为重训练触发器。

Result: 四种模型AUC-ROC集中在0.831–0.841区间（仅差0.011）：Logistic Regression取得最高AUC 0.8411和召回率78.34%，LightGBM准确率最高（78.42%），Random Forest F1最高（0.6231）；5折交叉验证下前三模型AUC差距小于0.007，实质持平。全局SHAP识别tenure、TotalCharges和月付合同为最主要驱动；高风险案例（p=0.941）由短期tenure和月付合同主导，稳定用户（p=0.003）由长期tenure和两年期合同保护，SHAP与LIME结论一致。靶向风险最高的20%用户预计每周期可保留收入19.9万–31.9万美元，整体流失率降低3.3–5.3个百分点。

Conclusion: XAI驱动的流失预测可超越分析层面，作为结构化运营输入直接嵌入CRM决策流水线：模型对比证实Logistic Regression与树模型在该基准上实际持平，解释方法结论一致且与领域知识吻合；所提四层集成架构将SHAP归因转化为分层策略和查表驱动的挽留动作，并通过PSI监控的活动反馈闭环实现持续优化；未来工作指向联邦学习、uplift建模和时序XAI。

Abstract: Subscriber attrition is a costly, persistent challenge for telecommunications providers, with monthly churn of roughly 1.9% in mature markets eroding billions in revenue annually. Predictive models can flag at-risk customers accurately, yet they are routinely excluded from frontline CRM workflows because high-performing ensemble and non-linear architectures are opaque: a retention specialist cannot design a personalised intervention from a probability score alone, without knowing why a subscriber is at risk. This paper addresses that gap. We benchmark four classifiers--Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM--on the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark (7,043 records; 19 features; 26.5% churn, balanced to 50% via SMOTE on the training partition only). Logistic Regression attains the strongest AUC-ROC (0.8411) and LightGBM the highest accuracy (78.42%); all four fall within a 0.011 AUC band (0.831--0.841), and 5-fold cross-validation confirms the leading models are effectively tied. Explanations are delivered at two granularities: a global SHAP ranking identifying tenure, total charges, and month-to-month contract as the dominant churn signals, and instance-level SHAP and LIME decompositions that expose the drivers behind each prediction. Building on these outputs, we introduce a four-layer CRM integration architecture that converts risk scores and attribution vectors into tiered segmentation, maps top features to structured retention-action templates, and routes campaign outcomes into a retraining feedback loop. Targeting the highest-risk quintile is projected to cut overall churn by 3.3--5.3 percentage points, preserving an estimated $199K--$319K per campaign cycle.

</details>


### [135] [EEG-to-Report: An Annotation and Feature-Text Framework for Training Language Models on Clinical EEG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26153)
*Xuan-The Tran,Le Trung Kien Nguyen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EEG-to-Report 是一个基于浏览器的EEG标注与特征-文本一体化框架，支持多格式EEG导入、分段标注（文本/语音）、自动特征提取以及基于CNN集成与大语言模型的自动报告生成，旨在为训练多模态EEG-语言模型构建对齐的特征-文本语料库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床EEG报告撰写仍以手工为主，耗时且依赖专家经验；现有EEG工具箱主要面向可视化与预处理，缺乏面向临床医生构建AI就绪对齐数据集的工作流。同时，现有AI系统多为黑箱，缺乏可检查、可编辑的人工在环监督机制，难以整合到临床流程中。
