Third, we observe neither improvements in sophistication over time nor lasting improvements following formal AI training, suggesting that sophisticated use can be difficult to change. Together, our study provides measures of and insights into sophisticated genAI use that managers can use to improve outcomes and that researchers can use in future research.

</details>


### [216] [CorporateBench: Large-Scale Q&A Benchmarking with Temporal Knowledge Bases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27391)
*Sil Hamilton,Albert Yu Sun,Oscar J. Romero,Carl-Leander Henneking,David Mimno,Bishan Yang,Igor Labutov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CorporateBench (CB) 是一个大规模、经过人工验证的企业级问答基准测试，基于时序演化的知识库生成合成公司语料库（覆盖12至10,000名员工的四家公司，共263,466个文档），通过信息抽取和知识库查询两大维度评估大语言模型在企业通信推理任务上的表现，揭示了现有LLM在接近真实规模的语料上性能急剧下降的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前企业级LLM评估面临两大困境：真实企业数据受保密协议限制无法公开，现有合成数据集过于简单且规模不足（通常≤30,000文档）。此外，常见的长上下文测试（如"大海捞针"）缺乏真实企业环境的复杂性和互联性，无法有效衡量LLM在企业场景下的推理能力。这阻碍了LLM在工业界的大规模应用。

Method: 采用"知识库到语料库"（KB-to-corpus）生成流程：(1) 使用Turtle/OWL定义企业本体（实体与关系）；(2) 模拟公司层级、工作任务、跨90天的会议并注入约10%的新员工变动；(3) 从KB中采样3,217种"证据字符串"按时间阶段和显式程度分类，通过Claude Haiku 4.5填充邮件内容；(4) 引入3,000商业+3,000非商业主题（Dirichlet分布α=0.75）和16种MBTI人格以增强词汇多样性。评估任务包括抽取类（KB构建F₁、主题分类）与QA类（KB QA、Topic QA、Integrated QA），在RAG与直接KB SQL访问两种设置下，使用5个轻量LLM（Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.5、GPT-5 Nano、GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite）进行测试。

Result: 随着语料规模接近真实企业级别，模型性能急剧下降。关键发现：(1) 实体抽取F₁保持稳定（0.715-0.824），但关系抽取从小型（S: 0.419-0.845）大幅退化到超大型（XL: 0.205-0.494），时序关系退化尤为严重（S: 0.142-0.470 → XL: 0.062-0.173）；(2) KB直接访问始终优于RAG，差距随规模扩大而增加（KB QA上S→XL的KB-RAG差距从0.24扩大到0.37）；(3) KB QA和Topic QA性能随语料增大而下降，但Integrated QA因更大语料提供更丰富上下文反而略有提升；(4) GPT-5模型在RAG上领先，Sonnet 4.5在KB查询上最优，GPT-5.1存在过早停止问题（KB设置下191次 vs RAG下56次）。错误分析表明事件型关系（attend、organize）最难抽取，存在系统性漏报与过报问题。

Conclusion: CorporateBench填补了企业级LLM基准测试的关键空白，首次实现了在企业真实规模（>10⁵文档）下保持跨文档逻辑一致性的可验证合成评估。实验表明当代LLM对企业任务仅勉强胜任，性能与语料规模呈负相关。该基准可作为企业通信推理能力的衡量标准，推动研究者关注上下文窗口扩展与真实长上下文理解之间的差距，并鼓励未来通过程序化生成知识库的方法论在其他领域（如深度研究）复现。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly able to answer complex questions about enterprise-scale document collections. But evaluation is hard: companies don't want to share internal communications, and synthetic datasets have been overly simple. We present CorporateBench (CB), a human-validated multi-task Q&A benchmark whose scale approaches the conditions LLMs encounter in corporate communication networks, with evaluation corpora surpassing 230,000 documents. CB evaluates LLMs across two dimensions (information extraction and knowledge base querying) through four synthetically generated firms ranging from 12 to 10,000 employees. Each corpus is sampled from a temporally evolving knowledge base describing a consistent world, guaranteeing cross-document logical consistency even across hundreds of thousands of documents. We evaluate five LLMs on CB, revealing increasingly poor performance as input size approaches realistic scales. CB provides LLM developers a metric for corporate communication reasoning, filling a crucial gap in the benchmarking ecosystem.

</details>


### [217] [Learning a Continuous Sepsis Severity Score Without Hour-by-Hour Supervision: A Two-Site Retrospective Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27421)
*Kevin Zhu,Ryan Zhang,Baraa Abed,Tilendra Choudhary,Malvern Madondo,Mehak Arora,Yixuan Yang,Alasdair Gent,Aditya Nagori,Omer T. Inan,Krista L. Haines,Patrick Georgoff,Suresh M. Agarwal,Vijay Krishnamoorthy,Tetsu Ohnuma,Mihai V. Podgoreanu,Michael R. Pinsky,Gilles Clermont,Craig M. Coopersmith,Craig S. Jabaley,Rishikesan Kamaleswaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文开发了一种直接从患者临床轨迹中学习的脓毒症严重程度指数（基于43个常规变量、72小时治疗窗口），将死亡率作为治疗级别排序信号而非逐状态目标，并在两个大型医院系统数据上验证其在不同SOFA亚组及外部机构中均能有效区分预后。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统脓毒症严重程度指数（如SOFA）依赖几十年前固定的变量和权重，分层粗糙且不再适应当代重症监护环境，尚无基于患者轨迹学习的替代方案在临床常规使用。

Method: 回顾性双队列研究（麻省和乔治亚州两家医院系统，共29,116+7,691名Sepsis-3成人患者）；使用72小时治疗窗口内的43个常规记录变量；将死亡率建模为治疗级（treatment-level）排序信号而非逐状态目标，从而在时间步间非均匀分配贡献；通过20%永久测试集、临床情境（vignettes）和Spearman相关进行评估；通过整患者自助法（bootstrap）获取不确定性区间。

Result: 在所有SOFA-2基线分层内，非存活者评分比存活者高1.19–1.64分（0–10量表）；乳酸、MAP、肌酐分层结果类似。指数变化与乳酸变化Spearman ρ=0.39（n=1,854），与MAP、肌酐相关性较弱但方向一致。跨机构模型间Spearman相关达同机构模型的70–77%。外部验证中患者内相关性为0.54和0.59（上限0.92和0.90）。与既有指数相关，空对照接近零。

Conclusion: 该脓毒症指数提供小时级预后信息，能有意义地区分患者结局并与临床预期一致，有望作为临床决策支持的补充工具。

Abstract: Currently used sepsis severity indices rely on fixed variables and weights established decades ago, which are coarsely discretized and calibrated to a cohort that no longer reflects contemporary critical care. No alternative learned directly from patient trajectories is in routine use. We conducted a retrospective two-cohort study on a total of 29,116 and 7,691 adult patients meeting Sepsis-3 criteria from two hospital systems in Massachusetts and Georgie, respectively. We developed a sepsis index using 43 routinely charted variables over a 72-hour treatment window. Unlike previous studies, we use mortality as a treatment-level ranking signal rather than a per-state target, allowing credit to be redistributed non-uniformly across timesteps. Evaluation was done on a permanent 20% test holdout, using clinical vignettes and Spearman correlation. Uncertainty intervals were obtained by bootstrap resampling of whole patients. Under this ranking scheme, non-survivors scored 1.19-1.64 points higher than survivors on a 0-10 scale within all strata of baseline SOFA-2, with similar results stratifying within lactate, mean arterial pressure (MAP), and creatinine. Within-patient change in the index correlated with change in lactate (Spearman rho = 0.39; n = 1,854). Similar, weaker correlations were found for MAP and creatinine. On a cohort level, cross-institutional agreement measured by Spearman correlation between models trained on different sites, were 70-77% of same-site correlation. External within-patient correlations were 0.54 and 0.59 against ceilings of 0.92 and 0.90. Our index also correlated with established indices, while null controls stayed near zero. Our index demonstrated hourly prognostic information that meaningfully separates patient outcomes and is consistent with clinical expectation, indicating potential as a decision support tool complementing clinical judgement.

</details>


### [218] [Mechanistic Reaction Prediction via Discrete Flow Matching on Graph-Structured Electron Occupation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27429)
*Nguyen Xuan-Vu,Octavian Susanu,Daniel Armstrong,Philippe Schwaller*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 MAELLE，将化学反应建模为电子占据向量上的离散流匹配（discrete flow matching），通过基于最优传输的连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）生成机理可解释的电子重排轨迹，在 USPTO-480K 基准上取得竞争性表现，并在分布外场景中保持鲁棒性，还能恢复与已知化学一致的机理轨迹及预测副产物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的机器学习反应预测方法主要通过对分子拓扑进行启发式图编辑或从头生成分子进行建模，未直接从电子层面的化学本质出发，因此难以自然地生成机理可解释的反应路径，且在分布外场景下性能下降明显。

Method: 1. 将反应建模为作用于所有成键、非成键和氢位点的图结构整数电子占据向量上的离散流匹配过程；2. 通过连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）刻画反应物到产物的映射；3. 利用最优传输（Optimal Transport）将离散流匹配的混合路径推广到离散电子重排，生成机理可解释的中间编辑轨迹，无需基本反应步骤标注。

Result: 在 USPTO-480K 基准测试中取得与主流反应预测模型相当的性能；在结构复杂度和反应类型两种分布外设置中显著优于现有方法的鲁棒性；学习到的电子重排流可自然恢复与已知化学一致的机理轨迹，并具备预测反应副产物的能力。

Conclusion: MAELLE 通过在电子占据空间中进行离散流匹配，提供了一种更贴近化学本质的反应建模范式，不仅提升了反应预测的准确性和分布外鲁棒性，还赋予模型机理可解释性和副产物预测能力，展示了电子层面建模在反应预测中的潜力。

Abstract: Chemical reactions are fundamentally transformations in electron space, yet most machine learning approaches model them either through \textit{de novo} generation of product molecules or through heuristic graph edits that operate directly on molecular topology. We introduce MAELLE (\textbf{M}ech\textbf{A}nistic \textbf{E}dit f\textbf{L}ow-matching on e\textbf{L}ectron r\textbf{E}arrangements), which instead models reactions as discrete flow matching over electron occupation vectors. Concretely, we formulate the reactant-to-product mapping as a Continuous-time Markov Chain (CTMC) over the graph-structured integer-valued electron occupation space defined on all bonding, non-bonding, and hydrogen sites. To construct the intermediate edit trajectories, we generalize the discrete flow matching mixture path to discrete electron rearrangements using Optimal Transport, yielding a sequence of mechanistically interpretable edit moves without requiring elementary step annotations. MAELLE achieves competitive performance on the USPTO-480K benchmark compared with leading reaction prediction models. Beyond in-distribution accuracy, we evaluate robustness across two out-of-distribution settings - structural complexity and reaction type - and find that MAELLE maintains strong performance where existing methods degrade. Finally, because the learned flow operates over the full electron redistribution, MAELLE naturally recovers mechanistic trajectories that align with known chemistry and can predict side products of a reaction.

</details>


### [219] [WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27454)
*Liyan Tang,Cyrus Rashtchian,Chun-Sung Ferng,Andrew Tomkins,Da-Cheng Juan,Tu Vu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出WikiSkill框架，通过引入持久化知识库（wiki）实现智能体技能的协同演化。在原始执行轨迹、累积知识和可执行技能三层架构基础上，持续将执行经验整合到wiki中，为后续技能更新提供系统性支撑。在五个基准和五个模型上的实验表明，WikiSkill优于现有技能演化方法，且技能演化与模型扩展互补，演化技能可跨模型有效迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能演化方法（如EvoSkill、Trace2Skill、SkillOpt）的洞察通常分散在优化历史中，缺乏独立的、持续演化的知识表示，限制了跨迭代的系统性复用。受Karpathy提出的LLM Wiki观点启发，研究者希望将智能体经验编译为持久化、复合增长的知识，以支持长期技能演化。

Method: WikiSkill采用三层知识架构：(1) 原始层（raw/）存储不可变的执行轨迹；(2) Wiki层（wiki/）维护结构化、复合增长的知识，包含模式目录、演化日志和技能影响追踪器；(3) 技能层（skills/）包含活跃的可执行技能。演化循环包括四个组件：推理智能体执行回滚、Wiki维护者整合轨迹形成模式、基于ReAct的技能提议者利用wiki和轨迹提出技能更新、门控与回滚机制基于验证性能保留改进。Wiki永不回滚，而技能更新可被回滚。

Result: 在5个基准（LiveMath、SealQA、SpreadSheet、OfficeQA、ALFWorld）和5个模型（Qwen-3.5-4B/9B、Qwen-3.6-27B、Gemma-4-31B、Gemini-3.5-Flash）上，WikiSkill在所有模型上均达到最高平均性能。在Qwen家族中，WikiSkill的收益随模型规模递增（4B: +12.3%、9B: +17.5%、27B: +23.9%）。Qwen-3.5-9B配合WikiSkill可超越无技能的Qwen-3.6-27B（47.4% vs 39.4%）。跨模型迁移实验中，他模型演化的技能常优于自演化技能。消融实验证实持久化wiki对技能演化至关重要。

Conclusion: WikiSkill通过系统性地累积和精炼智能体经验，显著提升了技能演化的效率和效果。技能演化与模型扩展互补，演化技能具备良好的跨模型迁移能力，持久化知识累积是实现有效技能演化的关键因素。

Abstract: Agent skills package specialized knowledge and workflows into reusable resources that extend AI agent capabilities. Recent work automatically discovers such skills from agent experience, which enables agents to progressively adapt through interaction. However, the insights that guide skill development typically remain scattered across optimization histories, limiting their systematic reuse across iterations. We introduce WikiSkill, a framework that co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). At a high level, WikiSkill separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills, while continuously consolidating experience into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates can build on. Across diverse benchmarks and models, WikiSkill consistently outperforms state-of-the-art skill-evolution methods and improves over no-skill baselines in most model-benchmark settings. We find that skill evolution complements model scaling: larger models generally benefit more from evolved skills, while smaller models with skills can outperform substantially larger models without them. We also find that evolved skills transfer effectively across models and model families, and skills evolved by other models can outperform self-evolved skills. Finally, our ablation studies confirm that persistent knowledge accumulation in the wiki is critical for effective skill evolution. These results demonstrate the benefits of systematically accumulating and refining agent experience for developing reusable and transferable skills.

</details>

### [220] [From SQL to Knowledge Graphs: An LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Approach with Data Schema Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26117)
*Dinh-Khanh Pham,Quy-Anh Dang,Lam Mai Thanh,Khanh Bui,Truong-Son Hy*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于LLM的多智能体系统，用于将RDBMS（关系型数据库）自动转换为知识图谱数据库，并通过BFSI数据集验证了图谱化后在问答准确率和延迟方面的优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RDBMS在多跳查询和图解释方面存在局限性，现有转换方法过度依赖Cypher加载命令，缺乏语义层面的模式优化。本文旨在利用LLM的多智能体协作能力解决从关系数据库到图数据库转换中的语义模糊性问题，并提升下游问答任务性能。

Method: 提出端到端多智能体系统（ETL Agent、Graph Agent、Analyzer Agent），通过迭代循环（建议-评分）优化图谱模式，并以Accuracy、Groundedness、Faithfulness三个5分制指标评估模式质量，阈值≥5时接受。CypherAgent融合Meta Error（常见错误库）、Few-shot Learning（k=3）和Correct Error技术生成Cypher查询。

Result: 在BFSI数据集的1,081个查询（三档复杂度）上，CypherAgent整体准确率达85.57%，较SQLAgent（73.45%）提升12.12%；延迟降低约3倍（2.00s vs 6.34s），Token消耗降低超2倍。各档准确率：易90.43% vs 72.66%（+17.77%）、中81.98% vs 77.78%（+4.20%）、难80.08% vs 69.07%（+11.01%）。消融实验显示Meta Error带来+28.84%准确率提升，Few-shot Learning额外+4.63%。

Conclusion: 验证了基于LLM多智能体的RDBMS→知识图谱转换流水线的可行性与优越性，图谱化显著提升LLM驱动的问答准确率与效率。未来工作将引入强化学习、自反思推理，并将该框架推广到医疗、电商、物流等领域及多模态数据。

Abstract: RDBMS (Relational Database Management System) databases face several limitations, including slow execution with multi-hop queries and a lack of explainability by graphical interpretations. In contrast, Graph database offers a more intuitive and efficient data schema that performs faster execution on large datasets. Most existing RDBMS conversion pipelines focus on running traditional loading commands and relying on Cypher queries. However, the efficiency of using an LLM to generate an effective graph data schema, significantly reducing the ambiguity of the graph database, remains underexplored in the current research literature. This paper presents a novel algorithm that bridges RDBMS and graph database by using a novel LLM-powered ETL agent to standardize table and column names before saving them to the Data Mart. A Multi-Agent System generates a looping discussion between ETL, Analyzer, and Graph agents to optimize the final design through an iterative process of suggesting and scoring the graph database schema. We ensure that the final graph database meets three criteria before being accepted for data conversion: Accuracy, Groundedness, and Faithfulness. This system demonstrates an effective pipeline to automatically convert a tabular database into a graph database through a comprehensive end-to-end process. Our study highlights notable efficiency in using the converted graph database, which is measured on 1,081 samples of the BFSI dataset across three levels of complexity (easy, medium, and hard). Specifically, CypherAgent achieves an 85.6% accuracy for Q&A tasks using a Graph database, which is 12.12% higher than the accuracy achieved by an SQLAgent on the RDBMS database type PostgreSQL, for all queries. Additionally, the Graph database demonstrates faster performance, reducing latency by approximately 3 times.

</details>


### [221] [DRL: A Deterministic Relational Middleware Layer for Transaction-Safe Enterprise NL2SQL Under Schema-Graph Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26172)
*Sanjay Mishra,Divya Chukkapalli,Ganesh R. Naik*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: DRL是一个确定性关系中间件层，通过动态上下文剪枝、关系AST类型系统和事务安全验证（EXPLAIN门控与NULL守卫），将企业OLTP环境下的NL2SQL从模型能力问题重新定位为系统工程问题，并在PostgreSQL和MySQL上以1,000对验证套件评估了GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5和Gemini 2.5 Flash三个模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NL2SQL系统在企业OLTP目录（150–500个高度规范化表、外键部分强制、命名空间冲突）上扩展性失败，因为语义解析器在schema图膨胀时崩溃，导致上下文超出稳定的LLM注意力预算。论文主张这是一个"系统边界"问题而非模型能力问题，需要确定性中间件来约束上下文、编译LLM输出并验证查询安全性。

Method: DRL中间件包含三个核心组件：(1) 动态上下文剪枝路由器（基于词汇锚定+1跳FK闭包，将表数限制为k≤5）；(2) 关系AST编译器（ANSI优先的中间表示，支持PostgreSQL/MySQL方言发射）；(3) 事务安全验证层（操作静默分歧SDop标志、EXPLAIN门控的Plan Safety Compliance、NULL处理强制）。论文还形式化了OLTP Schema图扩展问题，证明了join-path搜索空间增长定理。

Result: 在PostgreSQL上，模式链接提示（B1）相对朴素全目录（B0）实现76%上下文缩减，DRL动态路由器（B2）达到92%缩减，剪枝p95=0.58ms，中间件p95=4.6ms。GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5和Gemini 2.5 Flash在修正后的评估框架下执行匹配率分别为52.9%、52.8%、52.1%（Wilson 95%置信区间重叠）。SDop标记89-100%的EX通过查询为潜在静默分歧。GPT-4o失败以语义/过滤错误为主（254/471），列名幻觉仅占47/471。论文还发现并修正了评估后处理器中的一个正则表达式缺陷，该缺陷曾人为制造4-10%的跨厂商差距。

Conclusion: DRL将企业NL2SQL重新定位为系统工程问题（上下文约束、验证、计划感知准入）而非排行榜竞赛。三者前沿模型在企业OLTP场景下性能统计不可区分（~52-53% EX），瓶颈在于schema图扩展而非模型能力。中间件应针对连接/过滤语义和计划安全性，而非仅目录链接。此外，论文的评估框架修正表明NL2SQL系统的后处理代码应作为被测系统的一部分接受同等审查，这一条经验超越了DRL本身。

Abstract: Deploying natural-language interfaces over enterprise OLTP catalogs fails at scale because semantic parsers collapse under schema-graph scaling, inflating context beyond stable LLM attention budgets. We present DRL (Deterministic Relational Middleware Layer), a safe pipeline interposing between front-ends and SQL backends. DRL comprises dynamic context pruning, relational AST typing, and transactional safeguard verification (EXPLAIN gating and NULL guards) to bound context and flag operational silent divergence (SDop). We evaluate DRL on PostgreSQL and MySQL, contributing (i) an OLTP schema-graph scaling model, (ii) a 1,000-pair Workload Verification Suite, (iii) baselines B0-B3, and (iv) an enterprise NL2SQL failure taxonomy. On PostgreSQL, schema-linked hints (B1) yield a 76% context reduction over naive full-catalog prompting (B0); DRL's dynamic router (B2) reaches a 92% reduction at pruning p95 = 0.58 ms and middleware p95 = 4.6 ms. GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Gemini 2.5 Flash achieve 52.9%, 52.8%, and 52.1% execution match under a corrected evaluation harness; SDop flags 89-100% of false-positive EX-passing queries. GPT-4o failures are dominated by semantic/filter errors (254/471), while column hallucination is a minor factor (47/471). Crucially, a single regex defect in our evaluation post-processor silently suppressed accuracy and manufactured a false 4-10% cross-vendor gap that vanished when corrected, showing that benchmark code deserves the same scrutiny as the models it scores. DRL reframes enterprise NL2SQL as systems engineering - context bounding, verification, and plan-aware admission - not a leaderboard exercise.

</details>


### [222] [Realistic Counterfactual Explanations via Denial Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26335)
*Avia Asael,Nave Frost,Amir Gilad,Daniel Deutch*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文针对可解释AI中反事实解释（CF）缺乏"现实性"的问题，提出将数据库中的拒绝约束（Denial Constraints, DCs）引入CF生成框架，通过扰动-投影（perturb-and-project）迭代算法，在保证反事实解释贴近原实例、多样化的同时，使其严格满足DCs所定义的现实性约束，并设计了多种求解器优化策略以提升可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的反事实解释方法（如DiCE）主要优化距离（proximity）和多样性（diversity），但往往会生成不现实的实例（例如曼哈顿公寓有10间卧室），严重限制了其在实际场景中的可用性。本文指出需要一种形式化、可验证且能自动获取的机制来刻画"现实性"。

Method: 1) 问题形式化：定义"多样化且现实"的反事实问题，要求CF集合最大化距离-多样性的加权得分，同时满足不可变属性和DCs约束；2) 扰动-投影框架（Algorithm 1）：迭代地先由DiCE生成候选CF，再通过PROJECT将其投影到DC一致的空间；3) 基于SMT求解器（Z3）的投影算法（Algorithm 2）以及三种优化：优化器缓存（Pre-processing）、嫌疑集过滤（Suspect Set Filtering）、多样性约束（Diversity Constraints）。此外证明了投影子问题是NP难的（即使仅有一元DCs）。

Result: 在Adult、NY-Housing、Tax、Census四个数据集上：DiCE生成的CF中有55.9%–100%违反DCs，而本文方法实现零违反；在距离上仅退化不到10%，多样性退化约3%（在多数数据集上），且统计显著（p<0.001）；所提优化使求解速度比Vanilla SMT方法最高提升63倍，相比DiCE仅增加1.1–10.5倍开销；CARLA中的可塑性感知方法（甚至包括VAE类）也100%违反DCs。

Conclusion: 将数据库拒绝约束（DCs）引入反事实解释生成，可以在几乎不牺牲距离与多样性的前提下提供严格的、可证明的现实性保证；通过求解器缓存、嫌疑集过滤与多样性约束等专用优化，使该方法在大规模数据集上具备实用性。未来工作将探索进一步优化及在对抗鲁棒性等领域的应用。

Abstract: In the realm of Explainable AI, classification results are often explained via counterfactuals (CFs for short), which are (ideally small) perturbations to an instance that lead to a change of classification label. Such CFs may serve as explanations for the prediction, pinpointing the features that were important. Existing explainability solutions typically aim at minimizing the distance of CFs from the original instance so that they are specific to it, and/or maximizing the diversity of CFs to cover multiple facets of the reasons underlying the prediction. In this paper, we note that in pursuing these aims, state-of-the-art explainability solutions may (and often do) yield counterfactual explanations that do not correspond to realistic instances. This limits their applicability and usefulness in practice. To remedy this, we combine ideas from Explainable AI with ideas from data management. Specifically, we capture realism of CFs via logical constraints that hold with respect to a dataset of examples (e.g., training set); the class of such constraints that we focus on is that of denial constraints, extensively studied in the context of relational databases. Algorithmically, we then combine explainable AI solutions to yield CFs, with ideas from data cleaning that we adapt to this unique setting, to transform CFs into realistic ones. Extensive experiments across four datasets validate that our solutions achieve realism with relatively minor compromise in terms of distance and diversity. They further validate that the dedicated optimizations that we have developed to speed up the search for CFs are indeed highly effective.

</details>


### [223] [VoS: Variate Ordering Strategies for Skyline Query Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26464)
*Abhinav Gorantla,Pratanu Mandal,K. Selçuk Candan,Maria Luisa Sapino*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出VoS（Variate Ordering Strategies），通过优化偏好属性的排列顺序来提升Skyline查询效率。作者指出每属性支配检查（v-check）比元组对支配检查（t-check）更能反映真实执行时间，并基于属性相关性矩阵提出了多种排序策略（NCF、NACF、INCF、IXCL、NPC），其中最小相关优先（NCF）策略表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Skyline优化主要关注减少元组对支配检查次数，但实践中元组对之间的支配判断往往无需比较所有偏好属性，导致t-check优化与实际执行性能脱节。作者旨在通过优化v-check次数并结合属性相关性寻找高效排序策略。

Method: 1) 定义v-check为更准确的性能代理指标；2) 基于早期停止条件利用属性相关性；3) 提出五种策略：最小绝对相关优先(NACF)、最小相关优先(NCF)、增量最小相关优先(INCF)、增量最大相关最后(IXCL)、最小成对相关(NPC)；4) 针对L-VOS采用NCF字典序排序结合LIFO扫描；5) 扩展至SIMD架构进行chunk级剪枝。

Result: 在合成与真实数据集、标量与SIMD架构上的实验表明：NCF策略在SaLSa和D&C算法上分别最高获得41%和47%的执行时间缩减；NCF字典序+LIFO组合显著优于传统sum和max,sum排序方式；属性数量增加时增益更明显。

Conclusion: 每属性支配检查是Skyline查询执行时间的更准确代理指标，基于属性相关性的NCF排序策略能显著降低冗余比较、提升查询效率，尤其在SaLSa、D&C算法及高维偏好空间中效果最佳。

Abstract: Efficiency of skyline algorithms is highly influenced by the underlying data characteristics. Traditionally, optimization efforts have focused on minimizing the total number of tuple-pair dominance checks to improve query performance. However, in practice, a dominance check between two tuples does not necessarily require evaluating dominance relationships for each and every preference attribute of the data and this creates a disconnect between dominance checks optimization and query execution performance. In this paper, we argue that skyline algorithms need to optimize total per-attribute dominance checks, along with per-tuple dominance checks and that, for both of these goals, the ordering of the attributes (or variates) can have a substantial impact on the efficiency of skyline computation. Based on this premise, we present several strategies for identifying an effective variate order to minimize redundant attribute comparisons. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets, and on both scalar and SIMD architectures, confirm the effectiveness of the proposed approach in reducing computational overhead and improving skyline query performance.

</details>


### [224] [IBLTs Measure Before They Decode: Self-Sizing Set Reconciliation from Pre-Peeling Counts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26537)
*Min Wu,Ji Qi,Chengdui Luo,Shudong Lu,Zhengsheng Ye,Zhengyang Wei*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出自调容量集合对账协议：利用IBLT解码前剥离计数的二次统计量无偏估计差集基数d̂，从失败的同一草图中读取，完成2-RTT自调容量。相比盲倍增和Strata前置方法，比特成本仅1.3–1.7×预言机，已在NineData云90天生产数据和China Mobile Redis/Pika跨城部署中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据库一致性验证中，IBLT容量必须匹配未知的差集基数d，d跨越七个数量级（从0到4.41×10⁷）。现有方法（Strata预估、盲倍增、Rateless IBLT）各有缺陷：Strata固定摘要代价大；盲倍增轮次对数增长；Rateless在扫描密集型场景下增量编码器内存达93 GiB。需要一种直接从IBLT草图本身测量d的方法。

Method: 核心观察：IBLT在尝试解码前已完成测量——每个单元的计数记录了映射到该单元的差集元素数。对计数向量进行去心二次统计T=C⊤QC，归一化得d̂=T/γ，其中γ=k(1-k/M)。证明：(1)对任意符号模式精确无偏；(2)精确方差Var(d̂)=2d(d-1)/(M-1)与k和符号平衡无关；(3)固定M下d̂/d弱收敛于χ²_{M-1}/(M-1)。协议：固定容量M₁发送，首次失败后从同一草图读取d̂，计算第二轮容量M₂=⌈β·d̂/q_δ⌉，2 RTT内完成。映射感知定理3.1推广到Irregular、Random、Rateless、MET变体。

Result: 统计层：在M∈{64,256,1024,4096}网格上，均值误差≤5×10⁻⁴，方差闭合式匹配精度0.9981–1.0018，卡方极限在1%分位上精度达千分位。失败条件下均值仍精确无偏。协议层：六种M₁容量档位，比特遗憾1.3–1.7×预言机，轮次稳定为2。系统的层：90天NineData生产分析41,603次运行，Oracle↔MySQL跨引擎回放P1/P2/P3（P1的6.1亿行93,130差异场景），IBLT在10 Mbps下比Merkle风格快1.55×，最坏情况散列差异下Merkle慢278–1189%而IBLT仅慢2–9%；China Mobile Redis/Pika跨城部署（10 Mbps、28.8 ms RTT），d从1增至937时IBLT端到端时间几乎不变（28.7–29.6 s）而Merkle从28.3 s增至121.0 s。

Conclusion: IBLT在解码之前已完成测量；失败的IBLT草图并非浪费，而是已付费的映射感知测量。自调容量协议将未知差集基数转化为第一轮已支付的测量，在2 RTT内完成，与盲倍增和Strata前置方法相比，比特成本仅1.3–1.7×预言机且轮次可预测。局限性：加权频次模型的方差与置信区间需单独推导；Rateless序贯估计的最优停止、未签名通道的不可能性表征仍是未来工作。

Abstract: Set reconciliation recovers the symmetric difference $A\triangle B$ with communication far below the data volume. Invertible Bloom Lookup Tables (IBLTs) are a standard tool, but their capacity must match the unknown difference cardinality~$d$. In database deployments, $d$ spans orders of magnitude, so undersizing causes rescans or replays while oversizing wastes network and memory. We show that an IBLT measures $d$ before decoding. Each cell count records how many difference elements map to it; a quadratic statistic over the count array gives an exactly unbiased estimate with no extra transmitted bytes. The estimate remains valid after decoding failure because it is read from the same sketch. For standard IBLTs, we derive exact mean and variance formulas and chi-square confidence intervals. The same chi-square law governs failed instances in deep overload. A mapping-aware theorem extends the construction to Irregular, Rateless, and MET IBLTs through per-variant adapters. Our self-sizing protocol uses a first-round failure to compute the second-round capacity in one step, completing within two interaction rounds with an explicit success-probability guarantee. We profile 41{,}603 reconciliation runs over 90 days at NineData Cloud, compare end-to-end against Merkle-style localization in a cross-engine replay of production tables, and deploy across Redis and Pika in China Mobile. The first round therefore turns an unknown difference cardinality into a measurement it has already paid for.

</details>


### [225] [Size Bounds for CQs Under Acyclic Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26775)
*Stefan Mengel,Andrei Romashchenko*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文研究带无环函数依赖的合取查询（CQ）结果大小的上界，比较了渐近紧但不可计算的熵界和可计算但通常不紧的多拟阵界。证明了在允许投影时，即使FDs无环，两界之间也存在多项式间隙；同时给出了一个由输出变量在拓扑序中的"前缀"位置刻画的紧致特例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 查询结果大小估计在数据库基数估计和最坏情况最优连接算法中至关重要。AGM界在仅基数约束下紧致，但在加入函数依赖（FDs）后，熵界虽紧但不可计算，多拟阵界虽可计算但一般不紧。此前已知无环FDs且无投影时两界重合，但实践中投影很常见（SPARQL语料中约15%），因此需要研究有投影时无环FDs下两界是否仍重合，以理解PANDA算法等在最坏情况下的最优性。

Method: 采用两步策略：（1）负面结果——从已知存在间隙的Zhang-Young循环FDs查询出发，设计"解缠算法"（Untangle Algorithm），通过引入新变量副本打破FDs环路，从而将循环FDs转化为无环FDs，并证明该变换同时保持熵界和多拟阵界；（2）正面结果——定义"前缀"性质（输出变量在依赖图拓扑序中位于非输出变量之前），证明此时两界相等（通过将问题约化到无投影的已知紧致情形，借助输出限制查询的等价性）。技术核心包括Lemma 15和Lemma 16关于条件熵在变量替换下的单调性。

Result: 主要定理9：构造了Q'_ZY查询（含9个变量、11个FDs），证明其熵界≤(43/11)log(N) < 4log(N) ≤ 多拟阵界，即存在严格的多项式间隙。定理17：若输出变量X关于FDs Σ是前缀（即存在拓扑序使X中变量排在非X变量之前），则熵界与多拟阵界相等。多项式间隙约4 vs 43/11≈3.909，比例约1.023但差距稳定。

Conclusion: 投影从根本上改变了无环FDs下两界重合的局面：在一般有投影时多拟阵界不再紧致，因此基于它的PANDA算法不最坏情况最优；而当输出变量在拓扑序中构成前缀时，紧致性得以保留。这深化了对查询大小界的理解，明确了可计算界仍有效的边界条件。计算机辅助验证（4617个基本Shannon不等式+非Shannon型不等式**）确认了核心技术结果。

Abstract: We study size bounds for conjunctive query (CQ) results which in recent years have played a crucial role in database theory. In particular, we compare the so-called entropic bound which is known to be asymptotically tight but not known to be computable, and its computable relaxation called the polymatroid bound, which is generally not tight. We focus here on conjunctive queries under acyclic functional dependencies. These queries are known to be well-behaved in the sense that, in the case without projections, both bounds coincide. We show that this picture changes when projections are allowed: in this case, even for acyclic functional dependencies, there is in general a polynomial gap between the two bounds. We complement this negative result by showing a special case for which the polymatroid bound is tight under acyclic functional dependencies and projections that is characterized by the position of the output variables in a topological order of the query variables.

</details>


### [226] [Incremental Delta-Shapley: A Standalone Runtime for Predicate Attribution on Sliding Windows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26930)
*Pouya Khani,Ira Assent*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: IDS（Incremental Delta-Shapley）是一个独立单节点运行时，将伴随论文中关于谓词级 Shapley 归因的封闭形式（SUM、COUNT、AVG、方差）转化为可部署的流式归因系统。它通过窗口维护增量维护全局、边际和原子摘要，以 O(1) 时间评估归因，并通过保留状态扫描、倒排索引或带浓度保证的滑动窗口采样处理未注册的即席谓词，频繁使用的即席谓词通过重建原子细化被提升为注册谓词。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流处理系统只能报告聚合结果"是什么"，但无法归因"哪个"谓词造成了结果变化；现有的 Shapley 近似方法（如 KernelSHAP）是无状态的，将每次窗口转换视为全新问题，浪费了窗口间 >99% 的元组共享。同时，伴随论文虽给出了谓词级 Shapley 归因的封闭形式，但未解决运行时如何跨滑动维护摘要、暴露归因查询、回答未注册谓词以及摊销重复即席查询等系统问题。

Method: 1) 基于增量驱动的摘要维护：通过窗口维护增量 Δ_t=(X_out, X_in) 以 O(|Δ_t|·K) 成本更新全局摘要 (N, A(W), B(W))、每个注册谓词的边际摘要及原子表；2) 原子细化：对 K≥2 个重叠注册谓词，同时维护原子级摘要（用于组合查询）和边际摘要（用于 O(1) 单谓词查找）；3) 声明式 SQL-like API：REGISTER PREDICATE、SHAPLEY_ATTRIBUTE 和 SHAPLEY_DELTA 作为一等操作符；4) 三种即席机制：暴力保留状态扫描（精确 O(N)）、倒排索引辅助扫描、基于 Babcock 链采样/优先级采样的滑动窗口均匀采样（带 Hoeffding-Serfling 浓度保证），采用摊销惰性剪枝使维护成本 O(log r)；5) 自适应谓词提升：基于频率的策略将重复即席谓词通过精确重建原子细化迁移至注册集。

Result: 在合成、对抗性、NEXMark 风格和 NYC 出租车工作负载上：1) 正确性：归因结果与穷举 Shapley 枚举在浮点精度内一致（绝对误差 ≤4×10⁻¹²，相对误差 ≤5×10⁻¹³，Efficiency 残差 ≤4×10⁻¹⁵）；2) 增量维护吞吐量平坦（7.3×10⁷~1.3×10⁸ 元组/秒），相比每窗口扫描基线最高加速 4.3×10⁵ 倍（N=10⁶，|Δ_t|=1）；3) 采样质量匹配 O(1/√r) 误差率，经验 Bernstein-Serfling 界比 Hoeffding-Serfling 紧 22.5 倍；4) 自适应提升在 Zipfian 轨迹上将即席成本降低 9.2 倍；5) 相比 KernelSHAP 和置换 Monte Carlo（每次窗口需保持全量数据），IDS 以 1.3 μs 完成归因，独立于窗口大小。

Conclusion: IDS 将伴随论文中的封闭形式 Shapley 归因理论转化为实用化的单节点流式归因引擎，通过增量摘要维护、原子细化组合查询支持和三级即席机制（扫描/索引/采样）解决了"如何在线维护、查询、近似和摊销归因"的系统问题。其声明式 API 使归因和每滑动变化成为一等公民算子，在四个标准工作负载上验证了精确性、吞吐量和内存效率，确立了无状态 Shapley 近似方法在滑动窗口场景下的不适用性。

Abstract: Continuous aggregate queries over sliding windows are common in real-time analytics, but most systems report \emph{what} an aggregate is doing without attributing \emph{which} predicates account for the result. A companion paper~\cite{khani2026closedformpredicatelevelshapleyattribution} shows that exact predicate-level Shapley attribution for SUM, COUNT, AVG, and variance needs only three additive predicate summaries with closed-form coefficients. Those results settle the mathematics, not how a runtime maintains summaries across slides, exposes attribution, answers unregistered predicates, or amortizes repeated ad hoc ones. We present \textbf{IDS} (Incremental Delta-Shapley), a standalone single-node runtime that turns those closed forms into a deployable explanation system. IDS consumes window-maintenance deltas, updates global, marginal, and atom summaries, and evaluates any closed form in constant time. Overlapping predicates use atomic refinement, and a restricted SQL-like API exposes attribution and its per-slide change as first-class operators. Unregistered predicates are answered by a retained-state scan, an inverted index, or an amortized sliding-window sample with concentration guarantees; frequent ones are promoted by rebuilding the refinement. On synthetic, adversarial, NEXMark-style, and NYC taxi workloads, attribution matches exhaustive Shapley enumeration to floating-point precision; incremental maintenance is flat in $N$ and up to $4.3\times10^{5}\times$ faster than per-window scans of the same form; and adaptive promotion cuts ad hoc cost by up to $9.2\times$ on Zipfian traces.

</details>


### [227] [Compositional Online Learning for Semantic Data Processing Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27244)
*Paweł Liskowski,Fuheng Zhao,Benjamin Han,Anupam Datta,Dimitris Tsirogiannis*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出"LLM调用边界的组合在线学习"框架，利用LLM调用延迟窗口（数百毫秒）足够容纳CPU端学习器更新的观察，在Cortex AISQL中实例化三个组件（记忆化层、Larch过滤器排序、GAMCAL级联路由），在合取过滤工作负载上实现理论上界11.4×、现实约8×的LLM成本降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LLM驱动的语义数据处理系统中，LLM调用占查询成本的80-90%，每次调用比关系谓词贵10^5-10^7倍，但延迟窗口（数百毫秒）可隐藏CPU端在线学习器的更新。经典自适应查询处理（AQP）要求学习器必须轻量以避免主导被优化的谓词，但在LLM延迟下该约束被反转。现有工作对各优化组件孤立研究，未分析多个在线学习组件如何组合、收益是否可叠加。

Method: 框架以"决策粒度"和"学习器更新节奏"为两轴构成设计空间。共享学习模式分三相：(1)优化器查询当前工件并派发后台训练步；(2)发出LLM调用，训练步在往返中完成并写回工件；(3)LLM结果追加到监督缓冲。在Cortex AISQL中实例化三个组件：(1)记忆化层（无学习器，每调用粒度）；(2)Larch过滤器排序（每调用在线节奏，双层MLP选择性估计+DP求解器，泛化Krishnamurthy-Boral-Zaniolo异构成本排序定理到AND/OR树）；(3)GAMCAL级联路由（每批在线节奏，标定GAM+双阈值优化，按倍增计划重拟合，路由时注入高斯噪声实现不确定性探索）。用Hoare风格顺序组合规则配合成本语义形式化组件组合，引入条件成本分解式 Cost=N·ē·[c_proxy+p_deleg·c_oracle]，将Larch的ē降低与GAMCAL的p_deleg降低在独立性下相乘合成。识别三类跨组件交互：自选择κ₁、样本预算收缩κ₂、选择性估计漂移κ₃。

Result: 代表性合取工作负载（N=10^6行，m=5谓词，c_proxy/c_oracle≈0.05）下：(1)Larch单独使ē从5降至约1.25，成本比约0.25（典型Mix工作负载4-8×，相对Palimpzest和Quest最高19×）；(2)GAMCAL单独使p_deleg从1.0降至约0.30（F₁≥0.95下委托率范围17-68%，六个基准上五个领先LOTUS，BoolQ从69.7%降至29.3%，最多少58%的oracle调用）；(3)两者组合独立性上界11.4×；考虑κ₁∈[1.0,1.5]、κ₃∈[1.0,1.4]、κ₂仅影响早期批次后取中点（κ₁=1.25, κ₃=1.2）得现实约7.8×≈8×；悲观角约5.7×，乐观角恢复11.4×。训练步耗时7-11ms，远小于LLM往返的数百毫秒。

Conclusion: 框架在LLM调用边界开辟经典AQP无法企及的在线学习空间。两个学习组件在成本分解的不同因子上独立工作时可乘性合成，跨组件交互是结构性的而非根本性的，可在优化器层面补救。LLM原生数据系统的定义将更少取决于单个操作符语义，更多取决于延迟预算感知的分层优化架构。后续方向包括设计空间中其他层（提示缓存、模型替换、提示结构、自适应批处理）、跨组件联合控制器、跨查询学习、以及统一质量契约。

Abstract: An LLM call in a semantic data processing system is expensive enough to dominate query cost, yet slow enough to hide a CPU-side learner's update behind its round-trip. In production, LLM compute accounts for $80-90\%$ of query cost, and each call costs $10^5-10^7\times$ a relational predicate. The latency window inverts a design constraint of classical adaptive query processing, where online learners had to stay lightweight to avoid dominating the predicates they optimize. At LLM latency, per-call gradient steps and per-batch threshold solves fit inside the round-trip. We develop compositional online learning at the LLM call boundary: a framework for combining online-learning components in semantic data processing systems. Each component makes execution-time decisions and refines its learned artifacts online. The design space spans two axes, decision granularity and learner update cadence, and the components share a single learning pattern that hides each trainer step inside the next LLM round-trip. A production case study in Cortex AISQL composes three components: a memoization layer, an online per-call filter-ordering learner, and an online per-batch cascade-routing learner. A conditional cost decomposition assigns each learning component to a distinct factor of per-row LLM cost. Under independence, the two learning components compose multiplicatively to an $11.4\times$ upper bound on a representative conjunction-filter workload. Self-selection at the cascade boundary, sample-budget shrinkage, and selectivity-estimation drift reduce it to a realistic figure near $8\times$.

</details>

### [228] [Fairness Invariants: A Relational Approach to Explaining and Mitigating Fairness Bugs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26209)
*Ranit Debnath Akash,Ashish Kumar,Gang Tan,Saeid Tizpaz-Niari*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: REMI 是一个将个体公平性（individual fairness）视为关系不变式（relational invariant）发现问题的框架。它通过对（原始，反事实）样本对进行双向约束学习，自动定位、解释并缓解机器学习系统中的个体歧视。该框架在符号程序和黑盒神经网络模型上均显著优于现有基线（如 AFT），可在 80% 以上的情况下准确定位歧视根因，并将黑盒模型的歧视性决策减少高达 70%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动的软件系统在高风险社会经济领域广泛部署，但常表现出个体歧视——即对仅在受保护属性（如种族、性别、年龄）上不同的相似个体给出不同结果。现有研究多集中于检测和量化公平性 bug，但缺乏原则性的解释与定位机制，且现有解释技术主要面向单输入决策，未考虑公平性的关系本质（即需比较原始与反事实对）。

Method: REMI 受程序语言中循环不变式合成的启发，将反事实公平性建模为关系不变式发现问题。具体方法包括：1）生成反事实样本，构成 (x, x') 对，根据待测程序（DPuT）的输出是否一致标记为公平（+）或歧视（-）；2）提出三种关系数据集构建方式：无扩展（DCNE，仅保留原始点）、垂直扩展（DCVE，将原始与反事实各自作为独立实例）、水平扩展（DCHE，将原始与反事实的特征拼接为单条记录）；3）用决策树等可解释学习器（CART、C4.5、FIGS 等）在关系标签上训练，提取歧视性叶节点的 if-then 规则作为"公平性不变式"；4）将这些规则部署为护栏（guardrail），在推理时选择性拒绝或重新标记落入不安全区域的输入，无需重新训练模型。此外，将传统单向蕴含对约束扩展为双向约束（要求原始与反事实输出一致）。

Result: 在 6 个符号程序（PG1-PG6，涵盖招聘、再犯风险等场景）和 20 个黑盒神经网络模型（Adult Census、Bank Marketing 数据集上）上的评估表明：1）三种数据构建方式在 80%+ 的情况下优于 AFT 基线，水平扩展和无扩展对齐效果最佳；2）C4.5、FIGS、CART 三种可解释学习器在 83% 的基准测试中表现最佳；3）提取的规则能精确刻画符号程序的根因（如 PG1 中识别出 ethnic→college rank→hiring 路径），在 83% 案例中优于 AFT，其中 AFT 在 50% 案例中完全无法找到歧视实例；4）作为护栏使用时，符号程序上的歧视实例数从数千降至 0-2 个，黑盒神经网络模型上的歧视决策减少 40%-84%，显著优于 Themis、ExpGA、LIMI 等基于反事实再训练的基线方法。

Conclusion: REMI 成功将个体公平性重构为关系不变式发现问题，提供了从检测到定位、解释和缓解个体歧视的端到端自动化框架。其双向关系约束设计与三种数据对齐策略使其能够在不修改原模型的前提下，作为后处理包装器部署于任意分类器。局限性包括：1）规则质量受限于 IDI 发现阶段的覆盖率；2）非结构化数据（文本、图像）的反事实生成需要领域知识；3）应作为审计与护栏合成工具使用，不能保证全局公平性。未来工作将扩展到自然语言等非结构化领域。

Abstract: Data-driven software systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes socio-economic domains, from criminal justice to financial lending. However, these systems often exhibit individual discrimination---unjustified disparities in which a program yields different outcomes for similar individuals who differ only in their protected attributes (e.g., race, gender, age). While existing research has focused on detecting and quantifying these bugs, there remains a critical lack of principled mechanisms to explain and localize individual fairness bugs. Current explanation techniques are largely designed for single-input decisions rather than the relational nature of discrimination, which inherently involves a comparison between an original and a counterfactual pair. We present REMI, a framework for the automated localization, explanation, and mitigation of individual discrimination. Inspired by loop-invariant synthesis in formal methods, we treat counterfactual fairness as a relational invariant discovery problem. We introduce a bidirectional relational explanation framework that learns over paired examples $(x, x')$ to identify regions of the input space where fairness is violated. Unlike traditional one-way implication pairs used in invariant inference, our approach enforces bidirectional constraints: requiring identical outcomes for both original and counterfactual samples. REMI utilizes three data-alignment techniques to infer interpretable rule-based models that act as "fairness invariants." These rules serve as guardrails to selectively block or relabel unfair predictions without requiring model retraining. Our evaluation on symbolic and neural network programs demonstrates that REMI localizes ground-truth fairness bugs in over 83% of cases, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines and reducing discriminatory decisions in black-box models by up to 70%.

</details>


### [229] [FaultLens: Learning Compact Behavioral Test Suites for Generated Operational Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26746)
*Zeming Liu,Hang Lyu,Jingtao Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: FaultLens 提出一种面向生成式运维程序的行为测试用例优先级学习方法。该方法利用历史程序的执行证据，构建稀疏的故障-探针击杀关系缓存，结合主动贪心排序与结构多样性排序的交替混合策略，仅用极小比例的探针预算即可在未来程序上保持高故障覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式运维程序（如数据库索引选择、缓存策略选择等）需要行为验证，但当前做法存在两难：少量手工示例难以捕捉稀疏的边界与交互故障；穷举式回归套件代价过高且不必要的浪费。本文旨在回答一个更窄的问题：在已有的可解释穷举探针域与历史生成程序的基础上，能否学习一个更小的测试套件，在未来程序上保留故障敏感性。核心挑战是泛化性——突变驱动的优先级排序可能过拟合到相关突变体，导致在新故障机制（时序、顺序敏感等）下失效。

Method: FaultLens 方法包含以下核心组件：(1) 静态契约层：解析 Python AST，验证入口点，拒绝导入与动态调用，禁止全局状态修改，执行 CPU/地址空间/时间限制检查；(2) 场景派生探针域：在每一轮穷举阈值邻域（0、0.5、0.95、0.999、1.0、1.001、1.05、2.0 倍）、重复/三倍观察、模板对两种顺序、高低混合模板对及未知模板，产生 1,620–2,700 个探针；(3) 稀疏执行结果缓存：对每个历史程序执行完整域一次，仅存储静态结果与击杀探针 ID 列表，将 O(|M|×|P|) 矩阵压缩为每个突变体一个击杀列表；(4) 主动贪心排序（Active Greedy）：基于集合覆盖启发式，按击杀训练突变体数量贪心选探针，每步更新未覆盖集合；(5) 突变无关多样性排序（Diversity Ranking）：不读取击杀关系，仅依据探针族、案例、五轮时间分箱、家族-时间交互、模板词元等结构特征贪心覆盖未探索特征；(6) 混合策略：固定 1:1 比例交替从两个排名中选取唯一探针，平衡利用已知击杀证据与探索场景结构。下游部署使用保守准入规则，基于行为契约 + 标定损失 + 单侧 95% bootstrap 上界决定是否接纳。

Result: 案例研究评估了 20 个生成程序，跨 4 个环境（突发、三阶段合成负载、周期切换、稀有高成本事件）、10 个执行种子、1,200 次运行汇总、2,160 个受控程序变换、4,120,200 个程序-探针对。结果显示：(1) 1,960 个预期故障变换中有 1,779 个在完整域中改变契约或输出，200 个对照保持行为不变；(2) 跨程序泛化上，32 探针混合策略覆盖未来 582 个可击杀突变体的 576 个（99.0%），仅使用穷举域的 1.2–2.0%；(3) 在整族故障留出协议下，多样性将场景族宏覆盖率从纯主动贪心的 84.6% 提升至 94.9%，对阈值损坏、轮次偏移、部分调度等故障提升最大；(4) 下游部署研究中，保守准入规则将严重尾部回归从 15/20 个程序-环境组降至 0/20，同时保持标定损失 0.0269 与受限参考策略持平。稀疏缓存仅占用 27 MiB，支持无需重新执行程序的预算曲线复算。

Conclusion: FaultLens 证明了紧凑测试选择可在生成程序间泛化，并在故障机制层面部分泛化。其核心价值不在于穷举检测，而在于将预算、证据来源、泛化分割与部署操作点全部显式化且可审计。剩余的遗漏（交叉程序中 6 个全部来自 Burst 环境；整族留出下轮次偏移仅 68.8%、观察丢弃 81.2%）表明紧凑验证是一种优先级证据机制而非正确性证明，多样性是鲁棒性机制而非领域完备探针的替代品。研究也明确指出局限：仅覆盖 20 个确定性 Python 策略；受控变换衡量敏感性而非真实故障普遍性；有限域等价性、隐藏状态程序、有限种子数下的 bootstrap 边界均不构成形式保证。

Abstract: Generated operational programs are often validated with either a few hand-written examples or exhaustive regression suites. The former can miss sparse boundary and interaction faults, while the latter can be unnecessarily expensive. We introduce FaultLens, a method for learning compact behavioral test suites while preserving an auditable connection to executed evidence. It executes a rich probe domain once, stores the fault-probe kill relation as a sparse outcome cache, and learns probe orderings only from earlier program generations. A fault-driven greedy component exploits known kill structure, while a mutation-independent diversity component covers probe families, cases, templates, and temporal bins. Their alternating hybrid remains useful when a new program contains a fault mechanism absent from ordering construction. We evaluate twenty generated operational policies across four environments, ten execution seeds, 1,200 measured run summaries, 2,160 controlled program transformations, and 4,120,200 executed program-probe pairs. Of 1,960 intended faulty transformations, 1,779 alter a contract or output somewhere in the finite audit domain; 200 additional controls preserve behavior. A 32-probe hybrid learned on generations 1-3 covers 576/582 (99.0%) dynamically killable faults in generations 4-5 using 1.2-2.0% of the exhaustive domain. With an entire fault family withheld from training, diversity raises scenario-family macro coverage from 84.6% to 94.9%. In a downstream deployment study, a conservative admission rule reduces severe tail regressions from 15/20 program-environment groups to 0/20. FaultLens provides a prioritized evidence mechanism, not a proof of correctness, and makes its budget, evidence source, generalization split, and misses explicit.

</details>


### [230] [Beyond Execution: Auditing Experimental Fidelity in LLM-Driven Scientific Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26753)
*Lezhi Yu,Xiaogang Xu,Yuhua Zhou,Shuibing He,Aimin Pan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 ABE-Ralph 框架，用于审计 LLM 驱动的科学实验中的"方法论幻觉"，通过 YAML 约束契约和三层验证机制确保实验保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 科学智能体评估仅关注代码是否成功执行，忽视了实验方法论的忠实性，导致"方法论幻觉"（如静默缩减数据集、替换学习模块为查找函数、资源受限下得出错误结论）。

Method: 将科学复现形式化为约束满足问题（CSP），通过声明式 YAML 契约约束结构性、过程性、评估性约束；采用 8 步工作流指导执行；引入三层验证管道（定量对齐 V_quant、语义逻辑 V_qual、结构对齐 V_struct）。

Result: 在 30 个长周期 ML 复现任务中达到 93% 鲁棒执行率，加权综合得分 58.8（显著优于 Raw LLM 30.8、Claude Code CLI 51.0）；识别出 5 类方法论幻觉（M1-M5），其中 M5（执行不完整）占 53.3%；消融实验证明 V_qual 是最关键组件；在 NatureBench 23 个发现任务中有 5 个匹配或超过 SOTA。

Conclusion: 可靠的 AI 科学家评估必须检验实验设计是否忠实测试预期主张，而非仅依赖代码执行或表面合理的指标；未来需向资源感知的多智能体协作架构发展。

Abstract: LLM agents used for scientific experimentation must do more than generate executable code: they must implement the reference method faithfully, design experiments that test the paper's claims, and provide evidence supporting those claims. We show that agents often produce methodological hallucinations: silently reducing datasets or training budgets, replacing failed learning or generative components with lookup or oracle functions, or drawing conclusions from resource-limited settings where a method's claimed advantage disappears. To detect these failures, we introduce ABE-Ralph, a reference-anchored auditing framework that represents claims, protocols, required components, baselines, and metrics as structured experimental constraints, guides implementation through an 8-step workflow, and performs quantitative, qualitative, and code-level verification. Across 30 long-horizon reproduction runs covering 12 machine learning domains, ABE-Ralph achieves a 93% robust execution rate and identifies five scientific failure modes. In 23 NatureBench discovery tasks, ABE-Ralph matches or exceeds state-of-the-art performance on 5 tasks. These results show that reliable evaluation of AI scientists must assess whether the experimental design faithfully tests the intended claim and whether the resulting evidence supports it, rather than treating code execution or plausible metrics as evidence of scientific success.

</details>


### [231] [Persona-Execution Separation: An Architecture Pattern for Evolving LLM Agents under Execution Audit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27427)
*Yisen Xi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出PES架构模式：将LLM智能体的persona（人设）与execution（执行）置于不同信任域，通过治理契约桥连接，以同时满足人格自由演化（G1）、执行可追溯（G2）和解耦（G3）三个目标。在FIA Workbench金融行业数字员工平台的开发/试点案例中通过五项决策链及机制验证证实其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在受监管组织中部署的LLM智能体面临结构性矛盾：人格（指令、语气、表达）需自由演化以持续改进，而执行（状态变更、受审计的工作）必须可追溯。单信任域无法同时廉价满足两者——治理过严则每次人格编辑触发执行侧重新验证；治理过松则失去可靠审计。现有架构被迫牺牲其一。

Method: 1) 构造性论证（命题1）：在LLM表征不可区分性下，单域内满足G1-G3必须重建类型化变更对象、外部强制点和稳定审计锚点——即重建PES但耦合代价更高。2) 架构设计：双面模型（同一员工身份两个面）、人格单宿主（执行侧无面孔）、绑定而非投影（引用而非复制SOP）。3) 治理契约桥：三个通道（状态摘要回流、数据体留存、身份连续性），由审批矩阵、DLP和审计强制执行。4) 案例研究：FIA Workbench平台五项决策链（2026-07-19至08-17），每项记录被拒替代方案。5) 机制验证：V1（R=0人侧无重新验证）、V2（跟踪隔离A/B检查）、V3（前分离构建探针）。

Result: V1: 五种扰动级别（含对抗性L5）下R_PES=0/5=0.00，在五个模型配置上全部复现。V2: 固定输入A/B对中，状态路径、工具集、结构参数和审批链完全相同，硬断言字段无persona指纹；qwen3.8-max因不收敛而无法测量。V3: 前ADR-030构建的单域探针显示SOP路径通过"遗漏"而非"构造"与persona解耦，显式注入探针证实连接persona后执行改变（2/2）。结构检查S1b从FAIL翻转为PASS。S1a和S3仅在演化判据下通过。

Conclusion: PES是首个将智能体操作身份与其受治理执行置于不同信任域的架构模式，通过契约桥实现persona自由演化而不污染审计账本。适用于多用户部署、执行审计要求和预期persona变更三者并存场景。局限：单一开发/试点案例、单一领域、无对照实验、无安全分析。未来工作包括persona版本化、协调层级、重新验证作为一等制品、以及模型推进时机的契约侧约束。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents in governed organizations must let the persona (instructions, tone, self-presentation) evolve freely, while keeping execution (stateful, audited work) traceable. A single trust domain does not satisfy both cheaply. We present Persona-Execution Separation (PES): persona and execution reside in different trust domains, connected by a governed contract bridge. The persona is singly-homed and may drift; execution is faceless and audited. Status summaries may return; data bodies remain in the restrictive domain except a graded data-loss-prevention (DLP) exception; identity stays continuous. An approval matrix, DLP, and audit enforce the crossing. PES follows from three goals---free drift, execution traceability, and decoupling. Under LLM representational indistinguishability, any single-domain mechanism that meets all three must re-introduce typed change objects, an external gate, and a stable audit anchor: PES rebuilt at higher coupling cost. A development/pilot case in a regulated digital-employee platform records five decisions over one month, each with a rejected alternative. A mechanism check on the shipped implementation found no execution-side re-validation under persona perturbation (five model configurations) and no persona fingerprint on hard-asserted fields. A probe of a recovered pre-separation build found the governed execution path decoupled from the persona by omission, not by construction; a later wiring change could reverse that isolation, which PES makes an audited architectural rule. The pattern applies when multi-user deployment, execution audit, and expected persona churn hold jointly.

</details>


### [232] [From Static to Dynamic: Benchmarking Real-World Code Review with MCR-Bench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27442)
*Dewu Zheng,Yanlin Wang,Xiwen Wang,Kefeng Duan,Hongyu Zhang,Xilin Liu,Yuchi Ma,Zibin Zheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: MCR-Bench是首个面向真实多轮代码审查的缺陷状态感知基准，包含2,269个跨5种编程语言的真实多轮审查任务，通过细粒度缺陷标注和跨轮状态标签评估LLM在多轮交互中的缺陷检测与生命周期状态追踪能力，揭示了主流LLM在该场景下性能有限、随轮次增加而退化、对缺陷类型与严重程度敏感等关键发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化代码审查研究普遍将代码审查简化为单轮静态决策任务，未能捕捉真实代码审查中开发者与审查者之间迭代交互的多轮特性以及缺陷在多轮过程中的动态演化，亟需一个面向多轮、状态感动的真实基准来推动相关研究。

Method: 构建MCR-Bench基准，采用严格的多阶段数据构建流水线：(1)基于GitHub Octoverse报告选取5种主流语言并筛选高质量仓库；(2)PR数据收集与多轮交互过滤；(3)基于LLM的两阶段状态感知缺陷标注（先局部逐轮候选检测，后全局跨轮合并与生命周期追踪），并通过三次一致性过滤；(4)由6名资深开发者进行人工交叉验证（Kappa=0.87）。评测7个主流LLM和2个PR级ACR基线，采用LLM-Hit-Judge（GPT-5.2-pro为评判模型）作为主要评估指标，并基于ClearCRC框架评估评论质量。

Result: 实验发现：(1)LLM整体性能有限，最佳F1仅略超0.55，缺陷生命周期状态追踪准确率最高约80%，且性能随审查轮次增加而显著退化；(2)LLM在不同缺陷类型（如E.2、E.3.1）和严重程度（Trivial/Minor缺陷漏检率更高）上表现差异显著，语义复杂或低显著度缺陷更易被遗漏；(3)误差分析揭示FP主要源于状态-时间错位（32.5%）和过度审查（27.8%），FN主要源于跨轮缺陷遗忘（25.1%）和长程依赖缺失（23.4%），反映出LLM在跨轮记忆与时间对齐方面的根本不足。

Conclusion: MCR-Bench作为首个多轮状态感知代码审查基准，填补了现有单轮静态评估范式的空白，为评估LLM在真实多轮代码审查场景下的缺陷识别与生命周期追踪能力提供了更具现实意义的评估基础，推动未来自动化代码审查方法向多轮、状态感知的方向发展。

Abstract: In real-world software development, code review typically involves iterative interactions between developers and reviewers to improve software quality, making the process costly and time-consuming. Although recent work explores large language models (LLMs) for automated code review, most approaches oversimplify code review into a single-round, static decision task, which fails to capture the multi-round interactive nature and the complex problem-solving processes inherent in realistic review scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce MCR-Bench, the first defect state-aware benchmark designed for realistic multi-round code review. MCR-Bench covers five commonly-used programming languages and consists of 2,269 real-world multi-round code review tasks, each of which is annotated with fine-grained defect information and cross-round state labels. Each task in MCR-Bench is equipped with fine-grained defect metadata (e.g., description, type, severity) alongside dynamic state annotations, capturing the complete evolutionary trajectory of a defect throughout the multi-round process. We obtain several findings through extensive experiments on MCR-Bench with mainstream LLMs. (1) Limited overall capability: experiments reveal that mainstream LLMs exhibit limited overall performance in defect detection and defect lifecycle state tracking, with performance degrading significantly as the number of interaction rounds increases; (2) Defect-sensitive performance: LLMs' performance varies substantially across different defect types and severity levels, with semantically complex or low-salience defects being significantly more likely to be missed; (3) Underlying Failure Mechanisms: our in-depth error analysis dissects the distinct drivers of false positives and false negatives, revealing critical weaknesses such as cross-round temporal misalignment and inadequate long-range memory.

</details>


### [233] [SWE-Prime: Fewer Trajectories, Better Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27449)
*Dewu Zheng,Ruizhe Ye,Yanlin Wang,Yang Ye,Hongyu Zhang,Ensheng Shi,Xilin Liu,Yuchi Ma,Jianxing Yu,Zibin Zheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出SWE-Prime，一种用于软件工程任务中大语言模型监督微调(SFT)的多粒度、两阶段数据选择方法。核心发现是：仅使用10%的轨迹子集训练，效果优于使用全部成功轨迹，相对性能提升最高可达24.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要通过执行验证筛选成功轨迹进行SFT，但任务成功并不能保证监督质量。成功轨迹中可能包含无效、冗余或有害的步骤（如缺乏观察-编辑-验证流程、工具调用失败率高、重复操作、利用Git历史作弊、修改范围过大等），直接用于SFT会引入噪声监督，使模型模仿不良的问题解决行为。

Method: SWE-Prime采用两阶段渐进式过滤：阶段一在轨迹层面筛选，基于(1)过程质量（观察-编辑-验证工作流、工具调用成功率、连续冗余控制、Git作弊检测）；(2)结果质量（修改的文件数和行数与参考补丁对比）；(3)数据代表性（使用Qwen3-Embedding-8B编码问题描述，通过HDBSCAN聚类以保证多样性）。阶段二在语义段层面筛选：将连续步骤按共同意图分组成语义段，采用边界感知分块机制处理长轨迹，并基于对最终修复的贡献度、可学习性和行为风险三个标准进行打分（0-10），仅分数≥阈值的段参与损失计算。SFT时所有段保留为上下文，仅选中段的助手回复token计算损失。

Result: 在SWE-Bench Verified和SWE-Bench Pro两个基准上，使用3个基座模型（Qwen3-30B-A3B、Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B、GLM-4.7-Flash）进行评估，SWE-Prime（10%数据）一致优于Resolved-Trajectory SFT（100%数据），相对提升最高达SWE-Bench Verified上24.2%和SWE-Bench Pro上12.2%。同时显著优于Random-10%基线和去掉阶段二的消融版本。行为分析表明，SWE-Prime降低了冗余操作、提高了编辑前观察率和工具调用成功率，同时平均交互轮次减少4.1-12.7轮。超参数分析确定最佳配置为10%保留率和7分段阈值。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了成功轨迹之间数据质量的差异，提出以语义段为行为一致性单元进行细粒度监督质量评估。SWE-Prime证明了数据质量比数据数量更重要：紧凑、低噪声、信息丰富的监督信号能够更有效地提升编码智能体能力。这一结论对编码智能体SFT实践具有重要指导意义——应从关注任务成功转向关注完整轨迹及其内部行为的监督价值。

Abstract: To improve large language models' ability to resolve real-world software issues, prior work has focused on constructing large-scale agent trajectory datasets and performing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on successful trajectories. However, task success does not guarantee high-quality supervision: successful trajectories may still contain ineffective, redundant, or risky steps. Directly using such trajectories for SFT can introduce noisy supervision and encourage models to imitate undesirable problem-solving behaviors. Therefore, we propose SWE-Prime, a multi-granularity, two-stage SFT data selection method that progressively filters training data at the trajectory and segment levels. Specifically, the first stage performs trajectory-level screening based on process quality, result quality, and data representativeness, selecting a high-quality and representative subset of successful trajectories. The second stage performs segment-level selection by grouping consecutive steps into semantic segments and assessing each segment based on its contribution to the final solution, learnability, and potential risks. During SFT, all segments remain in the sequence to preserve context, while only selected segments contribute to the loss computation. Experiments on SWE-Bench Pro and SWE-Bench Verified show that training on the 10% trajectory subset selected by SWE-Prime outperforms training on the full resolved dataset, yielding relative performance gains of up to 12.2% and 24.2%, respectively.

</details>


### [234] [Agentic AI Containment Architecture for Security Hardening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26108)
*Mohamed ElBendary*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"代理遏制架构"(Agent Containment Architecture)的多智能体系统安全架构，将安全性视为通过显式约束在设计阶段强制实施的架构属性，而非事后附加的安全层。该架构包含六项核心约束，强制执行"提议-验证-执行-验证"(Propose-Verify-Act-Verify)执行模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多智能体AI系统在自主协调、工具使用和持续学习中面临新型安全与治理风险，而现有的遏制方法主要采用事后附加安全层的方式，缺乏在设计阶段就将安全性作为架构属性进行强制实施的系统性方案。

Method: 提出一种新颖的形式化组织映射方法，将标准系统分析工件映射到提议的约束系统下的机器可验证合约。架构引入六项交互约束：1）职责分配的分离；2）部署前一致性检查；3）价值流绑定；4）时间隔离；5）知识积累前的严格验证；6）结构与过程完整性的确定性验证。这些约束共同强制实施"提议-验证-执行-验证"执行模型，使所有操作均以合约方式定义、独立验证并可追溯至特定执行上下文。

Result: 通过命题和正确性推理论证，将六项约束与针对关键威胁类别的防御机制相关联，包括提示注入、编排器操控、跨会话状态投毒以及涌现的智能体合谋。简历筛选案例研究展示了该架构在对抗条件下如何产生可审计且符合策略的结果。

Conclusion: 该工作明确区分了结构完整性与语义安全，限制了残余风险，同时使残余语义风险变得明确且可衡量，为多智能体系统安全提供了一种架构层面的系统性解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-agent AI systems are increasingly deployed in contexts where autonomous coordination, tool use, and continuous learning introduce novel security and governance risks. The containment approach to multi-agent system security remains underdeveloped, primarily resorting to add-on layers post-design and sometimes post-implementation and deployment. This paper proposes an Agent Containment Architecture that treats security as an architectural property enforced through a set of explicit constraints that bound the design space of multi-agent systems. The architecture proposed in this paper introduces a novel formal organizational mapping from standard systems analysis artifacts to machine-verifiable contracts under a proposed constraint system. The architecture introduces six interacting constraints: separation of responsibility assignments, pre-deployment coherence checking, value stream binding, temporal isolation, strict knowledge verification before accumulation, and deterministic verification of structural and process integrity. Together, these constraints enforce a Propose-Verify-Act-Verify execution model in which all operations are contractually defined, independently verified, and traceable to specific execution contexts. The paper presents propositions and correctness reasoning arguments linking these constraints to defenses against key threat classes, including prompt injection, orchestrator manipulation, cross-session state poisoning, and emergent agent collusion. A resume screening case study demonstrates how the architecture produces auditable, policy-compliant outcomes under adversarial conditions. The work explicitly separates structural integrity from semantic safety, bounding residual risks while making residual semantic risk explicit and measurable.

</details>


### [235] [Four Ways to Forge a Bundle My Own Verifier Calls Clean: Refusal-Site Mutation Testing of an Evidence-Bundle Verifier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26183)
*Erik Hill*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于离线证据束验证器(VAC)的案例研究,通过外部审计和作者自研的"拒绝位点删除"变异测试方法,在已加固的验证器中发现了四种"空洞通过"(vacuous pass)类型的伪造攻击。作者构建了一个拒绝位点活性测量工具,系统性地测量验证器中拒绝语句的可触发性,发现基线时75/112(0.330)的拒绝语句可以被删除而所有测试仍保持绿色。研究表明,按发现缺陷添加回归测试几乎不能提高覆盖率(从0.330到0.328),而系统性测试每个拒绝位点则可将覆盖率提升至1.000。论文同时记录了测量工具自身在研究过程中出现的七次"空洞通过"失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机源于作者构建的离线证据束验证器VAC的一个核心承诺:任何陌生人都可以离线重新运行作者的声明并获得相同答案。然而外部审计发现,一个头部数字为假的证据束(代价仅为四个字节"null")能够通过验证。作者需要量化该验证器的拒绝逻辑中有多大比例从未被观察到拒绝任何输入——即"通过但不检查"的失败开放漏洞有多普遍。

Method: 方法核心是"拒绝位点删除"变异测试操作符。1)枚举验证器源文件中所有向失败列表追加命名失败原因的语句(refusal sites);2)逐一将这些语句替换为pass;3)用三路析取式kill谓词判定变异体是否被捕获(单元测试失败、活性控制退出非0、已提交的篡改固件不再被拒绝);4)运行有效性门控,确保未变异的基线测试套件为绿色。研究从提交f59fb62开始(112个拒绝位点)到92e4548结束(146个位点,3个排除)。

Result: 关键结果:基线(f59fb62)时,112个拒绝位点中75个可被删除而全套测试仍绿色,得分0.330;四个手找伪造中有三个落在存活的拒绝类中。修复这四个缺陷并添加对应回归测试后,得分仅从0.330变为0.328(112个原有位点完全不变)。系统性为每个存活拒绝位点编写测试后,得分升至0.941,最终达1.000(143/143)。研究过程中测量工具自身出现七次"通过但不检查"失败,包括一次变异扫描报告完美1.000但基线实际为红色的严重事件。

Conclusion: 结论是n=1的案例研究,提出"你发现的缺陷是样本;你拥有的门是总体"作为启发式方法。论文坦承:1)声明式漏洞修复(对已发现缺陷加回归测试)无法提升整体覆盖率;2)拒绝位点活性测试能显著提升覆盖率,但部分增益由操作定义本身决定;3)对于自己编写的验证器、测试、变异操作符和论文,所有数据均为自测量,唯一的外部数据点是外部审计。论文未声称方法可推广,且明确标注了哪些声明是新颖的、哪些已被现有文献占据。

Abstract: I built a protocol whose premise is that a stranger can re-run my claims offline and get the same answer. An outside engineer audited it and broke it: a bundle whose headline numbers were false verified clean, the cheapest forgery four bytes. I merged his fix, then pointed my own instruments at the fixed verifier and found the same defect four more times, in places his audit did not reach. The cheapest is one capital letter. The unifying defect is not cryptographic or exotic: a check that reports success along a path where it never examined anything. Vacuous pass is a working label, not a discovery; Section 4 names the literatures already occupying it. So I stopped collecting anecdotes and measured. At f59fb62, under the extraction rule of Section 6, the verifier exposes 112 refusal sites; 75 could be deleted with the whole suite and every tamper fixture still green, a score of 0.330. Three of the four hand-found forgeries fall in surviving classes; the fourth is an obligation with no refusal site. Scored alone, the sixteen-fixture corpus built to prove the verifier can refuse catches 10. Testing the refusals themselves took it to 0.941, then to 1.000 at 92e4548 over a grown population of 146 sites; those denominators differ and the series between them is non-monotone, so Section 7.5 carries all eleven, not just the five rows of Table 2. Fixing the four found defects instead moved 37/112 to 39/119, leaving the pre-existing sites at 37. Seven times during this study my own measuring tools reported success while measuring nothing; four were built to detect this class, and one returned a perfect 1.000. Every number here is self-measured on a system I wrote, over a registry that is a closed loop of my own repositories; the one external data point is the audit of Section 2.2. That is stated here rather than buried: it is the paper's credibility, not a caveat.

</details>


### [236] [Cost-Utility Alignment in LLM Agent Trajectories:Profiling,Attribution,Diagnosis,Adaptation,and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26195)
*Dan Liu,Jian Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向LLM智能体轨迹的成本-效用对齐（Cost-Utility Alignment）框架，将智能体执行中的资源消耗与任务贡献视为同一执行的双重账本，围绕成本剖析、效用归因、错位诊断、针对性适配与评估五个分析阶段构建闭环。该框架将效用归因置于核心地位，按证据强度（过程代理→信息依赖→反事实重放）组织贡献方法，为诊断与适配提供因果证据，并系统梳理了五类错位（认知与上下文使用、外部交互、恢复循环控制、资源-能力分配、多智能体协同）及对应的适配策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有综述分别讨论推理优化、智能体能力或评估，但将资源消耗与任务贡献割裂，缺乏原则性工具判断某条轨迹的资源支出是否被其任务贡献所正当化。LLM智能体通过多步轨迹执行任务，在token、延迟、货币费用、环境风险上累积成本，而效用仅在聚合任务层面体现，亟需统一的成本-效用对齐分析框架。

Method: 提出基于类型化智能体轨迹的五阶段闭环分析框架：(1)成本剖析构建资源侧账本（多维资源剖析、层级成本定位、语义动作标注、工作负载特征化）；(2)效用归因构建贡献侧账本，按证据强度三级递进（过程代理、信息依赖、反事实干预）；(3)错位诊断检验是否存在可行低代价替代轨迹；(4)针对性适配针对五类错位（认知/上下文、外部交互、恢复循环、资源-能力、多智能体协同）进行干预；(5)评估通过质量-成本权衡、可靠性、人类经济价值与基准基础设施完成闭环。形式化定义代价向量、效用信号、局部贡献与错位条件。

Result: 系统分析了约90项代表性方法，覆盖成本剖析、效用归因、五类错位与适配及评估四大维度：(1)成本剖析揭示上下文重复处理、工具协议开销、KV缓存占用与不可逆外部影响构成独立成本维度；(2)效用归因从代理信号、依赖关系到反事实因果逐步加强证据；(3)五类错位（认知/上下文、外部交互、恢复循环、资源-能力、多智能体协同）均有对应诊断与适配方法；(4)评估协议覆盖效率-质量权衡、风险调整可靠性、人类经济价值与基准审计。识别四个开放挑战：开放环境中的可扩展因果归因、归因成本下的闭环适配、非平稳基础设施下的可靠性、人类价值与成本转移核算。附录提供TraceCard模式及对比示例。

Conclusion: 本文将LLM智能体效率重构为成本-效用对齐问题，建立五阶段闭环框架统一分析从剖析基础设施到因果归因再到部署评估的代表方法，为资源感知智能体设计与部署提供结构化基础。剩余四个开放挑战要求方法将可观测成本记录与因果贡献证据相连接，闭合当前效率研究尚未可靠完成的回路。

Abstract: LLM agents execute tasks through multi-step trajectories that accumulate cost in tokens, latency, monetary fees, and environmental risk while producing utility only at the aggregate task level. Prior surveys address inference optimization, agent capabilities, or evaluation in isolation, leaving practitioners without principled tools to determine whether a trajectory's resource expenditure is justified by its task contribution. We address this gap by developing a trajectory-centric cost-utility alignment framework that treats resource consumption and task contribution as dual ledgers over the same execution, organized around five analytical stages: cost profiling, utility attribution, misalignment diagnosis, targeted adaptation, and evaluation. Utility attribution is central to this structure: rather than relying on aggregate outcomes, it organizes contribution methods by evidential strength, from process proxies and information dependency to counterfactual replay, supplying the causal evidence that grounds diagnosis and guides adaptation. Using this framework, we analyze recent agent systems, attribution methods, and evaluation protocols covering efficiency, reliability, and economic value, as well as five forms of misalignment spanning cognitive and context use, external interaction, recovery-loop control, resource-capability allocation, and multi-agent coordination, together with their targeted adaptations. The result is a closed analytical loop connecting the cost side of agent execution to its utility side, providing a structured basis for resource-aware agent design and deployment.

</details>


### [237] [Harness Engineering for Predictable Agentic Systems: An Empirical Study of Deterministic Execution Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26197)
*Saransh Dhage*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究了"harness engineering"（将LLM agent包裹在确定性执行层中）对智能体可复现性的影响。通过两个合成任务和两个开源模型的实验，发现仅加入有限状态控制、强制工具选择、输出验证和有界重试的"第一代harness"对可复现性影响参差不齐（一升两降一无效），根源是未受约束的自由文本规划步骤仍是变异的主要来源；加入"结构化规划"（在调用任何工具前对计划进行模式校验）后，所有模型-任务单元达到近乎完美的可复现性和任务成功率，但延迟成本呈模型依赖性（Qwen更快、Gemma更慢）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在相同任务、工具和环境条件下存在显著的运行间执行变异，这在金融、合规等受监管领域的部署中是不可接受的。先前研究要么仅观测该现象而未干预，要么评估样本太小、未做机制分解。本文旨在回答：确定性执行harness能否在不影响任务成功率的前提下降低运行间变异？若初次harness未达成效果，需补充何种约束，代价几何？

Method: 实现了一个模块化harness，包含：有限状态执行、强制单工具选择（tool_choice="required"）、输出验证、有界重试、结构化规划（JSON模式校验）。在2个合成任务（finance_ecl 12笔贷款ECL计算、legal_clause 10条款分类）×2个开源模型（Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct、Gemma-3-27B-IT）的4个单元中，三种条件下（Baseline无约束、Harness不含结构化规划、Harness+SP含结构化规划）每单元N=100次运行进行对比。指标包括确定性指数（DI：Plan Stability/Tool Path/State Transition/Output Consistency四子项加权）、复现率（严格轨迹匹配）、任务成功率、token数和延迟。统计采用bootstrap 95%CI、置换检验（10000次）和Cohen's d。

Result: 第一代Harness对复现率影响混杂：1升（Gemma-finance，0.42→0.55，p=0.006）、2降（两个legal_clause单元均显著恶化，Qwen p=0.038、Gemma p<0.001）、1无效（Qwen-finance）。任务成功率保持高位（0.97-1.00）。通过逐层诊断，发现工具序列、状态序列、输出已接近天花板，唯一未被约束的是自由文本计划措辞，成为复现率变异的主导来源。加入结构化规划后，三个单元达到DI和复现率1.000（p<0.001），Qwen-finance单元达0.980（p=0.019 vs 基线）。任务成功率达100%（3/4单元）。Token成本全面降低（vs 基线-15%至-17%），但延迟呈模型依赖：Qwen加快-12%至-21%（vs Harness），Gemma减慢+15%至+24%，该分裂在N=100下稳健。

Conclusion: Harness engineering是提升智能体可靠性的有效且可度量的独立学科，但其机制（哪种约束起决定作用）和代价（哪种资源轴被交换）必须经验性分解而非默认假设。仅添加结构性约束可能不足以提升测量可复现性——需补充对计划本身的模式约束（结构化规划）；且同一harness架构在不同基模型上的成本权衡可能截然不同，单一聚合性结论会掩盖这种差异。研究还指出，复现率指标一旦饱和将无法再区分条件，此时成本指标成为唯一剩余的辨别维度。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) based agents exhibit substantial run-to-run execution variance even when given identical tasks and tools -- acceptable for exploratory use but unacceptable in regulated domains such as finance and compliance. We study harness engineering: wrapping an agent in a deterministic execution layer (finite-state control, forced tool selection, output validation, bounded retry, and structured planning) and measuring its effect on execution determinism and task success. Across two synthetic tasks (finance and legal) and two open-weight models (Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, Gemma-3-27B), a first-pass harness produces a mixed result: it significantly improves reproducibility in one of four model-task cells, significantly degrades it in two, and has no effect in the fourth. A trace-level diagnostic finds the cause: once tool sequence, state sequence, and output are already highly consistent, an unconstrained free-text planning step becomes the dominant remaining source of variance. Adding Structured Planning -- validating the plan against a fixed schema before any tool is invoked -- eliminates the effect entirely: three of four cells reach a Reproducibility Rate and Determinism Index of 1.000 at N=100, and task success rises to 100% in three of four cells. The gain is not free: token cost falls in every cell, but latency shows a genuine, sample-size-robust split by model -- one becomes faster under the constraint, the other markedly slower. We argue harness engineering is a distinct, effective discipline for agent reliability, but its cost is model-dependent and must be measured, not assumed.

</details>


### [238] [Characterizing the Landscape of Open-Source Satellite Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26211)
*Jinfeng Wen,Qi Liang,Yuehan Sun,Federica Sarro,Ao Zhou,Xuanzhe Liu,Shangguang Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对GitHub上22,286个开源卫星软件项目进行首次系统性特征研究，从流行度趋势、软件目标分类法和开发实践三个维度全面刻画了开源卫星软件生态系统，揭示了该领域日益增长的关注度、高度异构的技术栈以及以工具类项目为主导的现状。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星已成为现代社会的关键基础设施，但现有研究缺乏对开源卫星软件生态系统和开发实践的系统性实证分析。鉴于NASA数据显示约24.2%的卫星任务完全失败、11%部分失败，且软件缺陷是重要诱因，深入理解卫星软件生态对于提升任务可靠性至关重要。同时，开源协作已成为卫星工程的重要趋势，但学术界对此缺乏系统认识。

Method: 从GitHub REST API检索关键词"satellite"，经自动过滤（排除404错误、缺乏README、非英文项目）后保留22,286个项目。通过三个研究问题展开分析：RQ1通过created_at时间戳和commit记录衡量年度新建项目和活跃开发者数量；RQ2从22,286个项目中按99%置信度、±5%误差随机抽样646个，采用开放式编码（open coding）方法由两位作者协作分析，三位专家仲裁分歧（Cohen's Kappa=0.857），构建层级分类法；RQ3对620个含源代码的样本进行编程语言使用和实现策略的深入分析。

Result: RQ1发现：卫星软件关注度持续增长，新建项目从2008年的1个增至2025年的4,997个（同比增长42.24%），活跃开发者从1人增至9,018人，累计达37,246人，2025年提交136,248次commit。RQ2构建了包含22个内部类别和43个叶子类别的分类法，涵盖概念设计（0.48%）、数据集（3.39%）、系统实现（14.03%）、仿真（7.42%）、测试（1.94%）和工具（72.74%）六大类，其中工具类的数据实用工具占主导（53.71%）。RQ3识别出66种编程语言，前六位为Python（32.91%）、Jupyter Notebook（28.06%）、JavaScript（7.40%）、C++（4.40%）、MATLAB（4.06%）和HTML（3.57%），不同类别的语言使用存在显著差异。

Conclusion: 开源卫星软件生态日益壮大但仍不成熟，多数项目聚焦孤立组件而非端到端平台。研究为卫星开发者和研究者提出五项可操作建议：1）扩展数据集范围至应用和执行导向资源；2）开发可配置架构以支持动态星地协同；3）推进软件感知热仿真；4）将地面预处理功能迁移至在轨执行以减少下行开销；5）构建开源整星平台支持端到端实验。研究表明卫星软件正从基于物理建模向物理-数据驱动融合演进，SE社区应在配置管理、平台整合和在轨智能方面加大研究投入。

Abstract: Satellites have become fundamental components of modern technological systems, supporting critical infrastructure in communication, navigation, Earth observation, and scientific research. As space exploration advances and demand for satellite-enabled services grows, reliance on complex, heterogeneous satellite software continues to increase. A systematic understanding of the satellite software landscape is therefore increasingly important, yet existing studies still lack a comprehensive empirical examination. To address this gap, we present the first characterization study of open-source satellite software, examining its ecosystem and development practices. We mine and analyze 22,286 satellite-related GitHub projects through three research questions on popularity trends (RQ1), software goals (RQ2), and development practices (RQ3). First, we characterize the temporal evolution of projects and active developers, revealing increasing popularity. Second, through manual inspection of 646 projects, we construct a taxonomy of 43 software-goal categories spanning conceptual design, datasets, system implementation, simulation, testing, and tools. Third, we conduct an in-depth analysis of projects with source code, revealing a highly heterogeneous and task-specialized ecosystem with 66 programming languages and diverse implementation strategies. Finally, we summarize key findings and derive actionable implications for satellite developers and researchers.

</details>


### [239] [Challenges and Contributions in Quality of AI-Based Software: A Systematic Mapping Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26215)
*Maryum Hamdani,Mateen Ahmed Abbasi,Marko Jäntti,Markku Tukiainen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 这是一篇系统映射研究(SMS)，通过分析2020-2026年间发表的33篇主要研究，综述了AI软件质量领域的挑战、贡献及证据成熟度，旨在为AI软件质量评估与保证提供全面的现状图景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI组件日益嵌入现代软件系统，但AI软件具有数据依赖性、概率性和上下文敏感性等特性，使得质量定义、评估和保证面临重大挑战。已有研究证据分散在不同分析范围（质量模型、质量评估、选定质量属性等），缺乏综合性视角。同时，AI事故快速增长（如2024年HAI指数记录233起AI相关事故），凸显了该领域的紧迫性。

Method: 采用Peterson等学者提出的系统映射研究(SMS)指南。基于PICO框架构建搜索字符串，在五个电子数据库(IEEE Xplore、ACM、SpringerLink、ScienceDirect、Wiley)进行自动化搜索(2020年1月1日至2026年1月15日)，结合前向和后向滚雪球抽样。通过标题、摘要、全文三轮筛选，最终纳入33篇主要研究。使用归纳主题分析提取挑战和贡献，并按Wieringa、Petersen和Glass的分类法对研究类型、贡献类型和研究方法进行分类。

Result: 识别出六大挑战类别：(1)现有质量评估模型的局限性(13篇，占40%)，(2)非功能需求(NFR)管理问题(6篇)，(3)缺乏质量感知开发方法(6篇)，(4)AI软件质量保证不充分(5篇)，(5)现有质量管理框架(QMF)的局限性(1篇)，(6)跨领域问题(2篇)。识别出11个贡献类别，主要集中在质量模型增强(6篇)、质量模型开发(5篇)、NFR管理方法(4篇)等。研究类型以评估研究(10篇)和解决方案提案(8篇)为主；贡献类型以方法为主；研究方法以概念性实施(10篇)和概念分析(9篇)为主，工具支持贡献极少(仅2篇)。

Conclusion: 该领域已建立坚实的概念基础，但仍需大量工作来将AI特定质量属性操作化，并在真实工业环境中验证所提出的方法。现有质量模型（特别是ISO/IEC 25059:2023）在覆盖AI特有特性方面不充分，且大多数研究仍处于早期阶段，缺乏实证验证和工业验证。未来研究应优先考虑实证验证、加强工具支持，并密切结合研究、工业实践与标准化工作，呼吁研究人员、工业从业者与标准化组织合作制定全面的质量评估模型及其测量方法。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in modern software systems, raising important questions about how its quality should be defined, assessed, and assured. This paper presents a Systematic Mapping Study (SMS) on the quality of AI-based software. The study synthesizes primary studies published between January 2020 and January 2026 and selected from five electronic data sources. A total of 33 primary studies were included after automated search, screening, and snowballing. The results identify six recurring challenge categories, with the most prominent being limitations in existing quality assessment models, followed by issues in non-functional requirement management, quality-aware development, and quality assurance. The findings suggest a call for collaboration of researchers and industrial practitioners with standardization organizations, that could possibly devise comprehensive quality assessments and their measurement methods.

</details>


### [240] [The Green Software Landscape: A Systematic Mapping Study on Evolution, Applications, Software Lifecycle, and Best Practices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26229)
*Max Hort,Maria Kechagia,Federica Sarro*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文是对2010-2024年间绿色软件工程（Green SE）研究进行的系统性映射研究，分析了390篇出版物，涵盖研究趋势、应用领域、研究类型及实验设计要素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化与能源消耗使可持续性成为软件工程（SE）领域的核心议题。Green SE研究虽在过去15年迅速增长，但领域分散、研究方向多元，亟需系统性的梳理以理解其演化、应用、生命周期及最佳实践，从而推动更可持续的软件开发。

Method: 采用系统性映射研究方法，手动检索2010-2024年间顶级SE会议、期刊及其共同举办的研讨会（基于CORE A/A*排名），应用纳入与排除标准筛选出390篇出版物，并由两位作者独立标注应用领域与研究类型（一致性81%与75%）。进一步从390篇中筛选出79篇进行实验设计要素的细粒度分析，使用SWEBOK框架与ACM计算分类系统对软件生命周期阶段与应用领域进行分类。

Result: 1）47%的出版物出现在顶级SE会议，34%在研讨会，仅19%在期刊；GREENS和JSS是出版物最多的场所。2）应用领域随时间发生明显迁移：早期（2010-2013）以硬件与SE为主，中期（2014-2019）以移动为主，近期（2021-2024）AI迅速崛起成为主导领域。3）优化研究（119篇）和基准研究（88篇）是最普遍的研究类型，开发阶段是研究最密集的环节。4）实验设计的关键要素包括硬件配置、稳定性控制、重复策略、测量工具及数据集。

Conclusion: Green SE研究在过去15年显著增长，呈现明显的领域迁移（从硬件到移动再到AI），但仍呈碎片化。研究类型集中于优化与基准测试，实验设计实践仍需标准化以提高可重复性。论文呼吁SE社区持续关注能源问题，推动更严谨、更可复制的可持续软件工程研究。

Abstract: Energy consumption and climate change have made sustainability critical in Software Engineering (SE), driving the emergence of Green SE. Over the past 15 years, numerous solutions for sustainable software systems have been published by the SE community, offering a rich resource for analyzing the field's evolution. To explore this, we conducted a systematic mapping study of Green SE research published between 2010 and 2024. We collected 390 publications, categorizing them by application domain (e.g., mobile, cloud, AI) and research type (e.g., optimisation study, benchmarking, literature review Additionally, we analyzed a representative subset of 79 papers to classify the key elements-such as hardware, measurement, stability, and replicability-considered during energy measurement experiments. Our findings indicate that SE conferences host the majority of energy-related literature. Notably, Green SE studies surged in popularity starting in 2023, largely driven by AI-related publications. Optimization and benchmarking emerged as the most prevalent research types. Ultimately, we aim to inform the SE community about current approaches to energy concerns, highlight critical experimental practices, and advocate for continued action toward more sustainable software engineering.

</details>


### [241] ["A Second Set of Eyes": The Process and Challenges of Software Documentation Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26232)
*Avinash Bhat,Ian Arawjo,Disha Shrivastava,Jin L.C. Guo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过对31位资深技术写作人员开展半结构化访谈，系统性地揭示了软件文档审查（documentation review）的协作流程、相关工具及面临的挑战。研究提炼出文档审查的五个阶段（自我审查、技术审查、编辑审查、试玩测试、发布后反馈），刻画了干预时机（事前/纠错/事后）与决策主体（个人/协作）两维度的工具设计空间，并指出文档审查实质上是一项"无可视机制保障"的协调工作（articulation work），主要由技术写作人员承担却未被组织认可。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究多关注软件文档的"质量标准"（准确性、完整性、可发现性等），但缺乏对"如何在实践中达成这些标准"的实证研究。尤其是在LLM生成文档日益普及的背景下，理解人工协作式质量保障过程变得愈发紧迫。此外，现有研究多从开发者视角出发，而忽视了负责流程编排的技术写作人员的视角。

Method: 对来自不同组织（创业公司、大型企业、开源项目；涉及数据平台、安全、硬件、军事、航空等行业）的31位资深技术写作人员开展半结构化访谈（45–70分钟），采用远程视频并鼓励屏幕共享演示实践。分析采用Charmaz（2014）的迭代式开放编码方法，由第一作者主导编码，定期与全体作者进行同行评议（peer debriefing）以修正分歧，并在饱和点（约20次访谈后）停止招募。通过合成式成员检验（synthesized member checking）开展参与者验证，13位反馈者中有12位确认分析准确反映其经验。

Result: 1. **五阶段审查流程**：自我审查（写作人员独立）、技术审查（开发者/SME）、编辑审查（同行写作人员/PM）、试玩测试（QA/外部视角）、发布后反馈（用户/客服）。各阶段涉及不同实践者、聚焦不同质量维度（内容/呈现/用户体验），且因行业和团队规模而异（如航空/军方需严格合规流程）。
2. **质量维度**：参与者关注7项质量属性，归为三大类——内容（准确性、完整性）、呈现（语言、结构、一致性）、用户体验（可发现性、易用性）。
3. **设计空间**：沿"干预时机（事前/纠错/事后）"和"决策主体（个人/协作）"两维度刻画工具，绝大多数工具集中于"纠错-个人"象限，"协作"维度存在最大空白。
4. **三类流程挑战**：文档周期规划差、优先级冲突（写作人员对评审者无强制力）、专业知识与沟通鸿沟（如资深写作人员反比评审者更懂产品，导致审查流于形式）。
5. **三类工具挑战**：缺乏文档专用工具（被迫借用开发者工具）、工具维护负担、LLM反馈不可靠（上下文受限、安全合规、谄媚倾向）。
6. **既有应对策略**：战略沟通（早期PR、精准提问、实时同步）、制度与社会压力（升级管理、利用公共渠道可见性）。

Conclusion: 文档审查是软件工程中一个重要但被忽视的协作场景。技术写作人员承担了关键的"协调工作"（articulation work），却因工作不可见而得不到组织认可与支持。组织应：(1) 为内容与用户体验质量建立共享标准；(2) 将写作人员正式视为"协调枢纽"并跟踪其协调工作量；(3) 开发支持协作的专用文档工具，特别是在设计空间的"协作"维度；(4) 在引入LLM等智能工具时，警惕被用于监控写作人员而非赋能协作。本研究为工具设计者提供了实证基础，并呼吁未来研究关注协作式审查工具的设计以及LLM在文档工作流中的合理集成方式。

Abstract: Organizations assign documentation work to technical writers, yet the knowledge required to produce it is distributed across developers, managers, and other practitioners. Prior work has established quality criteria for judging "good" documentation, but it has not examined how practitioners bring that expertise to improve documentation quality or the challenges they face in doing so. Through semi-structured interviews with experienced technical writers ($n=31$) from different organizations, our work reveals the individual and collaborative effort required to maintain documentation quality. We identify five distinct stages of the documentation review process: self review, technical review, editorial review, play testing, and post-publication feedback. Each stage draws on practitioners with distinct expertise to address quality across content, presentation, and user experience. Our findings surface organizational and technical challenges writers face in recruiting expert reviewers, navigating development timelines, and contending with tools not specifically designed for documentation workflows. Our work positions documentation review as a crucial yet understudied site of collaborative work and opens new research and design directions for process improvement and tool support.

</details>


### [242] [When Review Alone No Longer Scales: Layered Supervision in AI-Assisted Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26316)
*Markus Stolze,Mirco Strässle*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文基于五位软件工程从业者的定性访谈研究，提出在AI辅助软件开发场景下，组织正从以代码评审为中心的传统"护栏"机制转向由三类层级护栏共同构成的"分层监督"(layered supervision)体系——预防性护栏、可执行护栏与人类监督，以应对AI生成代码吞吐量激增所带来的验证压力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助开发工具（如Copilot、智能体编码系统）大幅提升了代码生成的速度与体量，使传统依赖代码评审、linting、CI/CD等下游检测型护栏难以跟上生成节奏。然而，现有研究多聚焦生产力、开发者交互与代码质量验证，较少关注既有软件工程护栏在高吞吐量AI生成压力下如何演变。本文旨在填补这一空白，理解组织在实践中如何重新配置监督机制以约束和管控AI辅助开发流程。

Method: 采用探索性定性访谈方法，对五位来自不同组织背景（企业软件、能源前端、建筑软件、数字代理、工业技术）的软件工程从业者（P1–P5，含架构师、工程经理、团队负责人、高级工程师等角色）进行半结构化访谈，并辅以一项50人从业者调查提供情境背景。访谈使用Braun & Clarke六阶段主题分析法进行编码，由单一研究者完成，借助ChatGPT与Claude辅助翻译、措辞梳理与引用核验。此外，与四位参与者开展了成员核查(member-checking)会议以验证研究发现。

Result: 研究识别出五项主题：（F1）以评审为中心的护栏已无法扩展，且规范质量变得至关重要——生成代码呈现"表面正确"但架构上不可解释的"虚假正确"(false correctness)现象；（F2）团队将隐性上下文外部化为上游预防性护栏（如steering files、结构化prompt工作流）；（F3）可执行护栏（linting、测试、CI/CD）的重要性提升，被重新定位为可扩展的监督基础设施；（F4）人类监督从逐行检查转向监督性解读与运营可解释性(operational explainability)，强调架构推理与长期可维护性；（F5）护栏配置沿治理姿态、系统关键性与团队组成三个维度差异显著。研究将这些发现概括为从"评审中心护栏"到"分层监督"的转变，其中无单一护栏可独立承担监督负荷。

Conclusion: AI辅助开发并非孤立自动化实现环节，而是在整个开发过程中重新分配监督职能。现有工程基础设施（linting、测试、CI/CD、架构验证）在AI生成场景下获得新的角色——成为可扩展的监督基础设施；人类监督则从逐行检查转向聚焦架构推理、可解释性与长期可维护性的监督性解读。三层护栏互为补充：预防性护栏无法编码所有架构权衡，可执行护栏无法评估上下文适宜性，人类护栏无法扩展至AI生成吞吐量。文章提出四项实践模式（将常见评审意见提升为lint规则、前置规范与架构规划、使用子智能体进行并行监督、转向高层抽象验证），并指出有效应用依赖稀缺的架构与上下文专业能力，其可持续性是更广义的职业层面问题。局限性包括样本量小（n=5）、单一研究者编码、P4为共同作者带来的潜在偏差风险，以及基于自报实践而非纵向观察等。

Abstract: AI-assisted development tools enable software engineers to generate implementations at substantially higher speed and volume than in traditional workflows. Software teams have long relied on guardrails -- standing control mechanisms such as code review, linting, testing, and CI/CD pipelines -- to maintain quality and coordination. High-throughput AI-assisted generation increases pressure on these guardrails -- straining their capacity to keep pace with the volume and rate of generated changes -- and reshapes how organizations supervise development workflows, yet relatively little is known about how existing guardrails evolve in response. We conducted a qualitative interview study with five software engineering practitioners, situated within a broader practitioner survey. Our findings indicate that organizations distribute the work of supervision across multiple guardrail layers: preventive guardrails (produced by externalizing architectural intent and conventions into machine-interpretable form), executable guardrails (linting, testing, and CI/CD repurposed as scalable supervision infrastructure), and human oversight (shifting from line-by-line inspection toward supervisory interpretation focused on architectural reasoning, explainability, and long-term maintainability). We characterize this as a transition from review- centric guardrails toward layered supervision, in which no single guardrail carries the supervision load alone.

</details>


### [243] [Investigating Software Aging in LLM-Generated Software Systems across Generation-and-Execution Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26391)
*Cesar Santos,Michele Vitagliano,Roberto Natella,Ermeson Andrade*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对LLM生成的后端服务（JavaScript/Python/Rust三种语言生态）在48小时持续负载下的软件老化（software aging）症状进行了系统性实证研究。核心发现：内存使用是最一致的老化指标（12种应用-语言组合中11种呈现统计显著上升趋势），而响应时间和吞吐量表现更为异质；静态分析揭示了无界持久状态、缺失清理路径和临时资源保留等老化机制；与人类编写的Python开源实现对比表明，老化并非LLM生成代码独有。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成代码的评估研究主要集中在功能正确性、安全性、可维护性和鲁棒性等短期质量属性上，忽视了长期运行后端服务时可能出现的渐进性性能退化（即"软件老化"现象）。功能测试通过的代码仍可能因资源泄漏、状态无限增长等问题在长时间执行中表现出不可靠性。

Method: 采用BaxBench后端场景（Image Converter、Credit Card、Monitor、Uptime），通过Bolt（JavaScript/Node.js/Express）、ChatGPT（Python/FastAPI）、Gemini（Rust/Actix Web）三种LLM平台生成等效实现。使用BaxBench功能测试验证后，通过Apache JMeter施加48小时持续负载（10并发线程，0.1秒间隔），监控OS级内存使用、响应时间和吞吐量。采用Mann-Kendall检验和Sen's斜率估计进行趋势统计分析。补充方法包括：使用CodeQL/Semgrep/LeakAudit/SlowQL及Claude Code LLM辅助代码审查进行静态分析；与功能相关的人类编写的Python开源实现进行探索性对比。
