Method: 采用受潜意识学习启发的受控协议：1) 通过系统提示或微调诱导教师模型表达目标特征（如动物/植物偏好、数学能力、安全姿态等）；2) 让教师生成受限的离任务数据（如纯数字续写），并过滤掉所有与目标特征相关的显式词项；3) 在不同数据规模下用LoRA微调学生模型；4) 在独立的评估域中测量学生行为，使用匹配的无特征对照组分离目标特征传递效应。主要指标包括参考调整后的目标分数Δτ（n）、封闭候选集中的定位裕度Γτ（n），以及LoRA更新空间的几何分析。实验涵盖单特征/多特征、同模型/跨模型、不同教师扰动类型（偏好提示、GSM8K任务SFT、邪恶系统提示）等多种设置。

Result: 核心发现是：更大的独立离任务数据集使教师的诱导特征在学生后续行为中更清晰可辨。在偏好设置中，16个动物目标的正定位裕度从1K样本时的2/16上升到40K时的14/16，植物从10K时的2/16上升到100K时的11/16。小规模时行为可能指向相关替代特征（如老虎→狮子），随规模增加逐渐收敛到目标特征。LoRA更新的几何分析显示目标相关结构同步增强。GSM8K-SFT教师通过纯数字载波传递数学能力，邪恶系统提示教师导致安全评估不安全率从2%升至33.7%。多特征设置中存在竞争与交互，跨模型传递仍存在但噪声更大。固定计算景观分析表明，规模化主要通过将优化轨迹推向与隐藏特征更兼容的区域来实现，而非放大固定的局部特征敏感方向。

Conclusion: 数据规模不仅是性能杠杆，还会改变哪些隐性教师特征变得可被学生学习。看似粗粒度、模糊或无害的信号在大规模下可能变得更具目标特异性。因此，在实际蒸馏流程中，应将规模化数据与特征感知的策展（trait-aware curation）、匹配对照组以及部署规模的评估相结合，不能仅依赖小规模试点审计来预测大规模下的潜在行为风险。

Abstract: Scaling model-generated data is usually viewed as improving distillation: more examples should increase coverage, reduce noise, and produce stronger students. We show a second effect: larger datasets can make subtle teacher-specific signals easier to detect in the trained student, even when examples are off-task and never mention the trait. In a controlled setup inspired by subliminal learning, a teacher induced to express a target trait generates restricted off-task data, such as number-only completions. Students trained on different amounts of independent off-task data are evaluated in a separate domain, with matched no-trait controls isolating target-specific transfer. Our main finding is that larger independent datasets make the teacher's induced trait stand out more clearly in the student's later behavior. Other plausible traits may also strengthen with scale, but the target usually grows more. When the small-scale student already favors the target, scaling mainly amplifies that behavior; when it favors a related or salient alternative, more data can shift behavior toward the intended trait. Analyses of learned LoRA updates show a parallel trend. These effects appear across model families, trait types, multi-trait settings, and cross-model transfer. Our results suggest that scaling generated distillation data should be paired with trait-aware curation and evaluation, even when the data appears off-task or benign.

</details>


### [302] [Gromov-Monge Flow Matching for Equivariant Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26961)
*Moritz Piening,Christian Wald*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Gromov–Monge Flow Matching框架，将图生成中的节点重标记对称性纳入流匹配的源–目标耦合设计，通过商空间上的Gromov–Monge距离统一内层节点对齐与外层图配对，在少步采样下显著提升图与分子生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图数据天然具有节点置换不变性。现有基于流匹配的图生成器虽使用置换等变架构，但未在源–目标耦合中显式选择图轨道内的对齐代表，导致插值路径在少步欧拉采样时出现结构失真（如边模糊、环塌缩）。需要一种原则性的耦合构造方法，使商空间上的Wasserstein几何与Gromov–Monge节点对齐一致。

Method: 理论部分：(1)证明商空间上任意耦合可被提升到对齐的代表空间而不增加二次代价，且最优耦合提升对应常数速度Wasserstein测地线（定理3.1）；(2)证明对耦合做对角Haar对称化在G-等变场约束下保持流匹配目标，且对范畴端点预测也成立（定理3.2）。实践部分：内层用Frank–Wolfe求解Gromov–Wasserstein松弛或基于节点离心率的廉价下界FLB配对节点；外层可选地在固定大小子批次上用Hungarian算法对图整体重排。仅修改训练耦合，等变图Transformer骨干保持不变。

Result: 在N=10的随机块模型连续生成上，5步欧拉采样时GW+外层配对使FGW-NNA从0.796降至0.568，度MMD从0.114降至0.018。在QM9（5步）和ZINC250k（5步）分类分子生成上，GW+out分别将有效性从0.885/0.564提升至0.942/0.728，FCD从1.731/18.448降至1.232/15.377。125步后各耦合差距收窄。放大GW-CatFlow模型在QM9（有效率99.34%，FCD 0.115）和ZINC250k（有效率99.01%，FCD 0.966，列表最低）上具有竞争力。FLB作为廉价替代仅捕获部分低步增益，且与GW代价相关性弱（皮尔逊≈0.15–0.23）。

Conclusion: Gromov–Monge结构感知耦合通过显式选择对齐的图代表，在少步采样下大幅改善流匹配图生成质量，同时不损害多步采样下的竞争力；内层节点对齐贡献主要增益，外层图配对提供较小且依赖于数据集的额外收益。GW求解器的计算开销仍为实际瓶颈，未来工作可探索加速GW近似与半离散形式以支持更大批次或更多训练轮次。

Abstract: Graphs are invariant under node permutations, motivating the use of permutation-equivariant architectures in generative models. In flow matching, however, symmetry may also enter the source--target coupling: once graph pairs are compared up to node relabeling, the natural Wasserstein geometry is that of the graph quotient space. The Euclidean quotient metric of this space coincides with the Gromov--Monge distance, obtained by optimally relabeling the nodes. We develop this perspective theoretically, showing that quotient couplings can be lifted to aligned representatives without additional cost and that symmetrization yields equivariant flow-matching minimizers, including for categorical endpoint prediction. In practice, exact Gromov--Monge alignment is intractable, so we construct minibatch couplings using efficient Gromov--Wasserstein-type relaxations and lower bounds for the inner node alignment, optionally combined with an outer assignment between graphs. The resulting procedure changes only the training coupling and is compatible with standard permutation-equivariant architectures. Across continuous graph and categorical molecular generation, these structure-aware couplings substantially improve sample quality at small integration budgets, while our scaled-up molecular models remain competitive under conventional many-step sampling.

</details>


### [303] [Packora: Systematic Design for Generative Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26962)
*Nayoung Kim,Kiyoung Seong,Sungsoo Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Packora是一个基于变分流匹配（VFM）的全原子生成模型，用于分子晶体结构预测（CSP），能从分子图同时预测原子坐标和晶格。它采用Pairmixer+DiT架构，支持显式氢原子、多组分和有机金属晶体，并可灵活条件化于分子构象模板、立体化学标签和空间群信息。通过系统的架构、训练、条件化、推理和缩放研究，作者提出了一个有效配方。Packora在六个生成基准上均取得最佳匹配预算覆盖率，并在FastCSP单形和多形基准上实现更高的实验形式恢复率、更低的排名和更快的松弛收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子晶体结构预测（CSP）在制药、农化和有机电子领域至关重要，因为分子构象和堆积方式的微小差异会强烈影响材料性质。现有生成式CSP方法在支持的化学系统、条件化信息和评估协议上存在差异，难以直接比较，且关键设计选择（架构、训练、条件化、推理、缩放）的影响尚不清晰。本文旨在提出一个灵活统一的生成模型，并建立系统的设计方法论。

Method: 方法核心包括：(1) 变分流匹配（VFM）目标，采用线性插值路径和L1终点回归，坐标-晶格损失权重比为10:1；(2) 晶体表示采用Niggli归约加Cholesky分解消除旋转自由度；(3) 架构为Pairmixer（4块，仅含TriMul省略TriAttn）+ DiT主干（16块），采用后注入设计使条件相关的Pair表示可缓存，采样加速20.1倍；(4) 条件嵌入支持原子特征、模板坐标、立体化学、空间群，配合可用性掩码和null状态；(5) 训练采用Muon+AdamW混合优化器、EMA 0.9999、Beta-uniform混合时间分布、随机平移增强；(6) 推理采用EDM-Heun求解器（ρ=7, 400 NFE），不需要autoguidance；(7) 通过控制消融发现双轨宽度（d_s, d_p）平衡缩放（768/192）优于单轨缩放。

Result: 在六个生成基准（OXtal Rigid/Flexible、CSP5/6/7、CSD Teaching）上，Packora-M/L在30和1000候选预算下均达到最高Sol_C，23/24设置中超越最强基线CLARI-H，相对提升最高达54.5%（CSP7标准）和188.0%（CSP6严格）。在FastCSP单形基准上，Packora-L恢复19/26目标（CLARI-H为16/26），平均排名从4.25降至2.05；在多形基准上恢复21/29晶型（CLARI-H为18/29），平均排名从102.17降至54.62。Packora候选结构松弛更快（98步达50%收敛vs CLARI-H的198步），总松弛时间减少约39%。

Conclusion: Packora提供了一个灵活统一的分子CSP生成框架，通过系统消融研究建立了基于缓存式Pairmixer、L1终点回归、EDM-Heun采样和双轨宽度平衡缩放的设计配方。双轨评估协议有效分离了生成器质量和端到端实用性。局限在于消融为单变量变化且主要基于k=30候选预算选择模型，可能不全局最优；未来工作应探索更大的候选预算对模型选择的影响。

Abstract: Molecular crystal structure prediction (CSP) is important in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and organic electronics, where subtle differences in molecular conformation and packing can strongly affect material properties. We present Packora, a flow-based generative model for molecular CSP that jointly predicts atomic coordinates and the lattice from molecular graphs. Packora supports multi-component and organometallic crystals and can condition on any subset of molecular conformers, stereochemical labels, and space-group information within a single model. Inspired by the CCDC CSP blind test, we evaluate generation and ranking separately, using generation to isolate generator quality and ranking to measure end-to-end performance under a common relaxation and ranking pipeline. We also systematically study architecture, training, conditioning, inference, and scaling, identifying an effective design based on cacheable pairwise reasoning, training objective and numerical solver choices, conditioning dropout, and balanced scaling of pairwise and single representations. Packora outperforms the baselines on both structure generation and ranking benchmarks, achieving the best matched-budget coverage across all six generation benchmarks, as well as higher experimental-form recovery, lower experimental-form ranks, and faster convergence in ranking.

</details>


### [304] [Adversarial Training Without Input Gradients via Low-Rank Householder Expansions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26963)
*Tiana C. Johnson,Donsub Rim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需对输入求梯度的对抗训练方法，通过低秩Householder展开(LRHE)识别网络中对抗扰动敏感的子空间，将min-max问题中的内部最大化替换为对前向传播中已有方向的正则化惩罚，在MNIST上以远低于多步PGD的计算成本获得了与之相当的小扰动鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗训练中标准min-max公式的内层最大化需要K步投影梯度上升，每步都需对输入求梯度，计算成本高昂。现有的免内层搜索方法（如Jacobian正则化、曲率正则化等）虽然消除了搜索，但仍通过对输入求导来获取局部几何信息。本文旨在证明在小范数对抗扰动下，局部几何信息可直接从激活模式（前向传播）中获取，无需任何输入梯度计算。

Method: 核心方法基于低秩Householder展开(LRHE)：将ReLU激活改写为Householder反射I - v_ℓv_ℓᵀ的形式，展开网络复合映射后得到低秩修正项F_σ（秩至多为L-1）。F_σ的列空间基ϕ_ℓ通过前向传播中σz_ℓ - z_ℓ经后续仿射映射传播获得，行空间基ψ_ℓ通过转置权重传播获得。训练时最小化目标L(f_θ(x), y) + λ·R(θ, x; γ)，其中R惩罚f_θ(x) + γϕ_ℓ导致的预测变化。整个过程仅需额外前向评估和标准反向传播更新权重，完全消除内层最大化，不对输入求梯度。还需将CNN中的max-pooling改写为ReLU网络形式以适配LRHE。

Result: MNIST上：(1) LRHE基攻击成功率7.79%，随机基攻击仅1.88%；(2) 将对抗扰动投影到LRHE基的正交补后，攻击成功率从28.01%降至9.20%，随机正交基仅降至25.42%，证明LRHE基有效捕获了对抗敏感子空间（784维中仅7维）；(3) LRHE正则化训练每epoch耗时12.7s，等效2.8步PGD，相比40步PGD减少8.7倍，低于3步PGD成本；(4) 小扰动范围内（相对ℓ²预算ε≤0.02）匹配3步PGD训练，ε≤0.012时匹配40步训练，超过该范围后多步PGD占优；(5) 黑盒攻击测试排除梯度掩蔽疑虑。

Conclusion: 本文证明了无需对输入求梯度的对抗训练是可行的。LRHE方向已在前向传播的激活模式中可用，小ℓ²范数对抗扰动局限在由此确定的低维子空间内。方法以远低于多步PGD的成本获得可比的小扰动鲁棒性，但限于LRHE仅在单个仿射单元内有效，大预算下表现下降。局限在于：仅在MNIST上实验，未在更大预算和更高分辨率数据上验证，且方向与标签无关，描述的是放大方向而非决策边界。

Abstract: This work concerns adversarial training against the small-norm adversarial examples that arise from the inherent input instability of a trained deep neural network. Examples in this class are small as measured in the relative $\ell^2$-norm, and therefore lie in the neighborhood of the input on which the model acts approximately linearly, the regime in which the perturbation remains imperceptible. We first show that such examples can be computed directly from the trained network parameters, without input gradient iterations, by means of a linearization called the low-rank Householder expansion (LRHE). The expansion describes the composed affine map rather than any individual layer, and the directions it identifies are read from the activation pattern already available in the forward pass. We then propose a simple adversarial training scheme built on this construction. No differentiation with respect to the input is performed at any point: training requires only additional forward evaluations, with weight parameters updated by the standard backward pass, and the inner maximization of the usual min-max formulation is eliminated entirely. That such a regularizer exists is our main finding: the methods that dispense with the inner search all obtain their local geometry by differentiating with respect to the input, and we show this is not necessary. The regularizer costs the equivalent of $2.8$ PGD steps per epoch, an $8.7\times$ reduction relative to 40-step adversarial training on MNIST and below the cost of 3-step training. The resulting models match three-step PGD adversarial training for relative $\ell^2$ budgets $\varepsilon \le 0.02$ and 40-step training for $\varepsilon \le 0.012$, falling away beyond, consistent with the locality of the expansion.

</details>


### [305] [Graph-Based Pseudo-multimodal Contrastive Learning for 12-Lead ECG Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26964)
*Mengyu Wang,Kozo Okada,Takafumi Goto,Natsuko Jinba,Hiroki Yamaya,Kiyoshi Hibi,Tomoki Hamagami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Graph-CMMC框架，将12导联心电图波形与GADF图像作为伪多模态互补表示，通过自监督对比学习对齐，并引入可学习的图结构建模导联间依赖关系，在冠状动脉闭塞多标签分类任务中取得优于其他自监督方法的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ECG分析方法多将信号视为一维时间序列并独立处理各导联，难以捕获临床诊断所依赖的导联间依赖关系与全局波形形态。

Method: 1. 将ECG波形通过GADF变换转为64×64图像，构建波形-GADF伪多模态表示；2. 采用两个2层CNN分支分别编码波形与GADF表示；3. 引入共享的可学习邻接矩阵（仅在波形分支优化）的图卷积模块建模12导联间关系；4. 使用SimCLR风格的NT-Xent对比损失对齐波形与GADF表示；5. 下游任务冻结预训练波形编码器并附加MLP分类器，d2设置进一步融合预训练阶段学到的邻接矩阵。

Result: 在1068例患者的3641个ECG样本的多标签冠状动脉闭塞分类任务上，Graph-CMMC (d2) 取得Macro F1=0.776、Subset Accuracy=0.711、Overall Accuracy=0.873、Jaccard=0.752，优于CMLC (0.563)、CMMC (0.729) 及CMLC+CMMC (0.703) 等自监督方法，接近全监督基线 (0.822)；嵌入空间分析显示其导联间距离均值与标准差最小 (0.0589/0.0265)，表明表示更紧凑稳定；学到的邻接矩阵呈非对称性，反映导联间方向性信息流。

Conclusion: Graph-CMMC验证了GADF作为互补表示以及显式图建模导联间依赖对12导联ECG自监督表示学习的有效性，在多标签冠状动脉闭塞分类上接近全监督性能，且学到的导联间图结构对下游任务具有可迁移性。未来工作将扩展至更大规模数据集、采用患者级数据划分并探索轻量化图设计与领域知识融合。

Abstract: 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) is a standard, non-invasive examination widely used for diagnosing coronary artery disease, where clinical interpretation relies on comparing waveform patterns across multiple leads. However, most existing ECG analysis methods focus on single-lead signals or treat each lead independently, and typically process ECG signals as one-dimensional time-series data using CNNs or RNNs. While effective in modeling local waveform changes, such approaches have difficulty capturing inter-lead dependency and global waveform patterns essential for clinical diagnosis. To address this limitation, we propose a graph-based pseudo-multimodal contrastive learning framework called Graph-CMMC. ECG waveforms are transformed into Gramian Angular Difference Field (GADF) images to construct complementary representations of the same cardiac activity, enabling a pseudo-multimodal learning setting. Using all 12 leads, Graph-CMMC aligns waveform and GADF representations in a self-supervised manner, while a graph-based relational module is employed to model inter-lead dependency and enforce structural consistency across leads during contrastive learning. Experimental results on a multi-label coronary artery occlusion classification task demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance compared to supervised learning methods. These results further suggest the effectiveness of using GADF as a complementary representation and incorporating explicit graph-based modeling of inter-lead dependency for learning robust 12-lead ECG representations.

</details>


### [306] [ClusterAttention: A training-free speedup of bidirectional attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26965)
*Kasper Nordenram,Amelie Dittmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ClusterAttention，一种用于双向注意力层的免训练加速方法。它通过快速递归聚类（基于主成分对角化分割）将键和查询分组为固定大小（2的幂次）的簇，然后基于质心相似度选择 top-k 簇执行块稀疏注意力，并通过对未选中簇进行质心均值补偿（SMC）来恢复被忽略的注意力质量。在 TabPFN-3 表格数据和 Wan 2.1-14B 视频生成上均取得显著加速且精度损失极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双向注意力机制在视觉Transformer、视频生成、表格数据等模型中广泛应用，但其计算复杂度为 O(n²)，当 token 数很大时成为瓶颈。现有稀疏注意力方法要么依赖输入的结构性先验（如语言顺序、图像空间位置），要么需要多次前向传播分摊的昂贵聚类过程，缺乏一种能在无结构输入上、仅单次前向传播中即用即生效的通用免训练稀疏注意力方法。

Method: ClusterAttention 包含三个阶段：1) **聚类**：对每个注意力头分别对键和查询进行对角化递归分割聚类，沿主成分将向量集递归二分直到所有簇大小为 c（2的幂），并通过 Q^T Q / K_c^T K_c 度量矩阵将键和查询变换到"查询感知"和"键感知"空间后再聚类，以更好地反映注意力交互；2) **分配**：用质心点积对查询簇和键簇打分，按 top-k 选取或基于注意力质量阈值自适应选取；3) **注意力计算**：使用 SpargeAttn 的块稀疏注意力核（簇大小固定为 128 键/64 查询），并对未选中的簇通过其质心进行"条纹均值补偿"（SMC）以恢复被忽略的注意力质量。作者还推导了稀疏注意力的输出误差表达式，揭示紧簇未必优于随机簇的反直觉现象。

Result: 在三个领域进行评估：1) **DINOv2-L**（视觉Transformer）：在中高分辨率（3500² 和 5306² 像素）下 ClusterAttention*（top-k + SMC）在延迟-表示失真 Pareto 前沿上优于 SpargeAttn 和其他基线；2) **TabPFN-3**（表格数据）：在 TALENT 基准 6 个最大分类数据集上，ClusterAttention* 保持 ≥99% 密集精度的同时实现 2× 至 6× 加速；3) **Wan 2.1-14B T2V**（视频生成）：在 5 个 OpenSora 提示词上，ClusterAttention 在 PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS 上均优于 SVOO，加速比 1.8× vs 1.4×，且均无离线标定。消融实验表明变换、SMC 和 top-k 选择的组合在大多数情况下为 Pareto 主导。

Conclusion: ClusterAttention 是首个可在无结构输入、单次前向传播场景下成功应用的免训练稀疏注意力方法。通过递归主成分聚类、查询/键感知的线性变换以及条纹均值补偿，它在表格数据和视频生成等大 token 数领域实现了显著的加速和高质量近似。理论误差分析揭示了注意力质量（遗漏的注意力权重）与被排除集加权值偏差对误差的共同影响，为后续改进（如非线性 softmax 感知聚类、MuSe 风格的指数倾斜补偿）指明了方向。

Abstract: This paper introduces ClusterAttention, a general training-free speedup of bidirectional attention layers. Existing sparse attention methods either rely on structure in the input, such as order in language or spatial proximity in images, or use slow clustering processes amortized over several forward passes. ClusterAttention instead uses a fast recursive clustering method that adapts to the geometry of the keys and queries in each attention head to produce useful clusters. This method allows setting the size of the clusters arbitrarily. We utilize this by setting all clusters to be a fixed size that is a power of two, allowing the block-sparse attention to run at the same latency per query-key interaction as dense attention on GPUs. We also derive an expression for the output error in sparse attention, that explains the counterintuitive experimental finding that tight clusters can lead to larger errors than random clusters. We then derive the error when excluded clusters are compensated through their centroids, and show that this error shrinks with tighter clusters. We integrate this compensation into the method. On large-scale tabular data ClusterAttention speeds up TabPFN-3 arXiv:2605.13986 by two to six times, while retaining at least 99% of the dense accuracy. To our knowledge, it is the first training-free method that can be successfully applied in the setting of unstructured input and a single forward pass. For video generation with Wan 2.1-14B T2V arXiv:2503.20314 , ClusterAttention achieves output closer to dense attention and a larger speedup (1.8x versus 1.4x) compared to SVOO arXiv:2603.18636 , a leading method developed specifically for this domain, both run without offline calibration.

</details>


### [307] [TEMPLAR Wales: A georeferenced environmental and toponymic dataset of Welsh settlements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26970)
*Oktay Karakuş,Can Eyupoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TEMPLAR Wales是一个面向威尔士3757个定居点的地理参考环境-地名数据集，将可复现的定居点框架、确定性词法筛选（基于24个威尔士地名词素的冻结注册表）和多尺度环境属性通过稳定的项目标识符链接为四个关系表，强调观测、注释和解释的分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有地名数据集通常针对特定研究问题组装，缺乏可复用的明确分离结构，限制了比较和方法论应用。威尔士地名具有语言历史复杂性，且其地貌多样，是环境-地名研究的理想场景，但同时需要明确区分映射的定居点记录、分析名称、计算词法检测与已验证词源学。

Method: 采用分阶段构建工作流：1）从OS Open Names筛选威尔士5类定居点（Village/Hamlet/Suburban Area/Other Settlement/Town），生成3757条记录；2）应用冻结的24元素词法注册表（RCAHMW和GPC源审核）和ETDE v1确定性检测器进行精确/前缀词法匹配；3）并行从OS Open Rivers、OS Terrain 50、OS Boundary-Line、CORINE 2018和Copernicus DEM GLO-90派生水文、海岸、地形（1/2/5 km多尺度）和土地覆盖属性；4）通过templar_id整合为四个关系表并执行确定性导出验证。

Result: 发布3757个定居点记录的v1.0.0数据集，含1350条词法检测（覆盖1294个定居点，378条精确匹配+972条前缀匹配）、47个环境字段，以及完整字段级数据字典、来源溯源、清单和SHA-256校验。技术验证显示：关系完整性、词法检测确定性重建、OS Terrain 50与Copernicus GLO-90在2 km尺度地形参考的Pearson r=0.9999158（MAE=1.18 m）、局部地形位置r=0.9950185（MAE=2.70 m），证明派生地形属性对单一高程源不敏感。木质覆盖可用性随邻域尺度降低（500 m: 96.3%, 1 km: 92.2%, 2 km: 85.6%）。

Conclusion: TEMPLAR Wales为地名学、语言地理学、历史和环境景观研究、GIS和空间数据分析提供了可重用基础，关键设计原则是分离观测（映射的定居点记录）、注释（冻结字符串级词法检测）和解释（环境测量），明确文档化其局限性：不将计算词法检测视为已验证的词源学，也不将当代环境测量视为历史景观重建。

Abstract: Place names provide persistent records of how landscapes have been described and organised, but their quantitative reuse requires explicit separation between mapped places, lexical annotations and environmental measurements. TEMPLAR Wales is a georeferenced environmental-toponymy dataset comprising 3,757 settlement records across Wales. The resource links a reproducible settlement frame to deterministic lexical screening and settlement-level environmental attributes through stable identifiers. It contains 1,350 lexical detections across 1,294 settlements, generated from a frozen registry of 24 Welsh place-name elements, while retaining exact- and prefix-token matches and their provenance separately. Environmental attributes describe river and coastal proximity, elevation and local terrain context at multiple spatial scales, land cover and neighbourhood woody cover, with parallel terrain measurements derived from independent elevation products. The dataset is distributed as four relational tables accompanied by a field-level data dictionary, source-provenance register and licensing metadata. Technical validation confirms relational integrity, deterministic lexical reconstruction, documented environmental coverage, strong agreement between independent terrain sources and reproducible reconstruction of the frozen release. TEMPLAR Wales provides a reusable foundation for research in toponymy, linguistic geography, historical and environmental landscape studies, GIS and spatial data analysis without treating computational lexical detections as verified etymologies or contemporary environmental measurements as historical landscape reconstructions.

</details>


### [308] [Terrain signatures in Welsh settlement names](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26978)
*Oktay Karakuş,Can Eyupoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究以威尔士3,757个定居点为对象，使用预注册的、来源可审计的24元素词汇框架，检验地名中是否保留可测量的当代地形信息。核心比较发现：含高地词汇（bryn或mynydd）的101个定居点比含低地词汇（cwm或pant）的139个定居点，在2公里邻域内的相对地形位置高出24.4米（95% CI: 10.8–38.1米）。该结论在1、2、5公里邻域、独立高程数据源及地理留出预测中均稳健。河流相关地名支持方向一致但较弱的证据，林地模型无法估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地名是文化景观中持续性最强的空间信息形式之一，但其是否保留可测量的环境信息（而非仅反映宏观地理结构）鲜有严格检验。现有研究多依赖词面匹配或相关性分析，缺乏预注册、地理结构化验证与稳健性分离。该研究以威尔士语地名为案例，测试一组预设词汇分类是否在地理隔离条件下仍保留关于当代局部地形的信息。

Method: 研究采用四阶段方法：(1) 冻结的、来源审计的24元素词汇暴露系统（含bryn/mynydd、cwm/pant、afon/nant、coed/llwyn等）；(2) 三个预注册结果特定假设（H1河流、H2地形、H3林地），使用调整后的高斯或分数logit模型，Holm校正，名称组聚类稳健标准误；(3) H2的稳健性检验：1/2/5公里邻域、独立Copernicus高程源、重复名控制、空间限制置换（1999次）；(4) 注册后地理留出空间预测：10/25/50公里空间分块的岭正则化交叉验证，比较无词汇基线M0与加入H2极性指标的M2。

Result: 主要结果：H2地形极性对比显示高地词汇定居点比低地词汇定居点高24.43米（95% CI: 10.77–38.08米；Holm调整p=0.00137，n=240）。稳健性：1公里邻域19.23米，5公里25.89米，Copernicus源24.07米，单一记录21.25米，限制置换p=0.002。M2相对M0的池化留出MSE在10、25、50公里分块下分别降低4.63%、6.22%、7.30%，但各折改善程度不均（10和25公里为3/5折改善，50公里为4/5折）。H1：河流距离比值比0.649（95% CI: 0.459–0.917；调整p=0.0284），方向支持但证据较弱。H3：林地模型未收敛，无法估计。

Conclusion: 研究建立了可复现的框架，用于测试来源审计的词汇层是否在指定地理和定居点基线之外包含环境信息。结论为：在威尔士定居点框架内，选定的地形词汇类别（特别是bryn/mynydd与cwm/pant的极性对比）保留关于当代局部地形的可测量信息，且该信息未被拟合的空间与定居点基线耗尽。但该结论不建立：因果命名过程、个体词源验证、历史环境记忆或向其他命名体系的迁移性。限制包括残余空间自相关、命名语言未解析、缺乏外部独立复制。研究贡献为方法论与实证兼具：将词汇分类作为可复现的暴露定义，结合预注册推断、显式稳健性检查与地理结构化评估。

Abstract: Landscapes are named, but whether names retain measurable environmental information beyond broad geographic structure is rarely tested. We analysed 3,757 Welsh settlements using a frozen, source-audited 24-element lexical framework, preregistered outcome-specific models and geographically structured validation. The central comparison contrasted 101 settlements carrying high-terrain elements (\textit{bryn} or \textit{mynydd}) with 139 carrying low-terrain elements (\textit{cwm} or \textit{pant}). High-terrain names occupied locations 24.4 m higher relative to their 2-km surroundings (95\% CI, 10.8--38.1 m; Holm-adjusted $p$ = 0.00137). The association remained positive across prespecified 1-, 2- and 5-km neighbourhood definitions and was reproduced using an independently produced elevation source (24.1 m; 95\% CI, 10.6--37.6 m). Adding terrain-name polarity to a non-lexical spatial and settlement baseline reduced geographically held-out mean squared error by 4.63\%, 6.22\% and 7.30\% under 10-, 25- and 50-km spatial blocking, respectively, although improvement varied among held-out regions. River-related names provided weaker, directionally consistent evidence, while the preregistered woodland model was non-estimable. Residual spatial structure, unresolved name language and the absence of independent external replication limit interpretation. Selected Welsh settlement-name categories therefore retain measurable information about present-day terrain within Wales, without establishing individual etymology, causal naming, historical environmental memory or transferability to other naming systems.

</details>


### [309] [Decentralized Multitask Learning over Learned Task Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26989)
*Zirui Wan,Stefan Vlaski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种去中心化的两阶段策略，用于在未知任务关系的情况下进行多任务学习。第一阶段通过非合作随机梯度迭代估计广义图拉普拉斯矩阵，第二阶段利用学习到的图进行协作式多任务扩散学习，并给出了理论性能保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于图正则化的多任务学习框架通常假设任务间的图结构是先验已知的，但在实际去中心化网络中，任务关系往往是未知的且需要从分布式数据中推断。此外，中心化的图学习方法需要全局协方差估计或大规模矩阵逆运算，不适用于去中心化场景。

Method: 1. 高斯马尔可夫随机场（GMRF）先验建模任务参数，将任务关系编码为广义图拉普拉斯矩阵（GGL）；2. 两阶段策略：第一阶段各智能体独立运行非合作随机梯度下降，利用稳态迭代通过去中心化边际似然最大化（MML）方法估计局部逆协方差，再通过Schur补恒等式恢复局部拉普拉斯矩阵块；第二阶段将估计的拉普拉斯矩阵嵌入到多任务扩散策略中进行协作学习；3. 分析了拉普拉斯估计误差及其对多任务学习稳态性能的影响，并引入了拓扑敏感度指数（TSI）。

Result: 1. 拉普拉斯估计误差可分解为协方差集中项（O(K/M)）和由非合作学习步长引起的偏差项（O(μ)）；2. 拓扑敏感度指数TSI表征了异构网络（如枢纽节点）对估计误差的放大效应；3. 多任务学习的稳态偏差为O(μ)+O(μ')，其中O(μ')来自梯度噪声，O(μ)来自图估计偏差；4. 仿真验证了学习到的图显著优于非合作学习，且当步长足够小时接近真实图的基准性能。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一个端到端的去中心化框架，能够在仅知局部连通性的条件下联合学习任务关系图并进行多任务适应。通过GMRF先验和去中心化边际似然估计实现了图的分布式推断，并提供了从图估计到多任务学习的完整性能保证，为去中心化多任务网络中的自适应协作提供了理论支撑和设计指导。

Abstract: This paper investigates decentralized multitask learning over networks when the underlying task relationships are unknown. While existing graph-regularized multitask frameworks typically assume a known structure, practical settings often require learning inter-task dependencies directly from distributed data. We propose a decentralized two-phase strategy that first estimates a generalized graph Laplacian from noisy non-cooperative stochastic gradient iterates, and subsequently exploits the learned graph to enable cooperative multitask diffusion learning. This framework is motivated by a Gaussian Markov random field prior, which gives rise to a decentralized maximum likelihood estimator for the graph Laplacian. The analysis quantifies the Laplacian estimation error and its propagation to the steady-state performance of the multitask diffusion recursion, and introduces a topology sensitivity index to capture the effect of network heterogeneity. Simulation results corroborate the theoretical findings and demonstrate that cooperation enabled by the learned task graph significantly improves performance over non-cooperative learning, while approaching the true-graph baseline when the estimation stepsize is sufficiently small.

</details>


### [310] [Benchmarking_Fast_Domain_Adaptation_for_Unsupervised_Speech_Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26992)
*Robin San Roman,Manel Khentout,Tu Anh Nguyen,Paul Michel,Yossi Adi,Emmanuel Dupoux*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了 ABX-Accent 基准，基于 AESRC 数据集（包含10种英语口音），用于评估自监督语音表示模型在少量无标注数据下对口音的快速领域自适应能力，并以 CPC + 自适应域归一化（Adaptive Domain Normalization）作为基线方法，在跨说话人 ABX 指标上取得平均 23.6% 的相对提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督语音表示学习（SSL）依赖大量无标注语音数据，但数据分布高度不平衡，主流口音占主导，对长尾口音及域外语音的适应性研究不足。口音具有社会语言学上的长尾特性，不可能穷尽所有口音训练数据，因此亟需在少量数据下实现快速口音自适应的方法与评测基准。

Method: （1）构建 ABX-Accent 基准：在 AESRC 的10种英语口音上划分为 train/dev/test，每口音 dev/test 各约2小时、含12名说话人，并为每个说话人额外提供2分钟的自适应数据，评测采用 Zero Resource Challenge 的跨说话人 ABX 指标；（2）基线方法：以 LibriSpeech 预训练的 CPC 模型为基础，使用自适应域归一化（Adaptive Domain Normalization）并结合 resampling 策略进行微调，先冻结主网络仅训练归一化层参数进行 warm-up，再解冻全网精调。

Result: 在 LibriSpeech 男/女二分的初步实验中，DN+FT 方法在 8× 更少新域数据下即可超过其他方法；在 ABX-Accent 上，最佳方法（DN+FT joint）取得平均 12.3% 的跨说话人 ABX 错误率，相较非自适应基线（16.1%）实现约 23.6% 的相对提升；单口音专用模型平均更优，但联合训练在多数口音上仍带来收益。

Conclusion: ABX-Accent 可作为评估自监督语音模型在少量无标注口音数据下快速自适应能力的新基准；自适应域归一化结合分阶段微调是有效的基线方案，但口音自适应问题相比性别域更具挑战，仍有较大改进余地，希望该基准能推动领域自适应研究。

Abstract: Representation learning has attracted great atten- tion and managed to reach good performances as a pretraining method for downstream tasks or as a first step towards unsu- pervised speech modeling. Yet, little is known about how such methods deal with out-of-domain speech and how could they be adapted in a few shot to new domains. This is important especially for accented speech where one observes a long tail of accents that diverge from the standard ones. We introduce ABX- Accent, a benchmark based on the AESRC dataset that features 10 different accents of English. It includes a small (< 10 hours) unlabelled training set in each of the accents and adaptations of the Zero Resources Challenge ABX evaluation metrics to each of the accents. We illustrate this benchmark with a baseline model that uses adaptive domain normalization to fine tune a pretrained Contrastive Predictive Coding model on the accents. This method is first developed on LibriSpeech using a male/female split. When applied to the new benchmark, the proposed method yields a relative improvement of 23.6% on across-speaker ABX scores on average compared to non adapted models. The data and metrics will be open sourced upon paper acceptance

</details>


### [311] [Disentangling Optimization Scale from Preference Scale in DPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27032)
*Ivan Kruzhilov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了DPO中系数β同时承担"偏好噪声逆尺度"和"优化步长缩放"两种角色的耦合问题，提出中心化softplus归一化重参数化方法，在保持最优解不变的前提下解耦这两个效应，并使损失值在不同β之间具有可比性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在DPO及其众多变体中，β系数通常被视为控制KL正则化强度的旋钮，但论文发现β实际上同时承担两个不同角色：一是作为有效的偏好噪声逆尺度，二是通过边际梯度中的显式β乘子直接缩放更新步长。这种耦合导致：(1)固定学习率下策略偏离度对β呈非单调关系（在小β处出现死区、中等β处达到峰值、大β处衰减）；(2)标准DPO损失值在不同β之间不可比，因为损失仅通过乘积βΔ依赖参数。

Method: 1. 理论分析：证明标准DPO边际梯度∂L/∂Δ = -βσ(-βΔ)包含显式β乘子，导致更新幅度线性受β抑制；在初始化时该预测被精确验证（G₀/β在20×β范围内恒定在2%以内）。2. 阈值模型：引入停止容差τ，推导出饱和边界Δ*_DPO = (1/β)log(β/τ - 1)，识别出三个区域——死区(β≤2τ)、非单调峰值(β_peak≈4.6τ)、右侧饱和。3. Adam补偿分析：推导β_crit = ε/√v̂^h阈值，解释自适应优化器为何部分掩盖该效应。4. 归一化目标：提出中心化softplus损失L^norm_DPO(Δ;β) = s_c(-Δ;β) = (1/β)log((1+e^{-βΔ})/2)，证明其对β>0与标准DPO具有argmin等价性，且边际梯度为-σ(-βΔ)（无β乘子），并在β→0处有定义良好的线性偏好边界极限L = -Δ/2。5. 实验验证：在HelpSteer3、UltraFeedback、HH-RLHF三个数据集上，使用Qwen3-4B、Qwen2.5-3B、Ministral-3B和Mamba-2四种模型进行LoRA微调，验证梯度缩放预测、死区-峰值-饱和行为、损失不可比性（UltraFeedback上KL比≈3、HelpSteer3上≈10、Ministral上≈6.5），以及归一化目标的1/β单调标度律。

Result: 1. 经验证实了G₀/β在20×β范围内近似恒定（表2），梯度幅度线性正比于β。2. 阈值模型预测与HelpSteer3 SGD扫描高度一致（图2），τ的两种估计（5.99×10⁻⁴来自β_peak，6.37×10⁻⁴来自Δ̄(β)形状拟合）几乎重合。3. 归一化目标在固定lr_norm = β·lr_standard下与标准DPO产生几乎相同的验证轨迹（图4），证实梯度缩放等价性；同时归一化训练损失清晰分离了不同β运行，而标准损失几乎重叠。4. UltraFeedback AlpacaEval 2长度控制胜率在损失曲线几乎一致的两组标准DPO运行之间相差约14个百分点（表I1）。5. HelpSteer3上八组配对种子的Wilcoxon符号秩检验在所有报告指标上p>0.05，无统计显著差异（表I2），证实argmin等价性。6. 归一化目标实现了对1/β的单调饱和边界（Δ* = (1/β)log((1-τ)/τ)），消除了死区和非单调峰值。

Conclusion: 中心化softplus归一化重参数化在保留DPO最优解（β>0）的同时，解耦了偏好噪声逆尺度和优化步长缩放两个β角色，使损失值在不同β之间具有可比性。该方法：(1)解决了小β处梯度衰减问题；(2)使偏好边界Δ和验证对NLL对β呈单调关系；(3)使训练和验证损失在不同β之间可比；(4)可通过简单的损失评估局部改写直接集成到现有DPO代码库（如TRL）中，无需重构训练器或数据管道。该方法不声称通用优于精心重新调参的标准DPO基线，而是提供更清晰、可解释的参数化。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a widely used objective for aligning language models from preference data, with the coefficient $\beta$ commonly interpreted as controlling the KL constraint to a reference policy. We show that $\beta$ entangles two distinct roles: it governs the effective inverse preference-noise scale and simultaneously rescales the optimization dynamics, coupling this scale with the effective step size. As a consequence, at a fixed learning rate the achieved policy deviation is non-monotone in $\beta$: it vanishes in a dead zone at small $\beta$, reaches a peak at an intermediate value, and decreases again for larger $\beta$. Moreover, standard DPO loss values are not comparable across $\beta$: runs with nearly identical loss curves can differ several-fold in KL divergence from the reference model. This entanglement obscures the role of $\beta$, increases sensitivity to hyperparameter choices, and complicates learning-rate scheduling. We propose a centered-softplus reformulation that is argmin-equivalent to DPO for $\beta>0$, while making the inverse preference-noise-scale and learning-rate effects explicit and independently tunable. The normalized centered-softplus objective also admits a continuous $\beta\to0$ endpoint that reduces to a linear preference-margin objective.

</details>


### [312] [Soft Active Electromyography Interface for Machine Learning-Enabled Silent Speech Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27048)
*Yuta Kurotaki,Shusuke Yamakoshi,Reitaro Yoshida,Yutaka Isoda,Tamami Takano,Yuji Isano,Yusuke Miyake,Kentaro Kuribayashi,Hiroki Ota*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种佩戴在手指上的柔性主动式肌电图（EMG）接口，通过指尖电极按需采集嘴唇附近的EMG信号，实现了无需持续面部佩戴、保护隐私、信号稳定的无声语音识别（SSR），并通过深度神经网络在30词词汇表上达到97.2%的识别准确率，还实现了实时无人机控制验证其实际应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统无声语音识别（SSR）方法存在三大局限：1）需要持续在面部粘贴电极，舒适性差；2）涉及面部生物特征，存在隐私泄露风险；3）信号采集不稳定。这些问题限制了SSR在日常场景中的实际应用。因此需要一种新型的、按需触发、隐私友好且信号稳定的肌电接口。

Method: 提出一种佩戴在手指上的软体主动式EMG接口，关键技术包括：1）液态金属（LM）互连线，提高手指运动期间的机械稳定性；2）透明柔性印刷电路（FPC）电极；3）弹性体封装，实现柔软可穿戴；4）指尖电极按需贴近嘴唇采集EMG信号；5）采用深度神经网络（DNN）对30词词汇进行分类训练；6）通过实时无人机控制进行应用验证。

Result: 在三名受试者的30词词汇分类任务中，深度神经网络达到97.2 ± 1.3%的平均识别准确率，展现出良好的语言区分能力；通过实时无人机控制实验验证了系统在嘈杂和保护隐私环境中的实用性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了软体可穿戴EMG系统作为安全、直观的人机交互界面的可行性，按需采集的设计解决了传统SSR在佩戴舒适性、隐私保护和信号稳定性方面的瓶颈，为隐私敏感场景下的人机交互提供了新方案。

Abstract: Silent speech recognition (SSR) provides an alternative communication pathway in the absence of audible speech. However, conventional approaches are limited by the need for constant facial attachment, privacy concerns, and unstable signal acquisition. Here, we propose a soft, active electromyography (EMG) interface that enables word-level SSR using machine learning. Worn on the hand, the device uses a fingertip electrode that can be positioned near the lips to acquire EMG signals only when needed. The interface integrates liquid metal (LM) interconnects, transparent flexible printed circuit (FPC) electrodes, and elastomer encapsulation to ensure high mechanical stability during finger motion. A deep neural network trained on these stable signals achieved a mean accuracy of 97.2 $\pm$ 1.3% across three subjects in classifying a 30-word vocabulary, demonstrating robust linguistic discrimination. Furthermore, real-time drone control validates the practicality of this approach in noisy and privacy-sensitive environments where conventional voice recognition fails. This study highlights the potential of soft, wearable EMG systems as secure and intuitive human-machine interfaces.

</details>


### [313] [Unifying Detection and Adaptation in Task-Free Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27070)
*Dezheng Han,Anbang Zhang,Zhihao Zhu,Shuaishuai Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FiUni框架，利用Fisher信息矩阵的K-FAC主子空间同时实现批级别隐式任务检测与参数高效持续适应，在无任务边界的任务无关设置下性能优于多数任务感知基线且参数更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM持续学习方法多依赖显式任务边界来分配隔离的PEFT子空间，无法适用于真实任务无关的在线流场景；需要一种能在不依赖任务ID的前提下统一实现隐式任务检测与子空间管理的信号。

Method: 基于少量下游样本估计预训练模型每层FIM的K-FAC近似，提取激活协方差因子与梯度协方差因子的top-r_det主特征向量作为Fisher主子空间；通过主子空间重叠度衡量批次间任务相似度，并据此通过REUSE/EXPAND/NEW三状态机制自适应管理一组Fisher冻结基底的LoRA子空间池。

Result: 在Standard CL、Long Sequence和TRACE三大基准上，使用T5-large与LLaMA-3.1-8B两种骨干，FiUni以仅约3.62M的可训练参数（远低于O-LoRA的35.39M和SpaRTA的44.24M）取得与先进任务感知CL基线相当或更优的整体准确率，并在TRACE任务流上达到55.21%的领先成绩。

Conclusion: Fisher/K-FAC主子空间能够刻画任务相关的二阶几何结构，为任务无关持续学习提供统一的隐式任务识别与低秩适应基底；FiUni验证了通过Fisher几何动态平衡知识共享与任务隔离的可行性，但检测仍需额外前向/反向开销，且在更大规模模型上的扩展性有待进一步验证。

Abstract: To mitigate catastrophic forgetting in downstream continual learning (CL) for large language models (LLMs), existing methods typically constrain parameter updates or introduce task-specific adaptation modules. However, these methods often rely on explicit task boundaries during training, limiting their applicability to realistic task-free scenarios. In this paper, we propose a \textbf{Fi}sher-guided \textbf{uni}fied (\textbf{FiUni}) framework for batch-level task detection and parameter-efficient continual adaptation. FiUni is motivated by a key observation about the Fisher information matrix (FIM) of pre-trained models: the orthogonality among the principal subspaces of its Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (K-FAC) approximation, estimated from a small number of downstream task samples, can reflect the similarity between different tasks. Based on this observation, FiUni constructs FIM-derived frozen subspaces to guide low-rank adaptation (LoRA), while matching the Fisher principal subspace of each incoming batch window with historical subspaces. This enables FiUni to adaptively determine whether to reuse existing knowledge, expand a related subspace, or create a new subspace, dynamically balancing knowledge sharing and task isolation. Experiments show that FiUni can effectively infer latent batch-level task affiliations and achieve competitive performance against advanced task-aware CL methods with fewer trainable parameters.

</details>


### [314] [Tabular Deep Learning for Algorithmic Trading: Cross-Regime Bayesian Optimisation for Equity Signal Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27076)
*Joshua Le Grice*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对算法交易中预测模型在市场制度转换下鲁棒性不足的问题,提出了一种跨制度贝叶斯优化框架,在约300只美股大盘股11年日度数据上,系统性比较了梯度提升树与表格深度学习(TabNet、FT-Transformer)架构,并通过XGBoost+TabNet的秩聚合Hybrid集成,实现了2025年样本外年化收益51.26%、夏普2.44、显著CAPM alpha 0.423(p=0.011)的优异表现,同时揭示了替代数据的补充性作用及方向不对称性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法交易市场已超200亿美元,但现有股票预测模型的超参数选择未明确针对制度(Regime)鲁棒性,导致策略在不同市场环境下表现不稳定。预测准确率与交易绩效并非等价目标,边际的信号稳健性提升可转化为显著的经济收益。

Method: 1) 数据层:整合Bloomberg(价格/基本面/情感)、FRED(宏观)、Google Trends(关注度),经严格滞后处理防前瞻偏差,VIF剔除多重共线性;2) 目标构造:横截面次日收益十分位排名,顶部/底部10%为多空标签;3) 数据划分:2015-2024训练,2025样本外;2022/2023/2024扩展窗口验证(三制度,经KS检验证实统计显著差异);4) 模型:LR/XGBoost/MLP/TabNet/FT-Transformer五类;5) 跨制度贝叶斯优化:Optuna+TPE,30次试验,目标函数联合三制度年化收益、夏普比率、最大回撤(带二次惩罚防止单制度崩溃);6) Hybrid集成:XGBoost+TabNet秩聚合;7) 鲁棒性:四水平高斯噪声注入与季度时序稳定性检验;8) SHAP特征归因(分多空方向)。

Result: 样本外(2025)表现:Hybrid集成年化收益51.26%、夏普2.44、最大回撤-7.76%、CAPM alpha 0.423(p=0.011)、beta 0.048、PSR 0.96,为唯一产生显著alpha的模型;XGBoost为最强单模型(33.61%收益,夏普1.37);TDL模型单独表现均不及XGBoost。鲁棒性:σ≤0.20噪声下策略缓慢退化,σ=0.50后崩溃;随机噪声基线收益-8.21%证伪随机解释;四季度信号精度均超10%随机基线约13-17个百分点。SHAP:技术特征主导(40-63%);替代数据贡献随架构变化显著(XGBoost仅1.6-2.9%,LR则达12-14%),且对空头信号贡献持续高于多头。

Conclusion: 研究结论:(1)跨制度贝叶斯优化能产出泛化至未见市场条件的超参数配置,提供一种独立于资产类别的可迁移调优协议;(2)TDL架构单独并不优于梯度提升树,但通过XGBoost+TabNet的秩聚合集成可获得显著超额收益,体现组合价值高于个体性能;(3)分类指标无法替代组合层面回测作为模型选择标准,应优先考虑信号正交性;(4)替代数据贡献受模型架构强烈影响,主要为补充性角色,在最强模型中未达10%假设阈值,且在空头信号中贡献更大,反映负向信息定价的认知行为不对称。研究对实盘部署、持仓集中度、制度监控与定期再训练具有重要实践意义。

Abstract: Algorithmic trading now represents a market exceeding $20 billion, where even marginal gains in signal robustness can translate into economically significant returns. Existing evaluations of equity prediction models do not explicitly target regime robustness during hyperparameter selection. Five model classes are trained on daily observations from approximately 300 large-cap US equities over eleven years, with Bayesian optimisation configured to target trading performance across three statistically different market regimes. Regime-robust hyperparameter selection is associated with out-of-sample generalisation, as signal precision remains above the random baseline across all four quarters of the test period, and portfolio performance slowly degrades under simulated input noise before collapsing beyond a defined threshold. No individual tabular deep learning architecture outperforms gradient-boosted trees, but combining XGBoost and TabNet using rank aggregation produces a Hybrid ensemble with an annualised return of 51.26%, a Sharpe ratio of 2.44, and a statistically significant CAPM alpha of 0.423 (p = 0.011). A near-zero beta indicates this outperformance is driven by stock selection, not market exposure. Alternative data plays a secondary role once technical and fundamental features are accounted for, as well as contributing more strongly on the short side than the long, and varies by model class. An interactive application makes these results explorable in real time, with live data integration the remaining step toward practical deployment.

</details>


### [315] [Cone Extended Rayleigh Quotients for Directed Graph Learning: Minimax Spectral Certificates, Sensitivity, and Adaptive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27122)
*Yavdat Sh. Il'yasov,Nur F. Valeev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将双侧锥Rayleigh商框架推广至可训练非对称有向传播算子，提出了无需对称性、非负性或锥保持假设的光谱认证、灵敏度分析与自适应控制方法，并在有向Cora引文网络上实现了显著的光谱水平降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有向图学习中传播算子天然非对称，传统Rayleigh-Ritz理论依赖对称性，经典二次Rayleigh商无法保留右侧与左侧特征结构的差异。需要一种直接在非对称算子上工作，同时提供可计算的认证包络与可微训练兼容性的框架。

Method: 基于广义矩阵束B_θ−λG的锥极小极大原理，建立双侧锥Rayleigh商框架。对正象限给出可计算的上下界包络（Collatz-Wielandt型公式），引入软min/max代理保持可微性并给出显式逼近误差。在简单内部特征值条件下推导右-左灵敏度公式Dλ_C(B)[H]=v_C^T H u_C，由此导出Frobenius与L1预算下的图支撑一阶最优干预，并提出每次干预后重计算模式的自适应控制策略。

Result: 1) 符号非对称扰动实验显示内部特征对向边界互补准对的转变；2) 有向SBM上50次实现全部认证通过（Perron根从1.576降至1.546），测试精度无统计显著变化；3) 方向性对照实验显示对称化可消除仅由边方向承载的预测信息（δ=0.04时ΔAcc=0.094, p=1.36×10⁸）；4) 在有向Cora上，0.5%边权预算下自适应灵敏度使λ_C降低约21.5%，显著优于固定排名策略（37%相对增益），且测试精度保持不变。

Conclusion: 该框架为可训练非对称传播算子提供了从光谱认证到选择性修改的直接变分路径，核心机制为"双侧认证→定向灵敏度→自适应光谱控制"。局限在于强非正规算子的瞬态放大与伪谱行为不受λ_C单独控制；自然推广包括可训练度量G_θ、更一般锥及非正规暂态目标。

Abstract: Directed graph learning naturally leads to trainable nonsymmetric propagation operators with distinct right and left spectral structures. Building on the two-sided cone Rayleigh framework for generalized pencils \[ B_\theta-\lambda G, \] we develop a learning-oriented methodology for spectral certification, sensitivity analysis, and control without requiring symmetry, nonnegativity, or cone preservation. In the positive-orthant setting, computable lower and upper cone bounds provide an a posteriori enclosure of a distinguished cone level, while smooth soft-min/max surrogates preserve rigorous one-sided bounds with explicit approximation errors and remain differentiable with respect to the trainable parameters. For a simple interior level, the right and left modes satisfy \[ D\lambda_C(B)[H]=v_C^T H u_C, \] yielding first-order optimal graph-supported interventions under prescribed perturbation budgets and motivating adaptive spectral control. Numerical experiments demonstrate the applicability of the approach beyond cone-preserving operators and in directed learning settings. Signed nonsymmetric perturbations reveal a transition from interior eigenpairs to boundary complementary quasi-pairs, including non-spectral cone levels, while controlled experiments show that symmetrization can remove predictive information carried solely by edge direction. On the directed Cora citation network, adaptive recomputation of the right--left sensitivity reduces the distinguished spectral level by approximately $21.5\%$ under a cumulative edge-weight reduction budget of $0.5\%$, with no observed change in test accuracy for the trained model and data split considered.

</details>


### [316] [TRACE-CRC: Trajectory-Adaptive Conformal Risk Control for Multi-Step Channel State Information Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27124)
*Kiarash Rezaei,Mehdi Sattari,Javad Aliakbari,Tommy Svensson,Paolo Monti,Carlos Natalino*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TRACE-CRC 是一种针对多步 CSI 预测的轨迹自适应共形风险控制框架，通过构建 Frobenius 范数不确定性球，在轨迹级（而非逐预测步级）上控制预测失败风险，并结合预测步难度剖面和轨迹难度分层来减小不确定性区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习 CSI 预测器通常只给出点预测，缺乏校准的不确定性估计。在多步预测场景下，下游波束成形、调度等决策依赖完整的未来 CSI 轨迹，任一帧不可靠都可能导致决策失败。逐预测步的边际覆盖无法保证整条轨迹的可靠性，因此需要将校准目标从单步覆盖转移到轨迹级失败风险控制。

Method: 方法包括四个核心组件：(1) 三段式校准数据划分（profile/conformal/validation）；(2) 基于残差上分位数的预测步难度剖面 $w_j$（含滑动平滑与下界稳定化）；(3) 基于预测范数序列特征的岭回归难度评分与中位数二分轨迹分层，得到分组共形分位数 $q_g$；(4) LTT（Learn-then-Test）风险控制，通过单侧 Hoeffding–Bentkus p 值与多重检验校正，从候选网格中选出最小全局乘子 $\lambda^*$。最终每个预测步 $j$ 的不确定性球半径为 $r_{i,j}^*=\lambda^* q_{g_i} w_j$。

Result: 在 28 GHz CDL 信道、1000 条轨迹（每条 100 帧，30 帧轨迹输入，预测 20 步）上的实验表明：TRACE-CRC 达到轨迹覆盖率 TC=0.933±0.011（目标 0.90），平均 Frobenius 半径 AFR=13.64±0.41。消融实验显示预测步剖面贡献了主要的效率提升，轨迹分层进一步减小半径。在 50 次运行的鲁棒性测试中，每轮均通过 LTT 正式认证，平均 TC=0.940±0.015。

Conclusion: TRACE-CRC 将多步 CSI 可靠性形式化为轨迹级 CRC 问题，通过 Frobenius 不确定性球、预测步剖面、轨迹分层和 LTT 风险控制的组合，在保持轨迹级覆盖的同时显著减小不确定性区域，实现了优于逐预测步/轨迹级/Bonferroni 等基线的可靠性–效率权衡。该框架可推广至金融、工业传感、医疗等需要序列级可靠性的领域。其局限在于风险证书依赖于轨迹级可交换性假设，在 SNR、移动性或阻挡等分布偏移下可能失效。

Abstract: Reliable prediction of time-varying channel state information (CSI) is essential for efficient wireless communication. Each CSI frame is a matrix-valued representation of the wireless channel response, and a sequence of CSI frames forms a temporal channel trajectory. Modern deep learning-based CSI predictors, however, often provide only point predictions and lack calibrated uncertainty estimates. This limitation is particularly problematic in multi-step CSI prediction, where the target is a sequence of future CSI matrices, and downstream decisions such as beamforming or scheduling may fail if any part of the predicted trajectory is unreliable. We propose trajectory-adaptive calibration and error profiling with conformal risk control (TRACE-CRC), a method for trajectory-aware uncertainty quantification in multi-step CSI prediction. TRACE-CRC constructs Frobenius-norm uncertainty balls around predicted CSI matrices and controls the risk that at least one future frame is uncovered. Instead of calibrating each future step independently, TRACE-CRC combines future-step-dependent error profiling, trajectory difficulty stratification, and learn-then-test (LTT) risk control. Empirically, TRACE-CRC achieves reliable trajectory-level coverage with substantially smaller uncertainty balls than conservative multi-step corrections, while avoiding the trajectory undercoverage of compact stepwise and adaptive conformal baselines.

</details>


### [317] [Ultra Low-Power, Lightweight, Probabilistic RSS-Based Path Reconstruction: A System for Landscape-Scale Bee Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27152)
*Christopher J. Noroozi,Joseph L. Woodgate,Michael Mangan,Michael T. Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于RSS的轻量级、超低功耗概率路径重建系统，用于景观尺度（如300m范围）下追踪极小目标（如38mg的接收器，可用于追踪熊蜂Bombus terrestris）。系统使用少量旋转高增益发射机的RSS测量值，通过贝叶斯方法概率性地推断到达角(AoA)，然后利用高斯过程（GP）和双随机变分推断重建路径。在仅需3个RSS采样时，可实现~15m精度（功耗<180μW）；增加采样数可达~10m精度（功耗<600μW）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNSS功耗与重量过高（最先进商用GNSS单元需8mW），无法用于追踪大多数飞行昆虫等微型目标（如熊蜂单次觅食负重上限仅70mg）。基于RSS的AoA定位方法虽硬件简单，但传统方法要么需要大量RSS测量导致功耗过高，要么受限于距离或天线数量难以覆盖景观尺度。因此需要一种兼顾超轻量、超低功耗、远距离与景观尺度覆盖的定位方案。

Method: 1）**硬件**：38mg接收器（DA14531 BLE芯片 + 24mg超级电容 + PCB单极天线），以7ms短周期扫描；旋转发射机使用14 dBi八木天线（300m范围），30 rpm旋转，将旋转角度、时间戳、发射机ID编码进BLE定向广播包。2）**AoA推断（三种方法）**：① 全概率分布法（贝叶斯，对未知衰减a取均匀先验解析积分，得似然N(d|0,σ²)，计算p(θ|y,γ)）；② 拒绝采样法（与训练集RSS模式匹配采样θ）；③ 峰值RSS法（Savitzky–Golay滤波平滑后取峰值对应角度）。3）**路径重建**：使用高斯过程（采用EQ核的积分核，置于速度上）建模x/y轨迹；通过双随机变分推断（DSVI）最小化KL散度，使用诱导变量u与JAX自动微分优化ELBO；似然函数将AoA概率分布插值后用于评估，或将单AoA转为过发射机的射线并以高斯距离作为似然。

Result: 在Norfolk Heritage Park的地面真实验证中：① AoA推断：k=15时全概率分布法与峰值法MAE<2°，拒绝采样法MAE≈5°；k=5时所有方法误差剧增，但全概率分布法可通过分布熵表达不确定性。② 路径重建：k=3时全概率分布法~15m MAE、峰值法急剧退化；k=10时两法均~10m MAE；80%预测点误差在10m内（高k），全概率分布法在低k下仍保持80%预测在16m内。③ 寿命：k=3时功耗<180μW，超级电容可工作约5分钟；k=10时<600μW，寿命~90秒。④ 占空比权衡实验：在固定100个RSS预算下，频繁但不确定的观测优于少而精确的观测；最佳突发长度为2000ms（匹配发射机旋转周期）。⑤ 实地应用：成功重建熊蜂Bombus terrestris被位移后返巢飞行轨迹，路径与研究者观察一致（沿树行飞行）。

Conclusion: 论文展示了一种新颖的RSS概率式路径重建系统：通过贝叶斯AoA推断+高斯过程+双随机变分推断，仅用极少的RSS测量即可在复杂景观尺度上以~15m（<180μW）或~10m（<600μW）精度追踪38mg的接收器。该系统在重量、功耗、范围上填补了GNSS与现有RSS方法之间的空白，特别适用于以往难以研究的飞行昆虫（如熊蜂）等微型目标的中枢觅食者追踪，未来可推广至其他运动生态学、IoT与微型机器人领域。

Abstract: Applications in fields such as movement ecology, Internet of Things or robotics share the need for systems that localize devices that are too small and power constrained to implement GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite Systems). Alternative low-power localization methods often rely on only measurements of RSS (Received Signal Strength) to infer the AoA (Angle of Arrival) of a transmitted radio frequency signal, but are limited by range and the power demand of the large number of RSS measurements required to infer an accurate AoA. In this paper we address these issues with a novel RSS-based method for tracking ultra lightweight and low-power moving receivers across a complex landscape, achieved by using a minimal number of RSS measurements from simple rotating high-gain transmitters with a range of 300m, and applying probabilistic modelling to infer their AoA. The receiver's movement path is then modelled using a Gaussian process and reconstructed using doubly stochastic variational inference, resulting in approximately 15m accuracy tracking of receivers weighing 38mg (including power source) over a scalable landscape range while consuming less than 180uW, increased to approximately 10m accuracy at less than 600uW by taking more RSS measurements. We anticipate that this method will support fields such as the behavioural study of flying insect species, which we demonstrate by applying the system to track Bombus terrestris nest return flights.

</details>


### [318] [Inductive Correlation Clustering with Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27153)
*Francesco Paolo Nerini,Francesco Bonchi,Arijit Khan,André Panisson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Inductive Correlation Clustering（ICC）问题，利用GNN解决相关性聚类（CC）中的可扩展性和转导限制。提出了CC-GNN框架，包含NodeGNN（转导，节点级优化）和LinkGNN（归纳，链接级优化）两种变体，并引入了基于KwikCluster的pivot采样策略。在标准CC基准上，NodeGNN优于现有组合算法；LinkGNN在归纳设置中可泛化到未见图，推理速度比基线快最多5个数量级，且解质量在最优基线的10%以内。还展示了作为可学习图池化层（CCPool）的下游应用，在图分类任务上具有竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统相关性聚类（CC）算法存在两大瓶颈：1）APX-hard的NP难问题，现有近似算法可扩展性差；2）本质上是转导式的，必须针对每个新图实例从头运行，无法利用跨实例的共享模式。这阻碍了CC在大规模、批量或流式图数据场景下的应用（如层次池化、实体解析、子图检测等）。与此同时，GNN已被证明能通过学习结构模式和节点特征在组合优化问题中跨实例泛化，因此成为解决归纳式CC的自然候选方案。

Method: 提出CC-GNN框架，包含两种变体：(1) **NodeGNN**（转导）：将CC成本函数松弛为可微损失 $\mathcal{L}(C) = \|W-CC^\top\|_2^2 - \|CC^\top\|_2^2$，通过softmax归一化得到节点分配矩阵 $C$；(2) **LinkGNN**（归纳）：优化共聚类矩阵 $M \in [0,1]^{|V|\times|V|}$，将节点嵌入归一化后映射到超球面，用欧氏距离定义 $M_{ij}=1-\frac{1}{2}\|\tilde{O}_i-\tilde{O}_j\|_2$，自动满足对称性和三角不等式等度量约束。两者均配合**基于pivot的采样策略**（受KwikCluster启发）实现可扩展训练，复杂度从 $O(E)$ 降为 $O(M/|V_{tr}|\cdot E)$。推理时通过阈值 $t$ 对相似度矩阵二值化后取连通分量得到聚类。池化变体CCPool引入边池化百分位参数 $r$ 控制粗化率。架构上采用单层GCN（无非线性），转导设置使用随机节点特征，归纳设置使用Node2Vec嵌入。

Result: **RQ1（近似质量）**：在SBM合成图上，NodeGNN和LinkGNN均能在Gurobi最优解的1.05倍以内；NodeGNN对最大聚类数K敏感（K不足时误差陡增），LinkGNN误差略大但无K限制。**RQ2（转导性能）**：在6个标准CC基准上，NodeGNN在5个数据集取得最佳成本，全面优于KwikCluster、ModifiedPivot和CFP；LinkGNN在大规模图（Enron、cond-mat）上更具优势。**RQ3（归纳泛化与效率）**：LinkGNN在7个数据集中的4个上优于KwikCluster，部分接近ModifiedPivot；推理时间最多快5个数量级（如OGBG-ppa上仅0.52秒 vs ModifiedPivot的2234秒）。NodeGNN因将聚类视为分类而无法泛化。**RQ4（图池化）**：CCPool在EXPWL1、MUTAG、NCI1、OGBG-molhiv上平均排名2.88（最优），兼顾稀疏池化的灵活性（动态聚类数）与密集池化在分子图上的性能，优于DMoN、HOSC、JBPool、ACC、k-MIS、MaxCut、SEP等基线。**消融实验**：单层GCN最优；去掉pivot采样使训练时间增加43倍、内存增加4倍；去掉L2归一化使收敛慢5倍。嵌入维度D影响较小（≥64即可），训练选择的阈值 $t\approx 0.90$ 能稳健迁移到未见图。

Conclusion: 本文成功将GNN引入相关性聚类，提出了归纳式相关性聚类（ICC）新问题，并构建了CC-GNN框架。NodeGNN在转导设置中提供当前最优的解质量，LinkGNN在归纳设置中以极低的推理开销（最多5个数量级的加速）达到与转导基线相当的解质量，二者在适用场景上互补。作为可学习池化层CCPool时，框架兼具稀疏与密集池化的优势，在图分类任务中具有竞争力。这项工作将组合优化聚类与图深度学习相融合，为大规模、批量的图数据聚类提供了可扩展、通用的解决方案。未来工作方向包括归纳式CC扩展（如重叠聚类、多样性约束）及更优的舍入算法。

Abstract: Correlation Clustering (CC) is a natural formulation of clustering in combinatorial optimization, which uses a graph representation of the input and does not require a pre-specified number of clusters. Given $n$ objects and a pairwise similarity function, the goal is to cluster the objects so that similar objects are put in the same cluster and dissimilar objects are put in different clusters. Despite its versatility, existing CC algorithms suffer from significant scalability issues and are inherently transductive: i.e., the algorithm must be executed from scratch for any new problem instance. In this work, we bridge this gap by leveraging Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to solve Inductive Correlation Clustering, a novel generalization of the CC problem designed to handle unseen graph instances. By learning to exploit common structural patterns and node features during training, our framework generalizes to new graphs drawn from the same distribution with minimal computational overhead with respect to standard algorithms. We demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of our approach through extensive experiments. Our framework not only excels in the inductive setting, e.g., lowering the inference time up to $5$ order of magnitude, while maintaining an approximation ratio within $~10\%$ of the best baseline solution, but also achieves competitive results on standard (transductive) CC benchmarks. Finally, we showcase a practical application of our framework as a learnable pooling mechanism for graph classification. Our results indicate that our method serves as an efficient pooling layer, enhancing the ability of GNNs to capture hierarchical structural information in networks.

</details>


### [319] [Diffusion Policies for Short-Horizon Planning in Robot Crowd Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27158)
*Wendong Li,Jochen Garcke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PDPO（Planning Diffusion Policy Optimization），将扩散策略与短时域动作块生成结合，用于密集动态人群中的机器人导航。通过离线行为克隆预训练加在线PPO微调的框架，策略生成5步动作块并以滚动时域方式执行。论文还指出当前CrowdNav基准缺乏边界约束导致的评估偏差，并提出了Bounded CrowdNav基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的强化学习方法在人群导航中通常输出单步反应式动作，并使用单峰高斯分布参数化策略，难以表示同一观测下多种可行的避让策略（如从不同侧绕行、减速让行、利用间隙通过等）。同时，现有CrowdNav++基准缺乏边界约束，智能体可能离开有效区域绕过密集人群，造成评估过于乐观。

Method: PDPO是一个离线到在线的强化学习框架：1) 使用ORCA收集约3000条避碰演示轨迹，通过行为克隆预训练扩散策略；2) 将扩散去噪过程视为内部MDP，使用PPO进行在线微调，将环境奖励按去噪步分配；3) 在执行时生成5步（H=5）动作块，仅执行第一步，以滚动时域方式重规划。观察编码采用MLP+掩码自注意力+注意力池化。提出了Bounded CrowdNav基准，将越界视为碰撞。

Result: 在原始CrowdNav++基准上，PDPO成功率90.6%，优于CrowdNav++的87.0%；在Bounded CrowdNav基准上，PDPO成功率达84.7%±1.4%，比CrowdNav++的74.5%±2.1%高出约10.2个百分点，比无动作块的消融版本（73.7%±0.7%）高出11个百分点。PDPO同时降低了入侵率（ITR从8.53%降至6.81%）。分析表明在原始基准中16-32%的成功轨迹存在越界行为，验证了评估偏差问题。PDPO仅使用1.049M参数，低于CrowdNav++的2.503M参数。

Conclusion: 扩散策略生成短时域动作块能有效表示密集人群导航中的多模态避让行为和时序一致性，显著提升成功率和安全性。动作块设计在边界受限的评估环境中尤为重要。Bounded CrowdNav的提出揭示了基准设计中边界约束对评估结果的关键影响。论文局限性包括去噪过程的推理开销、仅仿真评估、未考虑真实人机交互等。

Abstract: Robot crowd navigation requires safe and efficient decision-making under dense, dynamic, and multimodal human--robot interactions. Existing reinforcement-learning methods typically output a single reactive action at each timestep, which limits their ability to represent diverse short-term avoidance strategies. We propose Planning Diffusion Policy Optimization (PDPO), an offline-to-online reinforcement-learning framework that uses a diffusion policy to generate short-horizon action chunks for crowd navigation. PDPO is first pretrained on collision-avoidance demonstrations and then fine-tuned online with PPO by treating the denoising process as an internal decision process. During execution, the policy generates a five-step action chunk and applies it in a receding-horizon manner. Furthermore, we observe an evaluation artifact in common crowd-navigation benchmarks: without explicit boundary constraints, learned agents may leave the valid domain and bypass dense crowds. To address this, we introduce a setting in which boundary violations are treated as collisions. Experiments show that PDPO obtains an improved success rate over strong baselines, and ablations demonstrate that action chunks are especially important for the modified bounded benchmark.

</details>


### [320] [TraceBench: Controlled Evaluation of LLM Agents for Time-Series Root-Cause Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27182)
*Tommaso Bendinelli,Artur Dox,Christian Holz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TraceBench 是一个基于物理动力学系统模拟的受控基准测试框架，用于系统评估 LLM 智能体在时间序列根因归因任务中的表现。它沿四个可控轴（领域上下文、观测噪声、标注示例、提交模式）生成任务，并使用三个可解释的机械系统（BallDrop、BounceBall、MassSlide）对四个 LLM 智能体进行评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对 LLM 智能体的根因分析基准多基于真实运维环境，但难以系统性地隔离出智能体结合时间序列物理推理与领域知识的能力。本文旨在填补这一空白，构建一个可控的诊断测试平台，以独立评估智能体在多变量时间序列上利用系统级先验进行多步、工具辅助推理的能力。

Method: 框架通过物理模拟器生成多变量时间序列，并对单个候选参数施加瞬时干预；通过基于无噪声轨迹与探测轨迹的效应-噪声比（threshold ρ=2）以及特定于模拟器的拒绝规则进行可解性过滤。任务沿四个独立轴实例化：（1）领域上下文（提供/隐藏系统描述）；（2）观测噪声（κ_low 和 κ_high）；（3）标注示例（3-shot/0-shot）；（4）提交模式（直接答案 vs 程序化 Python 脚本）。评估在隔离容器内进行，记录智能体的轨迹指标（Python 调用、绘图、控制台输出 token 占比等）。

Result: 主要发现：（1）gpt-5.5 在所有条件下均达到最高准确率（低噪声 S_direct 约 0.933），且资源消耗更低；（2）所有闭源模型在高噪声下准确率下降 11–19 个百分点；（3）程序化提交模式普遍表现差于直接答案模式，且在保留测试集上泛化能力有限；（4）智能体主要依赖控制台数值输出（77–80% 的输入 token）而非可视化图表来推理；（5）消融实验显示移除领域上下文使准确率下降 20–32 个百分点，而移除标注示例反而使准确率小幅提升并显著降低 token 消耗；（6）经典基线（Euclidean 1-NN、DTW 1-NN、MiniRocket+Ridge）的特权变体在高噪声下也难以超越随机水平（0.189），远弱于 LLM 智能体。

Conclusion: TraceBench 表明 LLM 智能体能够有效结合系统级机制描述与多步工具辅助分析进行时间序列根因归因，但其表现受观测噪声影响显著，并将分析压缩为可重用程序的能力有限。领域上下文对智能体表现至关重要，而有限的标注示例在已有充分上下文时可能适得其反，增加成本而无明显性能收益。该基准作为受控诊断测试床，衡量的是受控条件下的时间与机制推理能力，而非复杂工业部署的就绪程度。数据集、轨迹、实验代码与公开排行榜已发布。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly applied to anomaly detection and root-cause analysis in time-series observations collected from real-world systems; however, their performance on these tasks has not been systematically evaluated under controlled conditions. We introduce TraceBench, a simulation-based framework for generating controlled root-cause attribution tasks. In each generated task, an agent receives time-series observations produced by simulating a physical dynamical system and must determine whether a system parameter was altered during the simulation and, if so, which one. Using TraceBench, we generate tasks from three interpretable mechanical systems and systematically evaluate four LLM agents across controlled experimental conditions, yielding new insights into how these agents analyze time-series observations from dynamical systems. Our results show that agents benefit substantially from domain context and explore data primarily through numerical console output rather than visualizations. We also find that agents generally perform worse when required to produce a Python script that maps each time-series sample to a predicted root-cause label than when they submit predictions directly. We release our datasets, agent trajectories, experimental results, and a leaderboard on our website, this http URL .

</details>


### [321] [When Interference Graphs Evolve: Doubly Robust Estimation of Dynamic Peer Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27187)
*Xiaojing Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对演化网络中的同伴效应估计问题，提出了"控制对比框架"和双重稳健估计器DynaNet-DR。核心思想是将处理效应分解为自身处理、同伴暴露和后处理网络演化三个坐标的对比，而非中介分解。该方法在四个真实动态网络序列上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当交互网络随时间演化时，传统的因果推断面临挑战：分配前的网络历史、动态同伴暴露和分配后的网络变化具有不同的因果角色。静态网络下的同伴效应估计方法无法处理这些时变结构。需要一种能够分离这三种因果角色的框架来准确估计动态网络中的同伴效应。

Method: 1. 控制对比框架：将潜在结果索引为自身处理(a)、时序聚合同伴暴露(z)和后处理演化摘要(m)的函数，定义四类对比（自身处理对比、同伴暴露对比、控制网络演化对比、联合控制对比）。2. 动态暴露映射：使用固定时序衰减和边权重将近期同伴处理聚合为分数，再离散化为低/中/高三级。3. DynaNet-DR估计器：结合时序因子化倾向得分g₀(a,z,m|h)=g_{AZ,0}(a,z|h)·g_{M,0}(m|a,z,h)与归一化增强项，形成正则化增强估计器。4. 时序样本外干扰估计：将训练窗口分为三个连续块，交叉预测后在更晚的估计窗口上平均。5. 有限样本稳定化：固定剪裁[0.02, 0.98]、自适应门控λ̂、基于有效样本量的调整。6. 代表性分数插件近似：用目标层训练条件均值s_z替代连续分数。

Result: 在四个真实动态网络（CollegeMsg、email-Eu、PrimarySchool、HighSchool）的半合成基准测试中，DynaNet-DR在所有16个数据集-对比族单元中均达到最低RMSE。相比TL和GML-DR中较优者，单元平均降低25.9%。节点聚类名义区间经验覆盖率0.91-1.00。自适应门控在所有数据集上优于固定λ=1。干扰模型压力测试显示DynaNet-DR在倾向得分受限时表现最佳。MathOverflow观测应用展示了方法在真实场景中的描述性结果。

Conclusion: DynaNet-DR通过时序因子化倾向得分和归一化增强来估计控制对比分布。其规范估计器在一致性、摘要充分性、序列可交换性、正值性、干扰收敛和弱依赖条件下具有双重稳健性。有限样本稳定化（固定剪裁、自适应门控）是额外的工程选择，其理论覆盖范围有限。随机图干预和跨节点推断仍是未来工作。论文明确区分了控制对比与中介分解，不声称处理响应性网络或边编辑策略的因果效应。

Abstract: Peer effects are difficult to estimate when interaction graphs evolve because pre-assignment network history, dynamic peer exposure, and post-assignment network change have distinct causal roles. We introduce a controlled contrast framework that indexes potential outcomes by own treatment, temporally aggregated peer exposure, and a post-assignment evolution summary. Differences between the resulting means define own-treatment, peer-exposure, controlled network-evolution, and joint controlled contrasts rather than a mediation decomposition. We develop the Dynamic Network Doubly Robust estimator, DynaNet-DR, which combines a temporally factorized propensity with normalized augmentation. Under consistency, summary sufficiency, sequential exchangeability, positivity, nuisance convergence, and weak dependence, its canonical estimator is consistent when either the outcome regression or the propensity estimator is consistent. The reported implementation adds representative-score prediction, fixed clipping, and finite-sample stabilization. Semi-synthetic benchmarks on fixed real temporal graph sequences show favorable estimation accuracy among methods targeting the full profile. These benchmarks assess summary-indexed contrasts rather than counterfactual edge generation, and the MathOverflow study is an observational illustration under the stated assumptions.

</details>


### [322] [Common Geodesics Do Not Guarantee Fisher Consistency of the Structured SVM: Minimal Counterexamples and a Tree-Metric Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27203)
*Jintao Fei,Jiangying Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明结构化SVM（SSVM）Fisher一致性的已知必要条件——公共测地线条件（任意三点共享测地线交点）——并非充分条件。以四输出单位星图等精确反例推翻了Nowak-Vila等人的充分性猜想，并对树度量给出了完整分类：仅加权路径在规范argmax解码下保持Fisher一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Nowak-Vila、Rudi与Bach(2021)证明了SSVM Fisher一致性的强几何必要条件：任务损失必须是一个度量空间，且任意三点存在公共测地线交点（公共测地线条件），并猜想该条件在规范坐标argmax解码下也是充分的。论文作者通过构造精确反例揭示该猜想不成立，并系统分析树度量的真实一致性范围。

Method: 1. 基于LP对偶的精确最优性证书：SSVM条件风险等价于自耦合运输对偶，通过构造对偶可行解（哈密顿环、跨边耦合等）证明得分向量的最优性。2. 反例构造：四输出单位星图（边界分布）、K_{m,n}完全二部图族（满支撑分布）、三维Hamming立方体。3. 树度量分类：通过"三脚架障碍"定理证明所有分支树含三脚架结构导致失败；通过传递耦合构造证明加权路径在所有分布下都一致。4. 替代方法分析：使用替代水平集Γ_v重新表述解码器一致性问题，揭示嵌入图像外的报告可被错误解码。

Result: 1. 公共测地线条件非充分：四输出单位星是满足该条件的最小反例（4个输出为下限，三输出必一致）。2. 树度量完整分类：规范argmax Fisher一致性当且仅当树为加权路径；分支树的失败仅发生在单纯形边界分布上，内部满支撑分布下所有树仍一致。3. 满支撑反例的精确阈值：满足公共测地线条件的度量中，最小满支撑反例需要5个输出，K_{2,3}是最小实例，属于无穷K_{m,n}家族。4. 标准Hamming度量的满支撑反例：三维Hamming立方体{0,1}^3上存在满支撑反例，唯一Bayes输出与argmax集合不相交。所有最优性结论均有原始-对偶证书支持，无需浮点计算。

Conclusion: 本文系统反驳了公共测地线条件对SSVM argmax Fisher一致性的充分性，提供了精确的基数下界和完整的树度量分类，揭示了规范argmax解码器与多面体嵌入之间的具体差距：在多面体设置中，嵌入只能保证"校准链接"在嵌入报告上的存在性，而不能保证预设argmax链接在所有替代风险最小化器上的有效性。即使满足H_M = 2H_L的Bayes风险等式和缩放嵌入，argmax一致性仍需独立验证所有条件最优集（包括多面体退化产生的非嵌入面）。

Abstract: A known necessary condition for Fisher consistency of the structured support vector machine requires the task loss to be a metric for which every output triple has a common geodesic point. We show that this condition is not sufficient for the canonical coordinate-wise argmax decoder. A four-output unit star admits an exactly optimal score vector whose maximizers are all strictly non-Bayes, and four outputs are minimal among metrics satisfying the condition. We then completely classify positively weighted tree metrics whose vertex set is the output space: argmax consistency holds if and only if the tree is a path. The failure on branching trees is confined to boundary distributions; every tree retains the argmax property at every full-support distribution. Among metrics satisfying the common-geodesic condition, five outputs are necessary and sufficient for a full-support counterexample; $K_{2,3}$ is the smallest member of an infinite $K_{m,n}$ family. We additionally give a full-support counterexample for the three-dimensional Hamming cube. All optimality claims have exact primal-dual certificates. The counterexamples expose a concrete decoder gap: in this polyhedral setting, an embedding can guarantee the existence of a calibrated link without validating a prescribed argmax link on every surrogate-risk minimizer.

</details>


### [323] [Profit based evaluation of machine learning for nitrogen recommendations in winter wheat](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27205)
*Xulong Wang,Po Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于利润（profit）的评估框架来评价机器学习模型为冬小麦推荐氮肥施用量的价值。研究基于英国Broadbalk（402条）和Woburn（490条）长期田间试验的892条产量响应曲线，扫描氮-粮价比以覆盖所有价格场景。结果表明：纯机器学习模型在正常价格下均输给标准建议RB209，且无任何模型能在农场可接受误差范围内恢复最佳施氮量；但在ML输出之后施加一个简单的修正步骤（向田块组均值阻尼回拉+不确定性封顶），可将利润损失削减约24%，并以冻结状态迁移至Woburn站点时削减43%。最终推荐的混合方案（RB209+阻尼ML修正）消除了偏差并削减了罕见的重大损失。同时该价格比可作为碳价隐式变量，温室气体减排成本约为32–72英镑/吨CO₂e。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冬小麦氮肥施用量需在播种前确定，受未知天气和价格影响。2020–2023年间英国氮肥与小麦价格的剧烈波动使最经济的施氮量移动了约45 kg/ha，但RB209标准建议不响应价格。现有关于机器学习推荐氮肥的研究普遍以预测精度（产量误差或氮量误差）作为评价指标，而预测精度高并不意味着推荐方案更盈利。作者指出需要一个"决策分数"，直接在已测量的产量响应曲线上用所放弃的利润来评分推荐方案。

Method: 1. 数据：Broadbalk（1968–2022，402条曲线，53年）和Woburn（490条曲线，43年，迁移测试用），每条曲线由0/144/288 kg N/ha三点拟合且共享曲率参数。2. 利润评分：以"谷物当量"表示利润 π_b(N)=Y(N)−(b/1000)N，其中b为氮-粮价比；扫描b∈[3,12]覆盖所有价格场景。3. 评估六类模型：均值曲线、田块均值曲线、岭回归、高斯过程、随机森林、TabPFN，按留年法交叉验证。4. 修正步骤：阻尼（向田块组均值回拉）、平移（学一个常数偏移）、封顶（模型分歧大时限制修正）。5. 控制实验：将曲线与田块组标签故意错配以验证修正机制依赖真实田间分组。6. 排放计算：每kg N排放因子9.10 kg CO₂e（制造3.42 + N₂O 5.68）。

Result: 1. 基准噪声：产量响应曲线本身最佳施氮量的留一观测扰动中位数约23 kg/ha，使20 kg容差测试即使对"完美"模型也会失败；20–30 kg的速率误差仅造成中位数0.023–0.052 t/ha的损失。2. 纯ML失败：在b≤6正常价格下，六种ML模型中位利润损失均超过RB209（0.070 vs 0.035 t/ha），仅在危机价格b≥7时反超；六模型间分歧中位数13.6%与误差相关性ρ=0.48。3. 修正步骤的效果：模型/特征改进（更换安全预测、加蛋白/天气特征、多随机种子平均、用中位数等）无可靠增益；唯有"向田块组均值阻尼+封顶"修正使利润损失下降24.1%；广b网格下的Bootstrap检验Δ=0.019，单侧p=0.037。4. 混合方案：RB209+阻尼ML修正使偏差从+6降至+1 kg N/ha，大额损失（>0.3 t/ha）从42次降至37次，最差10%损失由0.562降至0.518 t/ha。5. 迁移验证：冻结的修正流水线在Woburn站点将中位利润损失从0.074降至0.042 t/ha（−43%，Wilcoxon p=0.034）；错配对照组使增益完全消失，证明修正依赖真实田间分组。6. 排放定价：b从5升到8等价于每吨CO₂e征收66英镑，并节省约180 kg/ha；按实测曲线计算减排成本为£32–72/吨CO₂e，与当前英国碳价相当。7. 货币换算：RB209最差10%损失在b=3下对应£553–967/ha（@£160–280/吨粮）；价格响应腿在2023年高b下可节省约£82/ha，全国1.6M ha规模下单年约£1亿量级。

Conclusion: 本文给出"有条件的肯定"答案：当机器学习仅作为预测器替代RB209时并不划算；当作为标凈建议的"阻尼修正"使用、按利润在实测曲线上评分、并扫描价格比以响应价格波动时，其价值是实在的——偏差从+6降到+1 kg N/ha，罕见大额损失被削减，修正步骤在未重训的第二站点仍带来43%改进（p=0.034），同一价格旋钮还能以£32–72/吨CO₂e的成本实现温室气体减排。研究同时澄清了"预测精度"与"建议质量"之间的脱钩：决定推荐质量的不是产量曲线整体高度，而是其斜率。

Abstract: Nitrogen rates for winter wheat are set before the season, under unknown prices and weather. The standard UK advice does not respond to prices, yet recent price swings moved the most profitable rate by tens of kilograms per hectare. Machine learning is often proposed as the fix. However, it is usually judged on prediction accuracy, and accurate prediction does not by itself make the recommended rate more profitable. Our insight is to score nitrogen advice directly by the profit it forgoes on measured yield response curves. We build a test bench on 892 such curves from two long running UK experiments, and sweep the nitrogen to grain price ratio to cover all price scenarios. On this bench, machine learning fails as a predictor. No model recovers the best rate within farm tolerance, and the benchmark noise shows none can. At normal prices, every model also loses to the standard advice on profit. The gain sits elsewhere. A simple correction step applied after the model cuts profit losses by a quarter, while better models and extra features give no gain. The same frozen correction cuts losses by 43% at the second site without any retraining. A hybrid of standard advice plus a damped correction removes bias and trims rare large losses. The same price sweep also prices emission cuts, at a cost comparable to current carbon prices. Machine learning therefore pays as a profit scored correction to standard advice, not as its replacement.

</details>


### [324] [HALO: A Heterogeneity-Aware Language-Aligned IMU Foundation Model for Open-Set Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27233)
*Zihan Ding,Liyu Zhang,Xiaomin Ouyang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HALO提出了一种面向IMU的领域特定基础模型，通过两阶段训练框架（异构性感知的自监督预训练+同义词感知的软对比文本对齐），解决跨设备、跨数据集、跨活动的人体活动识别（HAR）问题，仅用约35M参数在10个训练集和7个测试集上超越5个基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HAR领域缺乏一个能跨不同采样率、传感器配置和身体位置泛化的统一模型。现有方法要么局限于封闭集分类器，要么缺乏HAR特定的归纳偏置，无法处理传感异构性和开放集识别。

Method: 两阶段训练：Stage 1使用自适应池化分词（基于秒级而非采样点）、通道独立的Transformer（双分支：时间+跨通道自注意力）、上下文传感器条件化（注入自然语言传感器描述）进行自监督预训练（掩码自编码+对比学习）；Stage 2通过同义词感知的软对比学习与冻结的Sentence-BERT对齐，使用自适应锐化的文本相似度作为软目标，并通过FIFO队列增加负样本。推理时通过余弦相似度检索实现开放集识别。

Result: 在10个公开数据集上训练，7个留出测试集上评估：HALO在8个聚合指标上全面超越5个SOTA基线（LiMU-BERT、MOMENT、CrossHAR、LanHAR、LLaSA），零样本开放集准确率42.0% vs MOMENT 28.3%（+13.7pp），参数仅35M（约MOMENT的1/10）。即使在基线等效输入下（20Hz、通用描述）仍领先3/4指标。严重分布外数据集（HARTH、VTT-ConIoT）零样本下所有模型均失败，但HALO在1%-10%监督下有效恢复。iPhone 16 Pro上推理延迟7.16ms。

Conclusion: HALO证明了异构性感知的预训练与同义词感知对比对齐的结合，能够构建一个单一可部署模型处理可变采样率、通道数和传感器位置，实现开放词汇活动识别。未来方向包括：逐样本通道-文本条件化、对严重分布偏移的鲁棒性、扩展标签词汇表和嵌入维度。

Abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using inertial measurement units (IMUs) enables a wide range of applications, yet the field still lacks a unified model that can generalize across diverse subjects, devices, and activities. Training such a model is difficult due to two key challenges: sensing heterogeneity -- differences in sampling rates, channel configurations, and sensor placements -- and poor generalization to unseen activities and label vocabularies. We introduce HALO (Heterogeneity-Aware Language-aligned Open-set model), a domain-specific IMU foundation model that addresses both challenges through a two-stage training framework. Stage 1 pretrains the IMU encoder with heterogeneity-aware self-supervised learning, including adaptive-pooling tokenization, channel-independent feature extraction, and contextualized sensor conditioning that injects natural-language sensor descriptions into each channel embedding. Stage 2 aligns this IMU encoder with text embeddings via synonym-aware soft contrastive learning, enabling open-set recognition via cosine-similarity retrieval without per-dataset classifiers. Trained on 10 public HAR datasets and evaluated on 7 held-out datasets, HALO outperforms five state-of-the-art baselines on all 8 aggregate metrics, and still leads on 3 of 4 settings under baseline-matched inputs. Despite using only ~35M trainable parameters -- 10x fewer than the latest foundation model MOMENT (341.2M) -- HALO improves zero-shot open-set accuracy, measured over all 87 training labels, by 13.7 percentage points. On two further datasets with severe distribution shift, every model including HALO collapses zero-shot. A video demonstration of HALO's performance in real world is available at this https URL

</details>


### [325] [Importance Scoring of Transformer Attention Heads in Learning Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27241)
*Ahmad Jad Allah,Kazi F. Akhter,Md. Kamrozzaman Bhuiyan,Manar D. Samad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对表格数据场景，提出了一种基于损失梯度加权的注意力头重要性评分指标 $I_h$，并在40个多样化表格数据集上验证了其用于解释和剪枝多头Transformer的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer在CV和NLP中已被广泛研究，但在表格数据上的应用仍不足。表格数据具有异构特征空间和置换不变性，不同于图像和语言的同构序列结构，因此NLP/CV中关于注意力头的层级规律可能不适用于表格数据。本文旨在量化并解释多头Transformer在表格数据学习中各注意力头的贡献，以支持模型剪枝和可解释性。

Method: 1. 头重要性评分 $I_h$：定义为头激活 $\text{Att}_h(x)$ 与损失对该激活的梯度 $\partial \mathcal{L}/\partial \text{Att}_h(x)$ 的绝对内积期望，按mini-batch累积并取训练集均值。2. 软动态门控：训练时使用连续门控值 $\xi_h^{(l,e)} = I_h^{(l,e)} / \|\mathbf{I}^{(l,e)}\|_2$ 对头激活进行缩放，预热阶段关闭门控。3. 架构：采用TransTab（6层、每层8头、共48头），特征嵌入基于预训练BERT。4. 评估：设计8个实验场景，比较软调谐×头删除策略（不删除、随机删除、按 $I_{min}\to I_{max}$、按 $I_{max}\to I_{min}$）在40个数据集上AUC表现。

Result: 1. 在160个实验示例中，按 $I_h$ 从低到高删除头的策略（Case 5&6）在72.5%（116例）的场景下表现最稳健，Wilcoxon检验显著优于随机删除和反向删除（Cohen's d=0.40–0.80）。2. 删除最重要的头导致性能下降最大，验证了 $I_h$ 的有效性。3. 重要头的分布在不同数据集间差异显著，无固定层级模式；某些数据集（如eucalyptus）软调谐+剪枝可在删除60%头后仍保持性能，疑似缓解了小样本过拟合。4. 软调谐并不总是带来收益：约30%案例获益，约18%案例随机删除反而更优，体现表格数据的异构性。

Conclusion: $I_h$ 指标能有效识别表格Transformer中可剪枝的冗余注意力头，提升模型压缩效率与可解释性；但表格数据的高度异构性使得不同数据集的最优调谐和剪枝策略差异显著，不存在普适层级规律。本研究局限在于仅基于TransTab一种架构，未来需在更多表格Transformer架构上验证头贡献模式的普适性。

Abstract: Computationally demanding and opaque deep learning models can be better understood and optimized by analyzing how they transform data. While deep transformers have been widely studied in computer vision and natural language processing, their application in tabular data remains relatively underexplored. This paper presents one of the first applications of an importance-scoring metric to interpret multi-head transformer models in learning from tabular data. Experiments conducted on 40 diverse tabular datasets demonstrate robustness to head drops based on the proposed head importance score. In 72.5\% of experimental examples, the model remains most resilient to performance drops when heads with the lowest importance scores are gradually removed. In contrast, removing the most important attention head first results in the greatest reduction in classification performance. A closer look at individual head importance scores across six attention layers reveals that important heads are scattered across layers, with no consistent layer-specific trends. In contrast to the image and language domains, the importance of individual attention heads varies considerably across tabular datasets with different schemas and feature spaces. The proposed importance score can improve efficiency and redundancy within transformer architectures. We make the source code for measuring the importance of individual attention heads publicly available.

</details>


### [326] [Circuit Condensation: Post-Training that Concentrates a Behavior's Causal Circuit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27254)
*Sai Adith Senthil Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Circuit Condensation（电路凝聚）方法，通过后训练将模型行为的因果电路压缩到更小的图结构中。在4种行为、8个模型上，凝聚电路比最强的冻结基线（EAP-IG）在30/32设置中更小，平均缩小8.1倍，最多316倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械可解释性中的电路发现方法（如激活补丁、EAP-IG等）在固定模型权重下搜索因果子图，但真实模型中恢复的电路往往包含数百条边，无法进行穷举的子集测试或配对消融。电路大小决定了哪些可解释性问题可以提出，因此是实用可解释性的关键瓶颈。论文提出：将"可发现性"视为模型可通过训练获得的属性，而非搜索的固定目标。

Method: 方法核心是一个迭代的"剪枝-愈合-回溯"循环：(1) 用EAP-IG对活跃边进行因果重要性排序；(2) 删除最弱的30%（若失败则逐步减半至5%）；(3) 在冻结基座权重的前提下，仅训练LoRA适配器（rank 16, α=32）通过KL散度最小化匹配原始模型的输出分布；(4) 仅当目标行为准确率和保留能力的困惑度比率同时满足约束（ε=κ=0.05）时才接受该轮剪枝，否则恢复状态并尝试更小的削减。冻结θ得到C0基线用于消融搜索本身的贡献。

Result: 在4种行为（IOI、主谓一致、归纳重复、文档字符串）、8个模型（GPT-2、Llama-3.2-1B/3B、Gemma-3-1B/4B、Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B）、3个种子共96次运行中：(1) C1在30/32任务-模型组合上小于EAP-IG，平均8.1倍，最多316倍（符号检验p=2.5×10⁻⁷）；(2) 冻结权重的C0在29/32设置中更大，证明收益来自权重更新而非搜索；(3) 在19个可枚举电路中，11个无法进一步缩小；(4) IOI上凝聚出24个头（17个有已发表功能），而匹配冻结电路为61个头（36个未记录）；(5) 凝聚电路追踪原始模型的下一词分布，中位KL=0.215，IOI锚点KL=0.056（对比冻结电路0.50），并在10/11单元中更好地预测原始模型的错误；(6) 169,476次配对消融显示边效应存在依赖，不能独立理解。

Conclusion: 电路级可解释性只有在电路足够小到可检查和测试时才有用。搜索固定模型无法改变弥散行为的分布方式；Circuit Condensation通过后训练改变这种分布，使穷举子集和全配对测试在匹配冻结电路不可行的情况下变得可行。收益范围窄于编辑或遗忘；当进一步剪枝损害通用语言能力时某些运行会停止。该方法不是总能产生最小电路（联合训练门和适配器在5/32单元中更小），且不同模型族的约束严格性不同（Gemma上能力门几乎从不触发）。

Abstract: One approach to mechanistic interpretability explains behavior through circuits: the components and connections that carry it. Frozen discovery often returns hundreds of edges, making them hard to inspect, compare, or verify exhaustively. We introduce Circuit Condensation, which post-trains models to concentrate behaviors into smaller causal graphs. Each round prunes low-attribution edges and trains a low-rank adapter to match the original through what remains, retaining the cut only if task performance and general capability survive. Across four behaviors and eight models, condensed circuits are smaller than the strongest frozen baseline in 30 of 32 settings, by $8.1\times$ on average and up to $316\times$. Repeating the search without weight updates produces larger circuits in 29 of 32 settings, showing that weight updates, rather than search alone, drive the reduction. Testing every subset of 19 circuits finds 11 that cannot be reduced and reveals removable edges in the rest. Pair ablations expose dependencies between edges, showing that their effects cannot be understood independently. On indirect object identification, condensation isolates 24 heads, 17 of them with documented roles, against 61 heads and 36 undocumented ones for the matched frozen circuit: a sufficient sub-circuit of the published mechanism rather than a reconstruction of it. The resulting circuit tracks the original model's next-token distribution and predicts its errors.

</details>


### [327] [Making Latent Evolution Explicit: Operator-Structured Transitions for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27259)
*Xiaoxiao Lu,Yunlong Dong,Jiahao Shi,Ye Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LEON（Latent Evolution Operator Network），一种基于受控Koopman生成元理论的算子结构化潜变量转移实现方式，用于替代World Action Models（WAMs）中基于Transformer的潜变量转移模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前潜在WAMs普遍使用Transformer作为潜变量转移的预测器，其归纳偏置侧重于token交互而非时间演化本身，潜变量演化的结构隐含在通用条件映射中而非被显式表达。本文将"转移实现"（transition realization）作为独立于预测表示和预测-策略耦合的架构维度进行研究。

Method: LEON将当前潜变量映射到学习到的可观测量坐标H=φ(X)，并通过学习到的条件Z构建转移上下文ξ=C(H,Z)。演化算子采用对角基线D加低秩子空间UV⊤形式，由上下文系数α(ξ)调制，并附加可加强制项b(ξ)，更新为H̃=H+η(A(ξ)H+b(ξ))。该结构受控Koopman生成元理论启发，将上下文对演化的影响组织在共享算子子空间内。分别集成到表示介导型VLA-JEPA和策略面向型LaWAM中替换原有Transformer转移模块。

Result: 在VLA-JEPA中，LEON将LIBERO平均成功率从97.2%提升至99.05%（+1.85），LIBERO-Plus聚合成功率从79.5%提升至80.6%，增益集中在视觉和环境扰动类别。在LaWAM四任务匹配训练设置下，聚合性能84.13% vs 84.50%，保持接近基线。受控动力系统验证：Koopman结构化预测器在阻尼弹簧外推中显著优于Transformer；非线性摆钟中优势在穿越分界线后减弱；驱动振子干预实验表明算子传播承载主要预测贡献（移除后RMSE增至10.95倍），加力项提供互补贡献（移除后增至3.03倍）。

Conclusion: 转移实现是潜在WAMs中一个重要的架构维度。LEON通过显式的演化导向结构改善了闭环策略性能，并在不同的预测-策略耦合方式下保持有效性。应将转移实现视为潜在WAMs设计中的一类独立架构变量。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies by predicting how task-relevant scene states may evolve under interaction. Recent WAMs increasingly perform such prediction in latent representation spaces, avoiding full appearance-level generation while preserving control-relevant information. Yet latent transitions are commonly realized with Transformer-based predictors whose inductive structure is centered on token interaction rather than temporal evolution. We study transition realization as an architectural choice distinct from predictive representation and prediction-policy coupling. We introduce the Latent Evolution Operator Network (LEON), which models latent evolution in a learned observable space through context-modulated operator-based propagation and additive forcing. Grounded in the controlled Koopman generator view of evolution, LEON organizes context-dependent transition variation around a shared evolution-operator structure while retaining a complementary path for additive change. Controlled dynamical systems verify the resulting evolution-specific inductive bias and the complementary roles of operator propagation and forcing. Across two WAM formulations that integrate latent prediction into the policy differently, LEON improves closed-loop performance and robustness while remaining effective under full transition replacement. These results establish transition realization as a consequential architectural choice in latent WAMs.

</details>


### [328] [MM-Spectrum: Multimodal Multi-spectral Molecular Structural Elucidation with a Stable MoE Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27286)
*Hai-tao Yu,Nan Min,Zheng Fang,Hongyu Zhan,Yusen Tan,Yuhan Wang,Jun Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MM-Spectrum，一个面向多模态多光谱（NMR/IR/MS）分子结构解析的稀疏Mixture-of-Experts框架，通过模态感知路由、结构化专家空间与异构专家容量，解决异构光谱直接拼接导致的"负迁移/全模态塌陷"问题，在全模态、双模态及缺失模态设定下均取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多光谱（NMR/IR/MS）具有明确的物理互补性，但序列长度、噪声水平与语义密度差异极大。直接将异构光谱序列拼接的早期融合范式常导致严重的模态不平衡——"长但弱"的IR/MS token在注意力与梯度更新中占据主导，致使全模态输入反而比单模态（尤其是NMR单模）表现更差，即"负迁移"或"全模态塌陷"。文章动机在于将多光谱融合重新定义为"不平衡约束下的结构化分配与信息分解"问题。

Method: 1) 谱感知表示：对NMR保留近似恒等映射，对IR采用局部分箱、对MS采用top-k峰过滤，缓解长度与密度失衡。2) 谱感知路由（Modality-Aware Routing）：在token内容表征之外，显式注入可学习的模态标签嵌入与模态偏置，实现"身份+内容"解耦的软特化。3) 结构化专家空间（PID启发）：将专家划分为共享专家（冗余信息R）、模态专属专家（唯一信息U_m）与交互专家（协同信息S），并以一致性损失L_sh与可分性损失L_sep进行结构正则。4) 异构专家与计算感知正则：设置Heavy/Light专家（不同隐藏维度），引入L_cost成本惩罚，促使路由按"边际效用"将重算力分配给高价值token。5) 稳定性→特化课程（Curriculum）：对平衡损失权重λ(t)与路由温度τ(t)进行退火，依次经历覆盖→对齐→特化三阶段。总损失：L_total = L_task + λ_cost·L_cost + λ(t)(L_bal+L_ent) + λ_pid·L_struct。

Result: 在Alberts et al.(2024)基准上：全模态Top-1准确率从基线44.29%提升至76.04%（+31.75%），NMR+MS双模态由59.15%升至72.98%，NMR+IR由64.88%升至71.96%，MS+IR由31.22%升至37.90%。缺失模态（S1–S6）下退化更平滑，S5（MS缺失0.6）下Top-1达62.16%（基线仅14.89%）。SDBS实测光谱：从零训练Top-1由基线14.10%提升至26.67%；预训练+微调协议下达59.52%（基线37.56%）。大规模MMST数据集（全模态）Top-1达87.35%（基线65.71%）。消融实验证实模态感知路由、交互专家、异构容量与成本正则各自贡献显著。资源方面：总参数450M、激活参数135M、推理FLOPs约为同规模Dense模型的40%。

Conclusion: MM-Spectrum通过将多光谱融合重构为"结构化专家分工+计算感知容量分配"，从架构层面系统性地缓解了由模态异质性引发的优化不稳定与全模态塌陷。其设计融合了谱学物理先验（模态压缩）、PID启发的专家结构（冗余/唯一/协同解耦）以及课程式条件计算，为跨谱协同学习提供了一个原则性的范式。该方法并非意在与高度专门化的单模态模型竞争，而是在多模态融合设定下建立了更优的精度-效率Pareto前沿。

Abstract: Inferring molecular structures from multimodal spectroscopic measurements requires integrating complementary yet highly heterogeneous signals. However, the common paradigm of directly concatenating multispectral sequences can exhibit anomalous performance degradation, primarily due to pronounced heterogeneity and the resulting multimodal imbalance across modalities. As a remedy, we propose MM-Spectrum, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts framework tailored for multimodal multispectral spectra-to-structure elucidation. To better match the information characteristics under multispectral imbalance, MM-Spectrum introduces an explicit modality-aware routing mechanism that exposes spectral identity to the router in addition to token content representations. Moreover, it incorporates shared and interaction experts, together with heterogeneous expert capacities, to extract multispectral modality-unique and cross-modal synergistic information while suppressing noise-induced interference. Across full-modality, bimodal, and missing-modality settings on molecular structural elucidation, MM-Spectrum achieves consistent and substantial improvements, supported by ablation studies and interpretability analyses.

</details>


### [329] [QuantumBoostNet: A Hybrid Classical-Quantum Architecture for Enhanced Accuracy in Cardiac Ultrasound View Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27302)
*Mihai Udrescu-Milosav,Stefan-Alexandru Jura,Mihai Udrescu,Gerhard-Paul Diller*

Main category: cs.LG
